title: Patient Services Specialist
description:
Department:

13566 Enterprise Revenue Cycle - National Service Line : Heart and Vascular: Arrival

Status:

Full time

Benefits Eligible:

Yes

Hours Per Week:

40

Schedule Details/Additional Information:

Monday-Friday 7:30am-4:00pm located at 10650 Park Road Suite 220. Assisting registration, confirmation calls, working Ques and scanning.

Pay Range:

$19.80 - $29.70

Essential Functions

  • Exemplify caring and compassionate customer service to create an excellent patient experience
  • Provide exemplary interpersonal skills and ability to interact with patients and families in a wide variety of sensitive situations
  • Demonstrates critical thinking skills and decisive judgment in an often-hectic environment and possess the ability to work cohesively on a team and independently with minimal supervision
  • Manages patient registration, insurance verification, scheduling, collection and cash receipting, arrival and/or departure desk activities according to standards and guidelines ensuring accuracy and an outstanding patient experience
  • Encourages patient utilization of front-end technology during the registration process
  • Enters and maintains confidential and accurate patient information including patient insurance, billing, and payment information throughout patient encounter Assists billing functions accurately and/or directs to appropriate billing office
  • Demonstrates proficiency of emergency codes and appropriate responses as well as applicable federal and state healthcare regulations
  • Monitors inventory and stock medications, narcotics, and emergency medications/equipment

Physical Requirements
Must be able to sit for long periods of time and work in a fast-paced office environment. Should be able to bend and lift up to 10 lbs.


Education, Experience and Certifications

High School Diploma or GED require. Computer experience required. Customer relations experience required. Experience with Medical Records Software preferred, Front desk practice experience preferred.

Our Commitment to You:

Advocate Health offers a comprehensive suite of Total Rewards: benefits and well-being programs, competitive compensation, generous retirement offerings, programs that invest in your career development and so much more – so you can live fully at and away from work, including:

Compensation

  • Base compensation listed within the listed pay range based on factors such as qualifications, skills, relevant experience, and/or training

  • Premium pay such as shift, on call, and more based on a teammate's job

  • Incentive pay for select positions

  • Opportunity for annual increases based on performance

Benefits and more

  • Paid Time Off programs

  • Health and welfare benefits such as medical, dental, vision, life, and Short- and Long-Term Disability

  • Flexible Spending Accounts for eligible health care and dependent care expenses

  • Family benefits such as adoption assistance and paid parental leave

  • Defined contribution retirement plans with employer match and other financial wellness programs

  • Educational Assistance Program

Note: Eligibility for programs listed above may depend on your FTE or status (e.g., full-time, part-time, per diem, temporary, etc.); please ask a Recruiter for more information during an interview.


About Advocate Health

Advocate Health is the third-largest nonprofit, integrated health system in the United States, created from the combination of Advocate Aurora Health and Atrium Health. Providing care under the names Advocate Health Care in Illinois; Atrium Health in the Carolinas, Georgia and Alabama; and Aurora Health Care in Wisconsin, Advocate Health is a national leader in clinical innovation, health outcomes, consumer experience and value-based care. Headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina, Advocate Health services nearly 6 million patients and is engaged in hundreds of clinical trials and research studies, with Wake Forest University School of Medicine serving as the academic core of the enterprise. It is nationally recognized for its expertise in cardiology, neurosciences, oncology, pediatrics and rehabilitation, as well as organ transplants, burn treatments and specialized musculoskeletal programs. Advocate Health employs 155,000 teammates across 69 hospitals and over 1,000 care locations, and offers one of the nation’s largest graduate medical education programs with over 2,000 residents and fellows across more than 200 programs. Committed to providing equitable care for all, Advocate Health provides more than $6 billion in annual community benefits.

title: Shift Leader
description:
Application close date:

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the requisition is closed.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!

This role is part of Blue Origin Operations, which is comprised of Integrated Supply Chain, Test Operations, Safety, Quality, and Mission Assurance. This includes Manufacturing and Supply Chain support across all Blue Origin facilities.

Job Profile:

Shift Leader

---

This role is part of Blue Origin Operations, which is comprised of Integrated Supply Chain, Test Operations, Safety, Quality, and Mission Assurance. This includes Manufacturing and Supply Chain support across all Blue Origin facilities.

Description:

We are a mission-driven team of collaborators, action-takers and problem solvers relentlessly committed to a culture of safety and success. Working as an integral part of a passionate and accomplished team of experts, you will directly impact the future of space flight and ensure the progression of building the road to space through reusable rockets. Through dedication and leadership, your influence will help guide your team to define the future of space flight production. In coordinating all aspects of machining flight vehicle components, you will support various spaceflight systems in the production of parts with high-value, tight tolerance and impeccable quality: driving towards on time delivery and first article success. This position will directly influence the history of space exploration and will require your unwavering commitment and unfaltering focus towards safe and repeatable spaceflight.

Responsibilities:

  • Ownership of machine shop personnel and day-to-day operations

  • Conduct performance reviews

  • Responsible for establishing work station assignments, employee training, overtime assignments and back-up for absent employees

  • Maintain and communicate machine shop schedule status to ensure meeting customer expectations

  • Provide first level escalation support to employees regarding HR issues (employee relations, worker’s compensation, disciplinary actions, time cards, PTO requests)

  • Identifying Continuous Improvement opportunities and implementing change to improve process, reduce cycle and setup times

  • Maintain shop measuring equipment calibration program ensuring all relative equipment is calibrated according to schedule

  • Maintain all shop programs. These programs include 5S, Lean, Cleaning and Safety

  • Ensure all team members follow work instructions, quality requirements and processes

  • Ensure accurate machine shop staff data recording. Namely clock-in/clock-out activities

  • Provide continued training and skills development for team members, and mentor early career team member

  • Ensure start-up readiness for production

  • Maintain machine shop organization, safety and cleanliness

  • Support design for manufacturing and provide job planning estimates

  • Ability to perform interviews, evaluate talent and provide hiring recommendations

  • Safely work within an industrial environment

Qualifications:

  • 4 years minimum of leadership experience

  • 7 years minimum experience in machining aerospace components

  • Root cause and corrective action analysis experience

  • Familiarity with KPI metrics

  • Excellent blue print reading skills including GD&T per ASME Y14.5M-1994 standard

  • Strong communication skills with a heavy customer focus

  • Must have a continuous improvement mindset

  • Clear understanding of production versus development environments

  • Fluent in use of precision hand tools

  • Familiar with use of personal computers

  • Self-motivation and ability to prioritize projects to meet completion dates

  • Must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Desired

  • Experience machining nickel-based stainless steel alloys, copper, titanium

  • Tooling and fixture design

  • 5S, Lean Manufacturing or Kaizen experience

  • Knowledge of CAD/CAM tools

  • Experience operating heavy lifting equipment such as cranes and forklifts around flight critical hardware

  • Knowledge and understanding of CMM programming/operation

  • Outside processing knowledge (heat treat, plating, coating, EDM, grinding, etc.)

  • Experience machining tight tolerance, high value components

Culture Statement

Don’t meet all desired requirements? Studies have shown that some people are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single desired qualification. title: Residential Real Estate Relationship Administrator I - Jackson, MS
description:
The Residential Real Estate Relationship Administrator I is responsible for working with Loan Officers to meet the banking needs of our Commercial customers, which includes the largest and most complex relationships in the Bank. This position is responsible for the filing, initiating, correspondence, scheduling, and coordination of the activities between the Loan Officer and Customer, to ensure efficiency and high performing service within the department. This position is responsible for ensuring the loan processing and loan closing are conducted in a prompt manner and providing excellent customer service. The Residential Real Estate Relationship Administrator I works directly with the customer, as necessary to obtain all necessary information. This position also collaborates and works with other positions within the department to ensure all loan documentation is processed accurately and timely.
Duties and Responsibilities:

Sells and cross-sells Bank products to new and established customers by assessing the customer's needs and being knowledgeable of the features and benefits of the products.
Prepares new loans, renewals, extensions, loan advances, and amendments. Works with Loan Officers, borrowers, title companies, and/or attorneys in closing and funding loans.
Determines proper loan system coding (e.g., product type, collateral codes, call codes, and Escrow, etc.) and sends documentation to respective department to be booked and/or maintenance in the core system.
Reviews loan documents for accuracy prior to closing and/or booking to ensure loan stipulations from the loan approval and credit memorandum are met.
Obtains required information for prospective customers and/or existing customers for collateral and credit files. Scans documents necessary for credit and collateral files.
Reviews and resolves credit and collateral exceptions.
Works with Loan Officers in compiling information for credit analysis, ordering credit bureau and Dun Bradstreet reports.
Request UCC searches and review for prior liens. Start the Loan Processing Request form, including coding, request loan documents, including appropriate security documents, such as Assignment of Rents, UCC search/filing, Mortgage, Initial Escrow Disclosure, etc.
Perform CIP, BSA and customer verification requirements (including Beneficial Ownership analysis).
Creates CIF records.
Updates – Loan Officer on loan progress/issues.
Pulls lender exception reports from Cognos, submits loan maintenance and fee waiver requests to Loan Servicing as needed.
Submits wire agreements to Deposit Operations. Submits AFT/ACH requests. Completes DepositPlus and ACH agreements.
Completes the Loan Processing Request, Preclosing Checklist, and any documents not printed from OnBoard.
Provides credit references.
Handles customer requests to draft/transfer funds and research information for customers.
Pays invoices and fees.
Works with Loan Officer in ordering title work.
Requests flood determinations and calculates flood insurance, if applicable.
Resolves un-posted loan items and ensures financial transaction balance each day.
Adds loans to Ebanking. Sets up online banking and forms required depending on customer preference.
Quotes loan payoffs and initiates loan payoff letters.
Prepares and monitors loan participation documentation as required for both sold and purchased loans, handle wiring transaction with corresponding banks.
May make payment decisions, with approval from banking center president or department head.
Participates in the bank’s High-Performance Rewards Connections program.
Maintains a thorough knowledge of Bank products, services, policies, procedures and appropriate regulatory issues as related to daily job functions including, but not limited to; Bank Secrecy Act; Privacy Act: Fair Lending Act; Regulation E, etc. Completes required compliance training and adheres to the Bank’s standard of conduct.
Maintains knowledge of competitors’ products and pricing.
Performs other duties as assigned.

Position Requirements:

Two years of similar experience required.
Bachelor’s degree preferred.
Previous Bank Plus product, services, and systems experience preferred.
General computer and typing experience Microsoft Office Suite, to include Excel, Work, and Outlook
Driving, and occasional travel, as needed for business purpose.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills
Work outside of regular business hours, as deemed necessary.
Ability to handle multiple tasks.

title: School of Visual Arts Instructor
description:
Come Join our Team!

Love getting creative and helping others discover their artistic side? We’re looking for a School of Visual Arts Instructor who’s excited to bring art to life for participants of all ages! From after-school classes and community programs to Open Studio and senior living classes, this position offers the chance to create, teach, and inspire throughout our community.


The School of Visual Arts Instructor will contribute to the vision, mission, and values of the Youngstown Area Jewish Federation by instructing various visual arts classes for the overall enrichment and well-being of all class participants. The ideal candidate should be able to demonstrate the following:

  1. Instruct a variety of visual art classes, following the class descriptions. Classes may include School Age, Open Studio, Community Classes, Senior Living Facilities, Summer Camp, Early Learning Center, and more.
  2. This position specifically will create and teach 2 after school art classes each week, a monthly Senior Living class, a monthly community class, and support community creativity by supervising Open Studio twice a month.
  3. Create and maintain age appropriate lesson plans, ensuring that scheduled class time consists of set-up, instruction, student work time, and clean-up.
  4. Communicate concrete and abstract concepts as part of class instruction, identifying and cultivating creativity and skill among students.
  5. Maintain a high level of applicable professional knowledge, including knowledge of art history, different art genres, and current art instruction trends in order to teach a range of art styles.
  6. Practice good time management skills such as arriving with enough time to prepare your workspace, and beginning and ending classes on time.
  7. Assist in inventory and ordering of supplies
  8. Follow class registration and attendance record procedures through Club Automation software and Google Suite.
  9. Maintain communication with both the department Manager and Director, as well as the Facility & Maintenance Team, ensuring that workspace is kept clean and in proper working order.
  10. Display at all times a professional and enthusiastic attitude while developing meaningful relationships with students, members, guests, and colleagues.
  11. Communicate and cooperate with colleagues and various departments as part of the JCC team, including attending staff meetings as needed.
  12. Adhere to all JCC and departmental policies
  13. Complete all additional duties as assigned by supervisor

Benefits include:

  • Free membership at the JCC/Logan Swim Club
  • Discounted daycare and summer camp rates at the JCC
  • Discounted rates on programming
  • And more!

title: Program Manager-Operations and Performance
description:
The Program Manager-Operations and Performance (Occupational Therapy, Physical Therapy, Social Work, Spiritual Care, Clinical Nutrition, Patient Relations, Interpretation Services, EVS, Transport and Food Services) reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

The Program Manager will lead planning and implementation activities for Northwestern Memorial HealthCare. This will include developing work plans and metrics, the monitoring of work plans and metrics to assure activities are on-time and on-budget, coordinating the internal and external resources to execute activities, and completing activities as assigned. The Program Manager will work closely with managers, directors and clinicians to develop work plans, metrics and resources to achieve the department’s strategic goals and objectives.

description:
RELOCATION ASSISTANCE: Relocation assistance may be available

CLEARANCE REQUIRED FOR START: No

CLEARANCE TYPE: None

TRAVEL: Yes, 10% of the Time

Description

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.

*Please be aware that this position will be contingent upon obtaining and maintaining customer and/or business funding*

Northrop Grumman’s Space Sector is seeking a Ground Software Integration Engineer (Level 3 or 4) to join our team of highly qualified, diverse professionals within the Western Region Software Engineering Directorate. This position is located onsite in Redondo Beach, CA.

The Western Region Software Engineering organization comprises over 800 skilled professionals—including Software Engineers, DevOps Engineers, Database Administrators, and Network Engineers—at every career stage, from early‑career engineers to senior chief engineers and architects. The organization supports numerous programs and offers ample opportunities for advancement into higher‑level technical roles or leadership positions. Our culture promotes cross‑program collaboration, continuous professional development, and a strong sense of community.

Job responsibilities of the Ground Software Integration Engineer (Level 3 or 4) include, but are not limited to, the following:

  • Lead Ground Entry Point (GEP) services integration, including development and management of Interface Control Documents (ICDs), and serve as the primary technical interface with commercial GEP and ground station providers.
  • Design, integrate, and operate end-to-end ground systems that ensure seamless interoperability across mission operations, ground communications, and secure data flows, including automated contact scheduling and data routing.
  • Implement and maintain secure data exchange solutions (e.g., encryption, IPsec, cross-domain/data diode integrations) and apply protocol standards (CCSDS, SLE, TCP/IP, Ka-/S-band) to ground system and network designs.
  • Utilize mission operations tools, network planning utilities, and orchestration software to enable reliable and efficient ground operations, and lead interface verification/test campaigns and ICD update cycles.
  • Apply strong problem-solving skills to rapidly understand and resolve complex technical issues, and prepare technical charts, present data, and provide clear recommendations to internal teams, leadership, and external customers.
  • Manage tasking and mentor team members across multiple, concurrent program schedules, ensuring high-quality execution of deliverables within tight deadlines.

*Please be aware that this position will be contingent upon obtaining and maintaining customer and/or business funding*

This requisition may be filled at a higher grade based on the qualifications listed below.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Principal Software Engineer (Level 3)
    • Bachelor’s degree in a STEM discipline with 5+ years of relevant software engineering experience or Master’s degree in a STEM discipline with 3+ years of stated experience or Ph.D. in a STEM discipline with 1+ years of stated experience.
  • Sr. Principal Software Engineer (Level 4)
    • Bachelor’s degree in a STEM discipline with 8+ years of relevant software engineering experience or Master’s degree in a STEM discipline with 6+ years of stated experience or Ph.D. in a STEM discipline with 4+ years of stated experience.
  • Ability and willingness to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government Secret clearance within a reasonable period of time as determined by the company.
  • Experience with ground system interfaces and integration (preferably with GEPs, Telemetry, Tracking, & Command (TT&C), SATCOM, or other ground communication assets).
  • Demonstrated experience developing, interpreting, or maintaining Interface Control Documents (ICDs).
  • Strong understanding of network protocols, data formats, and ground communications architectures.
  • Experience coordinating technical requirements and issue resolution with external service providers or vendors.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Active U.S. Government Secret clearance
  • Hands-on experience integrating with commercial GEP service providers or equivalent commercial ground stations.
  • Familiarity with automated ground contact scheduling, data routing, and mission data flows.
  • Experience with secure data exchange (encryption, IPsec, cross-domain/data diode integration).
  • Strong knowledge of protocol standards (CCSDS, SLE, TCP/IP, Ka/S-band satellite comms).
  • Experience with mission operations tools, network planning, or orchestration software.
  • Ability to support ICD update cycles, participate in technical interchange meetings (TIMs), and drive interface verification/test campaigns.

title: General Labourer
description:
About PreCon

With a solid history dating back to 1958, PreCon Precast Limited (now a member of the OSCO Construction Group) is known as a leading provider of architectural and structural precast concrete solutions with our manufacturing plant in Woodstock ON and office in Mississauga, ON. Across Ontario, you will find PreCon precast products and systems used in a variety of construction segments. We pride ourselves in being leaders in precast concrete innovation, building more energy efficient, sustainable, and safe structures.

Job Summary

Working as part of a team, this position is responsible for performing general labourer duties in a precast concrete manufacturing facility.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Must be able to work in a safe manner and comply with all safety policies and procedures while maintaining a clean and hazard free workspace.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with co-workers and management to complete work in a safe, efficient, and timely manner, with minimal supervision.
  • Must be able to read and write in English and understand basic mathematics and measurements.
  • Safely operate power tools and equipment related to job/task.
  • Visually inspects all equipment, personal protection equipment for faulty equipment, worn out parts, and immediately reports his findings to Lead Hand or Supervisor.
  • Placement of standard materials related to product, such as: insulation, erection hooks, etc.
  • Mix, pour, rake, shovel, vibrate and finish concrete.
  • Tie reinforcing, such as rebar to rebar, rebar to mesh, mesh to mesh, under specific direction.
  • Nailing and fastening wooden forms under specific direction.
  • Perform other general labourer duties as assigned.

Education And/ Or Experience

  • Completion of a high school diploma is an asset.
  • Previous labourer experience in the concrete and/or construction industry is an asset.
  • Certified crane or forklift training is an asset.
  • Ability to use and read a tape measure is an asset.
  • Ability to read and interpret shop drawings is an asset.
  • Experience operating specialized concrete fabrication equipment is an asset.
  • Experience operating overhead crane and/or forklift is an asset.

Physical Demands

  • While performing the duties of this job you are regularly required to stand for extended periods of time, lift, climb, push-pull, kneel, crouch, twist, bend, and stoop.
  • Must be able to lift up to 50lbs frequently.

Work Environment

  • May require working in hot (32C) and cold (-25C) temperatures.

Hours Of Work

  • Must have a willingness to work overtime as required.

This posting is intended to build a talent pool for future opportunities. There may not be an immediate opening at this time, but we will reach out to qualified applicants once a position is available.

As a member of the OSCO Construction Group, PreCon offers a comprehensive compensation package including seniority with Unifor union local 636 upon successful completion of probation, competitive wages, paid overtime and company benefits.

About OSCO

The origins of the OSCO Construction Group go back to 1955 when Ocean Steel & Construction Ltd. was founded in Saint John, New Brunswick. Since that time, the OSCO Construction Group has grown to encompass four main operating sectors: Steel, Concrete, Construction and Corporate. Within these sectors lie an ever-expanding number of companies and divisions, serving a growing market area and employing over twelve hundred employees.

The OSCO Construction Group prides itself not just in embracing change, but in leading it. We drive this change by maintaining our vision to be fast, be global and be connected. All of our sectors are committed to: conducting business with integrity and fairness; continuous education & training of our employees; improving our processes; focusing on our customers’ needs; and, providing top quality products & services.

title: Sairaanhoitaja Medisiininen vastaanotto
description:
Etsimme osaavaa ja motivoitunutta sairaanhoitajaa vakituiseen työsuhteeseen 19.10.2026 alkaen (tai sopimuksen mukaan) Medisiinisille vastaanotoille Jorvin sairaalaan.

Sairaanhoitajana toimii keskeisessä roolissa medisiinisillä ajanvarausvastaanotoilla, joissa hoitotyö on monipuolista ja vaihtelevaa. Työtehtäviisi kuuluu hoitotyön toteuttaminen ensisijaisesti obesiteetti- ja diabetesajanvarausvastaanotoilla. Työ koostuu potilaiden ohjauksesta ja neuvonnasta sekä lääkehoidon opetuksesta.

Työ on päivätyötä arkisin, mikä mahdollistaa tasapainoisen työrytmin, vapaat illat ja viikonloput. Tehtävä tarjoaa mahdollisuuden kehittyä monipuolisesti erikoisalojen hoitotyössä ja hyödyntää aiempaa osaamistasi. Työ tapahtuu sekä etänä että perinteisillä vastaanotoilla.

HUSin Sisätaudit ja kuntoutus -tulosyksikköön kuuluva yksikkömme tarjoaa monipuolisia palveluja monierikoisalaisella vastaanotolla. Potilaat saapuvat meille lähetteellä ja toiminta on ajanvarauksellista, mikä takaa suunnitelmallisen ja sujuvan hoitopolun. Erikoisaloina ovat obesiteetti, endokrinologia, gastroenterologia, kardiologia, keuhkosairaudet, infektiotaudit, reumatologia ja sisätaudit. Toimimme myös osana erikoissaanhoidon ja perusterveydenhuollon yhteistä diabeteskeskusta. Medisiiniset vastaanotot toimivat tiiviissä yhteistyössä ja osana samaa työyhteisöä sisätautien päiväyksikön kanssa, mikä mahdollistaa hoitoprosessien sujuvuuden ja potilaslähtöisen toiminnan. Potilaat ohjautuvat päiväyksikköön vastaanottojen eri erikoisaloilta.

Työympäristömme on dynaaminen ja monipuolinen, tarjoten mahdollisuuden kehittyä useiden erikoisalojen osaajaksi sekä osallistua potilaiden hoitoon laajasti eri näkökulmista. Panostamme tiimityöhön, asiakaslähtöisyyteen ja korkeaan hoidon laatuun. Vastaanotoilla tyypillinen työpäivä koostuu potilaan ohjaamisesta, hoidon suunnittelusta ja toteutuksesta sekä moniammatillisesta yhteistyöstä. Työ on ajanvarauksella tapahtuvaa vastaanottotyötä, puhelinpalvelua ja digitaalisia palveluita.

Mitä toivomme sinulta?

Hakijoilta toivomme innostunutta asennetta uuden oppimiseen sekä hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja tiimityötaitoja. Odotamme sinulta kykyä itsenäiseen työskentelyyn ja oman työn johtamiseen, oppimishaluista asennetta ja innokkuutta kehittyä, aktiivista ja kehittämismyönteistä työotetta sekä hyviä työyhteisötaitoja ja kykyä toimia sujuvasti moniammatillisessa työyhteisössä. Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää kokemusta vastaanottotyöstä. Hakijan eduksi katsomme kokemuksen erikoissairaanhoidosta ja medisiinisten vastaanottojen vastaanottotyöstä, erityisesti obesiteetti- ja diabetespotilaiden hoidosta.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?

Tarjoamme monipuolisia ja haastavia työtehtäviä moniammatillisessa työyhteisössä. Saat meillä osaamisesi mukaan räätälöidyn perehdytyksen, hyvät koulutusmahdollisuudet ja HUSin tarjoamat työsuhde-edut kuten ePassin.

Tehtäväkohtainen palkka on 3024,27 €/kk ja mahdolliset kokemus- ja muut lisät.

Hakeminen

Tule mukaan innovatiiviseen, aktiiviseen ja kehittämismyönteiseen tiimiimme. Tuo hakemuksessasi laajasti esille osaamistasi. Hae meille hakuajan loppuun mennessä. Hakemusten perusteella kutsumme osan hakijoista videohaastatteluun. Videohaastattelujen jälkeen valitut hakijat kutsutaan läsnäolohaastatteluun Jorviin 9.10.

HUSissa olet osa vaikuttavinta hoitoa.



Tehtävän kelpoisuusehdot

Laillistettu sairaanhoitaja.

Kielitaitovaatimuksena on suomen kielen hyvä suullinen ja kirjallinen taito ja ruotsin kielen tyydyttävä suullinen ja kirjallinen taito taikka ruotsin kielen hyvä suullinen ja kirjallinen taito ja suomen kielen tyydyttävä suullinen ja kirjallinen taito.

Edellytämme asiakas- ja potilastiloissa työskentelevältä tartuntatautilain mukaista rokotussuojaa, ja terveydenhuollon toimintayksiköissä työskentelevältä terveydentilan selvitystä keuhkotuberkuloosista.

title: HITL Software Engineer
description:
ABOUT ROCKET LAB

Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity’s reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Based in Auckland, NZ, the HITL (hardware in the loop) Software Engineer is responsible for designing, maintaining, and operating HITL systems. You will support the Production, Electron and Neutron organisations and will be responsible for developing and implementing tools and automation solutions to optimise and streamline HITL system operations.

WHAT YOU’LL GET TO DO:

  • Work within a small team dedicated to designing, operating, and maintaining the avionic test systems to support all of Rocket Lab’s mission from the production floor to the launch operations.
  • Contribute directly to the development of automation tools to optimise running HITL operations.
  • Work with other teams to verify the functionality and performance of the Rocket Lab avionic components.
  • Operate launch vehicle simulation platform for Day of Launch operations for specific missions.
  • Work hands-on with test and flight space hardware.
  • Ensure the HITL systems are subjected to an appropriate level of engineering rigour and documentation.
  • Make and maintain accurate technical documentation via system diagrams, schematics, ICDs, procedures, test/anomaly reports.
  • Analyse test results from raw data for pass/fail criteria.
  • Troubleshoot root cause from anomalies and communicate the results and path forward with internal teams, vendors, and customers.
  • Work under the New Zealand HITL team to improve the HITL standardisation processes and automation.

YOU’LL BRING THESE QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's or Master's in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or Information Science.
  • 4+ years working in a relevant engineering position
  • 2+ years developing in Python on Linux
  • Experience in designing and architecting automation solutions
  • Experience working in a Hardware-in-the-loop environment.
  • Exposure to designing and implementing test systems for Hardware-in-the-loop environments.
  • An understanding of sensors, signal conditioning, and data acquisition electronics
  • The ability to work under pressure and tight deadlines
  • Proven tracks of managing projects and delivering on time, on cost, and on quality
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to build strong working relationships

THESE QUALIFICATIONS WOULD BE NICE TO HAVE:

  • PhD in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or Information Science.
  • Ability to understand and create technical documentation via system diagrams, schematics, ICDs, procedures, test/anomaly reports.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills and an aptitude for technical guidance and mentoring of junior engineers.
  • Have the mindset of actively “make and break” to find flaws and issues and report them.
  • Experience with harness manufacturing, electrical connectors, crimping, and soldering.
  • Familiarity with Ethernet, RS485/422/232, CAN, LVDS, SpaceWire protocols.
  • Experience with computer networking: switching, routing and subnetting.
  • Experience reading engineering drawings.
  • Experience with PLCs, relays, and power systems.
  • Familiarity with Python, C++, Linux, CI/CD, Git, NX and SolidWorks.
  • Knowledge of spacecraft systems or similar highly complex and autonomous systems.
  • Experience with general design, documentation, and presentation in Microsoft Suite (Teams, Excel, Word, PowerPoint).
  • Experience with quality reporting and management, work instruction peer review, test procedure or data review, and time recording in Jira.

WHAT TO EXPECT

We’re on a mission to unlock the potential of space to improve life on Earth, but that’s not an easy task. It takes hard work, determination, relentless innovation, teamwork, grit, and an unwavering commitment to achieving what others often deem impossible. Our people out-think, out-work, and out-pace. We pride ourselves on having each other’s backs, checking our egos at the door, and rolling up our sleeves on all tasks big and small. We thrive under pressure, work to tight deadlines, and our focus is always on how we can deliver, rather than dwelling on the challenges that stand in the way.

Important information:

FOR CANDIDATES SEEKING TO WORK IN US OFFICES ONLY:

To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR), Rocket Lab Employees must be a U.S. citizen, lawful U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State and/or the U.S. Department of Commerce, as applicable. Learn more about ITAR here.

Rocket Lab provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment at Rocket Lab, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

Applicants requiring a reasonable accommodation for the application/interview process for a job in the United States should contact Giulia Johnson at g.biow@rocketlabusa.com.This dedicated resource is intended solely to assist job seekers with disabilities whose disability prevents them from being able to apply/interview. Only messages left for this purpose will be considered. A response to your request may take up to two business days.

FOR CANDIDATES SEEKING TO WORK IN NEW ZEALAND OFFICES ONLY:

For security reasons, background checks will be undertaken prior to any employment offers being made to an applicant. These checks will include nationality checks as it is a requirement of this position that you be eligible to access equipment and data regulated by the United States' International Traffic in Arms Regulations.

Under these Regulations, you may be ineligible for this role if you do not hold citizenship of Australia, Japan, New Zealand, Switzerland, the European Union, or a country that is part of NATO, or if you hold ineligible dual citizenship or nationality. For more information on these Regulations, click here ITAR Regulations.

title: Principal / Sr. Principal Production Operations
description:
RELOCATION ASSISTANCE: Relocation assistance may be available

CLEARANCE REQUIRED FOR START: No

CLEARANCE TYPE: Secret

TRAVEL: Yes, 10% of the Time

Description

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.

Northrop Grumman Mission Systems is looking for you to join our team as a Principal/Sr. Principal Production Operations based out of Sunnyvale, CA.

The Principal/Sr. Principal Production Operations leads and directs one or more project teams in the professional services arena. Prepares project execution plan and coordinates activities between client and company personnel. Monitors project completion from initiation through delivery to meet revenue and cost projections. Oversees performance of projects or engagements and typically utilizes management skills more than technical skills. Provides technical and analytical guidance to project team(s).

Working under an Operations Program Manager and with manufacturing operations functional management, you will be part of the team responsible for the execution of the manufacturing scope of a multi-million dollar naval production program. In this role, you will help guide and lead the manufacturing team by ensuring manufacturing issues and roadblocks are resolved quickly, and that the manufacturing program(s) perform on time and on budget. You will be a key point of contact within manufacturing for the program.

What you will get to do:

  • Resolve manufacturing issues by working with cross-functional teams.

  • Coordinate responses with functional organizations to keep projects on schedule.

  • Propose, plan/baseline, and execute to the performance management baseline.

  • Perform risk and opportunity management functions for the manufacturing scope in concert with the overall program RSKOM.

  • Perform EVMS and cost account management functions.

  • Resolve material, manpower, and machine issues to ensure successful manufacturing performance.

  • Travel as required (generally less than 10%).

This position may be filled at a level 3 (Principal) or level 4 (Sr. Principal) depending on candidate experience.

Basic Qualifications for a Principal Production Operations:

  • Bachelor’s Degree with a minimum of 5 years of relevant work experience; OR a minimum of 3 years of relevant experience with a Master's degree.

  • Minimum of 1 year of experience in a manufacturing environment.

  • Experience using ERP systems.

  • Ability to obtain a U.S. Government Secret Clearance.

  • U.S. citizenship is required.

Basic Qualifications for a Sr. Principal Production Operations:

  • Bachelor’s Degree with a minimum of 8 years of relevant work experience; OR a minimum of 6 years of relevant experience with a Master's degree.

  • Minimum of 1 year of experience in a manufacturing environment.

  • Experience using ERP systems.

  • Ability to obtain U.S. Government Secret Clearance.

  • U.S. citizenship is required.

Preferred Qualifications for a Principal / Sr. Principal Production Operations:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a technical field.

  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in a manufacturing environment.

  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in Program and/or Project Management.

  • Experience working on government contracts.

  • 3 or more years of experience in Earned Value Management.

  • Experience with manufacturing production proposals.

  • Experience managing hardware production activity.

  • Experience with SAP in a low-volume, high-mix manufacturing environment.

  • PMP certification.

What We Can Offer You:
Northrop Grumman provides a comprehensive benefits package and a work environment that encourages your growth and supports the mutual success of our people and our company. Northrop Grumman benefits give you the flexibility and control to choose the benefits that make the most sense for you and your family.

Your benefits will include the following: Health Plan, Savings Plan, Paid Time Off, and Additional Benefits, including Education Assistance, Training and Development, 9/80 Work Schedule (where available), and much more!

#MPR

Primary Level Salary Range: $103,600.00 - $155,400.00

Secondary Level Salary Range: $129,300.00 - $193,900.00

The above salary range represents a general guideline; however, Northrop Grumman considers a number of factors when determining base salary offers such as the scope and responsibilities of the position and the candidate's experience, education, skills and current market conditions.

Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay. Annual bonuses are designed to reward individual contributions as well as allow employees to share in company results. Employees in Vice President or Director positions may be eligible for Long Term Incentives. In addition, Northrop Grumman provides a variety of benefits including health insurance coverage, life and disability insurance, savings plan, Company paid holidays and paid time off (PTO) for vacation and/or personal business.

The application period for the job is estimated to be 20 days from the job posting date. However, this timeline may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates.

Northrop Grumman is an Equal Opportunity Employer, making decisions without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, national origin, age, veteran status, disability, or any other protected class. For our complete EEO and pay transparency statement, please visit http://www.northropgrumman.com/EEO. U.S. Citizenship is required for all positions with a government clearance and certain other restricted positions.

title: [Publishing Platform Div.] Game Security Data Scientist (7년 이상)
description:
우리는 게이머의 로망을 실현하기 위해, 누구도 가지 않는 길을 갑니다.
예상을 뛰어넘는 과감한 상상력과 기술로, 전 세계 팬들이 잊지 못할 세상을 만들기 위해 담대하게 도전하고 개척합니다.

We pioneer the path to players' dreams.
With bold imagination and breakthrough technology, we create unforgettable worlds for fans across the globe.

우리 팀(프로젝트)을 소개합니다.

KRAFTON 게임의 신뢰할 수 있는 플레이 환경을 만들기 위해 게임 보안 솔루션과 보안 운영 체계를 개발·적용·운영하는 조직입니다. KRAFTON Security Services(이하 KSS)를 중심으로 Anti-Cheat, Anti-Tamper, 보안 운영, 데이터 분석, ML 기반 탐지 등 게임 보안에 필요한 핵심 기능과 서비스를 제공합니다.

KSS는 KRAFTON의 다양한 게임 보안 기술과 운영 역량을 통합한 Game Trust Platform으로, 여러 게임 스튜디오가 빠르고 안정적으로 활용할 수 있는 표준화된 보안 플랫폼으로 발전하고 있습니다.

우리 팀과 함께할 미션을 소개합니다.

KSS가 제공하는 데이터 분석 및 ML 기반 탐지 역량을 고도화하여, 게임 내 비정상 행동과 부정행위를 빠르고 정확하게 탐지·판별하는 모델을 개발합니다. 대용량 게임 로그와 유저 행동 데이터를 분석하고, 탐지 모델의 성능을 개선하며, 탐지 결과가 보안 운영과 제재 대응에 효과적으로 활용될 수 있도록 지원합니다.

  • 게임 내 비정상 유저 행동 및 부정행위 탐지를 위한 ML 모델 개발 및 개선
  • 대용량 게임 로그, 유저 행동 데이터, 보안 이벤트 분석을 통한 이상 징후 탐지
  • 부정행위 패턴 분석, 탐지 피처 발굴, 탐지 로직 설계 및 고도화
  • 보안 운영 및 제재 대응을 위한 데이터 분석 지원
  • KSS 탐지/운영 효율성 향상을 위한 지표 설계 및 시각화
  • 게임 스튜디오, 보안 엔지니어 등과의 협업
  • 탐지 모델의 성능 평가, 오탐/미탐 분석 및 개선

이런 경험을 가진 분과 함께 성장하고 싶습니다! (필수요건)

  • Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Statistics, Computer Science 등 관련 분야의 학위 또는 이에 준하는 실무 경험
  • 이상 탐지, 분류, 예측, 패턴 분석 등 ML 기반 모델링 프로젝트 경험
  • Python, SQL 등을 활용한 대용량 로그/이벤트 데이터 분석 역량
  • 대용량 로그/이벤트 데이터 분석 역량
  • 로그 데이터의 정제, 피처 엔지니어링, 학습 데이터 구성, 모델 평가까지의 데이터 흐름에 대한 이해
  • 머신러닝/딥러닝 모델의 구조를 이해하고 목적에 맞게 모델을 개선한 경험
  • 데이터 품질, 재현성, 확장성을 고려한 피처 엔지니어링 역량
  • 모델 성능 정량적으로 평가하고 오탐/미탐 관점에서 개선 방향을 도출할 수 있는 역량
  • 스스로 문제를 정의하고 데이터 기반으로 개선해 나가는 역량

이런 경험들이 있다면 저희가 찾는 그 분입니다! (우대요건)

  • 게임 데이터를 활용한 Anti-Cheat, 부정행위/어뷰징 탐지, 이상행위 분석 경험
  • FPS/TPS, 배틀로얄, MMORPG 등 다양한 게임 장르에 대한 플레이 경험 또는 데이터 특성 이해
  • 유저 행동 데이터 기반의 비정상 패턴 탐지 및 모델/탐지 로직 개선 경험
  • 대용량 로그 데이터 처리 및 ML 파이프라인 구축/운영 경험
  • Spark, Hadoop 등 대용량 데이터 플랫폼 사용 경험 또는 이에 대한 이해
  • 글로벌 조직/스튜디오와 협업 경험 또는 영어/제2외국어 커뮤니케이션 역량

크래프톤의 도전에 함께 하기 위해 아래의 전형 과정이 필요합니다.

title: Senior Strategic Program Manager
location: Allen, Lenexa, Monett, Springfield, us, north_america
description:
At Jack Henry, we’re more than a technology company, we’re a force for good in financial services. We’re redefining how community banks and credit unions connect with the people they serve. Our mission is rooted in people inspired innovation, empowering financial institutions to deliver seamless, secure, and human centered experiences. We deliver cutting-edge solutions that are paving the way for the next generation of digital banking and payments, but our true impact begins with our associates. If you're ready to help transform an industry and grow with a company that values purpose, collaboration, and excellence then we’d love to meet you.

This role will support strategic programs across Card Processing Solutions (CPS) Software Engineering, including R&D initiatives involving card processing, transaction routing, integration, and platform modernization. The successful candidate will be comfortable navigating complex technical environments, managing multiple interrelated projects and dependencies, and partnering across product, engineering, operations, and executive leadership teams to deliver business outcomes. Experience within payments, banking technology, or financial services is highly valued.

This is a remote position and candidates must live within approximately a 70-mile radius of our office locations in Allen, TX; Lenexa, KS; Springfield, MO; or Monett, MO.

This position is ineligible for immigration sponsorship and support. Please do not apply if at any time you will need immigration support now or in the future (i.e., H-1B, PERM).

All positions, regardless of location, may require an onsite interview or in-person onboarding requirement to verify your identity.

What you’ll be responsible for:

  • Lead strategic software engineering programs comprised of multiple interrelated projects supporting CPS products, payment solutions, and business initiatives.
  • Establish strong partnerships across Product Management, Engineering, Architecture, Operations, and executive leadership to drive alignment and successful delivery of roadmap commitments.
  • Provide end-to-end program leadership, including planning, governance, financial management, stakeholder engagement, risk management, and executive communications.
  • Drive transparency and accountability across complex cross-functional initiatives by effectively managing dependencies, issues, risks, and key decisions.
  • Ensure delivery excellence through adherence to Corporate Program Management Office (CPMO) standards, SDLC processes, governance practices, and audit-ready program documentation.
  • Champion continuous improvement, innovation, and adoption of modern delivery practices, including automation and AI-enabled capabilities that improve program and organizational outcomes.
  • May perform other job duties as assigned.

What you’ll need to have:

  • Minimum of 6 years of program and/or project management experience.
  • Experience managing large, complex programs or projects involving multiple teams, third-party partners, and cross-functional dependencies.
  • Experience managing program governance, scope, schedules, budgets, risks, issues, and dependencies within Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid delivery environments.

What would be nice for you to have:

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred.
  • Experience within Financial Services, FinTech, Payments, EFT, Banking, Credit Union, or Card Processing industries.
  • Experience supporting platform modernization, cloud migration, digital transformation, or large-scale integration initiatives.
  • Experience leveraging AI tools to improve program planning, reporting, risk identification, stakeholder communications, knowledge management, or delivery efficiency.
  • Experience working with Azure DevOps, Jira, Microsoft Project, Power BI, and related delivery management tools.
  • Strong communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills, including experience presenting to and partnering with technical, business, and executive audiences.
  • Ability to influence, coordinate, and drive successful outcomes across diverse teams and stakeholders without direct reporting authority.
  • Ability to work effectively in a dynamic environment with competing priorities and changing business needs.
  • PMP, PgMP, SAFe, ACP, or similar project/program management certification.

If you got this far, we hope you're feeling excited about this opportunity. Even if you don't feel you meet every single requirement on this posting, we still encourage you to apply. We’re looking for passionate, driven individuals who align with our mission and can bring unique perspectives to our team.

Why Jack Henry?

At Jack Henry, we live by the motto: “Do the right thing, do whatever it takes, and have fun.” It’s more than a tagline, it’s the foundation of our culture. description:

Artists Wanted — Bring Your Hands and Your Eye for Color

Painters, sculptors, whittlers, sketchers, tinkerers — this one's for you. At Surface Experts, your artistic instincts aren't a hobby you leave at home. They're the whole job.

Every repair is a tiny, one-of-a-kind puzzle: a different color to match, a different sheen to nail, a different material to work with. No two are alike, so you're improvising, mixing, and problem-solving your way to an invisible fix — usually in a couple of hours. When you're done, the damage simply disappears. That's the art.

And yes — you'll get your hands dirty. This is real, physical, hands-on work: kneeling on floors, blending materials, feeling out textures, working on-site in apartments, hotels, and construction zones. If you love making things with your hands and have a good eye for color, this is a paycheck for the way your brain already works.

Curious what a day actually looks like? Watch here:
WHAT WE OFFER

  • Base Salary + Bonus: Performance-based commissions on top of your hourly
  • Real Work/Life Balance: No required overtime. No nights. No weekends.
  • Time Off: Paid holidays and accruable vacation at 6 months
  • Flexible Schedule: We can accommodate midweek appointments with advance notice
  • Paid Training: Learn the craft alongside a seasoned technician from day one
  • Company Car: Drive a branded company vehicle for the job
  • Tools Included: Every tool and product you need, provided
  • A Brand-New Trade: Get in early on an emerging craft few people have mastered
  • A Team That Has Your Back: We celebrate wins and solve problems together
  • Small-Business Feel: Local owner, close-knit crew
  • Mentorship: Ongoing training and real career growth
  • Support On Call: A dedicated Technician Support Team for your questions
WHAT YOU'LL DO
Out in the field, every day:
  • Complete repairs on-site, start to finish
  • Work on-location with great communication and customer care
  • Adapt to all kinds of settings — apartments, hotels, moving sites, construction sites, and more
Take care of customers:
  • Treat residents and staff like they are the reason you're there (because they are)
  • Log your progress and notes in our software
  • Troubleshoot alongside our Support Team when something's tricky
Master the craft:
  • Learn our one-of-a-kind 5-step process and make it your own
  • Get to know every tool in your personalized kit
  • Flex your artistic muscle — every repair needs a fresh solution
WHAT YOU BRING
  • Hands-on experience with some kind of manual or creative work — construction, manufacturing, painting, sculpting, music, baking, you name it
  • A facilities-maintenance or handyman background is a nice bonus, but not a dealbreaker
  • A sharp eye for color — you can see, distinguish, and replicate colors, because color matching is at the heart of what we do (if you are colorblind...this isn't for you)
ABOUT SURFACE EXPERTS
We fix minor damage on all kinds of hard surfaces — bathtubs, cabinets, floors, appliances, countertops, furniture, elevator panels and more! By pairing traditional trades with our own original process and products, we make repairs that last and look great — all with a smile.

Most companies want to resurface everything (which we can do if we have to), even a scratch a few inches wide. We fix the spot, not the whole surface. That means happy customers who save time and money, call us back again and again, and keep one more damaged surface out of the landfill. A typical repair leaves no mess, no smell, and takes under two hours — usually just a tablespoon or two of product, so everything you need fits in a small kit.

OUR VISION — To build and lead a nationally recognized market for surface repair as the smart alternative to replacement or full resurfacing and to make our brand mean "spot repair" to facilities and maintenance managers everywhere.

OUR MISSION — To build outstanding teams through strong relationships, and to solve our customers' problems by cutting the waste of time, money, and materials headed for the landfill.

OUR VALUES
  • Serve Others — Put relationships first. No jerks. Be humble.
  • Be a Problem Solver — Stay curious, find the root cause, work smart, keep improving.
  • Trust the Process — Stay organized, stay teachable, put the business's needs above personal wants.

title: Software Engineer - Fab Automation
description:
Jireh Semiconductor in Hillsboro, OR is currently seeking an experienced Fab Automation Software Engineer. This is a fully onsite position who will be responsible for developing and maintaining fab automation software systems.

RESPONSIBILITIES/DUTIES

  • Develop, maintain, and support manufacturing software systems for semiconductor wafer fabrication.
  • Design and develop manufacturing applications using Java, SQL, and Python with Java as a primary development platform.
  • Develop and maintain interfaces between MES, factory automation systems, equipment, and manufacturing applications.
  • Support fab automation and equipment integration, including SECS/GEM.
  • Work with Manufacturing, Process Engineering, Equipment Engineering, and IT teams to develop solutions and resolve production issues.
  • Troubleshoot manufacturing software and integration issues and perform root cause analysis in a 24x7 production environment.

QUALIFICATIONS

Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Engineering, MIS, or a related field.

5+ years of software development or manufacturing systems experience, preferably in a semiconductor wafer fab environment.

Strong hands-on Java development experience and solid SQL skills.

Good understanding of wafer fab MES, factory automation, and manufacturing system architecture.

Experience with SECS/GEM and equipment integration is preferred.

Knowledge of manufacturing systems such as RMS, SPC, or FDC is preferred.

Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.

Self-motivated and able to work independently in a cross-functional engineering environment.

*Pay range listed in this job posting is an estimate only, and is not necessarily reflective of actual compensation that may be earned, nor a promise of pay for any specific employee future or past. Offers made are always dependent upon actual experience, education and other factors. Depending upon experience, candidates may receive an offer for a position level lower or higher than that listed, i.e. application to a Senior level position does not guarantee an offer of Senior title.

COMPANY INFORMATION:

Alpha and Omega Semiconductor (AOS) is committed to excellence in design, manufacturing, and responsiveness to our customers through the continued development of new technologies, products and innovative solutions. We bring to the market devices designed to benefit our customers by meeting their product specific needs. Our mission is to bring value to our customers, shareholders and employees.

AOS differentiates itself by integrating its Discrete and IC semiconductor process technology, product design, and advanced packaging know-how to develop high performance power management solutions. AOS's portfolio of products targets high-volume applications, including but not limited to portable computers, flat panel TVs, LED lighting, smart phones, battery packs, consumer and industrial motor controls and power supplies for TVs, computers, servers and telecommunications equipment.

Jireh Semiconductor, Inc., a wholly owned subsidiary of Alpha and Omega Semiconductor Ltd., is the in-house wafer fab for AOS and is located in Hillsboro, Oregon.

title: Scrum Master
description:
Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.

We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!

Job Description

As an integral member of Agile development teams working on software, firmware, or hardware products, the Scrum Master has responsibility for coaching the team on Agility and accountability for the effectiveness of the team. Responsibilities include using Agile frameworks and practices to effectively achieve team goals. Depending on team/organization, this may include Scrum, Kanban, Lean, XP, and the Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe). Helps team to understand, teach and coach Agile and/or Lean principles. Creates an environment for continued learning and continuous improvement. Helps Agile teams identify, mitigate and/or eliminate dependencies with other teams and communicates the status of these dependencies as needed.

Facilitates team events and helps remove impediments. Collaborates with other Scrum Masters to identify, promote, and adopt best practices and lessons learned to optimize team and program performance through communities of practice.

You will report to the Technical Leader and will work a hybrid schedule at our office in Milwaukee, WI.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Guide rather than drive teams toward objectives, goals, and continuous improvement.
  • Initiate and foster collaboration, communication, and team building.
  • Work to remove impediments in the organization.
  • Facilitate team and program.
  • Help assure the team follows Scrum/XP/Agile best practices and product development processes.
  • Help the team achieve and improve in areas including quality, predictability, flow, and velocity.
  • Facilitate Scrum/XP, Agile and SAFe events including Daily Stand Up, Sprint Planning, Sprint Review, Retrospective, and Inspect and Adapt workshops.
  • Coordinate solution implementation and delivery with other Scrum Masters and external teams.
  • Communicate to all levels of the organization, including progress tracking and reporting.
  • Maintain relevant metrics that help the team and program see how they are doing.
  • Balances changes in direction or requirements while protecting the team so the team can achieve committed goals.
  • Collaborate with Product Owners to ensure team execution and performance are aligned with our goals – near and long-term.

The Essentials - You Will Have:

  • Bachelor's Degree or Equivalent Years of Relevant Work Experience.
  • Legal authorization to work in the U.S. We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job opening.

The Preferred - You Might Also Have:

  • Typically requires a minimum of 5 years of related experience.
  • 2+ years' experience in Software Development/Test, Applications Engineering work, Technical Support, or other related role.
  • Experience in Agile development environment.
  • In-depth knowledge of Agile methodologies and techniques.
  • 2+ years' experience as a Scrum Master (with certification) and/or Agile Coach (with certification).
  • Previous experience in a leadership role.
  • Knowledge of, or experience with Rockwell Automation products or other industrial control equipment.
  • Bonus points if you've done the Scrum Master role in an environment that produces hardware products.

What We Offer:

  • Health Insurance including Medical, Dental and Vision
  • 401k
  • Paid Time off
  • Parental and Caregiver Leave
  • Flexible Work Schedule where you will work with your manager to enjoy a work schedule that can be flexible with your personal life.
  • To learn more about our benefits package, please visit at www..

At Rockwell Automation we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this or other roles.

This position is part of a job family. Experience will be the determining factor for position level and compensation.

POSITION SUMMARY:
Reporting to the Manager, Human Resources, the Senior Organizational Change Management (OCM) Specialist / Organizational Change Management Practitioner will develop the OCM practice change strategies for complex business and transformation initiatives. The role partners with leaders, project teams, and stakeholders to support organizational readiness, employee adoption, and successful implementation of change. As a change advisor, the position provides strategic guidance, stakeholder engagement, communication planning, coaching, and adoption support to help the organization manage change effectively and sustain business outcomes.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Develop and lead change management strategies, plans, and activities for assigned initiatives.
Assess stakeholder impacts, organizational readiness, adoption risks, and change barriers.
Advise leaders, sponsors, and project teams on change approach, risks, communications, and readiness needs.
Engage stakeholders and facilitate planning sessions to support alignment, commitment, and adoption.
Partner with various teams to align change activities, messaging, and learning support.
Develop change communications, leader messaging, readiness updates, and stakeholder materials.
Coach leaders and people managers to help them lead teams through change.
Track readiness, adoption, issues, risks, and lessons learned; recommend actions to support successful outcomes.
Contribute to continuous improvement of change management methods, tools, and practices.

SKILLS, QUALIFICATIONS & DESIRABLE ATTRIBUTES

Dedicated to the principles of exceptional service, committed to responding to, anticipating, and addressing customer needs, for both internal and external customers.
Undergraduate degree in Business Administration, Education, Human Resources, Organizational Development, or a related field.
Minimum seven years of progressive experience leading organizational change management initiatives, preferably in cross-functional, or enterprise environments.
Experience advising leaders, managing stakeholder engagement, assessing readiness and impacts, supporting communications and training, and driving adoption.
Prosci Change Management Certification is preferred; Certified Change Management Professional (CCMP) or Project Management Professional (PMP) considered an asset.
Strong knowledge of change management methodologies, tools, and practices.
Strong strategic thinking, facilitation, coaching, consulting, communication, and stakeholder influence skills.
Ability to manage multiple priorities, solve problems, work collaboratively, and deliver results in a dynamic environment.Proficiency in Microsoft Office 365.

title: Apulaisosastonhoitaja Endoskopia Jorvin ja Hyvinkään sairaalat
description:
Apulaisosastonhoitaja, Endoskopia, Jorvin ja Hyvinkään sairaalat

Haluatko johtaa, kehittää ja tehdä merkityksellistä työtä potilaiden parhaaksi?

Haemme apulaisosastonhoitajaa vakituiseen tehtävään Jorvin ja Hyvinkään sairaaloiden endoskopiayksiköihin. Tarjoamme sinulle ainutlaatuisen mahdollisuuden yhdistää kliininen asiantuntijuus, päivittäisjohtaminen ja toiminnan kehittäminen kahdessa aktiivisessa ja jatkuvasti kehittyvässä yksikössä.

Endoskopia on erikoisala, jossa yhdistyvät huipputason osaaminen, teknologian kehittyminen ja moniammatillinen yhteistyö. Yksiköissämme toteutetaan laajasti ruoansulatuskanavan tähystystutkimuksia ja vaativia toimenpiteitä, päivystyksellisestä toiminnasta suolistosyövän seulontaan. Pääset työskentelemään ympäristössä, jossa jokainen päivä on erilainen ja jossa kehittämisellä on aidosti merkitystä.

Tehtävässäsi pääset

  • yksiköiden päivittäisjohtamista

  • tukemaan henkilöstön osaamista, työhyvinvointia ja onnistumista

  • koordinoimaan henkilöstöresursseja sekä työvuoro- ja vuosilomasuunnittelua

  • kehittämään potilasprosesseja, hoitotyön laatua ja potilasturvallisuutta

  • osallistumaan hoidonsuunnittelukeskuksen toimintaan ja potilasvirtojen hallintaan

  • edistämään näyttöön perustuvia toimintatapoja ja innovatiivisia ratkaisuja

  • tekemään tiivistä yhteistyötä osastonhoitajan alaisuudessa ja toimimaan hänen loma sijaisena

  • ylläpitämään omaa kliinistä osaamistasi osallistumalla hoitotyöhön noin puolet työajastasi.

Työpisteesi sijaitsevat sekä Jorvin että Hyvinkään endoskopiayksiköissä, joten tehtävä tarjoaa laajan näkymän kahden yksikön toimintaan ja kehittämiseen.

Ketä etsimme?

Olet kehittämismyönteinen terveydenhuollon ammattilainen, joka innostuu sekä ihmisten johtamisesta että toiminnan uudistamisesta. Sinulla on kyky nähdä kokonaisuuksia, tehdä päätöksiä muuttuvissa tilanteissa ja luoda ympärillesi luottamusta sekä yhteistyötä.

Arvostamme erityisesti:

  • kokemusta erikoissairaanhoidosta tai endoskopiatoiminnasta

  • näyttöä toiminnan ja palvelujen kehittämisestä

  • hyviä organisointi- ja koordinointitaitoja

  • vahvaa vuorovaikutusosaamista ja yhteistyötaitoja

  • ratkaisukeskeistä ja kannustavaa johtamisotetta

  • kiinnostusta henkilöstön osaamisen kehittämiseen ja valmentavaan johtamiseen.

Miksi meille?

title: Software Engineer - Internal Platform Team
description:
About Gallagher

Our purpose at Gallagher is ‘Protect what matters most’ and we live it every day, whether that’s protecting the world’s highest security environments or agricultural businesses, we care deeply about our people, their families, and our wider communities.

Gallagher Security is on a mission to unlock more value for our customers through the power of our people and solutions - and right now is a pivotal moment in our evolution. With operations across New Zealand, Australia, Asia, Africa, the USA, Canada, and Europe and exports to over 140 countries we’re building globally focused career pathways right here in New Zealand.

As we expand our Hamilton-based teams, this is your chance to be part of a true Kiwi tech success story making a global impact. If you’re driven by passion and purpose to protect what matters most, come help shape the future of what’s possible with us.

About the Role

We’re looking for a curious and adaptable Software Engineer, junior or intermediate, to join our internal Dev Platforms team. This team owns the shared foundation that Gallagher Security’s developers build on: pipelines, tools, platforms, and practices that make shipping software safe and repeatable. You’ll help build and maintain that platform, and you’ll stay close to the teams who use it, because their challenges are how we learn what to improve next. The best thing you’ll ship is one that means nobody needs to ask for help with that problem ever again.

What you’ll do:

  • Build and maintain the shared tools, pipelines, and services that other developers rely on.

  • Work with development teams to understand where they get stuck, and turn that into improvements to the platform and how we work

  • Work in a supportive squad with a great engineering culture that pairs, reviews, and shares what it learns

  • Bring ideas for improving our tooling, infrastructure, and practices, and get the room to try them.

About You

We’re looking for someone who is adaptable, eager to learn, and able to pick up new concepts, languages, and areas quickly:

  • You enjoy problem-solving and can break down complex challenges into actionable steps

  • You thrive in a collaborative environment and can follow guidance while thinking independently

  • You’re motivated to grow, experiment, and learn rather than needing experience with a long list of technologies

  • Experience with C# would be helpful, as it’s widely used in our environment, but it is not essential

  • Experience with (or an interest in) software delivery tooling and practices: CI/CD, dependency management, code signing, or similar

Working at Gallagher

At Gallagher, we foster a collaborative, innovative environment where continuous improvement is how we work. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to directly influence how customers, partners and teams learn about our technology, helping create training content that is accurate, accessible and impactful. You’ll work alongside passionate product, training and learning design specialists in a culture that values curiosity, trust, practical problem solving and balance so you can thrive both professionally and personally.

We also offer:

  • Competitive salary and bonuses

  • Hybrid flexibility (typically 3 days in the office a week, with additional onsite days required depending on work demands)

  • KiwiSaver on-top and Life and Disability insurance

  • Mentorship and professional development opportunities

  • A supportive team culture with team-building events, and a fun environment

Apply now to join the Dev Enablement team and help shape the tools and services that empower our development teams. Applications may be considered and appointments made prior to the closing date, so don’t wait!

Applications will be reviewed as they are received and an appointment to the position may be made prior to the listing closing – so apply now.

description:

Do you enjoy making things and using your hands? Have hobbies that involve color or 3-D art? Like finding ways to be creative in different areas? Becoming a Surface Experts Technician could pair your interests perfectly with your job! Take advantage of an artistic outlet as your work creatively to complete repairs, usually in an hour or less.

A Day in the Life of a Surface Experts Technician:
DUTIES:

In the Field Daily
  • Complete 4 or more creative repairs on-site each day
  • Perform work on-location while displaying good customer service and communication
  • Problem-solve with repairs in a variety of settings like apartments, hotels, moving sites, construction sites, etc.
  • Ride a company provided e-cargo bike (like Amazon's latest last-mile delivery vehicles) to jobs to avoid traffic, parking, and the subway.
Customer Service and Communication
  • Treat tenants and staff with exceptional customer service
  • Update progress on repairs by entering information and notes on our CRM/Dispatch tool
  • Problem-solve alongside our designated Support Team for any issue
Follow Repair Process
  • Learn and integrate our one-of-a-kind 5-step process into your creative routine
  • Master each instrument and tool in your personalized tool-kit
  • Flex your artistic talents – each repair requires a unique solution
Calling all artistic types! Technicians with backgrounds in painting, sculpting, whittling, drawing, and other visual arts of various mediums can excel at Surface Experts. Your talent with color is vital in matching colors and patterns for complex repairs. Every repair has a different design, sheen, and material, so creativity is a must.

QUALIFICATIONS
  • Willingness to learn and being coachable are the most important requirements.
  • Hands-on experience doing some form of manual work – from construction and manufacturing to painting or sculpting.
  • A background in some form of facilities maintenance is helpful but not a must.
  • Must be able to see, distinguish, and replicate colors – familiarity with colors and color matching is integral to our process.
  • Must be able to travel 1 week off-site for training.
ABOUT SURFACE EXPERTS

Surface Experts is a comprehensive hard surface repair company. We can fix minor damages to many surfaces including Bathtubs, Cabinets, Floors, Appliances, Countertops, Furniture, Elevator Panels … you name it!

  • By combining traditional trades with our own original processes and products, we are able to provide long-lasting repairs that are pleasing to the eye. And all with a smile!
  • Our competitors need to resurface entire areas or fully replace – even damage only a few inches wide! We can repair those small spots. Our goal is a happy customer who has saved money and time while avoiding adding another damaged surface to the landfill.
