title: Senior Full Stack Engineer (wiq)
description:
Who is Quantium?

Quantium is a world leader in data science and artificial intelligence. Established in Australia in 2002, Quantium is a global team of more than 1,200 people across 14 locations with a unique blend of capabilities across product and consulting services to help businesses unlock value from data and analytics. Quantium partners with the world's largest corporations to forge a better, more intelligent world.

We combine a team of experts that spans data scientists, actuaries, statisticians, business analysts, strategy consultants, engineers, technologists, programmers, product developers, and futurists - all dedicated to harnessing the power of data to drive transformational outcomes for our clients.

As a Senior Full Stack Engineer within our wiq (Woolworths iQ) practice, you will join the Buying & Merchandising team working on the Assortment Recommender - a well-scoped product with a defined roadmap, sitting at the intersection of data, analytics, and engineering inside one of Australia's largest retailers. You will work closely with data scientists and analysts to build and uplift the engineering capability of a fast-moving, high-impact team.

How will you make an impact?

  • Engineering delivery: Design, build, and maintain full stack solutions that bring analytical and data science work into production, working end-to-end from data pipelines through to user-facing features
  • Engineering standards uplift: Model and advocate for strong engineering practices - code quality, testing, and sound architecture - helping close capability gaps within the team and lifting the bar for the whole squad
  • Cross-disciplinary collaboration: Work as a bridge between engineering and data science, translating between technical disciplines to keep delivery on track and solutions grounded in good software fundamentals
  • Cloud-native development: Operate confidently in cloud environments (GCP preferred), contributing to scalable and maintainable infrastructure and data engineering solutions
  • AI-assisted development: Embrace and apply AI tooling as part of your everyday workflow - this is an expectation of the role, not a bonus

The superpowers you’ll be bringing to the team:

  • Solid engineering fundamentals: Demonstrated experience as a senior engineer, with strong instincts around code quality, testing, and software design across the full stack
  • Python and/or React experience: Hands-on experience with the core stack; additional data engineering experience is valued
  • Cloud experience: Practical experience with GCP, AWS, or Azure - GCP knowledge is a bonus but cloud fundamentals matter most
  • Comfort with ambiguity: Proven ability to deliver in fast-moving environments where priorities shift, documentation is incomplete, and quarterly reprioritisation is the norm
  • Collaborative mindset: Experience working alongside non-engineering technical stakeholders such as analysts and data scientists, with the interpersonal skills to communicate across disciplines effectively
  • AI curiosity: Actively using AI-assisted development tools and genuinely interested in how they improve the way you work

Remember – you might not tick all the boxes, but don’t let that from stopping you applying. We’re more interested in how you work, your ability to solve problems and think big.

What could your Quantium Experience look like?

Working at Quantium will allow you to challenge your imagination. You will get to solve complex problems using rigor, precision and by asking great questions – but it also means you can think big, outside the box and push your problem-solving skills to the max.

By joining the Quantium team, you’ll get to:

  • Forge your path: So many of our team have moved around different teams or offices. You’ll be in the driver’s seat, and we empower you to make your career your own.
  • Find your kind: Embrace diversity and connect with your tribe (think foodies, dog lovers, readers, or runners).
  • Make an impact: Leave your mark. Your contributions resonate, regardless of your role or rank.

But wait, there’s more!

We’ve got some pretty sweet perks:

  • Flexible work arrangements: Achieve work life balance at your own pace with hybrid and flexible work arrangements.
  • Continuous learning: Our vision is empowering analytics talent to thrive. The Analytics Community fosters the development of individuals, thought leadership and technical excellence at Quantium through building strong connections, fostering collaboration, and co-creation of best practice.
  • Remote working: Embrace the opportunity to work outside of your assigned home location for up to 2 months every year.

Apply now and let's forge a better, more intelligent world together!

This provides information on how we collect, use & store your personal information, including potential disclosure to our majority shareholder, Woolworths Group Limited.

title: Summer 2027 Field Services Internship
description:

Our 10-week Summer Internship Program encourages college students to explore their professional interests while working on real business projects. As an intern with our Field Services team, you will see firsthand what it’s like to be a subject matter expert helping our customers maintain their fleet of GE/Wabtec locomotives. title: Senior Integrated Master Scheduler
description:
Battelle delivers when others can’t. We conduct research and development, manage national laboratories, design and manufacture products and deliver critical services for our clients—whether they are a multi-national corporation, a small start-up or a government agency.

We recognize and appreciate the value and contributions of individuals from a wide range of backgrounds and experiences and welcome all qualified individuals to apply.

Job Summary

Battelle is seeking an experienced Senior Master Scheduler to support planning, coordination, and execution across the Advanced Microsystems Solutions (AMS) Spectrum Solutions portfolio. This role will serve as the central scheduling authority for production activities, laboratory utilization, engineering resources, and program execution across multiple concurrent efforts.

Approximately 50% of this position will support production planning and laboratory resource management in partnership with production leadership. The remaining 50% will support Spectrum Solutions Program Managers by maintaining integrated project schedules, synchronizing activities across programs, and providing portfolio-level visibility into schedule and resource demands.

The successful candidate will develop and maintain an integrated master schedule that provides leadership with a clear understanding of priorities, dependencies, critical paths, resource allocations, and potential conflicts. This position is based in Columbus, Ohio and supports a growing portfolio of advanced communications, sensing, electronic warfare, autonomy, RF hardware, and software-defined systems programs.

Responsibilities

Integrated Master Scheduling

  • Develop and maintain integrated master schedules across production, engineering, laboratory, and program activities.
  • Establish schedule dependencies, milestones, critical paths, and execution priorities.
  • Provide leadership with consolidated schedule status, forecasts, and execution metrics.
  • Identify schedule risks, resource conflicts, and potential bottlenecks before they impact program performance.
  • Maintain schedule baselines and support planning and change management activities.
  • Maintain a consolidated portfolio resource schedule and proactively identify conflicts involving personnel, laboratories, test assets, production resources, and critical milestones.

Production & Resource Planning

  • Coordinate production runs, hardware builds, laboratory activities, test events, and demonstrations.
  • Manage utilization of shared laboratory facilities, specialized equipment, engineering resources, and production assets.
  • Balance competing priorities across production, development, integration, and test activities.
  • Ensure technical teams have clear visibility into upcoming schedules and resource requirements.

Program & Portfolio Synchronization

  • Partner with Spectrum Solutions Program Managers to develop and maintain detailed project schedules.
  • Synchronize schedules across customer-funded programs, IRADs, proposal efforts, production activities, and product development initiatives.
  • Support planning for major reviews, demonstrations, test events, and customer deliveries.
  • Provide a portfolio-level view of key milestones, resource demands, and schedule impacts.

Cross-Functional Coordination

title: Fairchild Live: Senior Event Producer
location: New York - New York City Office
description:

Fairchild Live, the events arm of Fairchild Media Group under Penske Media Corporation (PMC), is seeking a Senior Events Manager to join its high-performing, fast-paced team. Fairchild is home to iconic brands including Women’s Wear Daily (WWD), Footwear News (FN), and Beauty Inc., and sits at the intersection of the global fashion, beauty, and retail industries. WWD, often referred to as the fashion bible, is where decision-makers go to understand where the industry is headed and why it matters.

This is a highly visible role for an experienced events leader who thrives in a strategic and execution-driven environment. The Senior Events Manager will own regional and international programs end to end while also contributing to long-term planning, team development, and operational efficiencies. This role partners closely with editorial, sales, marketing, and leadership to deliver best-in-class experiences that support both brand storytelling and business growth.

As Fairchild values in-person collaboration and team cohesion, employees work onsite four days per week with one remote day, reinforcing a connected and inclusive culture.

Key Responsibilities

Event Leadership & Execution

  • Serve as the lead on assigned tentpole programs, managing the full event lifecycle from planning through execution and post-event analysis
  • Lead large scale productions with a high degree of autonomy, ensuring delivery against brand, audience, and revenue objectives
  • Build and oversee comprehensive timelines, run-of-show documents, and production schedules to drive flawless execution
  • Lead on-site operations including load-in, live production, talent management, and strike.
  • Partner with editorial and programming teams to manage speaker and talent logistics, including travel, green room flow, and on-site experience

Strategic Planning & Calendar Development

  • Play an active role in the development and evolution of the annual Fairchild Live event calendar
  • Contribute to goal-setting, strategic planning, and post-event performance reviews to inform future programming decisions
  • Support the team in identifying new formats, locations, and opportunities aligned with business priorities

Venue & Vendor Strategy

  • Lead venue and vendor sourcing, negotiations, and contracting with a focus on quality, scalability, and cost efficiencies
  • Strengthen and maintain year-long vendor partnerships to drive consistency, leverage volume, and unlock operational efficiencies across the portfolio

Creative & Brand Execution

  • Translate established brand guidelines into elevated, execution-ready event environments
  • Lead the development of look-and-feel decks and activation presentations in partnership with internal teams
  • Oversee all physical design elements including staging, florals, signage, and sponsor activations to ensure cohesive, on-brand delivery across all touchpoints

Financial Oversight

  • Own event budgets, forecasts, and financial tracking, ensuring accuracy
  • Lead post-event reconciliation and reporting, identifying opportunities for optimization and savings

Post-Event Analysis

  • Lead post-event debriefs and reporting, capturing insights to continuously improve programming and execution
  • Ensure events deliver measurable impact against defined KPIs and strategic goals

Required Experience

  • At least 6–8 years of event management experience, ideally within media, fashion, beauty, or experiential agency environments
  • Proven ability to lead complex, high-profile events with multiple stakeholders
  • Strong background in vendor negotiations, contract management, and budget ownership
  • Strong creative sensibility with a sharp eye for detail and brand consistency

Skills & Competencies

  • Strategic thinker with a strong execution muscle and a solutions-oriented mindset
  • Comfortable operating at both the big-picture and ground-level details of live events
  • Comfortable with a roll-up-your-sleeves mindset. We move boxes, pack, and jump in with vendors to get the job done!
  • Confident vendor-facing leader with advanced negotiation and relationship-building skills
  • Team-first mentality with a genuine interest in developing others

A good faith estimate of the salary is $90k - $97k upon hire. Factors that could be used to determine your actual salary may include your specific skills, years of experience and comparison to current employees already in this role. If you have more or less experience than specified on this job posting, please apply and list your salary expectations.

If hired, employee will be in an “at-will position” and the Company reserves the right to modify base salary (as well as any other discretionary payment or compensation program) at any time, including for reasons related to individual performance, Company or individual department/team performance, and market factors).

title: Recruitment Supervisor
description:

Schedule Full-Time

Job Description

Prepare and post job announcements through approved recruitment channels.

Source and screen candidates based on approved job requirements and qualifications.

Shortlist suitable candidates and conduct initial interviews.

Arrange and coordinate interviews between candidates, line managers, and management.

Communicate with candidates by phone, email, or other approved communication channels regarding

interviews, recruitment status, and required documentation.

Conduct reference and employment background checks when required.

Follow up on pending candidates and ensure recruitment activities are completed within the required

timeline.

Prepare candidate information and salary proposals for management review and approval.

Communicate approved employment offers to successful candidates.

Collect and verify required employment documents before onboarding.

Prepare employment contracts and other required employment documentation.

Maintain accurate and confidential recruitment and candidate records.

Coordinate with line managers and relevant departments to prepare for new employees before their first

working day.

Support new employee orientation and onboarding activities.

Ensure line managers prepare appropriate orientation and probation plans for newly recruited employees.

Follow up with line managers on the performance and progress of new employees during probation.

Maintain probation tracking records and follow up on upcoming probation evaluations.

Coordinate final probation evaluations and required documentation before confirmation or other

employment decisions.

4. Recruitment Planning and Reporting:

Maintain and regularly update vacancy lists, candidate records, and recruitment progress.

Monitor urgent and priority vacancies and provide regular recruitment updates to the Recruitment

Manager.

Monitor recruitment sources and recommend effective channels for attracting qualified candidates.

Ensure recruitment documents and recruitment records are properly filed and updated.

Support and guide recruitment staff in candidate sourcing, screening, interview coordination, and

recruitment follow-up.

Monitor assigned recruitment targets and recruitment progress.

Review recruitment work to ensure accuracy, professionalism, and timely completion.

title: Lead Estimator - Gas Power Generation
description:
Blattner is expanding our energy construction leadership into gas power generation. This is a unique opportunity to help build this new business from the ground up, backed by a company with decades of proven success in the energy sector. This position will help us shape the processes and standards that carry this business forward to deliver end-to-end hybrid energy solutions.

A DAY IN THE LIFE

As a Lead Estimator, you’ll serve as a subject matter expert and lead the estimating team through every phase of the procurement and bidding process. Your day will involve coordinating complex bid efforts, ensuring accuracy, technical compliance, and alignment across estimating disciplines. You’ll provide guidance and mentorship to team members, set performance standards, and champion process improvements and new initiatives within your discipline.

You’ll also play a critical role in closing new work — supporting negotiations, participating in client presentations, and helping differentiate Blattner in competitive pursuits. Your leadership and expertise will directly impact on our ability to secure and successfully launch high-profile projects.

STEP INTO THE ROLE

  • Identifies and calculates cost of project safety requirements (training, ppe) into bid. Identifies and determines JHA risks and includes costs in estimates. Pursues, selects and utilizes subcontractors who meet DHB risk management criteria.
  • Displays personal and professional ethics and complies with and enforces company policies and procedures when bidding projects, including utilizing company estimating software, performing bid reviews, etc. Takes personal responsibility to ensure that a quality bid has been produced.
  • Plans the estimate for and during the pre-bid meeting. Creates preliminary project schedule during estimate.
  • Supports troubleshooting and problem solving of complex problems for projects as they arise for projects that employee is both directly and indirectly involved.

WHAT YOU’LL NEED

  • 4 or more years of construction or engineering degree with experience as an Estimator or equivalent combinations of technical training and/or related experience in mathematics including algebra and geometry.
  • 8 or more years of progressive estimating and preconstruction experience with increasing levels of responsibility, including leadership of crew-based and governance-driven estimating efforts. Experience may include mission-critical construction projects such as hyperscale or enterprise data centers, gas-fired power plants, or large commercial and industrial facilities; work within a PMO, CMAR, or General Contractor organization; or support of large-scale, multi-disciplinary utility-scale power generation projects.

WHAT SETS YOU APART

  • Advanced knowledge of construction market, estimating strategies, estimating techniques, cost control and proper scheduling of purchases and work.
  • Ability to read and understand engineering drawings, purchase orders, contracts, cost coding systems.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.

title: Marketing Program Manager
description:
Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.

We're looking for a Marketing Program Manager to join our Partner Marketing team and help us execute co-marketing programs, events, and industry marketing with top game developers and technology partners. This role sits at the intersection of partnerships, marketing, and program management, and plays an important part in supporting partner relationships and program delivery across our platform.

Reporting to the Director, Partner Marketing, you'll work cross-functionally to help ensure the successful launch of win-win-win campaigns: good for players, good for partners, and good for our business. You'll help keep timelines, processes, and cross-functional coordination on track across sales, product, brand, creative, and channel teams.

What You'll Be Doing

Co-Marketing Execution

  • Support and execute partner co-marketing campaigns across channels including owned social, email, in-product placements, and live events.
  • Help maintain marketing "playbooks" and repeatable program templates that support consistency and faster time-to-launch across partners.
  • Support GTM planning for partner moments (new product launches, integrations, tentpole game releases), helping prepare materials and recommendations for review.
  • Coordinate with partners' marketing counterparts on creative direction, promotional timing, approvals, and campaign deliverables.

title: AI Adoption Specialist
description:
This position may be filled prior to the posted deadline. Interested candidates are encouraged to apply as soon as possible.
Koniag IT Solutions, LLC a Koniag Government Services company, is seeking an AI Adoption Specialist with TS/SCI security clearance to support KITS and our government customer at Joint Base Langley-Eustis (JBLE), VA.

We offer competitive compensation and an extraordinary benefits package.
Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) retirement plan, paid time off, paid parental leave, life and disability insurance, flexible spending accounts, commuter benefits and tuition reimbursement.

The AI Adoption Specialist provides embedded, hands-on support to accelerate the integration and operational use of Artificial Intelligence (AI), Robotic Process Automation (RPA), and AI-adjacent tools across Air Combat Command (ACC) HQ A3 staff located at JBLE, and virtually to ACC Directorates, and Branches as directed. This is a practitioner-first role: the incumbent works alongside mission personnel, learn their workflows, identifies practical AI/RPA opportunities, and builds user proficiency through applied instruction and collaborative solution development. Deep subject-matter expertise is not required; practical, applied proficiency and the ability to foster cultural adoption are essential.
The AI Adoption Specialist serves as a trusted advisor and enabler, ensuring AI and RPA tools are effectively identified, prototyped, integrated, and sustained within daily operations. The role emphasizes user engagement, and mission-driven technical support across the ACC in both classified and unclassified environments.

Essential Job Functions:
Core Tasks:

Assist in the development of long-term strategic plans for AI/RPA integration across ACC directorate and wings.
Active TS/SCI or TS with SCI eligibility
Collect and synthesize data to inform AI/RPA adoption strategies and measure mission impact.
Coordinate AI/RPA integration activities across multiple functional areas and units.
Establish and maintain relationships with internal and external stakeholders to support AI/RPA integration.
Identify AI/RPA opportunities through direct observation of workflows and user engagement.
Monitor and evaluate the effectiveness of AI/RPA tools and provide recommendations for improvement.
Provide applied hands-on training to users on AI/RPA tools in ACC mission-relevant contexts.
Provide technical advisory support on AI/RPA integration, ensuring compliance with cybersecurity, data governance, and classification requirements.
Support the prototyping, testing, and transition of AI/RPA solutions into sustained operations.
Translate technical AI/RPA concepts into ACC mission-relevant guidance for operational users.

Additional Core Tasks:

Assist in the development of training materials, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and user guides for AI/RPA tools.
Coordinate with AI/RPA Solutions Architect to conduct needs assessments to identify skill gaps and training requirements.
Facilitate user-driven innovation challenges (e.g., solution-a-thons, ideation workshops).
Maintain knowledge repositories and update materials based on user feedback and evolving tool capabilities.
Participate in governance bodies, technical exchanges, and working groups related to AI/RPA adoption.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities (KSAs)

Core Knowledge:

Knowledge of AI, RPA, and machine learning concepts and their operational application in DoD/IC mission contexts.
Knowledge of cybersecurity, data governance, and records management policies applicable to DoD networks (NIPRNet, SIPRNet, AFSCI).
Knowledge of DoD and Air Force AI ethical principles, data strategies, and governance structures.
Knowledge of IT integration and secure network operations across classified and unclassified environments.
Knowledge of performance measurement, KPIs, and mission outcome evaluation.

Additional Knowledge:

Knowledge of Air Force information security, OPSEC, and CUI handling requirements.
Knowledge of enterprise AI and RPA platforms (e.g., Ask Sage and other DoW derived tools, e.g., Envision).

Core Skills:

Skill in delivering hands-on, mission-relevant instruction to technical and non-technical users.
Skill in identifying practical AI/RPA use cases through direct observation and user engagement.
Skill in prototyping and testing AI/RPA solutions in operational environments.
Skill in translating complex technical concepts into actionable, user-friendly guidance.
Skill in building and maintaining stakeholder relationships and facilitating cross-functional collaboration.

Additional Skills:

Skill in creating basic knowledge materials, advise on SOP development, and job aids tailored to mission-specific workflows.
Skill in data analysis and reporting to inform adoption strategies and measure ROI.
Skill in using collaboration and reporting tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, SharePoint, DAF365).

Core Abilities:

Ability to work independently and proactively identify AI/RPA opportunities without waiting to be tasked.
Ability to adapt support and instruction to each user's proficiency level and mission context.
Ability to shift fluidly between hands-on coaching, applied instruction, and practical solution development.
Ability to communicate effectively with diverse audiences, including senior leaders, technical personnel, and end users.
Ability to maintain TS/SCI clearance and comply with all security and operational requirements.

Additional Abilities:

Ability to learn and apply new AI/RPA tools quickly.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

Work Environment and Physical Demands
Location and Environment:

Primary Work Location: Joint Base Langley-Eustis (JBLE), Virginia
Classified Facilities: Regular work in Sensitive Compartmented Information Facilities (SCIFs) and secure spaces
Workspace: Government-provided office space in secure facility; access to NIPRNet, SIPRNet, and collaboration tools
Classified Work: Regular access to classified environments (SIPRNet, AFSCI) required for coordination and stakeholder engagement

Travel & Schedule Expectations

In-person presence at JBLE during normal duty hours (0800–1700 EST, Monday–Friday, excluding federal holidays).
Travel: as required to support ACC Directorates and Wing AI/RPA adoption activities, coordinated through ACC A3/AI Division.
Work in both classified and unclassified environments; ability to operate in SCIFs and meet all physical security requirements.
Ability to sit, stand, and use computers for extended periods; ability to lift and transport training materials and equipment as needed.

Schedule and Availability:

Core Hours: 0800-1700 EST, Monday-Friday), with occasional extended hours to meet mission deadlines or support operational events
Flexibility: Occasional early morning or evening meetings to accommodate ACC schedules across time zones
Telework: No telework eligibility for unclassified administrative tasks; all classified work must be performed on-site in approved facilities

description:

Description

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.

Northrop Grumman leads the industry in solid rocket propulsion systems, satellite components and subsystems, lightweight space deployments and solar arrays. We are constantly pushing the boundaries of our nation's capabilities in space.

Northrop Grumman Space Sector is currently recruiting for a Principal/Engineer Mechanical (Level 2 or 3) position (also known as a Facilities Mechanical Engineer) located in Promontory, Utah.

This position is fully on-site. Relocation assistance is not available.

Job Description:

  • Provide engineering design as needed to support the Facilities Mechanical Engineering Department.

  • Manage projects and coordinate all procurements and installation to meet the program cost and schedule requirements for capital upgrades.

  • Design mechanical piping and instrument diagrams (P&IDs) for chemical plant systems including boiler feed and condensate, water treatment, hydraulics, heat transfer systems, conveying systems, and air and gas systems.

  • Prepare design calculations and specifications for major plant related equipment including, but not limited to heat exchangers, industrial chillers, cooling towers, boilers, condensers, pumps, piping, etc.

  • Prepare mechanical engineering designs, including layout, design sketches, and conceptual design.

  • Check design deliverables in accordance with industry codes and standards, contract requirements, and company standards.

  • Develop schedules, work assignments and staffing requirements to ensure successful project completion.

  • Coordinate with other engineers and craftsman assigned to the project or a task, and reviews work progress and results

  • Providing detailed cost estimates for project design and implementation

  • Preparing specifications for the procurement of pumps, heat exchangers, valves, compressors, tanks, cranes, and other miscellaneous of plant equipment.

  • Review engineering drawings and designs for manufacturability and functionality.

title: Dishroom
description:

At Hy-Vee our people are our strength. We promise “a helpful smile in every aisle” and those smiles can only come from a workforce that is fully engaged and committed to supporting our customers and each other.

Job Description:

Job Title: Dishroom Clerk

Department: Market Grille

FLSA: Hourly

Revision Date: 07/2026

About Hy-Vee

At Hy-Vee, we believe the shortest distance between two people is a smile. We're seeking people with a passion for customer service, a willingness to learn, and a commitment to being part of a team that strives to make our customers' lives easier, healthier and happier.

The Role and Why It's Important

Our Dishroom Clerks are the backbone of a clean, safe, and well-run kitchen. In this role, you'll keep equipment, dishes, utensils, and the work area spotless so the rest of the team can focus on delivering great food and service to every customer.

If you take pride in a clean workspace, work well as part of a team, and enjoy staying active throughout your shift, we'd love to have you on our team.

What You'll Do

No two shifts are exactly the same, but here's what you can expect:

  • Provide prompt, friendly customer service by greeting customers with a smile and making every interaction a positive one

  • Wash department equipment, utensils, dishes, pots, and pans thoroughly and consistently

  • Handle food safely and ensure the work area is always clean and neat

  • Remove trash in a timely manner and take department garbage to the compactor or designated area

  • Answer the telephone promptly and provide friendly, helpful service to customers who call

  • Work with co-workers as a team to ensure customer satisfaction and a pleasant work environment

  • Assist in other areas of the store as needed and take on special projects as assigned

  • Maintain strict adherence to personal hygiene, dress standards, and all Hy-Vee policies and store guidelines

  • Report to work when scheduled and on time

Your Skills

To be successful, you'll need to be able to:

  • Follow detailed written or verbal instructions and work through tasks with a few concrete variables

  • Perform simple addition and subtraction, copy figures, and count and record accurately

  • Understand and follow verbal or demonstrated directions and communicate supply needs orally or in writing

  • Work effectively as part of a team to keep the kitchen clean and running smoothly

Reporting Relationships

Accountable and Reports to: Store Director; Store Manager; Assistant Managers of Store Operations, Perishables, and Health Wellness Home; Food Service Manager; Market Grille Department Manager; Assistant Market Grille Department Manager

Education and Experience

  • No education requirement; six months or less of similar or related work experience preferred

Physical Requirements

  • Frequently stand and walk throughout a shift in sales, food service, or delivery areas

  • Where applicable to the role: ability to safely use sharp knives and blades for food preparation

  • Where applicable to the role: exposure to heat- and burn-related hazards associated with cooking, baking, or grilling equipment

  • Where applicable to the role: ability to operate a delivery vehicle in accordance with applicable DOT standards

  • Perform repetitive standing, walking, reaching, and bending associated with order fulfillment, POS transactions, and cleaning/sanitation duties

Working Environment

This role is performed in a kitchen environment where you will be on your feet throughout your shift. You will have exposure to noise, equipment movement hazards, cleaning chemicals or solvents, temperature extremes, and possible electrical hazards. Safety is always a priority, and training is provided to help ensure a safe and supportive work environment.

Are you ready to smile, apply today.

Employment is contingent upon the successful completion of a pre employment drug screen.

title: Senior Cyber Security Analyst
description:
MANTECH seeks a motivated and mission-driven Senior Cyber Security Analyst to join our team in Springfield, VA.

This role supports critical defensive cyber operations through targeted analysis and coordination. You will help protect national security networks from advanced persistent threats by identifying emerging threats, analyzing cyber activities, and delivering actionable incident responses to key stakeholders.

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Provide detection, identification, and reporting of possible cyber-attacks/intrusions, anomalous activities, and misuse activities
  • Characterize and analyze network traffic and system data to identify anomalous activity and potential threats to resources
  • Perform security event and incident correlation using information gathered from a variety of sources within the enterprise
  • Conduct cyber incident triage to determine scope, urgency, and potential impact; identify specific vulnerabilities and recommend expeditious remediation
  • Track and document cyber incidents from initial detection through final resolution
  • Analyze and assess damage to data and infrastructure resulting from cyber incidents
  • Perform cyber incident trend analysis and reporting
  • Work on a 24x7 Shift Work basis (4/10 shift schedule; hours dependent on location)

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or 4+ years of additional IT experience in lieu of a degree
  • 5+ years of cybersecurity experience

  • Knowledge of common cybersecurity threats, attack techniques, vulnerabilities, and indicators of compromise (IOCs).
  • Experience with SIEM (Security Information and Event Management) tools
  • Experience monitoring and analyzing security events, network traffic, system logs, and other security telemetry to identify suspicious or anomalous activity.
  • Ability to analyze security-related data and communicate findings clearly in written and verbal reports.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • CSSP-IR certification (CEH, CySA+)
  • Experience analyzing network packet captures, firewall/proxy logs, DNS traffic, authentication logs, endpoint telemetry, and system events.
  • Knowledge of the MITRE ATT&CK framework and ability to map observed activity to adversary tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs).
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment while managing multiple tasks and coordinating resources
  • Strong interpersonal skills, including the ability to engage with senior management

Clearance Requirements:

  • Must have an active TS/SCI with Polygraph clearance

Physical Requirements:

  • Must be able to remain in a stationary position 50% of the time

title: Experience Designer (XD)
description:
The Role


As an Experience Designer at Amplify, you will help shape how Creatorverse looks, feels, and works for the people who use it every day — including brands, agencies, and creators. Creatorverse is Amplify’s proprietary Creator Marketing Operating System, designed to give clients, agencies, and creators the tools they need to manage and execute their creator marketing activities. You’ll be a key member of the Creatorverse team, working closely with Product and Engineering to turn requirements into user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs using Figma. You’ll work within an established design system, building on existing patterns and components rather than starting from scratch. You’ll also be expected to clearly explain the thinking behind your designs, including how different screens, interactions, and user scenarios should work. This role requires a combination of strong design skills, clear communication, independence, attention to detail, and good business judgement.


Creatorverse is an important part of Amplify’s product strategy. We’re evolving from delivering campaigns for clients one at a time to providing clients, agencies, and creators with a platform they can use as part of their everyday workflow. The product is still growing, the team is lean, and there is a great opportunity for you to contribute ideas and help shape the product as it develops.


Key Responsibilities


Design & Execution

  • Create wireframes, user flows, interactive prototypes, and high-fidelity Figma designs for web and mobile experiences.
  • Translate product requirements and PRDs into clear and intuitive user experiences that align with the product roadmap and delivery timelines.
  • Work closely with the Product team to clarify requirements and ask questions when information is incomplete or unclear rather than making assumptions.
  • Create responsive designs that work effectively across different screen sizes and devices.
  • Define interaction, motion, and UI states clearly enough for Engineering to implement.
  • Prepare well-organized design files with clear layer naming, component usage, and documentation to support smooth developer handovers.
  • Document different states and scenarios, including loading, empty, error, success, and other relevant user states.


Design System Management

  • Work within and contribute to the ongoing development of the Creatorverse design system.
  • Use established patterns and components wherever appropriate to maintain consistency across the platform.
  • Prioritize existing design patterns over creating custom solutions unless there is a clear user or product need.
  • Identify opportunities to improve or expand the design system when existing components do not adequately support new requirements.
  • Help keep the design system organized, relevant, and easy for the wider team to use as the product evolves.


Communication & Design Advocacy

  • Clearly explain the reasoning behind design decisions to Product, Engineering, and other stakeholders.
  • Communicate not only how a design looks, but also how it should work, including interactions, behaviors, and edge cases.
  • Present and explain your work during PRD reviews, design discussions, handover sessions, and sprint demonstrations.
  • Participate actively in design reviews and incorporate relevant feedback into your work.
  • Be comfortable explaining and defending design decisions while remaining open to alternative approaches and focused on the overall project goals.


Collaboration with Engineering

  • Develop a practical understanding of front-end and back-end considerations to ensure designs are realistic and technically feasible.
  • Work closely with Engineering during development to clarify design questions and resolve implementation blockers.
  • Provide timely feedback and guidance when developers have questions about design behavior or specifications.
  • Review implemented features against approved designs and identify any significant differences before release.
  • Work with Engineering and Product to resolve design or implementation gaps before they affect the final user experience.


User Insight & Validation

  • Conduct focused user research and usability testing to better understand user needs and validate design decisions.
  • Use research and feedback to identify opportunities for improving the user experience.
  • Focus on obtaining meaningful insights rather than relying solely on large-scale surveys or high-volume data.
  • Consider accessibility and usability throughout the design process rather than treating them as final checks before release.
  • Use available data, research, and user feedback to support design decisions while recognizing when professional design judgement is being applied.


Autonomy & Work Management

  • Manage your own priorities and workload based on product requirements, project timelines, and release schedules.
  • Balance competing priorities and adjust your focus as project requirements change.
  • Work effectively in a remote and collaborative environment with a high level of ownership and accountability.
  • Take responsibility for managing your time and delivering agreed outputs within the required timelines.
  • Proactively raise potential issues, risks, or blockers rather than waiting for them to affect delivery.
  • Work with the wider team to resolve blockers and keep projects moving forward.


Qualifications & Skills

  • Experience: 2–4 years of professional experience in Product Design, UX Design, UI/UX Design, or Experience Design.
  • Figma: Advanced proficiency in Figma is required, as it is our primary design tool.
  • Portfolio: A strong portfolio demonstrating both web and mobile design work. We are particularly interested in seeing your design process and problem-solving approach, not just the final visual output.
  • Design Systems: Demonstrated experience working with and contributing to established design systems, including the use of components, patterns, and design standards.
  • Communication: Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain design decisions, user interactions, and design requirements to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Responsive Design: Strong understanding of responsive layouts and designing experiences across different screen sizes and devices.
  • Interaction Design: Understanding of interaction design, user flows, UI states, and web-based interactions. Experience with motion design is an advantage.
  • Visual Design: Strong visual design skills, particularly in typography, layout, hierarchy, spacing, and color.
  • Problem Solving: Ability to identify user and product problems and translate them into practical design solutions.
  • Time Management: Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to work independently and manage priorities in a remote environment.
  • Location & Availability: Currently based in the Philippines, with the ability to maintain consistent daily working-hour overlap with the Sydney (AEST) team.


Preferred Skills


The following are advantageous but not required:

  • Technical Understanding: Basic understanding of programming and software development concepts to better understand technical limitations and collaborate effectively with Engineering. Coding experience is not required.
  • Marketplace Experience: Familiarity with platforms where the end users and the paying customers or business stakeholders may be different groups.
  • Industry Experience: Previous experience in the creator economy, influencer marketing, AdTech, MarTech, digital advertising, or similar industries.
  • Notion: Experience using Notion for documentation, requirements, project collaboration, or task management.
  • Research & Testing: Experience developing and applying user research and usability testing methodologies to inform design decisions.
  • Remote Collaboration: Experience working with geographically distributed teams and collaborating with stakeholders across different countries and time zones.



Life at Amplify

We move fast, back big ideas, and hold ourselves to high standards, all while keeping things down-to-earth, kind, and genuinely collaborative. Amplify is an energetic home for curious minds and bold thinkers who want true ownership over their work. We give sharp, ambitious people the freedom, clarity, and backing to craft a standout career and see the direct impact of their work on a global scale.

What You’ll Enjoy

  • Big Impact: Work directly with premier creators and iconic global powerhouse brands on campaigns that define modern culture.
  • Uncapped Trajectory: Build your career with total ownership, backed by clear, structured progression pathways to help you grow rapidly.
  • Flexible Rhythm: Strike the right balance with a hybrid model, including one day a week to work from home.
  • Time to Celebrate: Take a fully paid day off on your birthday to reset and celebrate you.
  • Family Backing: Access up to 12 weeks of Paid Parental Leave to support you and your growing family.
  • Holistic Support: Prioritise your well-being with dedicated, confidential EAP services designed to keep you feeling supported inside and outside of work.
  • Social & Connection: We celebrate everyone’s contributions and reward the team with regular events, lunches, and overseas company offsites to keep us connected.

title: Design Manager
description:
Want to be a part of Asia Pacific & Middle East's (APME) largest, most innovative, and rapidly growing data centre company?

AirTrunk is a technology company with a powerful purpose - to scale and sustain the relentless growth of the region’s digital future. We do this by continuously redefining and delivering hyperscale data centres that meet the needs of our customers - the world’s most transformational companies. And we’re doing so sustainably, for today and tomorrow.

Having opened Australia’s first and largest hyperscale data centres in 2017, we set our eyes on rapid expansion and now operate a platform of hyperscale data centres across the APME region. With backing from our investors, including Blackstone, this is just the beginning…

Come join the A-Team at AirTrunk, where the cloud meets the ground.

A Snapshot

As the Design Manager, you will report to the Director, Design, based in Tokyo and work closely with the rest of the Technology team, making your mark in a number of ways:

  • Lead the design for the world’s largest cloud technology companies
  • Contribute to developing the largest hyperscale data centre campuses in Japan and outside of Japan
  • Drive continuous engineering solutions across the business, including moving forward to a carbon free sustainable industry and incorporating leading edge technologies, such as liquid cooling, battery storage and AI solutions

Your Day to Day

  • Lead a project design team from inception to delivery of multi-MW hyperscale solutions attending design and construction meetings
  • Interface with our top cloud and enterprise customers and communicate presentations on all aspects of design
  • Develop high level master planning, space planning and engineering solutions for potential new developments (feasibility stage)
  • Produce Basis-Of-Design BOD documents in the project definition stage
  • Produce consultant’s briefs to develop designs from feasibility stage through concept, scheme and detailed design stages, ensuring continuity of design philosophy and approach
  • Oversee the technical aspects of direct procured equipment and facilitate their interface with the design team
  • Understand the commercial implications of engineering decisions and build cost models for customers
  • Provide technical assistance in the site election process and engage with service providers and local authorities

Requirements

  • Minimum 7+ years’ experience in MEP design, preferably with at least 3 years in data centre or mission-critical environments.
  • Fluent in English and Japanese (reading, writing, and presentation
  • Bachelor's degree in mechanical or electrical engineering or relevant experience in product design or commissioning
  • Project life-cycle experience within the Japanese construction industry is a must
  • Incredibly flexible and forward-thinking as you must be ready for a continuous change of directions
  • Willing to make decisions and be accountable for them
  • Excel at communication; you can deliver effective presentations on data centre design to customers, peers and management
  • Good leadership acumen to lead multi-disciplinary teams

The AirTrunk Culture
Working at AirTrunk is a once in a lifetime opportunity to fast-track your career and amplify your impact. Whilst you’re helping scale our region’s digital future, we’ll help you Grow@Hyperscale and unleash your full potential.
The pace in which we operate means you’ll feel an electric atmosphere at AirTrunk. We are a team of challengers and collaborative problem solvers who break new ground every day. We do this by living our values, going above and beyond, and being dynamic, transparent, and responsive.
Every AirTrunker brings their own unique background and diverse perspective to find solutions to problems that matter. We make sure you have everything you need to make your mark and thrive in a flexible and safe working environment, where everyone feels welcome. Our benefits empower AirTrunkers to stay positively charged.
Now’s your chance to Grow@Hyperscale.

title: ERP Developer
description:
The ERP Developer is responsible for developing, customizing, integrating, and maintaining the organization’s ERP platform and related enterprise applications. This role supports business operations by delivering scalable, secure, and high-performing technical solutions that align with institutional requirements and digital transformation initiatives. The position contributes to continuous system enhancement, process automation, and operational efficiency through innovative development and technical support activities.

Key Responsibilities:

ERP Development & Customization

· Develop, customize, and maintain ERP modules, forms, workflows, and business processes based on operational requirements.

· Design and implement technical solutions within the ERP platform while ensuring scalability and maintainability.

· Create and maintain custom reports, dashboards, and integrations with internal and external systems.

· Participate in troubleshooting, bug fixing, and performance optimization activities.

System Integration & Technical Support

· Develop and maintain APIs and integrations between ERP systems and other institutional platforms.

· Support data exchange and interoperability between enterprise applications.

· Coordinate with database administrators, infrastructure teams, and application teams to ensure smooth system operations.

· Assist in system upgrades, deployments, and migration activities.

Infrastructure & Technology Stack Support

· Support and maintain the ERP technical environment including application servers, Linux environments, Nginx, and related technologies.

· Monitor system performance and contribute to improving system reliability, security, and availability.

· Ensure coding standards, version control practices, and deployment procedures are properly followed.

· Participate in backup, recovery, and environment management activities in coordination with relevant IT teams.

Process Improvement & Innovation

· Identify opportunities for automation and operational enhancement through technical solutions.

· Contribute innovative ideas and modern development approaches that improve user experience and business efficiency.

· Stay updated with emerging technologies, ERP trends, and best practices related to enterprise application development.

· Support continuous improvement initiatives across business and academic operations.

Compliance & Security

· Ensure ERP developments and integrations comply with organizational IT standards and security requirements.

· Maintain secure coding practices and support vulnerability resolution activities.

· Assist in maintaining system stability, data integrity, and operational continuity.

· Support audit and compliance activities related to enterprise systems.

Collaboration & Communication

· Work closely with business users and technical teams to understand requirements and deliver effective solutions.

· Provide technical support and user guidance when needed.

· Prepare and maintain technical documentation for developed solutions and integrations.

· Coordinate with vendors and external partners when required.



Requirements

Qualification/Certification:
  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field.
  • Relevant certifications in ERP technologies, Linux administration, or software development are considered an advantage.

Experience:
  • 0–3 years of experience in ERP development, software development, or enterprise applications.
  • Experience with ERP systems, especially Odoo, is preferred.


Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:
  • Strong knowledge of Python programming and object-oriented development concepts.
  • Knowledge of Odoo development framework, including module development, customization, workflows, reports, and integrations.
  • Familiarity with PostgreSQL databases, APIs, and web technologies.
  • Knowledge of Git/GitHub version control practices and collaborative development workflows.
  • Understanding of software development lifecycle and coding best practices.
  • Basic knowledge of Linux servers, Nginx, and application hosting environments.
  • Ability to learn quickly and adapt to new technologies and business requirements.
  • Innovative mindset with the ability to contribute new ideas and improvements.
  • Good communication and teamwork skills.

description:
The Senior Mammography Technologist performs high-quality breast imaging procedures in accordance with physician orders, regulatory requirements, and established clinical protocols. Responsibilities include screening and diagnostic mammography, contrast-enhanced mammography (CEM), stereotactic breast biopsies, patient education, and support throughout the imaging and biopsy process. The Mammography Technologist is committed to providing compassionate, patient-centered care while ensuring image quality, patient safety, and operational efficiency.

As a part of our team, you’ll help deliver compassionate, patient-centered care that truly makes a difference. Join our Radiology team at Central Valley Medical and Women's Imaging in Fresno, CA where your skills will directly impact the health and comfort of patients in your community. We offer competitive pay, great benefits, and the opportunity to grow your career while helping others.

This full-time position offers hiring bonuses - $5,000 sign-on bonus and relocation assistance.

Responsibilities

Mammography Services

  • Perform screening and diagnostic mammography examinations according to physician orders and departmental protocols.

  • Obtain high-quality breast images while ensuring patient comfort and safety.

  • Review images for quality and completeness prior to patient discharge.

  • Adhere to MQSA, ACR, FDA, state, and facility regulations and standards.

  • Educate patients regarding mammography procedures and answer questions regarding the imaging process.

Contrast Enhanced Mammography (CEM)

  • Perform Contrast Enhanced Mammography studies according to established protocols.

  • Collaborate with nursing staff, radiologists, and providers to ensure safe administration and monitoring of contrast-enhanced procedures.

  • Monitor patients for adverse reactions to contrast agents and respond appropriately.

  • Maintain competency and certification requirements related to CEM imaging.

Breast Biopsy Procedures

  • Assist physicians and radiologists with stereotactic, ultrasound-guided, and contrast-enhanced breast biopsy procedures.

  • Prepare equipment, procedure rooms, and supplies for biopsy procedures.

  • Provide patient education regarding biopsy preparation, expectations, and post-procedure care.

  • Monitor patient condition during and after procedures.

  • Ensure accurate specimen labeling and documentation.

Patient Care

  • Deliver exceptional customer service and compassionate patient care.

  • Assess patient needs and provide emotional support throughout the imaging and biopsy process.

  • Maintain patient privacy and confidentiality in accordance with HIPAA regulations.

  • Utilize appropriate infection prevention and control practices.

Documentation and Quality Assurance

  • Accurately document procedures and patient information in electronic medical records and radiology systems.

  • Participate in quality assurance and quality improvement activities.

  • Ensure proper maintenance and operation of mammography equipment.

  • Report equipment malfunctions and assist with accreditation activities.

Team Collaboration

  • Collaborate effectively with radiologists, breast surgeons, nurse navigators, medical assistants, and administrative staff.

  • Support workflow efficiency and patient access initiatives.

  • Participate in departmental meetings, training, and continuing education activities.

Qualifications

  • Associate degree in Radiologic Sciences required.

  • Current ARRT, CRT, and CPR certifications are required.

  • Strong critical thinking, problem-solving, and communication skills.

description:
Job Description

Job Title: Senior Engineer - Device Technical Operations

Job Summary

The Senior Engineer - Device Technical Operations position is a key engineering role within the Device Development and Technology Organization. This position is responsible for building strong engineering capabilities related to medical devices and combination products. The individual is also responsible for managing internal and external manufacturing in the development, scale-up, commercialization, and design transfer of medical devices and combination products, with a focus on complex drug-delivery systems such as autoinjectors, ophthalmic products, and inhalation products. The Senior Engineer - Device Technical Operations role is a technical subject matter expert on the device components, combination products, and processes to support global commercialization and technology transfer activities and drive product robustness for sustained launch in alignment with the company's business goals, and quality and regulatory compliance.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Utilize extensive experience in design controls, design transfer, control strategies, device risk management, and design verification testing to develop value-added solutions for medical devices and combination products.
  • Provide support for internal and external component manufacturing and combination product manufacturing, globally.
  • Identify issues with minimal signals, problem solving, identification of root cause provides solutions.
  • Build design engineering mindset for medical devices or combination products in both development and lifecycle management, ensuring compliance with relevant regulatory standards.
  • Use engineering best practices and tools to optimize the design and manufacturing to ensure robust technical and programs decisions through the development and commercialization teams
  • Support responses regulatory agency questions and pre-approval inspections during product development and life cycle management
  • Develop and execute strategic plans for technology transfer, problem-solving, leading teams in late stages of development, and working collaboratively with external and internal partners.
  • Foster a culture of inclusion by integrating inputs and perspectives from various sources to meet customer and stakeholder needs.
  • Build strategic partnerships with manufacturing sites and partner groups
  • Ensure that all activities are conducted with the highest regard for safety, quality, and regulatory compliance, aligning with the company's divisional and local site procedures.
  • Support regulatory inspections and maintain proficiency in ISO 13485, ISO 14971-2019, and other relevant quality management systems.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, biomedical engineering, or a related technical field (e.g., Chemical Engineering, Materials Engineering) required; advanced degree (Master's or PhD) preferred.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in pharmaceutical, biologic, medical device or combination product engineering, with at least 2 years supporting commercial manufacturing
  • Proven expertise in design controls, risk analysis, control strategies, design verification testing, and process validation, with a strong understanding of quality management systems and regulatory compliance.
  • Demonstrated technical experience in injection molding, automation, complex assembly and packaging operations for medical device or combination product component manufacturing. Direct experience in autoinjectors, ophthalmic products, or inhalation products highly preferred.

title: Managing Director, Lead for Product Transformation - SSIM
description:
Who We Are Looking For

  • Are you energized by leading enterprise transformation across business and technology in a complex, global organization?
  • Do you thrive on translating strategy into a practical operating model, governance structure, and execution roadmap?
  • Are you passionate about building product-centric capabilities, leadership behaviors, and accountability for measurable outcomes?
  • Are you excited by the opportunity to scale product operating models and integrate AI-enabled product delivery across Investment Management?
  • Do you seek to influence senior leaders, align cross-functional teams, and build a high-performing transformation organization?

As Managing Director, Lead for Product Transformation at State Street Investment Management (“State Street IM”, formerly known as State Street Global Advisors or SSGA), you will lead the enterprise-wide adoption and evolution of product-centric operating model. This role is foundational to the broader product operating model transformation and will establish the vision, governance, decision rights, operating rhythms, measurement mechanisms, and capability-building agenda required to scale consistent and accountable product delivery.

You will serve as a strategic advisor to senior business and technology leaders and partner across product, engineering, operations, data, architecture, risk, and client-facing organizations. You will build and lead a team of transformation leaders and product coaches, with the organization expected to expand as the transformation scales.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and lead the Product Transformation, aligned with State Street IM priorities and measurable business and client outcomes.
  • Establish and execute the roadmap for adoption and scaling of product-centric operating model across business and technology organizations.
  • Design and mature the product operating model framework, including governance, decision rights, operating rhythms, role clarity, accountability models, and cross-functional interaction mechanisms.
  • Create governance forums and transparent mechanisms for prioritization, funding, portfolio trade-offs, dependency management, and strategic alignment.
  • Define transformation objectives, maturity targets, success measures, dashboards, and feedback loops to assess adoption, effectiveness, and realized outcomes.
  • Lead large-scale organizational change and embed product-centric leadership behaviors, customer focus, continuous planning, experimentation, and outcome accountability.
  • Partner with leaders to establish persistent, cross-functional teams with clear ownership and guardrails across the product lifecycle.
  • Build enterprise capability through playbooks, standards, communities of practice, role-based learning, leadership fluency, and high-touch coaching.
  • Integrate AI-driven product delivery and modern product development lifecycle practices into the broader product operating model strategy in partnership with business, technology, architecture, and engineering leaders.
  • Identify opportunities to improve speed, quality, effectiveness, risk management, and customer outcomes through AI-enabled workflows and automation.
  • Facilitate executive working sessions and present transformation recommendations, progress, risks, decisions, and organizational implications to senior stakeholders.
  • Build, lead, and develop a high-performing Product Transformation team, including product coaches and transformation practitioners.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience leading large-scale business transformation, operating model design, product management, strategy, business architecture, consulting, or organizational change initiatives, preferably within investment management or financial services.
  • Demonstrated success leading enterprise-wide transformation programs with executive-level visibility in complex, matrixed, and regulated organizations.
  • Strong expertise in product operating models, governance frameworks, organizational design, decision rights, portfolio management, and outcome-based measurement.
  • Proven ability to translate strategy into executable roadmaps, operating mechanisms, capability-building plans, and measurable outcomes.
  • Executive-level communication, facilitation, influence, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Experience building and leading cross-functional teams and driving sustained organizational adoption and behavioral change.
  • Experience with modern product management, continuous planning, customer discovery, product lifecycle management, and iterative delivery practices.
  • Working knowledge of AI-enabled product delivery, agentic automation, responsible AI, and the implications of AI for roles, governance, and ways of working preferred.
  • Experience within asset management, financial services, fintech, or wealth management preferred.
  • Bachelor’s degree in business, finance, management, organizational development, technology, engineering, or a related field required.

$170,000 - $282,500 Annual

The range quoted above applies to the role in the primary location specified. If the candidate would ultimately work outside of the primary location above, the applicable range could differ.

The Sr. Software Developer, Warehouse Management Systems, Warehouse Management Systems, is responsible for the development and support of applications utilized in McKesson distribution centers. The Distribution Technologies team provides expertise in optimizing application performance and the development of enhancements that will improve productivity and customer experience. We are looking for an experienced developer that is familiar with Tier 1 Warehouse Management Systems, and the integrations of this application into various levels of automation systems within warehouses.

This is a key position that will interface with many internal customers, internal groups, vendors, and others. This person will work in a team environment on various projects and initiatives. The position requires someone who is technology savvy, has a demonstrated willingness to learn, and has a demonstrated capacity to retain information and knowledge. Attention to detail, and the ability to create, document, and follow processes are essential. The candidate must have strong interpersonal and communication skills who can work with people at various levels.

Job Responsibilities

  • Participate in the full software development lifecycle (SDLC), including requirements gathering, design/architect, development, testing, deployment, production support and maintain scalable software applications and integrations, supporting enterprise platforms.
  • Partner with IT teams, business stakeholders, and external vendors to design and deliver solutions that increase productivity, efficiency, and operational insight.
  • Analyze existing business and operational processes to identify opportunities were automation, analytics, or AI/ML techniques can improve outcomes.
  • Collaborate with business analysts, solution architects, and operations teams to translate business requirements into technical architectures.

title: Principal or Senior Principal Aeronautical Engineer (Landing Gear)
description:
RELOCATION ASSISTANCE: Relocation assistance may be available

CLEARANCE REQUIRED FOR START: Yes

CLEARANCE TYPE: Secret

TRAVEL: Yes, 25% of the Time

Description

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.

Northrop Grumman’s Aeronautics Systems – Research & Advanced Design (R&AD) transforms breakthrough ideas into mission-ready capabilities through intelligent anticipation. We’re the front-end design engine, defining what comes next. From developing cutting-edge next-generation future aircraft to trailblazing collaborative autonomous platforms, we push the boundaries of technology and forge industry-leading partnerships that set new standards for what’s possible.

Our team owns the full lifecycle of advanced concept creation, from visionary early-stage designs and rapid prototyping to high-impact demonstrations and solving the toughest technical challenges in survivability, autonomy, and battle management. We seek curious, adaptable people who thrive on turning intuition into breakthrough solutions. If you’re driven to invent the future, build what’s next, and shape the landscape of national security, this is where you belong.

Northrop Grumman Aeronautics Systems is looking to add a Principal or Senior Principal Aeronautical Engineer (Landing Gear) to our team in El Segundo, CA or Rancho Bernardo, CA.

The selected candidate will be responsible for development, design, and integration of landing gear on an advanced aircraft.

Duties and Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Identify existing and/or conceptual landing gear systems to meet requirements, creating 3D models and layouts, and performing trade studies to analyze the impact of integrating proposed mechanisms systems onto aircraft, as well as identify main driver variables that most significantly impact top level program requirements.
  • Support advanced aircraft design efforts with landing gear system design, hardware selection, placement, preliminary sizing, and initial integration into different aircraft configurations. Secondary role is to provide mechanisms design support to other aircraft sub-systems, such as drive systems and door uplocks for in-flight door operation.
  • Develop landing gear system requirements and create the associated system specifications, supplier procurement specifications, and supplier SOWs. This will include, but is not limited to, creating functional architecture and activity diagrams, in collaboration with other sub-system engineering disciplines to understand power, cooling, signal, and structural interfaces for the landing gear system.
  • Support the supplier management team by being the primary technical interface between NGAS and landing gear supplier subject matter experts.
  • Participate in internal program, customer, and supplier technical exchange meetings and formal program milestone reviews to provide and/or obtain progress status updates.
  • Provide technical guidance to, and coordinate with, multiple engineering design teams, including the aircraft configuration team, the structures team, sub-systems team, and supplier management teams supporting the conceptual, preliminary, and detail design and development of the aircraft.

The selected candidate will be required to work full-time, on-site at our facility. There is no remote/telework option for this role.

This position requires the ability to travel up to 25% of the time.

This position can be filled at either the Principal Aeronautical Engineer OR Senior Principal Aeronautical Engineer level, depending upon the qualifications below.

Basic Qualifications for Principal Aeronautical Engineer:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in a relevant STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics) discipline with 5 years of related experience; OR a Master’s Degree in a relevant STEM discipline with 3 years of related experience; OR a PhD in a relevant STEM discipline with 1 year of related experience.
  • Prior experience with aircraft landing gear systems and landing gear design
  • Prior experience with 3D Computer Aided Design (CAD) software applications
  • Familiarity with industry standard software application tools such as Microsoft Office Suite, Adobe Acrobat, etc.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a US Government Secret clearance within a reasonable amount of time as determined by the company to meet its business needs.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain Special Program Access (SAP).

Basic Qualifications for Senior Principal Aeronautical Engineer:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in a relevant STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics) discipline with 8 years of related experience; OR a Master’s Degree in a relevant STEM discipline with 6 years of related experience; OR a PhD in a relevant STEM discipline with 4 years of related experience.
  • Prior experience with aircraft landing gear systems and landing gear design
  • Prior experience with 3D Computer Aided Design (CAD) software applications
  • Familiarity with industry standard software application tools such as Microsoft Office Suite, Adobe Acrobat, etc.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a US Government Secret clearance within a reasonable amount of time as determined by the company to meet its business needs.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain Special Program Access (SAP).

Preferred Qualifications for both levels:

  • Master’s Degree in Mechanical or Aerospace Engineering or related discipline
  • Expert knowledge of landing gear design including:
    • Landing gear placement (both deployed and retracted positions)
    • Landing gear loads and preliminary sizing
    • Shock struts
    • Wheel and tire selection
    • Braking systems
    • Retraction and locking systems
    • Landing gear door sequencing mechanisms
  • Experience with Siemens NX CAD application, including NX Motion module
  • Familiarity with development of landing gear doors, door actuation and door locks, as well as the development of in-flight door opening mechanisms
  • Prior experience leading a team of engineers
  • Prior experience in coordinating with multiple Integrated Product Teams (IPTs) within a dynamic program environment
  • Experience with suppliers and supplier coordination
