title: Senior Inventory Control Specialist
description:
Role Overview
The Senior Inventory Control Specialist is responsible for the organization, control, and accuracy of maintenance spare parts, materials, and consumables used throughout the facility. This role ensures maintenance technicians and production personnel have the right parts available at the right time to support safe, reliable, and cost-effective operations. The Senior Inventory Control Specialist manages inventory transactions, receives and issues materials, supports purchasing activities, maintains storeroom organization, and contributes to continuous improvement initiatives that reduce downtime and improve inventory performance.

This position is based at an active mine site and requires daily onsite presence. Work conditions may include uneven terrain, climbing ladders, navigating steps, and exposure to varying weather conditions such as heat, rain, or mud. Monday - Friday onsite required.

Key Responsibilities
Inventory Management

Maintain accurate inventory records within JDE
Monitor inventory levels and reorder points to prevent stockouts and minimize excess inventory
Conduct cycle counts and physical inventories to ensure inventory accuracy
Investigate and resolve inventory discrepancies promptly
Track critical spare parts and ensure appropriate stocking levels are maintained
Maintain accurate record of rebuildable inventory parts and communicate status updates

Parts Room Operations

Receive, inspect, and verify incoming materials and parts for accuracy and condition
Organize, label, and store inventory in a clean, safe, and efficient manner
Aid in the issuing of materials to maintenance and operations personnel while ensuring accurate transaction recording
Maintain proper location control and identification of all stocked items
Keep the storeroom organized and ready for auditing

Maintenance Support

Work closely with maintenance planners, supervisors, and technicians to support planned and emergency work.
Identify critical spare part needs for preventive and predictive maintenance activities.
Assist in researching replacement parts and identifying approved alternatives when needed.
Support equipment reliability initiatives by maintaining accurate parts information and equipment associations.

Purchasing and Vendor Coordination

Generate purchase requisitions and assist with procurement activities.
Communicate with vendors regarding pricing, availability, lead times, and delivery schedules.
Follow up on outstanding orders and expedite critical materials when necessary.
Help identify opportunities for cost savings through vendor negotiations, standardization, and inventory optimization.

Continuous Improvement

Identify opportunities to improve inventory accuracy, storeroom efficiency, and maintenance support processes.
Assist with inventory standardization and obsolete material reduction projects.
Develop and maintain documentation, procedures, and best practices.
Support reliability and maintenance excellence initiatives.
Support housekeeping and 5S initiatives within the parts room

Qualifications
Education & Experience:

High school diploma or equivalent with 3+ years of experience in inventory control, maintenance storeroom operations, warehousing, or a related field
Degree in business, supply chain, industrial maintenance, or related field
Experience with JDE, SAP, Maximo, or similar systems
Forklift certification or ability to become certified
Experience in manufacturing, mining, processing, or industrial environment

Skills & Abilities:

Strong computer skills and experience with ERP, CMMS, or inventory management systems
Knowledge of industrial maintenance parts, equipment, and materials
Ability to read and interpret vendor catalogs, equipment manuals, and parts breakdowns
Strong organizational and attention-to-detail skills
Valid driver's license
Knowledge of inventory optimization and reliability practices

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):

Inventory accuracy percentage
Cycle count completion rate
“Out of Stock” frequency
Critical spare availability
Purchase order turnaround time
Storeroom audit scores
Obsolete inventory reduction
Maintenance customer satisfaction

Physical Requirements:

Ability to lift and move materials up to established company limits
Ability to stand, walk, bend, and reach for extended periods
Ability to operate forklifts and material-handling equipment safely
Ability to work in industrial environments with varying temperatures and conditions

Compensation & Benefits

Competitive pay & annual bonus
401(k) with 6% company match
Paid parental leave, generous PTO, & paid holidays
Work-life balance
Career growth with exposure to senior leadership.
Annual Merit increase opportunity
Fitness & Gym Reimbursement
Employer Contribution - Health, Dental

About Us
Oil-Dri Corporation of America is a leading manufacturer and supplier of specialty sorbent products for consumer and business-to-business markets that has been voted as a Top 100 workplaces in the Chicago Tribune. Oil-Dri’s products are sold in the pet care, animal health, fluids purification, agricultural, sports field, industrial and automotive markets. Oil-Dri controls millions of tons of specialty mineral reserves, including calcium bentonite, attapulgite, and diatomaceous shale. The company’s mines and manufacturing facilities are located in Georgia, Mississippi, Illinois, and California. Oil-Dri is a family-controlled and operated organization that emphasizes honesty, integrity, and accountability. The company is dedicated to fulfilling its mission to Create Value From Sorbent Minerals.

Our customers include owners and operators in retail fueling, including car washes, and commercial/industrial markets.     troubleshooting, issue resolution, and user support.

    decision-making.

title: Maintenance and Repair Technician
description:
Maintenance and Repair Technician


We are seeking a skilled candidate to serve as the lead Maintenance and Repair Technician at a full-service materials testing laboratory. The ideal candidate will be responsible for the repair and maintenance of various mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, and pneumatic testing equipment, with fabrication and assembly of components and systems. This role involves working with a variety of materials, operating fabrication equipment such as mills and lathes, performing light welding, working with plumbing and fixturing, and troubleshooting instrumentation and electronics. The Technician will be chiefly responsible for the maintenance and upkeep of a wide variety of machines and equipment to support testing operations.


Responsibilities

Equipment Repair & Maintenance

  • Fabricate, repair, and maintain test equipment for outside sales, on-premises use, and inter-laboratory support.
  • Inspect, diagnose, troubleshoot, and repair mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, pneumatic, and laboratory testing equipment.
  • Identify equipment defects or failures, determine appropriate repairs or modifications, and return equipment to proper working conditions.
  • Perform preventive maintenance and routine upkeep to minimize equipment downtime and support laboratory testing operations.

Fabrication & Assembly

  • Perform fabrication, modification, repair, and assembly of components using wood, metal, plastics, and other materials.
  • Build and modify fixtures, components, and equipment to meet testing and laboratory requirements.
  • Use power tools, hand tools, drilling and tapping equipment, and other shop equipment safely and effectively.
  • Read measurements, drawings, schematics, and other technical documentation to fabricate and assemble components accurately.

Machining & Welding

  • Familiarity with operating milling machines and lathes to help build and modify parts.
  • Measure, cut, drill, tap, and fabricate components accurately.
  • Perform light welding and related fabrication tasks as needed.

CAD & Technical Documentation

  • Use CAD software, such as AutoCAD, SolidWorks, or similar platforms, to create or modify equipment designs, components, fixtures, and technical drawings.
  • Read and interpret engineering drawings, mechanical drawings, electrical schematics, and plumbing diagrams.
  • Create or update drawings and documentation to support equipment repairs, fabrication, assembly, and future maintenance.

Electrical, Instrumentation & Hydraulic Systems

  • Wire, troubleshoot, and repair instrumentation, sensors, electrical components, and data acquisition systems.
  • Work with air, water, and hydraulic systems, including pressure fittings, tubing, plumbing, and related components.

Vendor & Customer Support

  • Coordinate with outside vendors regarding equipment repairs, replacement components, technical questions, and maintenance requirements.
  • Inspect and evaluate customer equipment submitted for repair, identify deficiencies or failures, and perform appropriate repairs or modifications.
  • Communicate repair status, equipment issues, and technical requirements with customers, vendors, engineers, and laboratory personnel.

Engineering & Laboratory Support

  • Work under the direction of the Engineering team to develop practical equipment modifications, fixtures, and repair solutions.
  • Collaborate with laboratory technicians and engineers to improve equipment reliability, functionality, and efficiency.
  • Support the development, assembly, testing, and implementation of new or modified laboratory equipment.
  • Perform other duties as assigned to support the team and organization.

title: Document Control Coordinator
description:
Document Control Coordinator (Full Time Contract)
South Vancouver, BC

We are looking for a highly organized and detail-oriented Document Control Coordinator to join Wesgroup’s records digitization project through the end of 2027. Reporting to the Manager, Office Services, you will play an important role in transforming our physical records into an organized and accessible digital archive, with responsibility for document preparation, scanning, quality control and file organization.
This role is ideal for someone who thrives in structured environments, takes pride in producing high-quality work, and enjoys bringing order and accuracy to large volumes of information. As part of a significant company-wide records initiative, you will help preserve and improve access to critical organizational information for years to come.
ABOUT WESGROUP
Wesgroup started as a family business in British Columbia 70 years ago and today is one of Western Canada’s largest private real estate companies with a diversified portfolio spanning across residential and commercial real estate. Wesgroup owns and manages over 4.4 million square feet of commercial and multi-family real estate and has built almost 10,000 homes in communities across BC. With the active projects in our development pipeline, the portfolio is forecasted to grow to 6.7 million square feet by the end of 2031.
Our operations are vertically integrated, encompassing land acquisition, construction, finance, design, marketing, sales, leasing, and property management. We have a long history of looking forward and we are dedicated to conducting business in line with our values of adaptability, accountability, relationships, and observing The Golden Rule without fail.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Prepare documents for scanning by removing staples, paper clips, bindings, and other fasteners.
Operate high-volume scanning equipment and upload files to designated document management systems.
Perform quality assurance checks to ensure scanned images are complete, accurate, and legible.
Organize and track records throughout the digitization process while maintaining accurate project documentation.
Monitor processing volumes and maintain efficient workflow standards.
Handle confidential and sensitive information in accordance with company policies.
Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment.
Lift, carry, and move bankers' boxes weighing up to 40 lbs.
Work effectively in a warehouse or records storage environment.
Support additional records management and administrative activities as required.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

1-2 years of experience in document control, records management, document scanning, or a related administrative role.

Exceptional attention to detail and ability to follow established procedures.

Comfortable performing repetitive tasks while maintaining a high level of quality.

Organized, dependable, and able to work independently with minimal supervision.
Strong time management skills and ability to maintain productivity while meeting deadlines.

Able to perform the physical requirements of the role, including standing for extended periods and lifting bankers' boxes weighing up to 40 lbs.

Reliable, punctual, and committed to successfully completing the full contract term.
Proficient with basic computer applications and file management systems.
Ability to work independently and manage priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Opportunity to earn a performance bonus based on the achievement of key project milestones and successful completion of the full contract term.

title: Senior Data Scientist, Marketing Measurement, Consumer Solutions
description:
Labcorp is a global leader in laboratory services, providing the insights and answers that help healthcare providers, patients, researchers, pharmaceutical companies and health systems make confident decisions and improve outcomes. Through our unparalleled science, data, technology and laboratory network, we advance diagnostics, accelerate innovation and help address some of the world’s most important health challenges. As we shape the future of healthcare, we are leveraging advanced technologies, intelligent digital solutions and data-driven innovation across our operations to enhance how work gets done and deliver greater value to customers and patients. With our global scale and deep expertise, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, grow your career and make a real impact on people’s health around the world. Together, we’re improving health and improving lives.


Senior Data Scientist, Marketing Measurement, Consumer Solutions

Labcorp is seeking a Senior Data Scientist, Marketing Measurement, Consumer Solutions, to join our team in Burlington, NC or Durham, NC with the flexibility of a hybrid work schedule!

Responsibilities:

  • Lead Labcorp OnDemand's marketing measurement strategy, establishing scalable, privacy-compliant frameworks for performance tracking across all marketing channels.

  • Partner with Marketing, Data Engineering, IT, Privacy, and Analytics teams to build a unified marketing data model connecting campaign, customer journey, and business outcome data.

  • Define and govern KPI definitions, event taxonomies, attribution methodologies, tagging frameworks, and campaign tracking standards.

  • Develop and evolve reporting capabilities that deliver actionable insights to executive, marketing, and analytics stakeholders.

  • Build and maintain multi-touch attribution models to improve understanding of channel contribution and customer acquisition journeys.

  • Lead the evaluation, development, and optimization of Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM) capabilities to inform budget allocation and investment decisions.

  • Design and execute incrementality studies, lift tests, geo-based experiments, and other measurement frameworks to validate marketing effectiveness.

  • Develop predictive models and forecasting capabilities to support customer acquisition, lifetime value analysis, and growth planning.

  • Analyze full-funnel performance to identify opportunities to improve marketing efficiency, effectiveness, and return on investment.

  • Translate complex analytical findings into clear business recommendations for marketing leaders and executive stakeholders.

  • Evaluate measurement technologies, analytics platforms, and external partners to advance the organization's measurement capabilities.

  • Serve as the subject matter expert for marketing measurement, attribution, experimentation, and media effectiveness.

  • Support the development of a scalable marketing analytics and data science function, helping define future team structure, processes, and best practices.

  • Drive continuous innovation in marketing analytics and optimization methodologies to support long-term business growth.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Economics, Econometrics, Mathematics, Data Science, Computer Science, or Analytics.

  • 7 or more years of experience in marketing analytics, data science, marketing measurement, econometrics, or media effectiveness.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Advanced degree in Statistics, Economics, Econometrics, Data Science or Applied Mathematics.

Additional Job Standards:

  • Experience developing or managing Marketing Mix Models (MMM).

  • Experience with incrementality testing, geo-experiments, lift studies, and causal measurement methodologies.

  • Experience working in healthcare, diagnostics, eCommerce, consumer health, or highly regulated industries.

  • Familiarity with modern marketing technology and data platforms including Freshpaint, Adobe CJA, Databricks, Snowflake, and customer data platforms.

  • Experience evaluating or managing third-party measurement vendors and analytics partners.

  • Demonstrated experience leading complex analytics initiatives and influencing senior stakeholders through data-driven recommendations.

  • Strong background in digital marketing measurement, attribution, experimentation, and performance analytics.

  • Experience working cross-functionally with marketing, technology, analytics, and data engineering teams.

Skills and Competencies:

  • Advanced statistical modeling and econometric analysis.

  • Expertise in experimental design, causal inference, Bayesian statistics, and hypothesis testing.

  • Strong proficiency in Python and SQL.

  • Experience with visualization and reporting tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms.

  • Familiarity with Marketing Mix Modeling frameworks, attribution methodologies, and marketing analytics best practices.

  • Experience building predictive models and machine learning solutions in production environments.

About the Role

The Senior Data Scientist, Marketing Measurement is responsible for building and scaling Labcorp OnDemand's marketing measurement, attribution, analytics, and optimization capabilities. This role serves as the strategic owner of marketing measurement, partnering across marketing, data engineering, IT, privacy, and analytics teams to develop a unified marketing data foundation that enables accurate reporting, attribution, experimentation, and media investment optimization. The role will lead development of advanced measurement methodologies including Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM), Multi-Touch Attribution (MTA), incrementality testing, lift studies, customer journey analytics, and forecasting. Additionally, this individual will establish reporting standards, define measurement frameworks, and develop scalable analytics solutions that translate complex data into actionable business recommendations. The ideal candidate combines deep expertise in econometrics, statistics, and marketing analytics with the ability to influence senior stakeholders and shape long-term marketing investment strategy.

Applicants will follow a hybrid schedule that includes a minimum of three in-office days per week at the Burlington, NC or Durham, NC location, supporting both collaboration and flexibility.

Benefits: Employees regularly scheduled to work 20 or more hours per week are eligible for comprehensive benefits including: Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, STD/LTD, 401(k), Paid Time Off (PTO) or Flexible Time Off (FTO), Tuition Reimbursement and Employee Stock Purchase Plan. title: Sr. Analyst, Credit Risk Vendor Management
description:
At FNBO, our employees are the heart of our story—and we’re committed to their success! Please see below the details of this career opportunity and how it fits into our organization’s success.

Summary of the Job:

The Senior Analyst, Vendor Management – Credit Risk plays a critical role in supporting FNBO's Credit Risk division by managing and optimizing vendor relationships that directly support credit risk operations, analytics, and decisioning. This role partners closely with Credit Risk leadership, internal business stakeholders, and external vendors to ensure FNBO receives maximum value from its credit risk vendor portfolio while maintaining compliance with contractual obligations, regulatory standards, and organizational risk appetite. The Senior Analyst also serves as a key contributor to executive-level reporting and strategic planning initiatives, including quarterly business reviews and annual executive briefings focused on the evolving credit risk vendor landscape.

About This Role:

Cost Tracking & Financial Management

  • Monitor and track expenditures for Credit Risk vendors against approved budgets, identifying variances and escalating discrepancies as needed.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date cost tracking records across all active Credit Risk vendor relationships, including credit bureau data providers, scoring model vendors, and analytics platforms.
  • Develop and maintain financial models and dashboards to support Credit Risk vendor spend analysis and forecasting.
  • Collaborate with Finance and Procurement teams to ensure Credit Risk vendor invoices are reconciled and processed accurately.
  • Identify cost optimization opportunities across the Credit Risk vendor portfolio and present findings with supporting data to leadership.

Contract Negotiations & Governance

  • Support end-to-end contract lifecycle activities for Credit Risk vendors, including renewals, amendments, and new vendor agreements for services such as credit data, model validation, and risk analytics.
  • Conduct research and benchmarking to inform negotiation strategies and ensure competitive pricing for Credit Risk-specific products and services.
  • Coordinate with Legal, Compliance, and Risk teams to ensure Credit Risk vendor contracts meet FNBO's standards, regulatory requirements, and fair lending obligations.
  • Maintain a centralized contract repository for Credit Risk vendors, tracking key milestones, renewal dates, and SLA obligations.
  • Assist in drafting contract summaries, redlines, and negotiation briefs for Credit Risk stakeholder review.

Analytical & Business-Requested Projects

  • Execute ad hoc analytical projects requested by Credit Risk business stakeholders, delivering actionable insights and recommendations related to vendor performance, data quality, and model effectiveness.
  • Design and produce reports, scorecards, and visualizations to communicate Credit Risk vendor performance and program health to internal audiences.
  • Conduct vendor benchmarking, market research, and competitive analysis to support strategic decisions within the Credit Risk function.
  • Partner with Credit Risk analysts, model developers, and operations teams to assess vendor capabilities and alignment with credit strategy objectives.
  • Support RFP/RFI processes for Credit Risk vendor selections by compiling evaluation criteria, scoring vendor responses, and summarizing findings.

Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs)

  • Lead preparation and coordination of Quarterly Business Reviews with key Credit Risk vendors and internal stakeholders, including Credit Risk leadership and operations teams.
  • Compile and analyze performance data, SLA metrics, data quality indicators, and financial summaries specific to Credit Risk vendor engagements.
  • Develop presentation materials, talking points, and supporting documentation for QBR sessions, ensuring alignment with Credit Risk priorities and ongoing initiatives.
  • Track action items and follow-up commitments arising from QBRs, ensuring timely resolution and accountability.

title: Specialist, Data & Business Process
description:
Location: Calgary, Edmonton, Red Deer, AB.

Employment Type: Full Time – Permanent

Salary Range: T3, Level 5, $102,000 - $120,000 per year. The final compensation for this position will be determined based on individual factors, including education, qualifications, experience, and internal equity.

Specialist, Data & Business Process

The Opportunity­­

The Alberta Energy Regulator (AER) is seeking a Specialist, Data & Business Process to join its talented team of professionals in the Regulatory Applications (RA) Branch. This new and exciting opportunity will help shape how Regulatory Applications uses data, strengthens and capitalizes on process improvement, advances automation, and applies emerging digital tools to move important work forward. This is not a traditional data analyst or IT role — it is a business-facing opportunity, working closely with Regulatory Applications teams to connect data, processes, systems, and regulatory work to identify opportunities and support branch-wide improvements.

You will play a key role in strengthening data stewardship, improving data quality and accessibility, and turning operational information into clear insights that support credible, risk-informed, and evidence-based regulatory decision making. This role is well suited to someone who enjoys solving practical business problems, connecting data to decision-making, and helping teams adopt better tools, workflows, and practices that create lasting value for Regulatory Applications and the broader AER.

What your day-to-day will look like:

  • Foster and develop data stewardship by strengthening data governance and improving data integrity, quality, and accessibility using your expertise and capacity to meet current and future business needs.

  • Turn data into meaningful insight by building and maintaining reports, dashboards, visualizations, and analytics that help Regulatory Applications understand trends, monitor performance, and make informed operational and regulatory decisions.

  • Partner with branch subject matter experts to understand business challenges, map current and future processes, and deliver practical improvements that make work more consistent, efficient, and effective.

  • Help move the branch forward by developing and supporting automation and AI-enabled solutions that reduce manual effort, strengthen data readiness and quality controls, and promote responsible use of digital tools.

  • Use your understanding of AER systems, branch processes, data sources, and reporting structures to connect how information moves through the business and identify opportunities to improve how work gets done.

  • Build strong relationships across Regulatory Applications and partner teams by translating complex data, process, and system information into clear advice that helps stakeholders adopt better practices, procedures, and tools.

What we’re looking for in you:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business intelligence, data analytics, data science or a related field.

  • 5+ years of relevant experience in business intelligence.

  • You bring strong knowledge of data governance, business intelligence, reporting, analytics, process improvement, workflow optimization, and related tools such as Excel, Access, SQL, Tableau, Power BI, Cognos, FME, Python, SharePoint, Power Automate, or similar tools.

  • You understand AER regulatory processes, systems, data sources, and how application data supports decisions, reporting, strategic priorities, and responsible AI adoption.

  • You enjoy solving complex problems across data, processes, systems, and stakeholder needs and can turn analysis into clear recommendations, reporting, and practical business insights.

  • You can work independently, manage small projects or branch processes, identify inefficiencies, document workflows, and help implement improvements that support operational priorities.

  • You are a clear communicator and relationship builder who can explain complex data, process, and system information and influence adoption of improved practices, procedures, and tools.

Additional Information:

  • All applicants must be legally entitled to work in Canada at the time of application.

  • Should an individual with the required qualifications not be available, applicants with closely related qualifications may be considered. As a result, the position may be redesigned and/or reclassified.

  • If you need accommodation during any stage of the recruitment process, please email PeopleServices@aer.ca. Information relating to the need for accommodation and accommodation measures will be addressed confidentially.

What we offer you:

  • Opportunity to make a difference and be part of a performance driven team that is responsible for the efficient, safe, orderly, and environmentally responsible development of Alberta’s energy and mineral resources.

  • The ability to leverage your expertise and critical thinking skills to contribute in wide-ranging, challenging, and complex work.

  • Robust total reward packages including; a competitive compensation program, defined benefit pension plan(s), flexible benefits, and wellness programs.

  • Flexible work options and hours, aligned with organizational policies.


More information about working at the AER’s including our comprehensive Total Rewards package can be found in the careers section of our website.

Our Commitment to Diversity:

At the AER, our values of Accountability, Collaboration, Transparency, and Trust & Respect are foundational to our culture – a culture where every individual, regardless of race, colour, religion, gender, national origin, age, disability, or any other legally protected factors, thrives and contributes their unique perspectives.

Our commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion fuels innovation, creating a brighter, more sustainable Alberta for all. Join us in shaping this dynamic future.

This role will spend approximately 65% of its time supporting Hillcrest Silver Ridge and 35% supporting Hillcrest Highlands of Gretna, helping residents get to appointments, outings, and other scheduled destinations safely and comfortably.
At Hillcrest, our mission is simple: Inspiring people to live their best lives. As a Chauffeur, you will help bring that mission to life by providing safe, dependable transportation while also supporting vehicle care, documentation, recreation needs, and other community responsibilities when needed.
What You’ll Do
As a Chauffeur, you will work closely with community teams to coordinate transportation, maintain company vehicles, and provide a positive experience for residents throughout each trip.
You will:

Safely transport residents to and from scheduled appointments using Hillcrest vehicles.

Provide transportation support primarily for Hillcrest Silver Ridge and regularly assist Hillcrest Highlands of Gretna.

Help coordinate transportation schedules and communicate with residents regarding transportation needs.

Provide friendly, respectful, and professional assistance throughout each resident’s trip.

Complete required mileage documentation and incident reports when necessary.

Inspect vehicles before and after transportation trips.

Refuel vehicles and ensure appropriate fuel levels are maintained.

Monitor vehicle condition and promptly communicate maintenance or safety concerns.

Help keep Hillcrest vehicles clean, organized, and ready for use.

Support transportation needs for resident outings, special events, and community activities.

Assist the Recreation team with special events when needed.

Support transportation needs of other Hillcrest service lines when appropriate.

Assist with maintenance and housekeeping responsibilities as operational needs allow.

Transport recyclable materials to the recycling center as needed.

Purchase snacks and beverages for community vending machines.

Assist with cleaning, stocking, and maintaining vending machines.

Work collaboratively with Administrative, Environmental Services, Recreation, and community leadership teams.

Assist with additional transportation and community responsibilities as assigned.

The position combines resident transportation, vehicle inspections and maintenance, documentation, community support, and coordination across both Hillcrest Silver Ridge and Hillcrest Highlands of Gretna.
What We’re Looking For
We are looking for someone who takes safety seriously, enjoys working with aging adults, and understands that dependable transportation is an important part of helping residents stay active and connected.
The right candidate will be patient, flexible, and comfortable moving between two Hillcrest communities based on transportation needs. You should be someone who can manage a changing schedule, communicate clearly, and provide a consistently positive experience for residents.
Ideal candidates will have:

A safe and responsible driving history.

Previous experience as a chauffeur, driver, transportation specialist, senior living team member, customer-service professional, or similar role preferred.

A genuine interest in working with aging adults.

Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

A friendly, patient, and service-focused approach.

Strong attention to vehicle safety and maintenance needs.

Dependability and consistent follow-through with scheduled transportation.

Strong organization and time-management skills.

Ability to manage transportation needs across multiple communities.

Flexibility to adjust based on resident appointments, outings, and operational priorities.

Ability to remain calm and professional in stressful or unexpected situations.

Willingness to assist other departments when transportation responsibilities allow.

Comfort using technology and other resources needed to coordinate transportation.

Ability to work independently while remaining part of a collaborative team.

Education & Credentials

High school diploma or equivalent required.

At least one year of experience in a similar position preferred.

Valid driver’s license required.

Must maintain an acceptable driving record and meet applicable Hillcrest insurance requirements.

Why Hillcrest?
Transportation can have a meaningful impact on a resident’s independence and quality of life.
A ride to an appointment, community outing, or special event helps residents stay connected to the people, activities, and services that matter to them. As a Chauffeur, you will have the opportunity to build relationships with residents while helping them travel safely and confidently.
This role also provides variety. You will primarily serve Hillcrest Silver Ridge, while regularly supporting Hillcrest Highlands of Gretna, allowing you to build relationships with residents and team members across both communities.
The approximate 65/35 split provides a consistent primary home at Silver Ridge while giving you the opportunity to support transportation needs across more than one Hillcrest community.
What Hillcrest Offers

Competitive compensation.

Primary assignment at Hillcrest Silver Ridge with regular support for Hillcrest Highlands of Gretna.

Approximately 65% Silver Ridge / 35% Highlands schedule distribution.

Supportive leadership and collaborative community teams.

Professional development and career-growth opportunities.

Dayforce Wallet, allowing you to choose when you get paid.

Gym membership reimbursement and partner discounts.

Opportunities to build relationships across multiple Hillcrest communities.

Opportunities to grow within a mission-driven senior care organization.

Physical & Other Requirements

Must be able to speak, read, and write English.

Must be able to independently lift up to 35 pounds.

Must be able to perform repetitive sitting, bending, standing, walking, reaching, lifting, and movement as needed.

Must be flexible and calm when working with residents, families, or team members during stressful situations.

Must be able to safely operate company vehicles and follow applicable traffic and safety requirements.

Must maintain a valid driver’s license and meet applicable insurance requirements.

Must be comfortable traveling between Hillcrest Silver Ridge and Hillcrest Highlands of Gretna.

Must be able to work in a fast-paced environment with strong attention to detail.

Must be able to utilize technology and available resources efficiently and effectively.

Possible exposure to communicable diseases and bodily fluids.

Other duties as assigned.

Ready to Help Keep Our Residents Moving?
If you are dependable, safety-focused, flexible, and enjoy helping aging adults stay active and connected, we invite you to apply for the Chauffeur – Hillcrest Silver Ridge & Hillcrest Highlands of Gretna position.
Join Hillcrest Health & Living and help us continue inspiring people to live their best lives through safe transportation, dependable service, and meaningful connections across our communities.

description:

Description

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Northrop Grumman Mission Systems has opportunities for Embedded Engineers to join our team in San Diego, CA.

Join Northrop Grumman on our continued mission to push the boundaries of possible across land, sea, air, space, and cyberspace. In this role you will design, develop, integrate and test software for our end-user customers and businesses, primarily focused on cryptographic software code bases. Specifically, you will be responsible for the design, architecture, development, and administration of embedded and real time systems. You will work with multi-disciplinary teams, such as with Systems Engineering, Digital Engineering, Hardware, and Integration & Test, in an Agile software development environment. You will analyze system capabilities to resolve problems on program intent, output requirements, input data acquisition, programming techniques and controls.

This position is contingent upon program award, clearance and customer approval.

Basic Qualifications for Sr. Principal Engineer:

  • Bachelor of Science degree in a STEM (Science Technology, Engineering or Math) discipline AND 8 Years of experience in a related field; or 6 Years of Experience with a Masters; or 4 years of experience with a PhD

  • Ability to obtain and maintain Special Program Access (PAR) as determined by business needs

Preferred Qualifications:

  • An active U.S. government Secret clearance or higher (with background investigation completed within the last 6 years or currently enrolled into Continuous Evaluation)

  • Proficient in C/C++

  • Proficient in Object Oriented programming

  • Proficient in all areas of the formal software lifecycle process from requirements to testing

  • Experience integrating low-level firmware and software in complex real-time multi-threaded embedded applications

  • Experience with developing and debugging embedded real-time systems.

  • Experience using Jira/Bitbucket/Git and the Agile software development process

  • Familiarity with HAIPE, OTNK, and/or IKE

  • Experience implementing cryptographic mechanisms using dedicated software libraries

  • Experience with Xilinx platforms (Zynq, Ultrascale+ and VERSAL)

  • Experience with TCP/IP and common network configurations

  • Familiarity with Link 16/TACAN Waveform Standard Documents

  • Experience in testing and troubleshooting Link16 waveform in an embedded software environment

  • Hands-on experience with lab equipment such as Tactical Datalink radios/terminals

  • Familiarity with Common Object Request Broker Architecture (CORBA)

  • Experience with Software Defined Radios

title: Master Data Management & Vendor Success Leader
location: Brentwood, TN, US; Atlanta, GA, US
description:
What We Need
CORPAY is currently looking to hire a Master Data Management & Vendor Success Leader within our Operations division. This position falls under our Corpay Payables’ Data & Analytics line of business and is located in Atlanta, Nashville, or Beaverton offices. In this role, you will responsible for the strategy, governance, quality, and day-to-day effectiveness of the master data that supports our business operations, while also overseeing the daily operations and execution of the Vendor Success team.

This leader will step into an established MDM function and Vendor Success operating model, taking ownership of teams whose work directly impacts real-time operational processes across Corpay Payables. The Leader will provide strategic direction while remaining close to the data, systems, workflows, partner activities, client enablement processes, and business operations required to identify issues, resolve root causes, and ensure critical data and vendor-related processes are accurate, trusted, accessible, and fit for purpose.

The Leader will define and advance the MDM strategy and operating model while partnering closely with Operations, Technology, Engineering, Product, Finance, Analytics, Vendor Success, and other business stakeholders. This role will be accountable for strengthening data governance and stewardship, improving data quality and consistency, advancing MDM and metadata capabilities, ensuring master data supports operational execution, analytics & reporting, and emerging AI use cases, and ensuring

Vendor Success operations are well-controlled, measurable, and aligned to business priorities.
Success requires a leader who can move comfortably between executive-level strategy and detailed data and operational discussions; someone who can establish standards and direction, develop strong teams, influence across the organization, and roll up their sleeves when a business, data, partner, or client issue requires deeper investigation.

You will report directly to SVP of Operational Excellence and regularly collaborate with teams and departments.

How We Work
As a Leader you will be expected to work in an office environment. CORPAY will set you up for success by providing:

Assigned workspace in Atlanta, GA or Brentwood, TN office.
Company-issued equipment + remote access

Role Responsibilities
The responsibilities of the role will include:

Owning and continuously evolve the MDM strategy, roadmap, operating model, and priorities for Corpay Payables, aligning investments with business and Data & Analytics objectives.
Leading, mentoring, and developing the MDM team, establishing clear accountability, performance expectations, development objectives, and a culture of ownership and continuous improvement.
Remaining actively engaged in the data, systems, and operational workflows, personally helping investigate complex data issues, validate root causes, and determine appropriate solutions when needed.
Serving as the senior point of accountability for the quality, consistency, availability, and appropriate use of critical master and reference data across the organization.
Establishing and maintaining enterprise data governance standards, policies, controls, and decision rights governing the creation, modification, use, retention, and lifecycle of master data.
Defining clear data ownership and stewardship models and partner with business leaders to ensure appropriate accountability for data quality within individual domains.
Leading or actively participate in Data Governance Councils and steering forums, helping prioritize data issues, resolve ownership questions, and drive adoption of governance standards.
Overseeing key master and reference data domains, primarily focused on vendor data which drives significant value, as well as payment, customer, product and other operational data critical to Corpay Payables.
Partnering closely with Operations to ensure MDM processes support day-to-day business execution and to rapidly identify and address data issues that may affect operational performance.
Overseeing day-to-day operations of the Vendor Success team, ensuring clear ownership, prioritization, service-level expectations, and execution discipline across recurring operating activities, escalations, and cross-functional support needs.
Providing leadership for Vendor Success partner-management responsibilities, including ongoing operating relationships, enablement, exception reporting, cancellation/biller-update processes, and data-pull or match activities with partners such as Billtrust, Boost, BillGo, and Rampart.
Overseeing client-management and enablement activities for iPay, Fiserv, and related client programs, including vendor communications, daily payment-file reviews, monthly matching, vendor/RPPS enablement and tagging, campaign data preparation, campaign analysis, and support coordination.
Leading Vendor Success data, reporting, and operational visibility efforts, including dashboard development, daily and weekly flip metrics, campaign analytics, performance reporting, and executive-level insights that improve enrollment, vendor engagement, and operational outcomes.
Ensuring effective management of Bizpay MDM and matching activities, including Cortex active batch matching, ACH match outputs, vendor record upkeep, recipient address validation, continuous vendor-overlap monitoring, and BIN-block processes.
Maintaining strong operational support practices for Vendor Success, including partner and enterprise vendor escalations, support-case assistance, phone-number and RPPS trace-number research, ticket-system development, ticket assignment, SOP ownership, systems access, source/configuration control, and continuous process improvement.
Establishing data quality standards, service-level expectations, scorecards, and key performance indicators that provide visibility into data health and drive measurable improvement.
Leading data profiling, cleansing, standardization, deduplication, enrichment, entity resolution, and harmonization efforts across large and complex datasets.
Identifying recurring data defects and work across Data & Analytics, Operations, and Technology to address underlying process or system causes rather than relying solely on downstream data correction.
Defining and continuously improve master data creation, validation, approval, exception-management, and maintenance workflows to improve accuracy, control, and processing efficiency.
Establishing appropriate standard operating procedures, controls, documentation, and auditability across critical MDM processes.
Overseeing the selection, implementation, enhancement, and ongoing optimization of MDM technologies and related data-management capabilities.
Partnering with Technology, Enterprise Architecture, and Engineering to ensure MDM solutions integrate effectively with enterprise platforms, data pipelines, operational applications, and cloud data environments.
Partnering with Analytics, BI, Data Engineering, and AI teams to ensure master data is sufficiently accurate, governed, documented, and contextualized to support advanced analytics and AI-enabled use cases.
Ensuring MDM practices support applicable data privacy, security, and regulatory requirements.
Ensuring processes to identify, monitor, communicate, and mitigate data risks, quality issues, dependencies, and operational impacts are in place and effective.
Translating data-management priorities and technical issues into clear business implications, recommendations, and decisions for senior leaders and executive stakeholders.
Developing executive-level reporting on MDM performance, data quality, program progress, risks, adoption, and business outcomes.
Driving organizational adoption of MDM and data-governance practices by establishing practical standards that improve control and trust without unnecessarily slowing business execution.
Managing external technology and service-provider relationships, and vendor commitments.

Qualifications & Skills

Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Data Science, Business, Engineering, Finance, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
8+ years of progressive experience in Master Data Management, data management, data governance, data quality, data engineering, enterprise data strategy, or related disciplines.
Significant leadership and people-management experience, including responsibility for developing and leading high-performing data teams.
Experience leading operational teams responsible for recurring daily, weekly, monthly, and ongoing execution across partner management, client support, reporting, escalations, and process improvement.
Demonstrated ability to establish operating discipline, SOPs, ownership models, performance metrics, and continuous-improvement routines for teams supporting complex business workflows.
Demonstrated experience leading, scaling, or materially advancing an enterprise MDM or data-governance program.
Strong understanding of MDM principles, data governance, stewardship, data ownership, data lifecycle management, data quality, metadata, lineage, classification, and related controls.
Hands-on experience working with large and complex datasets, including data profiling, cleansing, standardization, reconciliation, deduplication, root-cause investigation, and data-quality remediation.
Strong analytical and problem-solving capability, including the ability to move from high-level business issues into detailed data investigation when necessary.
Experience with MDM technologies, enterprise data platforms, and data integrations.
Working knowledge of SQL or comparable query and analytical techniques used to investigate and validate enterprise data.
Experience establishing measurable data-quality standards, KPIs, service-level expectations, scorecards, and remediation processes.
Demonstrated ability to partner effectively across Operations, Technology, Engineering, Analytics, Product, and other business functions.
Experience leading complex, cross-functional data initiatives and managing priorities, dependencies, risks, and delivery commitments.
Proven ability to communicate complex data and technology concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences, including executive leadership.
Strong executive presence combined with a practical, hands-on leadership style and the ability to influence across organizational boundaries.
Demonstrated ability to drive organizational change and establish adoption of new governance standards, processes, technologies, and ways of working.
Experience within FinTech, payments, financial services, or another high-volume, transaction-oriented environment.
Experience with vendor success, vendor enablement, partner operations, payment-file review, campaign support, vendor matching, or related payables operations.
Experience with leading MDM platforms such as Informatica, Reltio, Atakama, Profisee, Syniti, or comparable enterprise technologies.
Familiarity with modern cloud and data platforms such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Microsoft Fabric.
Familiarity with Python or similar scripting capabilities used for data profiling, enrichment, analysis, or rapid prototyping.
Understanding of AI, machine learning, generative AI, conversational analytics, or agentic technologies and the data-quality, metadata, semantic, and governance conditions required to support them effectively.

Benefits & Perks

Medical, Dental & Vision benefits available the 1st month after hire

Automatic enrollment into our 401k plan (subject to eligibility requirements)
Virtual fitness classes offered company-wide
Robust PTO offerings including major holidays, vacation, sick, personal, & volunteer time
Employee discounts with major providers (i.e. wireless, gym, car rental, etc.)
Philanthropic support with both local and national organizations
Fun culture with company-wide contests and prizes

title: Desktop Support Specialist
description:
We are Vista Global Solutions, LLC (VGS), a government contracting and consulting firm supporting several federal agencies and military installations across the U.S. VGS is looking for a qualified Desktop Support Specialist for a full-time, 40-hour/week (Monday – Friday) position providing tiered IT support operations at Fort Sam Houston in San Antonio, TX.
The Desktop Support Specialist’s role is to provide desktop support to the staff at Fort Sam Houston on all user-level information technology resources (desktops/laptops, printers, scanners, etc.). This includes planning, developing, installing, configuring, maintaining, supporting, and optimizing assigned PC-based infrastructure. The Desktop Support Specialist works within a tiered system of support, receiving customer tickets via a DHA-provided work order system, documenting work efforts within the work order system, resolving tickets within the work order system, and/or elevating those tickets to higher levels of support (i.e., Server Administration, Network Administration, Cyber, DHA tiered support, etc.).
What You'll Do:

Deliver the full array of services, staff, and expertise to operate and maintain Help Desk functions, including ticketing, system and operational support, and troubleshooting onsite or remotely as required by Tier I, Tier II, and Tier III technicians.
Develop and update a knowledge base to assist Help Desk personnel in providing consistently correct information to the user.
Perform stress and performance tests on a variety of computer hardware, including circuit boards, processors, and wiring.
Map network drives, install peripherals using remote access, such as print drivers, change software settings, and perform other basic IT-level work.
Set up, maintain, troubleshoot, and repair PCs, peripheral components, and standard software packages.
Install Commercial Off-the-Shelf and Government Off-the-Shelf software, including but not limited to MS Server 2016, MS Windows 11, MS Office (all versions), VT emulation software, MHS GENESIS/Composite Health Care System, and other MTF-specific software (normally for Windows).
Participate in inventory control procedures, ensuring tracking of equipment in and out of the shop with temporary hand receipts for both acceptance and return of equipment.
Participate in weekly technical meetings with the extended team to share and brainstorm resolutions for technical issues.
Utilize specialty tools such as Olympus for printer and device management.
Utilize the DHA Global Service Center platform for the tracking, recording, and prioritization of support for Fort Sam Houston and associated organizations.
Support Incident, Problem, and Request Management processes leveraging the ITIL service framework and best-business practices.
Provide End User Devices (EUD) support services and incident resolution remotely and through touch-labor services to ensure that the end-user operational environment is functional.
Demonstrate proficiency in using Government-provided help desk systems/help desk ticketing software to log, monitor, document, and close network trouble tickets.
Fully document all tickets, including troubleshooting methods employed, root cause analysis, and resolution implemented.
Where problems are recurring, assist the Government in developing standard operating procedures for resolving the problem.
Respond to and diagnose problems through discussions with users and the ServiceNow help desk platform.
Provide a strong customer service attitude at all times.
Perform other duties as assigned within the employee’s skill set.

Some lifting of up to 40 pounds may be required.
May be required to work outside the traditional work schedule. May be called out to work off-shift for on-call or emergency situations. An equivalent amount of compensatory time will be scheduled to maintain a roughly 40-hour work week.
What You Bring:
Required:

CompTIA Security+ certification is required.
Must be a U.S. citizen and able to pass a Government background investigation (T3 for suitability).
May be required to consent to and provide documentation supporting basic immunization/vaccination status (including vaccination for COVID-19) to DHA HQ.

Preferred:

CompTIA A+ or a Microsoft Desktop certification (MCSA Win11, MCTS, MCDST)

What We Offer:
VGS, LLC offers a competitive benefits package to include: paid holidays, paid time off including sick and vacation leave, medical, dental and vision insurance, flexible spending accounts, short and long-term disability, company-paid life insurance, 401(k) with a company match and discretionary profit sharing, and tuition reimbursement.

title: Porter Attendant Courthouse Plaza Garage - Burlington, VT
description:
About Towne

Towne is an exceptional arrival through departure experience company. title: Executive Director, Head of Strategy & Transformation
description:
Executive Director, Head of Strategy & Transformation

Regeneron’s Global Technology, Engineering, Operations & Application Managed Services (GTEO) runs the technology behind our research, manufacturing, and commercial operations and the $15B+ revenue pipeline they drive. As the company has grown across Europe, Asia-Pacific, and beyond, our technology investments and modernization work have grown with it and so has the need to lead all of it as one coherent program rather than a set of separate efforts. Security and AI now run through everything we build, and the strategy must treat them as built-in from the start, not bolted on later. We are creating this role to do exactly that: put one senior leader in charge of where GTEO is headed, what we invest in, and how we transform the estate to support the next phase of the company’s growth.

The Executive Director, Head of GTEO Strategy & Transformation owns strategy, planning, design, and transformation for the GTEO organization. You will assist in setting the multi-year direction and the standards that guide it, own the investment portfolio and the budget for the function, and lead the major transformation programs through to results. You set the direction and govern the portfolio; the delivery teams continue to execute the projects. You will report to the Global Head of GTEO and be a lead voice on technology strategy and transformation for the organization with senior leaders inside and outside Regeneron.

Where and When:

This is an on-site position 4 days/week, primarily based at our Sleepy Hollow, NY or Warren, NJ office. If eligible, we can offer relocation benefits; we cannot offer a fully remote option.

A typical day in this role looks like:

  • Assisting with the multi-year strategy and architectural direction for GTEO, translating enterprise priorities into a funded roadmap and setting the standards that govern how we invest and modernize.

  • Owning the investment portfolio and the budget end to end: prioritizing and funding against business value and capacity.

  • Leading the major transformation programs from strategy through delivered value, accountable for the business case and the benefits we committed to.

  • Owning and shaping how capacity is allocated so the roadmap is one we can fund, staff, and sequence; procurement and the delivery teams own contracts and execution.

  • Setting direction on technology lifecycle, refresh, and technical-debt retirement as part of the roadmap, with delivery teams owning execution.

  • Prioritizing and funding transformation initiatives sourced from Business Process Excellence & User Experience (BPE/UX) process and experience redesigns and Enterprise Architecture's technology roadmap — completing the sequential model in which BPE/UX designs the experience, EA architects the technology, and S&T funds and delivers.

  • Building security and resilience into the strategy and architecture from the start, setting the standards in close partnership with the CISO organization, which owns security operations and policy.

  • Setting the strategy for how AI is adopted across GTEO, from the platforms and guardrails to the operating model, so the organization scales AI safely and gets real value from it.

  • Building and structuring the transformation functions across strategy, architecture, portfolio, and operations.

  • Partnering with senior leaders across Research, Commercial, IOPS, and our India GCC, and advising technology leadership, to keep the organization’s strategy tied to the business and execution aligned to the roadmap.

  • Representing the program to executive stakeholders with clear reporting, metrics, and audit-ready governance, and benchmarking against industry peers to keep us sharp.

This role might be for you if:

  • You have led strategy, planning, or transformation for a large infrastructure or technology organization and owned the results.

  • You have built and run a technology investment portfolio, deciding what gets funded when resources are tight and demands compete.

  • You have delivered large, complex transformation programs that crossed organizational lines, not just individual projects.

  • You know enough about cloud, network, compute, and platforms to set direction and standards that hold up under scrutiny.

  • You understand how security and AI reshape an enterprise estate, and you can set strategy and standards for both while partnering well with the security organization.

  • You build alignment across senior stakeholders and can drive decisions without relying on direct authority.

  • You have worked in pharma, biotech, or life sciences, with exposure to GxP, regulated environments, or global manufacturing.

  • You have operated in a global company with central strategy and distributed delivery.

This role requires

  • Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Information Management, or a related field. An advanced degree (MS, MBA, or equivalent) is preferred.

  • 15+ years in enterprise infrastructure or technology, with real depth in strategy, portfolio management, and transformation, and exposure to security and AI at enterprise scale.

  • 5+ years leading a strategy, portfolio, or transformation function, including managing people at the Director or Senior Manager level.

  • 3+ years owning portfolio prioritization and investment decisions in a complex, multi-domain environment.

  • A track record leading cross-functional programs with finance, delivery, and senior business stakeholders.

We are seeking a Technical Business Analyst with deep DevSecOps experience for an initial 6-month contract in Sydney to bridge the gap between application security, software engineering squads, and enterprise governance.

In this high-visibility delivery role, you will work embedded within engineering and security teams to translate enterprise security requirements into clear, actionable technical specifications. You will play a key role in integrating security controls, code scanning standards, and automated compliance directly into modern CI/CD software delivery pipelines.

Key Responsibilities

  • DevSecOps Process Mapping: Analyze current software development workflows to identify security bottlenecks, gaps, and opportunities to "shift left" security controls into the SDLC.

  • Requirements & User Stories: Translate complex application security policies, vulnerability management SLAs, and compliance standards into technical user stories, engineering epics, and acceptance criteria.

  • Security Tooling Integration: Partner with DevSecOps Engineers to scope and support the implementation of automated code scanning (SAST, SCA, DAST) and pipeline security gatekeepers.

  • Governance & Runbooks: Document DevSecOps frameworks, technical runbooks, operational support models, and developer guidance materials to ensure seamless platform adoption.

  • Stakeholder Alignment: Facilitate workshops between Security Architects, DevOps leads, Product Owners, and engineering squads to align delivery roadmaps with security posture goals.

Essential Experience:

  • Technical BA Background: Proven track record as a Business Analyst working within complex software engineering, cloud, or cybersecurity environments.

  • DevSecOps Knowledge: Strong understanding of DevSecOps principles, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and software security concepts.

  • AppSec Exposure: Practical familiarity with application security standards (e.g., OWASP Top 10) and code security scanning tools (SAST, SCA, DAST).

  • Agile Delivery: Experience writing technical user stories, managing backlogs, and working inside cross-functional Agile/Scrum delivery squads.

  • Communication & Collaboration: Outstanding stakeholder management skills with the ability to articulate technical security risks to non-technical business partners.

Why NCS?

This is a place for people who like to get stuck in, bring ideas to life and make things happen. You'll work alongside experienced people who care about what they do, contribute to meaningful work and have the support to keep learning and grow your career. Whether you want to deepen your expertise, explore something new or take your career in a different direction, there's room to make it your own. We value Adventure, Excellence, Integrity, Ownership and Unity - bringing curiosity, collaboration and accountability to the way we work with our clients and each other.

Ready to make extraordinary happen?

We'd love to hear from you.

We celebrate diversity and inclusion

We value different perspectives, experiences and strengths our people bring. We're committed to an inclusive workplace where everyone has the opportunity to contribute, grow and succeed, and to providing equal employment opportunities and reasonable adjustments throughout the recruitment process.

title: Ravitsemistyöntekijä Biomedicum
description:
Tule meille Biomedicumin ruokapalveluihin vahvistamaan tiimiämme!

Haemme ravitsemistyöntekijää Biomedicumiin toistaiseksi voimassa olevaan työsuhteeseen.

HUSin tukipalvelut, viralliselta nimeltään Runkopalvelut, vastaa siitä, että sairaalassa on parhaat mahdolliset puitteet potilaiden hoitamiseksi.

Ravitsemistyöntekijänä pääset tekemään meillä monipuolisesti erilaisia ravitsemistyöntekijän työtehtäviä. Työtehtäviisi kuuluu edustustarjoiluja Biomedicumissa ja Meilahden ympäristössä. lisäksi työtehtäviä sijoittuu myös henkilöstöravintolaan, kahvilaan sekä tarpeen mukaan astiahuollon tehtäviin.

Työpaikan sijainti: Biomedicum, Meilahti Helsinki

Työsuhde: vakituinen, 2-vuorotyö (voi sisältää ilta- ja viikonlopputöitä), kokoaikainen 38,25 h/viikko

Työehtosopimus ja palkkaus: HYVTES, tehtäväkohtainen palkka 2578,74 €/kk ja sopimuksen mukaiset lisät

Työn aloitus: 1.10.2026 tai sopimuksen mukaan

Tästä videosta pääset tutustumaan ravitsemistyöntekijän työhön:

Täällä voit tutustua HUSin potilas- ja henkilöstöruokailupalveluihin:

Miksi töihin HUSin Runkopalveluihin?

  • Monipuolisissa potilaan hoitoa tukevissa tehtävissä olet tärkeä osa sairaalamaailmaa.
  • Kattava perehdytys: kukaan ei joudu kylmiltään työntekoon. Saat myös aina apua perehdytyksen jälkeenkin.
  • Rento ja monimuotoinen työyhteisö, johon jokaisen työntekijän on helppoa tulla mukaan. Meillä kaikki auttavat toisiaan parhaansa mukaan ja töitä tehdään yhdessä hyvällä fiiliksellä.
  • Monipuoliset ura- ja koulutusmahdollisuudet, esimerkiksi mahdollisuuksien mukaan koulutus palvelutyöntekijän tehtäviin.
  • Työterveyshuolto, liikunta-, kulttuuri- ja työsuhdematkaetu, tuettu työpaikkaruokailu sekä vaihtuvia henkilökuntaetuja liikunta- ja hyvinvointipalveluista.

Mitä toivomme sinulta?

Ravitsemistyöntekijän tehtävässä edellytetään erityisruokavalioiden tuntemusta. Ilahdumme hyvistä vuorovaikutustaidoista ja iloisesta palveluasenteesta, sillä teet töitä tiiviisti työkavereidesi kanssa asiakkaidemme hyvinvoinnin eteen. Lisäksi toivomme ammattimaista ja reipasta työotetta, koska työ on vaihtelevaa ja jokainen työpäivä voi olla erilainen. Toivomme, että sinulta löytyy hygienia- ja anniskelupassi sekä omavalvonnan osaamista.

Suomen kielen suullinen ja kirjallinen taito on välttämätön. Muu kielitaito katsotaan eduksi.

Näin haet

Lähetä hakemus sähköisen rekrytointijärjestelmämme kautta hakuajan loppuun mennessä. Voimme aloittaa haastattelut jo hakuaikana.

HUSissa olet osa vaikuttavinta hoitoa.

Tehtävän kelpoisuusehdot

Soveltuva toisen asteen ammatillinen koulutus ja soveltuva kokemus.

Kelpoisten ja tehtävään soveltuvien hakijoiden puuttuessa, työnantaja voi palkata määräajaksi henkilön, jolla on riittävä kokemus alalta.

Edellytämme asiakas- ja potilastiloissa työskentelevältä tartuntatautilain mukaista rokotussuojaa, ja terveydenhuollon toimintayksiköissä työskentelevältä terveydentilan selvitystä keuhkotuberkuloosista ja salmonellasta.

Tehtävään valittavan tulee olla täysi-ikäinen.

Yhteystiedot

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa palveluesihenkilö Tiina Nenonen pu. 050 427 4486, arkisin klo 14–15 tai sähköpostitse tiina.a.nenonen@hus.fi.

title: Project Manager
description:
Career Category

Project Management

Job Description

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

Project Manager

What you will do

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role you will join our CMCi Integrated Portfolio Advancement team. This role will be based on our main corporate campus in Thousand Oaks, CA and will report to a Sr. Project Manager in the Pre-Pivotal, Late stage and Life Cycle Management (LCM) IPA team in Process Development. The Project Manager (PM) will be responsible for integrating Process Development (PD) activities by developing and maintaining project schedules for Amgen pipeline projects. This Project Manager will have a significant focus on supporting programs in the Pre-Pivotal, Pivotal (late stage) and/or Life Cycle Management (LCM) phases of development. Working with the Global Operations Leader and other members of the Product Delivery Team, the PM develops and aligns plans and schedules for PD activities with business priorities. The PM captures associated project risks, develops mitigation plans and communicates project status clearly to impacted stakeholders. The PM assists with driving decision making for the project and ensures that action items are captured and tracked to completion. The PM partners with PD technical leads to identify key deliverables and activities to be completed, identifies dependencies, and optimizes the sequence of project activities. The PM ensures cross-functional alignment through the integration of interdependent activities and through the communication of plans and timelines, with specific emphasis on critical path activities. The PM assists PD technical leads with tracking the execution of required deliverables and assists with navigating project teams through corporate governance. The PM collects, digests and assembles information to enable relevant business analysis and influence decision-making. The PM will leverage soft skills, technical knowledge, and leadership attributes to influence positive project outcomes.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Work with technical and/or Product Delivery Teams by creating project schedules/resources that align with PD prioritization
  • Support projects that utilize internal and external personnel, contract firms, and partners
  • Assist PD in driving decision making using DAI principles (D- Decision maker, A- Advice Giver, I- Informed) by producing risk analyses and scenario planning
  • Ensure participation in functional and cross-functional management reviews
  • Establish and manage collaboration and team SharePoint sites
  • Provide meeting management support including meeting planning, scheduling, facilitation, documentation (development of meeting agenda and minutes), and outcomes communication
  • Ensure product project reporting
  • Manage and prioritize support of multiple project teams at one time
  • Facilitate and incorporate lessons learned, best practices, etc.
  • Support business process improvements

What we expect of you

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The dynamic professional we seek is an individual with these qualifications.

Basic Qualifications:

Doctorate degree
OR
Master’s degree and 3 years of Project management experience
OR
Bachelor’s degree and 5 years of Project management experience
OR
Associate’s degree and 10 years of Project management experience
OR
High school diploma / GED and 12 years Project management experience

In addition to meeting at least one of the above requirements, you must have experience directly managing people and/or leadership experience leading teams, projects, programs, or directing the allocation or resources. Your managerial experience may run concurrently with the required technical experience referenced above

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 10+ years of experience in Pharmaceutical, Biotechnology or another Healthcare-related field
  • Direct CMC experience
  • Experience in an environment requiring one to foster collaboration and work effectively on cross-functional teams
  • Strong interpersonal and communication experience with the ability to effectively interface across all levels of the organization
  • Experience utilizing critical thinking and problem-solving skills to achieve results
  • Experience applying standard Project Management tools, and practices
  • Experience with MS Project, Excel and SharePoint

What you can expect of us

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.

The expected annual salary range for this role in the U.S. (excluding Puerto Rico) is posted. Actual salary will vary based on several factors including but not limited to, relevant skills, experience, and qualifications.

In addition to the base salary, Amgen offers a Total Rewards Plan, based on eligibility, comprising of health and welfare plans for staff and eligible dependents, financial plans with opportunities to save towards retirement or other goals, work/life balance, and career development opportunities that may include:

  • A comprehensive employee benefits package, including a Retirement and Savings Plan with generous company contributions, group medical, dental and vision coverage, life and disability insurance, and flexible spending accounts
  • A discretionary annual bonus program, or for field sales representatives, a sales-based incentive plan
  • Stock-based long-term incentives
  • Award-winning time-off plans
  • Flexible work models where possible. Refer to the Work Location Type in the job posting to see if this applies.

Apply now and make a lasting impact with the Amgen team.

careers.amgen.com

In any materials you submit, you may redact or remove age-identifying information such as age, date of birth, or dates of school attendance or graduation. You will not be penalized for redacting or removing this information.

Application deadline

Amgen does not have an application deadline for this position; we will continue accepting applications until we receive a sufficient number or select a candidate for the position.

Sponsorship

Sponsorship for this role is not guaranteed.

As an organization dedicated to improving the quality of life for people around the world, Amgen fosters an inclusive environment of diverse, ethical, committed and highly accomplished people who respect each other and live the Amgen values to continue advancing science to serve patients. Together, we compete in the fight against serious disease.

title: Engineer Manufacturing
description:
