title: Global Controller
description:
About the role

Willow is scaling rapidly, and the finance function needs the accounting discipline, operational infrastructure, and leadership to scale with it. We’re looking for a US-based Global Controller to lead accounting and finance operations across Willow’s jurisdictions — with immediate ownership of the core reporting, controls, tax, payroll, and benefits processes that support the business every day.


This is a hands-on leadership role. In the near term, we need someone hands-on enough to build the foundation, not just direct the work. That means documenting policies and procedures, modernizing the finance tech stack, and building scalable processes — while still providing excellent support to Willow teams throughout.


The Global Controller will report to the CFO and lead Willow’s accounting function globally, including oversight of the current APAC-based finance team. This role requires practical leadership across time zones, sufficient shared working time to support effective collaboration and coaching, and a mandate to continuously improve the finance operating model as Willow scales.


Two people we can picture in this role: the first is an experienced Controller from the SaaS or startup world — someone energized by a fast-moving environment, ready for broader scope and real ownership. The second is an experienced Controller from a larger organisation who is bored with the status quo and wants to move somewhere good judgment and strong execution can be felt immediately. If you are neither of these but you have the judgment, ownership, and builder mindset this role needs, we’d still very much like to hear from you.


What you'll do

1. Global accounting operations & close

  • Own the global accounting close process and reporting cadence, bringing discipline, accountability, and consistency across jurisdictions
  • Own revenue and COGS reporting from day one, becoming the trusted Finance partner GTM and other Willow teams rely on for accurate, timely, and decision-useful revenue information
  • Own multi-currency, multi-entity consolidating financial reporting, ensuring results are complete, consistent, and decision-useful across Willow’s global footprint
  • Strengthen the accounting operating model across reconciliations, account ownership, close controls, payroll and benefits accounting, systems integration, and vendor accountability
  • Create the operating rhythm that gives the CFO confidence in the numbers and the business confidence in Finance

2. Policies, procedures & scalable process design

  • Document accounting policies, procedures, and workflows so the function is no longer dependent on institutional memory
  • Build practical controls and process discipline across revenue, expenses, payroll, benefits, taxes, AP, reconciliations, and management reporting
  • Partner with the CFO to refine the finance roadmap and translate it into executable workplans, clear owners, realistic sequencing, and visible progress
  • Design processes that are robust enough for scale but still appropriate for Willow’s current stage

3. Finance systems & tech stack modernization

  • Modernize Willow’s finance technology stack, including ERP, spend management, close management, and adjacent finance workflows
  • Partner with the CFO and cross-functional stakeholders to implement tools in a way that improves control, visibility, speed, and user experience
  • Move the function away from manual, Excel-driven workflows where systems and automation can create a better answer
  • Provide excellent support to Willow teams through change, making adoption easier rather than harder

4. Team leadership — globally

  • Lead and develop a distributed finance team, setting priorities, clarifying accountabilities, and creating an effective management cadence across regions and time zones
  • Create meaningful working-time overlap with APAC-based teammates, while continuing to improve how global Finance operates so collaboration is practical and sustainable
  • Coach the team through process change, system implementation, and a higher standard of documentation and ownership
  • Help evolve the team’s resourcing, ways of working, and operating model so the function has the right roles, skills, and coverage for Willow’s next stage

5. Global finance operations, tax & compliance

  • Own the operating integrity of global finance operations across tax, payroll, benefits, compliance, and related accounting processes, ensuring Willow has accurate records, clear ownership, reliable controls, and timely execution across jurisdictions
  • Lead US tax compliance across payroll, state, and federal obligations, including advisor coordination, internal readiness, supporting documentation, defensible R&D credit positions, and recurring filing deadlines

What success looks like in year one

  • The monthly close is disciplined, documented, and less dependent on heroic effort
  • Revenue and COGS reporting is accurate, timely, and explainable without last-minute fire drills
  • Consolidated financial reports are prepared every month without relying on manual intervention or single-person knowledge
  • Core policies, procedures, calendars, and controls are documented and actively used by the team
  • Spend management has been re-platformed — all Willow teams know their spend against budget, and procurement processes are well-defined with appropriate controls
  • ERP migration is well underway with a clear timeline and roadmap
  • The distributed finance team has clearer priorities, stronger accountability, and a more sustainable cadence for global collaboration
  • Willow teams experience Finance as responsive, practical, and helpful through change

What is not in this role

This role will have broad ownership of accounting operations, but a few things are not the immediate focus:

  • Owning FP&A on day one — we want someone who brings FP&A fluency and can partner with the CFO on board reporting and strategic finance work, but the immediate mandate is to establish a reliable, scalable accounting cadence first
  • Operating as a purely strategic leader who delegates the details — this role requires someone willing to build, fix, document, and execute personally where needed

The long-term opportunity is broader than controllership, but the first mandate is clear: build the foundation, strengthen the roadmap through partnership, and raise the operating standard.


What we're looking for

You bring the following to this role:

  • Deep accounting judgment — strong command of US GAAP and IFRS, including ASC 606 / IFRS 15 for revenue, ASC 718 / IFRS 2 for share-based payments, and ASC 842 / IFRS 16 for leases. You’re comfortable with complexity and can distinguish between what needs to be perfect, what needs to be practical, and what needs to be flagged for visibility.
  • A builder’s mindset — you can create structure without needing a large team or perfect systems first. You know what good looks like across revenue, COGS, close, controls, tax, payroll, and reporting. You’re comfortable documenting policies, designing processes, implementing tools, and improving the operating rhythm while the business keeps moving.
  • Low ego, high EQ — you lead through trust, clarity, and service. You can support teams generously, challenge thoughtfully, and make Finance feel like an enabling function rather than a gatekeeper.
  • Discernment — you can absorb ambiguity, see around corners, identify the real risk, and make pragmatic decisions without over-engineering the answer.
  • A bias toward leverage — you look for smarter ways to get work done, using systems, automation, and AI where appropriate to improve accuracy, speed, visibility, and repeatability.
  • Global operating range — you’re comfortable leading across countries, currencies, cultures, and time zones, with both strong standards and practical flexibility.

✦ You are effective before the environment is perfect. You can build structure, improve systems, and raise the operating standard while also identifying the process, tooling, and resourcing decisions required for Willow’s next stage.

Essential experience

  • 8–10+ years of progressive accounting and controllership experience, ideally including time in a global technology or SaaS business
  • Strong knowledge of US GAAP and IFRS, revenue accounting, share-based payments, lease accounting, COGS reporting, close management, internal controls, and financial reporting
  • Hands-on experience with multi-currency, multi-entity consolidating financial reporting
  • Hands-on experience with US tax compliance and payroll accounting, including payroll tax, state and federal tax compliance, benefits accounting, reconciliations, and coordination with external tax advisors
  • Experience leading or materially improving accounting processes, controls, systems, and documentation in a scaling environment
  • Ability to lead distributed teams across time zones, including creating meaningful overlap with APAC-based finance colleagues
  • US-based, fully remote. Strong preference for candidates located in WA, TX, NY, CA, NC, NV, MI, MA, MD, IL, GA, or FL

Valued experience

  • CPA credential or equivalent technical accounting depth
  • Experience implementing or optimizing ERP, spend management, close management, payroll, or reporting systems
  • FP&A fluency, including experience supporting board reporting, investor requests, or strategic finance partnering
  • Experience working in a venture-backed, private equity-backed, or high-growth international company
  • Curiosity about AI, automation, and modern finance tooling


Compensation & Benefits

$175,000 – $210,000 base salary per year

Exact offer reflects your experience and the scope you bring to the role.

EQUITY

RSUs — details discussed during the interview process.

Meaningful upside as a small but mighty company.

HEALTH COVERAGE

Medical, dental, vision, STD, LTD, Life & AD&D

100% of employee premiums covered; 95% of dependent premiums covered by Willow.

RETIREMENT

401(k) with 100% company match on the first 5% of contributions.

TIME OFF

20 days accrued vacation + 10 days paid sick leave + 8 paid holidays per year.

PARENTAL LEAVE

Willow-paid parental leave, coordinated with applicable state leave programs.

REMOTE FIRST

Fully remote. Strong preference for candidates located in WA, TX, NY, CA, NC, NV, MI, MA, MD, IL, GA, or FL. US West Coast hours preferred; meaningful overlap with APAC-based teammates required.

In accordance with applicable state pay transparency laws, the salary range and a general description of all benefits and other compensation have been disclosed above. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience, skills, and other relevant factors.

title: Portfolio Management Director
description:
About InterDigital

InterDigital is a global research and development company focused primarily on wireless, video, artificial intelligence (“AI”), and related technologies. We design and develop foundational technologies that enable connected, immersive experiences in a broad range of communications and entertainment products and services. We license our innovations worldwide to companies providing such products and services, including makers of wireless communications devices, consumer electronics, IoT devices, cars and other motor vehicles, and providers of cloud-based services such as video streaming. As a leader in wireless technology, our engineers have designed and developed a wide range of innovations that are used in wireless products and networks, from the earliest digital cellular systems to 5G and today’s most advanced Wi-Fi technologies. We are also a leader in video processing and video encoding/decoding technology, with a significant AI research effort that intersects with both wireless and video technologies. InterDigital is a registered trademark of InterDigital, Inc.

Summary

InterDigital is seeking a Patent Portfolio Management Director for cellular-related inventions. This successful applicant will be responsible for, among other things, managing the quality, scope, and cost of his or her assigned portion of InterDigital’s cellular patent portfolio.

Responsibilities

  • Review invention disclosures, make filing decisions, and manage the work of internal and external prosecution counsels to best achieve the desired portfolio strategy within budget (the position does not involve hands-on application preparations or prosecutions)

  • Support the Litigation team during litigation on due diligence and other litigation-related matters

  • Work collaboratively within, and outside of, the Patents team on a variety of patent-related projects (e.g., SDO policy review and compliance, coordination with joint venture partners, portfolio acquisition due diligence, and/or portfolio sale efforts)

Qualifications

The ideal candidate will possess the following:

  • 8-10 years of experience in portfolio management

  • An aptitude for learning new and complex technology, and an ability to communicate with a global mindset at all levels of the organization

  • Extensive experience with cellular-related technologies (e.g., LTE, 5G), standards organizations (e.g., 3GPP), and patent pools

  • Experience reviewing and modifying claim charts; experience developing claim charts is highly preferred

  • BS or higher degree in Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications, Physics, Electronics, or a related technology area relevant to InterDigital’s business concerns

title: Head Stockperson - Sundown Valley
description:
We are seeking an experienced Head Stockperson with a genuine passion for animal welfare and life on the land.
This is an exciting opportunity to join an industry-leading agribusiness and play a key role in a high-performing livestock operation.

About the Property
Located in the stunning New England region of NSW, Sundown Valley offers a picturesque setting with convenient access to the regional centres of Armidale and Tamworth. The property plays a pivotal role in Hancock Agriculture's Wagyu business, focused on the production of premium, high-quality cattle.
Spanning approximately 22,000 hectares, Sundown Valley runs a herd of more than 12,000 head and manages an annual turnover of 15,000 to 20,000 cattle. The operation is underpinned by intensive rotational grazing across agronomically managed pastures, with a strong emphasis on performance, long-term sustainability, and the production of high-quality cattle and pasture systems.

About the Role
Reporting to the Property Manager, the Head Stockperson will assist with planning, implementing and evaluating the livestock program and related Property operations. Your key duties will include:

• Supervising and undertaking effective and timely herd management, including mustering programs
• Accurate recording of stock numbers for the livestock information system
• Providing leadership, supervision and training of stock camp team members
• Maintaining and developing facilities and improvements
• Monitoring and responding to land and environmental issues
• Assisting with purchasing.

About You
• Experience in the movement, handling and processing of cattle, using calm and quiet methods with the advantage of digitalised communication, improved weaner cradles, cattle crushes and yard shading
• Minimum 4 year’s experience in a stock camp
• Sound horsemanship and motorbike skills
• Proven livestock assessment and husbandry experience
• Demonstrated leadership and supervisory skills
• A good grasp of technology and computer literacy
• Ability to promote and maintain safe work practices
• Good understanding of animal welfare practices
• Mechanically minded
• Ability to record information and communicate effectively in the workplace
• Hold a current class C driver’s license (truck license an advantage, or be willing to obtain)

What We Offer
• Competitive remuneration
• The opportunity to live and work in the New England Region
• Comfortable on-site accommodation
• A collaborative team environment that values respect, support, and community

About Hancock Agriculture
Hancock Agriculture is a renowned agricultural company encompassing Hancock Pastoral, Wagyu Operations, and S. Kidman & Co. Pty Ltd. We manage over 20 properties across Australia, covering 3.49 million hectares. As one of Australia’s largest producers of Wagyu and commercial cattle, we maintain a herd of over 150,000.

We oversee every step of the process — from breeding to feeding and sales — ensuring the highest standards of animal husbandry, traceability, and quality assurance. At Hancock Agriculture, we are proud to offer our team members the chance to be part of an organisation that upholds these exceptional standards.

**We strongly encourage Australian Defence Force veterans to apply.**

Additional Information
Please note: You must have the right to live and work in Australia. This is a permanent position and not available to Working Holiday Visa holders (backpackers), nor do we offer sponsorship for overseas applicants.

title: Senior Strategist (£48,000-£56,000)
description:
Here at MATTA, we believe that sports have the power to change people and communities for the better. We are passionate about making brands and campaigns matter to more people, more often, by engaging fans with big, bold creative thinking and world-class execution.

We are an independent creative agency built specifically for sports and lifestyle brands. Our work has won multiple awards (from Clios to Sports Industry Campaigns of the Year), we have been Agency of the Year several times over, and we are one of the most exciting sports businesses in the country.

We are looking for a Senior Strategist to help shape the thinking behind our work. This is an opportunity for someone who combines intellectual curiosity, strong strategic instincts, digital fluency and sharp marketing acumen to make a meaningful contribution to our clients and our creative output.

The role:

You will turn audience, cultural and commercial insight into clear, inspiring strategies that unlock great creative work. Working closely with clients, creatives and the wider agency team, you will help define the problems we need to solve, identify the opportunities that matter and develop compelling strategic directions for campaigns and brands.

You will also help shape integrated campaign strategies, understanding how social, digital, content, PR, experiential and other channels can work together to create a coherent and effective audience experience.

You will be comfortable leading the strategic process on significant projects, from interrogating the initial brief through to presenting recommendations and evaluating effectiveness. You will also contribute to pitches, new business and the development of our strategic thinking as an agency.

What you’ll be doing:

Developing insight-led strategies: Researching audiences, markets, competitors and cultural trends to uncover meaningful insights and opportunities.

Shaping brand and campaign direction: Helping clients define propositions, target audiences and the strategic foundations of their marketing activity in category contexts.

Developing partnership strategies: Identifying how a brand partnership with a sports organisation can support wider marketing objectives, and developing the strategic thinking that turns the partnership into compelling creative work.

Developing integrated channel strategies: Shaping strategies that connect social, digital, content, experiential, PR and other channels around a clear audience journey and campaign objective.

Applying social and digital insight: Understanding how audiences behave across social platforms and digital environments, and using platform, content and performance insights to inform campaign strategy, creative development and optimisation.

Writing inspiring creative briefs: Apply your broad cultural knowledge to translate complex business and marketing challenges into clear, single-minded briefs that give creative teams a strong platform for ideas.

Partnering with creative teams: Working collaboratively throughout the creative process, providing constructive challenge and ensuring ideas remain strategically relevant and effective.

Understanding sport and fitness audiences: Exploring how people participate in, consume and connect with sport, from grassroots communities to elite competition, and from fitness participation to fan culture.

Leading client conversations: Presenting strategic recommendations, facilitating workshops and building trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders.

Measuring effectiveness: Helping establish campaign objectives and success measures, and using research and results to inform future strategy.

Contributing to agency growth: Supporting pitches and new business opportunities, sharing knowledge and helping develop the strategic capabilities of the agency.

You are an experienced creative marketing strategist or planner who can combine rigorous thinking with creativity and commercial understanding. You know how to move beyond interesting observations to find insights that genuinely make a difference to the work.

You bring:

  • Proven success in a strategy or planning role within a creative, advertising, brand or marketing agency.

  • Experience developing brand and/or campaign strategies, from research and insight through to creative briefing.

  • An understanding of how brand partnerships and sponsorships can contribute to wider marketing objectives, and how to develop creative campaigns that make those partnerships meaningful.

  • Strong digital and social media literacy, with a clear understanding of how different platforms, formats and audience behaviours influence creative strategy.

  • Experience developing or contributing to integrated marketing strategies, with the ability to connect social, digital, content and offline activity into a coherent campaign approach.

  • Excellent analytical and research skills, with the ability to turn complex information into clear, compelling recommendations.

  • Strong creative judgement and an ability to inspire, challenge and collaborate with creative teams.

  • Confidence presenting strategic thinking and building relationships with clients.

  • A good understanding of marketing effectiveness and how strategy contributes to measurable outcomes.

  • The ability to manage multiple projects, take ownership and work independently at a senior level.

  • A genuine curiosity about sport, fitness and the cultures and communities that surround them with the ability to cross fertilise thinking from beyond sport into the category

Experience working with sport, fitness, lifestyle or consumer brands, or on sponsorship and brand partnership campaigns, would be useful. However, we are equally interested in people who bring a fresh perspective and can demonstrate a strong understanding of how to connect brands with different audiences.


What we offer:

  • Generous annual leave (23 days, increasing by 1 day per year, plus 3 days extra at Christmas).

  • MATTA Sports Day: an extra day off every year for the purpose of either watching or playing sport.

  • Sabbatical Policy: providing options to travel, volunteer, study or generally have a reset.

  • Health & Financial Wellbeing: we’ve got you covered with a holistic support package that includes comprehensive health and dental insurance, 24/7 virtual GP access, and a range of financial tools, from life assurance and income protection to expert advice platforms.

  • Regular Socials: quarterly team events, Thirsty Thursday drinks, and PayDay Pizza at the end of each month.

  • Hybrid Working: staff can enjoy the comfort of working from their own home and from our London Bridge offices.

  • Discounts: exclusive access to our benefits platforms with hundreds of discounts on shopping, food, beauty, travel and much more.

  • Dog friendly office.

Making It MATTA:

Our clients are some of the most recognised and prestigious global brands in sport and lifestyle and include UEFA, ICC, Clinique, Budweiser, ATP Tour, The Ryder Cup, England Football, England Rugby, England Cricket, LTA, to name just a few.

We’ve launched fitness equipment, kits, and nutrition brands. We’ve created new competitions, leagues, and tournaments - as well as rebranding, revitalising and repositioning existing ones. We’ve sold out multiple World Cups and European Championships, pushed women’s sports forward (we created the Lionesses), driven participation, and led campaigns for equality and against discrimination and drugs. We’ve worked up close and personal with some of the most iconic sports stars and sports teams on the planet, shooting campaigns all over the world.

At MATTA you can expect a fast-paced, but relaxed atmosphere, where everyone is passionate about sport in some way. We believe happy and healthy people produce the best work - which is why you’ll get private health insurance, regular team away days - and generous annual leave.

We believe sport has the power to change the world. Come and work somewhere where, whatever you do - it matters.

What’s next?

If you think that MATTA could be the place where you grow professionally, and produce your best work, then we really want to meet you. Please apply below and we'll get back to you as soon as possible.

Whilst you wait to hear back from us, why don’t you check out some of our award winning work or keep up to date with our latest agency news.

When you attach your CV to your application, it will seem as though the document has not attached properly. But trust us, it has - just a small glitch in our recruitment system!

Please note: MATTA is unable to provide visa sponsorship.

Sorry - no agencies thank you.

title: Multi Property Account Receivable Supervisor
description:

Check figures, postings, and documents for accuracy. Organize, secure, and maintain all files, records, cash and cash equivalents in accordance with policies and procedures. Record, store, access, and/or analyze computerized financial information. Classify, code, and summarize numerical and financial data to compile and keep financial records, using journals, ledgers, and/or computers. title: Thought Leader Liaison (South Central)
description:
Department:

104220 Thought Leader Engagement

Location:

Kansas - Field, Missouri - Remote, Texas - Remote

Be a part of a global team that is inspired to make a difference in the lives of people living with rare disease.

At Travere Therapeutics, we recognize that our exceptional employees are vital to our success. We are a dedicated team focused on meeting the unique needs of rare patients. Our work is rewarding – both professionally and personally – because we are making a difference. We are passionate about what we do.

We are seeking talented individuals who will thrive in our collaborative, diverse, fast-paced environment and share in our mission – to identify, develop and deliver life-changing therapies to people living with rare disease. We stick by our values centered on patients, courage, community, and collaboration to pursue our vision of becoming a leading biopharmaceutical company dedicated to the delivery of innovation and hope to patients in the global rare disease community.

At Travere Therapeutics, we are in rare for life. We continue to courageously forge new paths as we move toward a common goal of elevating science and service for rare patients.

Position Summary:

The Thought Leader Liaison (TLL) is a field-based role that will be responsible for developing and managing strategic partnerships on behalf of Travere with national and regional US key opinion leaders (KOLs) within the rare nephrology space. This position will report to the Director, Thought Leader Liaisons and will help support the successful growth of FILSPARI® (sparsentan) for IgAN and FSGS. With supervision, this individual will collaborate cross-functionally on field activities as a strategic business partner with Marketing, Insights and Analytics, Sales management, Patient Advocacy, Compliance, Sales Training, Market Access, and Medical Affairs.

The preferred candidate will bring a deep understanding of nephrology, ideally with a focus on rare kidney diseases. They will have a demonstrated ability to engage with academic thought leaders and cultivate a community of brand advocates, driving impact through personalized interactions, focused small group meetings, and influential advisory boards.

Responsibilities:

  • Leverage insights to implement regional cross-functional account strategy and KOL engagement plan in partnership with the brand team and field partners (MSLs and sales representatives)

  • Collaborate and coordinate closely with marketing to identify partnering opportunities with KOLs and assist with KOL recruitment for specific marketing initiatives

  • Actively collect, analyze, and synthesize information on KOL sentiments, competitor activities, and broader market trends from diverse sources (1:1 meetings, advisory boards, congresses). Provide the brand team with regular updates, including strategic recommendations

  • Ensure compliant, fair-balanced, and effective message delivery within all promotional educational channels (i.e., speaker programs, product theaters, exhibitor spotlights, etc.)

  • Enlist appropriate KOLs to successfully support commercial activities, in partnership with the FILSPARI® brand team

  • Work with field partners to identify and vet qualified promotional speakers that align with overall needs of the brand

  • Assist with the contracting, training, and on-going educational efforts with contracted promotional speakers

Education/Experience Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Business or Life Sciences discipline. Advanced degree preferred but not required. Equivalent combination of education and applicable job experience may be considered.

  • Minimum of 8 years of related Marketing experience in specialty or rare disease marketing

Additional Skills/Experience/Requirements:

  • The ideal candidate will embody Travere’s core values: Courage, Community Spirit, Patient Focus and Teamwork

  • Strong scientific acumen and understanding of specialty clinical medicine

  • Proven, consistent history of high performance and leadership

  • Demonstrated ability to build and sustain exceptional business relationships internal commercial and cross-functional partners

  • Demonstrated ability to build productive KOL relationships and effectively execute engagement plans

  • Strong professional experience in a similar role within the pharmaceutical industry, preferably small molecule pharmaceuticals

  • Excellent collaboration skills with strong attention to detail and the ability to multi-task and manage complexity

  • Strong interpersonal and organizational skills and excellent verbal and written communication skills are required

  • Successful record of creating and managing complex project plans, timelines, budgets, and critical paths

  • Ability to adapt to modification and changes to project plans, demonstrating flexibility to implement new strategies and tactics to accommodate these changes

  • The position is field-based and the candidate must live in their region

  • Ability to travel 50-60% domestically. In the field a minimum of 3 days a week and some weekend work as required

  • All positions have an essential job function to be able to perform face to face work with colleagues and/or onsite in San Diego. No role is expected to be 100% remote

Total Rewards Offerings:
Travere provides comprehensive total rewards offerings that demonstrate our commitment as a diverse, equitable, people-centric, and pay-for-performance organization.

Benefits: Our benefits include premium health, financial, work-life and well-being offerings for eligible employees and dependents, wellness and employee support programs, life insurance, disability, retirement plans with employer match and generous paid time off.

Compensation: Our competitive compensation package includes a combination of both cash compensation (base pay and short-term incentive) and long-term incentive compensation (company stock), designed to recognize, retain, and reward employees.

Target Base Pay Range:

$162,000.00 - $211,000.00

*This information is current as of the date of this posting and may be modified in the future. Actual pay offered to a candidate will depend on a variety of factors including the candidate’s experience, education, skills, and location.

Travere will accept applications on an ongoing basis until a candidate is selected for the position.

Travere Therapeutics, Inc. is an EEO/AA/Veteran/Disability Employer.

If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete the application or interview process, please contact us by sending an email to accommodations@travere.com. Please note that this email address is to be used exclusively to request an accommodation with the online application, interview or hiring process only. Travere HR will not reply to emails sent to this address for any other reason.

title: Kätilö Raskaana olevien ja synnyttäneiden osasto 52 Naistenklinikka
description:
Haluaisitko tehdä työtä raskaana olevien, synnyttäneiden ja vastasyntyneiden parissa? Onko vauvamyönteisyys lähellä sydäntäsi ja sinua motivoi perheiden ohjaus synnytyksestä toipumiseen, imetykseen ja vauvanhoitoon?

Haemme kätilö vakituiseen työsuhteeseen Helsingin Naistenklinikan Osasto 52:lle. Työpiste on työsuhteen alussa Jorvin sairaalan Synnyttäneiden osastolla 2A-B johtuen Naistenklinikan peruskorjauksesta. Peruskorjauksen arvioitu kesto on kolme vuotta. Työpiste siirtyy tämän jälkeen Naistenklinikalle.

Tarjoamme sinulle monipuolisen, haastavan ja palkitsevan työn kansainvälisesti korkeatasoisessa yliopistosairaalassamme. Meillä sinua arvostetaan sekä kannustetaan kehittymään ammatissasi. Tarjoamme sinulle myös mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa, kehittyä ja tehdä aidosti merkityksellistä työtä raskaana olevien ja synnyttäneiden perheiden parhaaksi. Työ on kolmivuorotyötä ja alkaa 4.1.2027.

Toiveemme

Arvostamme muutosvalmiutta, joustavaa ja positiivista asennetta sekä aitoa kiinnostusta raskaana olevien ja synnyttäneiden hoitotyöhön ja sen kehittämiseen. Työssäsi sinua auttavat hyvät yhteistyö- ja vuorovaikutustaidot. Meillä työskentelet osana moniammatillista tiimiä, jossa jokaisella on tärkeä rooli. Odotamme eri kulttuureista tulevien potilaiden tarpeiden huomioivaa työotetta. Meillä toimitaan vauvamyönteisyysohjelman mukaisesti. Työtämme ohjaavat perhekeskeisyys ja asiakaslähtöisyys.

Osastoillamme teemme töitä yhdessä toinen toistamme auttaen. Panostamme uusien työntekijöiden perehdytykseen ja opiskelijaohjaukseen. Haluamme vaalia hyvää ilmapiiriä. Noudatamme yhteisöllistä työvuorosuunnittelua. Työskentelyssämme näkyvät HUSin arvot kohtaaminen, edelläkävijyys ja yhdenvertaisuus. Tavoitteenamme on tarjota joka päivä jokaiselle potilaalle yhä parempaa hoitoa.

Voit seurata meitä myös Instagramissa: @hus_nklsynnytykset ja @hus_jorvinsynnytykset

Tietoa tulevasta työpaikastasi

Naistenklinikka on Suomen suurin synnytyssairaala, jossa syntyy vuosittain yli 8500 lasta. Riskiraskauksien hoito on keskitetty Naistenklinikalle. Osastollamme hoidetaan sekä raskaana olevia että synnyttäneitä, vastasyntyneitä ja perheitä synnytyksen jälkeen. Osastolla toimii lisäksi haavapoliklinikka ja synnyttäneiden vastaanotto, jossa hoidamme vastasyntyneitä kotiutumisen jälkeen.

Jorvin sairaalassa syntyy vuosittain noin 5000 lasta. Synnyttäneiden osastolla hoidetaan synnyttäneitä ja vastasyntyneitä. Osastolla toimii lisäksi synnyttäneiden vastaanotto, jossa hoidamme vastasyntyneitä kotiutumisen jälkeen.

HUS tukee henkilöstön työhyvinvointia monipuolisin eduin: käytössäsi ovat liikunta- ja kulttuuriedut sekä työsuhdematkaetu. Tarjoamme myös sairaan lapsen hoitopalvelua, mahdollisuuden työsuhdeasuntoon sekä henkilöstöhintaisia lomamökkejä. Työympäristömme on savuton.

Tehtäväkohtainen palkka on 3218,18 €/kk ja mahdolliset kokemus- ja muut lisät.

Hae meille hakuajan loppuun mennessä. HUSissa olet osa vaikuttavinta hoitoa.

Tehtävän kelpoisuusehdot

Laillistettu kätilö tai laillistettu sairaanhoitaja ja erikoissairaanhoitajan tutkinto äitiyshuollon ja naistentautien opintolinjalla.

Kielitaitovaatimuksena on suomen kielen hyvä suullinen ja kirjallinen taito ja ruotsin kielen tyydyttävä suullinen ja kirjallinen taito taikka ruotsin kielen hyvä suullinen ja kirjallinen taito ja suomen kielen tyydyttävä suullinen ja kirjallinen taito.

Edellytämme asiakas- ja potilastiloissa työskentelevältä tartuntatautilain mukaista rokotussuojaa, ja terveydenhuollon toimintayksiköissä työskentelevältä terveydentilan selvitystä keuhkotuberkuloosista.

title: Portfolio Coordinator
description:
As a Portfolio Coordinator, you will play a key role in supporting the delivery of RAC’s projects and initiatives. Working within the Assurance, Integration & Change team, you’ll provide high-quality assurance, coordination and portfolio support activities to ensure programs and projects are well-managed, compliant, and aligned to RAC’s standards.

What will you be doing?

  • Supporting the development and improvement of project and portfolio management processes, including benefits, risks, issues and dependency management.

  • Preparing high-quality Board and Executive level reports, briefs and documentation to support assurance, governance, monitoring and evaluation requirements.

  • Overseeing Portfolio of projects, and collating data to monitor progress against deliverables.

  • Coordinating governance forums, including agenda preparation, minute-taking and action tracking.

  • Preparing cost allocation reporting to enable accurate project chargeback.

  • Delivering user support and training, creating and updating training and onboarding materials, performing user acceptance testing, and coordinating system updates and releases for Portfolio Project Management tool.

  • Conducting project health checks, control testing and the continuous improvement of portfolio processes, tools and systems.

  • Applying critical thinking to interpret reporting outcomes, draw meaningful insights, and foster strong stakeholder engagement in assurance and governance processes.

  • Supporting the identification and delivery of continuous improvement initiatives that strengthen the capability and maturity of the assurance and portfolio function, enabling it to better meet partner expectations and evolving business needs.

What are we looking for in you?

  • Experience in the management of project controls, including risks, schedules, and budgets.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with proven ability to prepare accurate reports and governance documentation.

  • High attention to detail, strong organisational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities.

  • Significant experience with project management tools and a sound understanding of project delivery and assurance frameworks.

  • Relevant tertiary qualifications are desirable, with additional certifications in process improvement (Lean, Kaizen, TQM) highly regarded.

  • Ability to adapt in dynamic environments, apply critical thinking, balance competing priorities, and build strong stakeholder relationships across the organisation.

What can we offer you?

  • Work with a team that ensures we are delivering on our promise to make a safe, sustainable and connected Western Australia.

  • Join a dynamic team that values engagement and personal development, which enables continuous learning opportunities, and career progression within a supportive and growth-focused environment.

  • Benefit from flexible and hybrid working arrangements, including temporary remote work options and a focus on work-life balance.

  • Contribute to high-impact projects or products that directly enhance RACWA's services to its members and the community.

  • Be part of an organisation that embraces diversity and inclusion, ensuring a welcoming environment for all employees.

  • Take advantage of a strong focus on employee wellbeing, including mental health support, wellness programs, and fitness incentives.

  • Engage in meaningful community and social responsibility initiatives that align with RACWA's values and mission.

About RAC

RAC WA is a member-focused organisation dedicated to serving the Western Australian community. Our mission is to create a safer, more sustainable, and connected future for all Western Australians.
RAC values inclusivity, diversity, and flexibility in the workplace. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we welcome everyone. For assistance during the application process, contact recruitment@rac.com.au.

title: Kettle Campaign Co-ordinator
description:
Who We Are

For more than 130 years, The Salvation Army has served people in need in communities across Canada and Bermuda. Building on our roots as a world-wide Christian church, each year we help more than 2 million people, providing necessities such as food, clothing and shelter. In addition, we support people experiencing unemployment, addiction and family challenges. We continually adapt and innovate to meet emerging needs and live out our mission, vision and values of hope, service, dignity and stewardship. As a faith- and values-based organization, we hire and serve people of all backgrounds and walks of life - there is a place for everyone to belong here.

Mission Statement

The Salvation Army exists to share the love of Jesus Christ, meet human needs and be a transforming influence in the communities of our world.

Job Description:

Position Purpose summary:

The Salvation Army Christmas Kettle Campaign is part of a century old tradition to contribute towards building strong communities by helping TSA to give hope to other. The Christmas Kettle Coordinator position is a short-term contract position. The successful candidate is responsible for oversight of several Christmas Kettle locations in a given geographical zone area. Zone locations include shopping malls, grocery stores and retail outlets. They organize, direct, and supervise the work performed by Christmas Kettle Campaign Workers. They will also ensure adequate staffing is met prior to and during each shift.

Accountabilities:

Incumbent may perform all, some, or similar range of duties as below:

  • Attend a day of training/orientation on The Salvation Army and the Christmas Kettle Campaign.
  • Provide support in getting Kettles to zone locations prior to staff and/or volunteer’s arrival at Campaign onset.
  • Ensure all Kettle donations are delivered to secure location at shift completion.
  • Communicate daily issues and supply deficiencies to the supervisor.
  • Orient and remind staff/volunteers on proper Kettle handling and duties as required.
  • Supervise, support and assign (as required) staff and/or volunteers throughout the Campaign.
  • Visit locations during shift changes and intermittently.
  • Ensure timesheets and mileage reports are submitted accurately and timely (weekly basis).
  • Remain at the Kettle for the full shift (until relieved), ensuring security of donations received.

title: Modeler - Asset Liability Management (ALM)
description:
Job Family

Treasury, Capital Management and Asset Liability Management

About Us

At Transamerica, hard work, innovative thinking, and personal accountability are qualities we honor and reward. We understand the potential of leveraging the talents of a diverse workforce. We embrace an environment where employees enjoy a balance between their careers, families, communities, and personal interests.

Ultimately, we appreciate the uniqueness of a company where talented professionals work collaboratively in a positive environment — one focused on helping people look forward and plan for the best life possible while providing tools and solutions that make it easier to get there.

Who We Are

We believe everyone deserves to live their best life. More than a century ago, we were among the first financial services companies in America to serve everyday people from all walks of life.

Today, we’re part of an international holding company, with millions of customers and thousands of employees worldwide. Our insurance, retirement, and investment solutions help people make the most of what’s important to them.

We’re empowered by a vast agent network covering North America, with diversity to match. Together with our nonprofit research institute and foundation, we tune in, step up, and are a force for good — for our customers and the communities where we live, work, and play. United in our purpose, we help people create the financial freedom to live life on their terms.

What We Do

Transamerica is organized into three distinct businesses. These include 1) World Financial Group, including Transamerica Financial Advisors, 2) Protection Solutions and Savings & Investments, comprised of life insurance, annuities, employee benefits, retirement plans, and Transamerica Investment Solutions, and 3) Financial Assets, which includes legacy blocks of long term care, universal life, and variable and fixed annuities. These are supported by Transamerica Corporate, which includes Finance, People and Places, General Counsel, Risk, Internal Audit, Strategy and Development, and Corporate Affairs, which covers Communications, Brand, and Government and Policy Affairs.

Transamerica employs nearly 7,000 people. It’s part of Aegon, an integrated, diversified, international financial services group serving approximately 23.9 million customers worldwide.* For more information, visit .

Job Description Summary

The Modeler - ALM Modeling will build and analyze sophisticated models for insurance products, investments and/or portfolios to increase company risk adjusted returns. Leverages advanced knowledge of actuarial, financial, statistical, data science and/or balance sheet modeling analytics to develop, test and validate models for various functions within the company.

Job Description

Responsibilities:

  • Model and quantify risks including equity and interest rate sensitivities, cash flow variability, credit, alternative investment, or liquidity risks.

  • Embrace new technologies to improve workflows.

  • Build external or embedded controls to mitigate operating risks in workflows.

  • Apply risk management techniques and procedures, including the company's mandated risk methodologies.

  • Gather and analyze market data, calculate hedge program or portfolio statistics and develop/use models to simulate financial reporting processes.

  • Apply and integrate statistical, mathematical, predictive modeling and business analysis skills to manage and manipulate complex high volume data from a variety of sources.

  • Interpret internal or external issues and recommend solutions/best practices.

  • Solve complex problems; take a broad perspective to identify solutions.

  • Apply judgment to modeling choices in a defensible manner.

  • Assess the materiality of various modeling and data choices.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a technical/quantitative discipline such as statistics, math, actuarial science, computer science, economics, engineering, or a related business field such as finance

  • Academic or job exposure to at least one area product such as insurance liability, asset valuation, derivatives modeling, liquidity management, machine learning, or artificial intelligence

  • Good understanding of investment and finance concepts, and be able to creatively apply them in solving analytical problems in the business setting

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Advanced degree

  • Insurance or asset/derivatives modeling experience

  • Actuarial Science background

  • Experience with database design and usage

  • 2+ years of programming experience in C++/C#/Python or other advanced language

  • SAS, R, SPSS or other statistical software experience

Working Conditions:

  • Hybrid office environment: Tues/Wed/Thurs in office

#LI-BD1

Compensation:

The Salary for this position generally ranges between $73,000 - $80,000 annually. Please note that the salary range is a good faith estimate for this position and actual starting pay is determined by several factors including qualifications, experience, geography, work location designation (in-office, hybrid, remote) and operational needs. Salary may vary above and below the stated amounts, as permitted by applicable law.

Additionally, this position is typically eligible for an Annual Bonus based on the Company Bonus Plan/Individual Performance and is at the Company’s discretion.

This job description is not a contract of employment nor for any specific job responsibilities. The Company may change, add to, remove, or revoke the terms of this job description at its discretion. Managers may assign other duties and responsibilities as needed. In the event an employee or applicant requests or requires an accommodation in order to perform job functions, the applicable HR Business Partner should be contacted to evaluate the accommodation request.

What We Offer

For eligible employees, we offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support both the personal and financial well-being of our employees.

Compensation Benefits

  • Competitive Pay

  • Bonus for Eligible Employees

Benefits Package

  • Pension Plan

  • 401k Match

  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan

  • Tuition Reimbursement

  • Disability Insurance

  • Medical Insurance

  • Dental Insurance

  • Vision Insurance

  • Employee Discounts

  • Career Training & Development Opportunities

Health and Work/Life Balance Benefits

  • Paid Time Off starting at 160 hours annually for employees in their first year of service.

  • Ten (10) paid holidays per year (typically mirroring the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) holidays).

  • Be Well Company holistic wellness program, which includes Wellness Coaching and Reward Dollars

  • Parental Leave – fifteen (15) days of paid parental leave per calendar year to eligible employees with at least one year of service at the time of birth, placement of an adopted child, or placement of a foster care child.

  • Adoption Assistance

  • Employee Assistance Program

  • Back-Up Care Program

  • PTO for Volunteer Hours

  • Employee Matching Gifts Program

  • Employee Resource Groups

  • Inclusion and Diversity Programs

  • Employee Recognition Program

  • Referral Bonus Programs

Inclusion & Diversity

We believe our commitment to diversity and inclusion creates a work environment filled with exceptional individuals. We’re thrilled to have been recognized for our efforts through the Human Rights Campaign Corporate Equality Index, Dave Thomas Adoption Friendly Advocate, and several Seramount lists, including the Inclusion Index, 100 Best Companies for Working Parents, Best Companies for Dads, and Top 75 Companies for Executive Women.

To foster a culture of inclusivity throughout our workforce, workplace, and marketplace, Transamerica offers a wide range of diversity and inclusion programs. This includes our company-sponsored, employee-driven Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), which are formed around a shared interest or a common characteristic of diversity. ERGs are open to all employees. They provide a supportive environment to help us better appreciate our similarities and differences and understand how they benefit us all.

Giving Back

We believe our responsibilities extend beyond our corporate walls. That's why we created the Aegon Transamerica Foundation in 1994. Through a mix of financial grants and the volunteer efforts of our employees, the foundation supports nonprofit organizations focused on the things that matter most to our people in the communities where we live and work.

Transamerica’s Parent Company

Aegon acquired the Transamerica business in 1999. Since its start in 1844, Aegon has grown into an international company serving more than 23.9 million people across the globe.* It offers investment, protection, and retirement solutions, always with a clear purpose: Helping people live their best lives. As a leading global investor and employer, the company seeks to have a positive impact by addressing critical environmental and societal issues, with a focus on climate change and inclusion and diversity.

* As of December 31, 2023

title: Leasing Professional - Shorewood
description:
ABOUT GREYSTAR


Greystar is a leading, fully integrated global real estate platform offering expertise in property management, investment management, development, and construction services in institutional-quality rental housing. Headquartered in Charleston, South Carolina, Greystar manages and operates over $350 billion of real estate in more than 260 markets globally with offices throughout North America, Europe, South America, and the Asia-Pacific region. Greystar is the largest operator of apartments in the United States, managing over one million units/beds globally. Across its platforms, Greystar has nearly $79 billion of assets under management, including over $34 billion of development assets and over $36.5 billion of regulatory assets under management. Greystar was founded by Bob Faith in 1993 to become a provider of world-class service in the rental residential real estate business. To learn more, visit .

JOB DESCRIPTION SUMMARY

Schedule: Tuesday - Saturday. Thursday-Friday 9am-6pm, Sat 10am-5pm.

This position is responsible for coordinating the community’s marketing, leasing, and renewal strategies to achieve occupancy, revenue, and resident retention goals by performing all activities related to leasing to new residents, providing resident satisfaction throughout the term of the lease, and securing resident lease renewals.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Essential Responsibilities:
• Performs all sales and leasing activities to achieve the community’s revenue and occupancy goals by greeting and qualifying prospects, conducting community tours and showing apartments, processing applications, credit screening, and criminal background checks, preparing the lease and move-in package, and ensuring a smooth resident move-in and lease signing.
• Inspects apartments prior to resident move-in and ensures apartments are in move-in ready condition and schedules any outstanding item to be addressed with the maintenance team.
• Stays informed about current market and competitor conditions that may impact the community’s occupancy and sales results, develops and implements short- and long-term marketing plans and goals to sustain occupancy, and follows the community’s established policies related to concessions, specials, and other programs to boost occupancy.
• Designs and executes marketing activities to create and drive traffic to the community, including implementing resident referral and employer outreach programs, using internet marketing tools (Craigslist, Facebook, e-mail, and other websites), and following other community-specific marketing plans, drives, and special programs.
• Uses the on-site property management software (OneSite, Yardi, etc.) to track apartment availability, record traffic and leasing activities, manage resident and prospect data, and capture critical demographic and other information about existing and future residents.
• Ensures that the community and show units meet the Company’s standards for show quality by daily inspecting the marketing corridor and leasing tour, communicating maintenance and upkeep needs to the community’s maintenance team members, merchandising and ensuring a physically appealing show unit and/or model and amenities, and preparing the leasing office for daily leasing activities.
• Follows-up with prospects and new residents to ensure satisfaction by sending e-mail, thank-you notes, and cards or making telephone calls or other contacts to finalize decisions to lease and/or renew.
• Executes and performs activities in support of the community’s lease renewal program by preparing lease renewal letters and packages for residents, meeting with and contacting renewing residents in advance of move-out dates, and ensuring that lease renewal documents are signed and implemented on time.
• Responds quickly and courteously to resident and client/owner concerns and questions, and takes prompt action to solve problems and/or document and convey resident or other requests to the appropriate individual(s).

Required Licenses or Certifications:
• Incumbents must have all licenses and/or certifications as required by State and Local jurisdictions

• Incumbents must have valid driver’s license to operate a golf cart on property.

Physical Demands:

  • Incumbents need to be able to stand, walk, and/or sit for extended periods of time and bend, stoop, climb ladders, reach, carry objects, and crawl in confined areas.
  • Incumbents must be able to work inside and outside in all weather conditions (rain, snow, heat, hail, wind, sleet).
  • Incumbents must be able to push, pull, lift, carry, or maneuver weights of up to twenty-five (25) pounds independently and fifty (50) pounds with assistance.
  • Rare or regular travel may be required to assist other properties as needed, attend training classes, business meetings, or other situations necessary for the accomplishment of some or all of the daily responsibilities of this position.
  • Incumbents must be able to work a flexible work schedule, which includes taking “call” during evenings, weekends and holidays.

#LI-EM

The hourly range for this role is $22.00 - $25.00


Additional Compensation:


Many factors go into determining employee pay within the posted range including business requirements, prior experience, current skills and geographical location.

  • Corporate Positions: In addition to the base salary, this role may be eligible to participate in a quarterly or annual bonus program based on individual and company performance.
  • Onsite Property Positions: In addition to the base salary, this role may be eligible to participate in weekly, monthly, and/or quarterly bonus programs.

Robust Benefits Offered*:

  • Competitive Medical, Dental, Vision, and Disability & Life insurance benefits. Low (free basic) employee Medical costs for employee-only coverage; costs discounted after 3 and 5 years of service.
  • Generous Paid Time off. All new hires start with 15 days of vacation, 4 personal days, 10 sick days, and 11 paid holidays. Plus your birthday off after 1 year of service! Additional vacation accrued with tenure.
  • For onsite team members, onsite housing discount at Greystar-managed communities are available subject to discount and unit availability.
  • 6-Week Paid Sabbatical after 10 years of service (and every 5 years thereafter).
  • 401(k) with Company Match up to 6% of pay after 6 months of service.
  • Paid Parental Leave and lifetime Fertility Benefit reimbursement up to $10,000 (includes adoption or surrogacy).
  • Employee Assistance Program.
  • Critical Illness, Accident, Hospital Indemnity, Pet Insurance and Legal Plans.
  • Charitable giving program and benefits.

title: Transportation Solution Specialist
description:
SUMMARY
Reporting to the Director – Transportation Network Strategy, the Solutions Architect will develop, design and deliver innovative, data driven supply chain solutions tailored to client needs. This role requires strong analytical capabilities, deep understanding of transportation and distribution networks, and the ability to translate complex data into actionable strategies. You will lead solution design efforts, incorporating carrier rate analysis, cost modeling, and operational feasibility to ensure optimal performance and cost efficiency.
RESPONSIBILITIES

Lead the design of customized logistics solutions across transportation, warehousing, and distribution.
Develop pricing models, network optimization strategies, and operational workflows aligned with client objectives.
Collect, validate, and analyze client data (volumes, lanes, costs, service levels).
Build advanced models to evaluate scenarios, optimize network design, and forecast performance.
Receive and analyze carrier rates across modes (FTL, LTL, intermodal) to build accurate cost bases.
Incorporate rate structures and accessorial charges, and market trends into solution pricing and optimization models.
Conduct discovery sessions to capture client requirements and operational constraints.
Present solution designs, cost models, and value propositions to internal and external stakeholders.
Partner with procurement, operations, and IT teams to validate feasibility and ensure seamless implementation.
Support implementation teams during solution handoff and deployment phases.
Identify opportunities for cost savings, process optimization, and service enhancements.
Stay informed on industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in supply chain design.

EDUCATION:

Bachelor’s degree in supply chain management, Logistics, Industrial Engineering, Business Analytics, or related field or equivalent experience.

EXPERIENCE:

3–5 years in logistics, transportation, or supply chain solution design within a 3PL or similar environment.
Advanced proficiency in Excel (modeling, pivot tables), data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau), and SQL.
Familiarity with TMS, WMS, and optimization tools.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Excellent communication, presentation skills and client-facing skills .
Ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.

COMPETENCIES

Customer Centricity
Fostering Culture
Collaboration
Problem Solving & Decision Making
Managing Through Change
Developing Self & Others
Planning & Results Orientation
Communication
Always Improving Mindset
Business & Financial Savvy

title: Scientific Editor, iScience

Tutor Perini Corporation is seeking a Structural Superintendent to join our Honolulu Authority for Rapid Transportation (HART) project in Honolulu, HI

About Tutor Perini Corporation

Extraordinary Projects, Exceptional Performance

The world relies on infrastructure — to ensure public safety, maintain a quality of life and support a healthy economy. For more than a century, Tutor Perini Corporation’s family of civil construction companies has supported the development and maintenance of infrastructure across our great nation.

We construct and rehabilitate highways, bridges, tunnels, mass-transit systems, and water management and wastewater treatment facilities. In short, we help our clients make “public works” work. Our corporate integrity, financial strength and outstanding record of performance makes us an attractive partner on large, sophisticated infrastructure projects.

Tutor Perini is the general contractor for the HART City Center Guideway and Stations project. The scope of the approximately $1.66 billion contract includes the design and construction of six rail stations and approximately three miles of elevated rail guideway beginning just east of the Middle Street Transit Center Station and ending at the Civic Center Station, which will be located just east of the intersection of Halekauwila Street and South Street in downtown Honolulu. Project design is expected to begin immediately while construction is estimated to commence in the second half of 2025. Construction of this segment is expected to be substantially completed in 2030.

Extraordinary Projects need Exceptional Talent

DESCRIPTION:

As a Structural Superintendent at Tutor Perini Corp., reporting to the Project Manager, you will have the opportunity to:

  • Supervise construction effort on elevated guideway structures to ensure project is constructed safely in accordance with design, budget and schedule.

  • Assume responsibility for planning, coordinating and supervising onsite functions (scheduling, subcontractor coordination, etc.).

  • Assume responsibility for compliance of craft workers and subcontractors with contract requirements, efficient use of materials & equipment, site safety plan and timely performance of the project schedule.

  • Provide technical assistance, i.e., interpretation of drawings, recommending construction methods and equipment, etc., as required.

  • Assist project management in developing, project schedule, site logistics plan and implementing project procedures, working documents, standards, etc.

title: DevSecOps SME - Contract
description:
We are seeking a hands-on DevScope SME / Senior DevSecOps Engineer to drive the end-to-end design, implementation, and roll-out of application security scanning standards across enterprise engineering pipelines.

This is not an operational or monitoring position—it is a delivery-focused engineering role for a specialist who has built, integrated, and deployed SAST, SCA, and DAST platforms from the ground up. You will take ownership of defining security scanning boundaries (Dev Scope), establishing quality gates, configuring scanning engines, and automating security controls directly within active CI/CD pipelines.

Key Responsibilities

  • Platform Implementation & Roll-Out: Lead the end-to-end configuration, deployment, and integration of code scanning platforms (e.g., Checkmarx, SonarQube, Veracode, Snyk, Fortify, or OWASP ZAP) across enterprise repositories.

  • SAST, SCA & DAST Governance: Establish baseline rulesets, policy standards, and enforcement mechanisms for Static Application Security Testing (SAST), Software Composition Analysis (SCA), and Dynamic Application Security Testing (DAST).

  • Pipeline Security Automation: Embed automated security testing stages, quality gates, and failure conditions seamlessly into modern CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Jenkins).

  • Dev Scope & Triage Strategy: Define the operational scope of security scanning, establish false-positive triage workflows, and optimize rulesets to minimize developer friction while maintaining high security coverage.

  • Engineering Enablement: Work directly with software engineering squads to provide guided remediation, establish secure coding standards, and build developer-first security

Essential Experience:

  • Proven Implementation Track Record: Demonstrated experience building, configuring, and deploying enterprise SAST, SCA, and DAST tooling (not just using or monitoring existing configurations).

  • DevSecOps Automation: Strong hands-on experience integrating application security testing directly into automated CI/CD pipelines and developer tools.

  • AppSec & Vulnerability Management: Deep understanding of the OWASP Top 10, CWE, open-source license risk, and dependency vulnerability management.

  • Scripting & Integration: Proficiency in scripting (Python, Bash, or PowerShell) and working with APIs to automate scanning workflows and reporting.

  • Location: Based in Sydney (or willing to work hybrid in Sydney) with full Australian working rights.

title: Sr Full Stack Engineer, Platform Services
description:
Senior Full Stack Engineer, Platform Services

College Board – Technology, InfoSec & Infrastructure

Location: This is a remote role. Candidates who live near CB offices have the option of being fully remote or hybrid (Tuesday and Wednesday in office). All CB employees are required to occasionally travel to meet in person for business purposes.

Type: This is a full-time position

About the Team

The Platform Services Team helps monitor and assure the health, security, and performance of the systems within a shared platform. The team owns a key piece of the platform shell, a shared foundation that domain teams across the organization build on to deliver a unified user experience. Team is responsible for designing, building, and deploying into the shell, integrating data and functionality from multiple domains into a single, cohesive entry point for users. It's a high-visibility role at the intersection of architecture, cross-domain collaboration, and platform reliability.

About the Opportunity

As a Senior Full Stack Engineer, you will play a strong technical role in the design, development, and reliability of a cloud-native, AWS-based platform that aggregates data and services from multiple domains into a cohesive, performant, and role-aware user experience for teachers, students, and administrators.

You bring strong full-stack engineering experience, with deep hands-on skills across React front-end development and AWS-based backend/API architecture. You are comfortable owning solutions end-to-end — from API design and cloud infrastructure to secure service layers and polished, responsive UI components — and you can guide architectural decisions, not just implement them. You are experienced in building Backend for Frontend (BFF) patterns that aggregate multi-domain APIs into clean, efficient contracts tailored to the UI's needs.

You have a strong grasp of authentication and session-aware UI — designing and implementing role-based rendering, token handling, and post-login experiences that adapt to the user's profile and permissions. You understand the performance demands of a landing page — applying strategies such as lazy loading, caching, and web vitals optimization to ensure fast, reliable experiences across devices.

You are senior enough to mentor other engineers, drive technical design discussions, and push back constructively on approaches that won't scale, while remaining hands-on in the code. You understand cloud software delivery practices deeply and are technologically curious, staying current on emerging tools, patterns, and standards. Your communication and collaboration skills allow you to articulate solutions clearly to both engineers and stakeholders while maintaining a clear, unified experience for the end user.

In this role, you will:

Software Solutioning & Design (10%)

  • Develop deep understanding of the business processes and domains that the BAWP UI serves

  • Lead evaluation of feature requests, provide effort estimates, and drive sprint/technical planning

  • Define and own architectural patterns and API contracts for integrating multiple domain services into the BAWP UI

  • Lead peer code and design reviews to ensure quality, consistency, and scalability

Design, Architecture & Implementation (60%)

  • Architect and build scalable, secure full-stack solutions using React (TypeScript) on the front end and AWS-native services on the backend

  • Design and implement APIs and data integration layers that aggregate content from multiple upstream domains, with robust handling of latency, partial failures, and caching

  • Build reusable, well-architected front-end components and shared modules within the BAWP Shell (micro-frontend/Module Federation or equivalent)

  • Design and implement cloud-native architectures using AWS services (Lambda, API Gateway, S3, DynamoDB, Step Functions, SQS/SNS, ECS, CloudWatch)

  • Apply and evolve architectural patterns, automation practices, and observability standards across the platform

  • Ensure systems meet enterprise requirements for scalability, data integrity, security, availability, and reliability

  • Integrate monitoring, telemetry, and operational readiness into all platform components

  • Own and evolve automated end-to-end and UI testing frameworks (Playwright) to ensure application quality and reliability

  • Drive performance optimization across API integration and rendering layers

Technical Contribution & Engineering Excellence (20%)

  • Solve complex technical problems and drive improvements to overall system design

  • Mentor and guide other engineers on best practices in development, testing, and system design

  • Continuously evaluate and introduce new cloud, front-end, and test automation technologies where they add value

  • Communicate technical approaches, tradeoffs, and architectural decisions clearly to engineering and business stakeholders

  • Champion best practices in secure system design, automation, performance, and resilient engineering

Team Operations & Cross-Functional Collaboration (10%)

  • Partner with product, operations, security, and domain teams to deliver aligned, well-integrated solutions

  • Support platform readiness through leadership in testing, monitoring, and reliability efforts

  • Drive documentation, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement initiatives

  • Collaborate with QA and engineering teams to embed automated testing into CI/CD pipelines

  • Foster a culture of ownership, documentation, accountability, and continuous improvement

About You

You have:

  • 5+ years of experience designing, building, and supporting scalable, cloud-native full-stack applications

  • 3+ years of experience building modern front-end applications using TypeScript and React

  • Strong hands-on experience with backend technologies such as Node.js (preferably TypeScript), building APIs and data integration layers

  • Deep experience with AWS services: Lambda, API Gateway, SNS, SQS, S3, Step Functions, EC2, ECS, VPC, IAM, CloudWatch, DynamoDB

  • Experience with Backstage and GitHub Actions

  • Experience designing systems that integrate and aggregate data and content from multiple independent backend/domain services into a single UI

  • Strong knowledge of distributed cloud infrastructure and microservices architecture

  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (AWS CDK, CloudFormation)

  • Experience building responsive, secure, high-performance UIs using React, TypeScript, HTML, and CSS

  • Familiarity with micro-frontend architectures (e.g., Module Federation) and shared shell/component patterns

  • Experience with automated testing frameworks, for end-to-end and UI testing, and integrating them into CI/CD pipelines

  • Strong focus on scalability, data integrity, reliability, and quality engineering practices

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to present ideas in business-friendly language and mentor other engineers

  • Ability to prioritize and lead execution of tasks in a high-pressure, fast-paced environment

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with monitoring/observability tools such as Grafana, CloudWatch dashboards

  • Familiarity with real-time stream processing (Apache Flink or similar)

  • Familiarity with ML/AI lifecycle concepts, and interest in AI-driven features (e.g., AI-generated insights) as part of the platform roadmap

  • Understanding of data isolation, performance segmentation, and secure access in distributed systems

All roles at College Board require:

  • A passion for expanding educational and career opportunities and mission-driven work

  • Authorization to work in the United States for any employer

  • Curiosity and enthusiasm for emerging technologies, with a willingness to experiment with and adopt new AI-driven solutions and a comfort learning and applying new digital tools independently and proactively.

  • Clear and concise communication skills, written and verbal

  • A learner's mindset and a commitment to growth: welcoming diverse perspectives, giving and receiving timely, respectful feedback, and continuously improving through iterative learning and user input.

  • A drive for impact and excellence: solving complex problems, making data-informed decisions, prioritizing what matters most, and continuously improving through learning, user input, and external benchmarking.

  • A collaborative and empathetic approach: working across differences, fostering trust, and contributing to a culture of shared success.

About Our Process

  • Application review will begin immediately and will continue until the position is filled. This role is expected to accept applications for a minimum of 5 business days.

  • While the hiring process may vary, it generally includes resume and application submission, recruiter phone/video screen, hiring manager interview, performance exercise such as live coding, a panel interview, a conversation with leadership and reference checks.

What We Offer

At College Board, we offer more than just a paycheck—we provide a meaningful career, a supportive team, and a comprehensive package designed to help you thrive. We’re a self-sustaining nonprofit that believes in fair and competitive compensation, grounded in your qualifications, experience, impact, and the market.

A Thoughtful Approach to Compensation

  • The hiring range for this role is $153,000–$166,000.

  • Your exact salary will depend on your location, experience, and how your background compares to others in similar roles at the College Board.

  • We aim to make our best offer upfront rooted in fairness, transparency, and market data.

  • We adjust salaries by location to ensure fairness, no matter where you live.

You’ll have open, transparent conversations about compensation, benefits, and what it’s like to work at the College Board throughout your hiring process. Check out our careers page for more.

description:
The Opportunity:

The Saskatchewan Ministry of Environment has an exciting GIS Technician opportunity in the Forest Service Branch, located in Prince Albert.
