  • Industry / Project: FinTech — Customer Experience (CX) Operations Platform
  • English Level: Advanced (spoken and written)

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Fullstack Engineer with a strong frontend focus to join a high-impact team building our client´s internal Customer Experience (CX) Operations platform — the tools CX agents and supervisors rely on daily to manage queues, assignments, conversations, and operational workflows.

This role is dedicated to designing and shipping agent-facing UI within a modern, modular frontend architecture, while collaborating closely with the backend services that power queues, agents, assignments, metrics, dashboards, and supervisor controls. Beyond technical excellence, we are seeking someone with strong product sense and communication skills, capable of partnering with Product, CX stakeholders, and backend engineers to turn operational requirements into reliable, intuitive experiences.

The Audiobook Production Executive coordinates the production of the Simon & Schuster Australia audiobook list across all imprints, ensuring titles are delivered to a high standard, on schedule and within agreed budgets.

Working closely with Publishing, Sales, Marketing and Publicity, the role supports the continued growth of the audiobook format by developing effective production approaches, identifying promotional opportunities and providing informed advice on audiobook production and market trends.

The Job Role

The Audiobook Production Executive oversees the production process from recording through to publication. This includes developing casting approaches, booking narrators, studios and external production partners, liaising with authors and agents, monitoring schedules and costs, and ensuring appropriate quality-control standards are maintained.

The role will record and amend audiobook credits, undertake minor audio amendments, and maintain an effective network and database of narrators, studios and production partners in Australia and internationally. It will also support the development and improvement of production systems and workflows.

Working collaboratively with Sales, Marketing and Publicity, the role will identify opportunities for behind-the-scenes material, interviews, bonus content and advance listening copies. It will monitor local and international audiobook trends, contribute production advice during acquisitions discussions, assess the audiobook viability of proposed titles and identify potential audiobook-original opportunities involving new and existing authors.

The Candidate Profile

The successful candidate will have relevant knowledge of audiobook, audio, media or publishing production, with an understanding of production schedules, quality requirements and the commercial considerations involved in bringing audio content to market. Experience working with authors, agents, narrators, voice artists, studios or external production partners will be highly regarded.

Highly organised and detail focused, the candidate will be able to manage multiple titles, deadlines and competing priorities while working confidently and autonomously. Strong communication, negotiation and relationship-building skills are essential, together with sound judgement, initiative and a collaborative approach.

The candidate will have excellent written and verbal communication skills, proficiency in Microsoft Word and Excel, and ideally experience using Adobe Audition or similar audio-editing software. The Research Assistant will serve as Research Assistant for the Principal Investigator (PI). They will: Independently perform a wide range of highly technical and complex research and laboratory tests and procedures; Devise highly specialized research procedures by applying knowledge of advanced research techniques and equipment; Provide input and recommend alternative approaches to research protocols; Analyze and interpret the results of studies; Train research staff in specialized procedures and theoretical concepts for unique tests; Assist in grant and other funding application preparation; Review literature for related research developments and techniques; Prepare written materials, charts and graphs on specialized techniques and research results for publication or presentation; Monitor the handling, storage and disposal of hazardous substances.

POSITION ACCOUNTABILITIES AND ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

Works closely with the lab PI. Results of experiments are considered authoritative and the applicant’s judgments must be acceptable without significant changes. Research guidelines are provided by the lab PI. Essential functions include the following:

  • Histological assessment in animals (rats, mice, and nonhuman primate), histology, microarray data analysis, bioinformatics, genotyping, animal colony management, and microscopy.

title: Integration Build Engineer
description:
Vast is developing next-generation space stations and space infrastructure using an incremental, hardware-rich, and low-cost approach. Vast is rapidly developing its multi-module Haven Station to ensure a continuous human presence in space for America and its allies, enabling advanced microgravity research and manufacturing, and unlocking a new space economy for government, corporate, and private customers. Haven Demo’s 2025 success made Vast the only operational commercial space station company to fly and operate its own spacecraft. Next, Haven-1 is expected to become the world’s first commercial space station when it launches in 2027, followed by additional Haven modules. Additionally, the company recently announced Vast Satellite, a high-power satellite product line leveraging its space station components and the heritage of Haven Demo.

Headquartered in Long Beach, California, and with more than 1,000 employees and over a billion dollars in private capital, Vast has built the facilities required to manufacture and operate America’s next space station. The company plans to develop future habitats and systems for the Moon and Mars, dedicated space stations for government partners, and other crewed systems that will unlock the expanding long-term space economy.

Vast is looking for an Integration Build Engineer, reporting to the Vice President of E-2, to create the world's highest performing engine for small launchers, while optimizing for production and low cost. In this role, you will join a team with exciting momentum that has produced and successfully tested fully integrated engine development samples. You will be a key member who will help transition the system from development to production.

This will be a full-time, exempt position located in our Hawthorne location.

  • Create and maintain detailed manufacturing plans, assembly procedures, and work instructions to ensure consistent and accurate production
  • Ensure integration procedures are continuously evolving to reflect the most efficient assembly practices
  • Perform hands-on assembly, integration, and testing of components, ensuring compliance with engineering specifications and industry standards
  • Specify and procure dedicated manufacturing and tools and equipment
  • Implement continuous improvements on shop floor to increase productivity

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field
  • 2+ years of experience in manufacturing engineering, preferably in aerospace
  • Hands on hardware integration and testing experience
  • Experience with working with technicians and running multi person operations

title: Value Stream Coach: Las Vegas
description:
Who will you be working with?

As a member of Wabtec’s Lean Operations team, you will partner closely with plant leadership, frontline associates, functional leaders, and the broader Continuous Improvement organization to drive operational excellence across the facility. This role reports directly to the Group Lean Leader with a dotted-line reporting relationship to the Plant Manager. You will serve as a trusted coach, mentor, and change leader, working side-by-side with teams to build lean capabilities, strengthen problem-solving disciplines, and drive sustainable business results through the Wabtec Management System.

How will you make a difference?

As a member of the Lean Operations organization, you will be responsible for leading the site’s lean transformation journey while developing leadership capabilities and driving a culture of continuous improvement.

The Value Stream Coach serves as a strategic partner to plant leadership, helping teams improve safety, quality, delivery, cost, and customer satisfaction through the application of lean principles and practices. This role provides hands-on coaching, mentoring, and facilitation to leaders and associates while supporting the implementation and sustainability of the Wabtec Management System. The successful candidate will develop lean management capabilities throughout the organization, facilitate continuous improvement initiatives, and ensure operational excellence is embedded into daily business processes. Regular communication of progress, priorities, and performance outcomes will be shared with plant leadership and corporate lean leadership teams.

What do we want to know about you?

  • Minimum of 10 years of experience leading lean transformation initiatives within a manufacturing environment.
  • Demonstrated success driving organizational change and developing lean leadership capabilities across all levels of an organization.
  • Deep understanding and practical application of Lean Manufacturing and Toyota Production System (TPS) principles.
  • Experience implementing and sustaining pull systems, flow, kanban, and other lean operating practices.
  • Proven ability to influence, coach, mentor, and develop leaders and teams through hands-on engagement.
  • Experience facilitating kaizen events, Daily Management systems, and structured problem-solving methodologies.
  • Strong project and program management experience with a track record of delivering measurable results.
  • Bachelor's degree from an accredited university or college preferred.
  • Prior manufacturing leadership experience preferred.
  • Strong written, verbal, interpersonal, and presentation skills.
  • Ability to lead cross-functional teams and gain buy-in from stakeholders in a matrixed environment.
  • Willingness to travel approximately 10%.

What will your typical day look like?

  • Coach and develop plant leaders to strengthen lean leadership capabilities, change management skills, and execution of continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Lead implementation and sustainability of the Wabtec Management System and associated lean operating disciplines.
  • Facilitate Daily Management processes, kaizen events, A3 problem-solving activities, and value stream mapping workshops.
  • Partner with plant leadership to develop and execute continuous improvement strategies focused on safety, quality, delivery, cost, and customer satisfaction.
  • Coach teams on standard work, visual management, flow, pull systems, and waste elimination principles.
  • Monitor operational performance and support achievement of production, efficiency, and business objectives.
  • Build organizational capability through training, mentoring, and hands-on application of lean tools and methodologies.
  • Lead and support strategic initiatives assigned by the Group Lean Leader and broader Operations leadership team.

What about the physical demands of the job?

  • Frequent walking throughout manufacturing, warehouse, and office environments.
  • Ability to stand for extended periods while observing operations and facilitating improvement activities.
  • Ability to occasionally climb stairs, ladders, or access elevated work platforms in accordance with site safety requirements.
  • Ability to visually inspect equipment, processes, production metrics, and operational performance indicators.
  • Ability to communicate effectively in office and manufacturing environments, including speaking, hearing, and presenting to groups.
  • Ability to wear required personal protective equipment (PPE) while working within manufacturing areas.

You may also be asked to perform other duties outside of your function or trade, for which adequate training will be provided if necessary.

Location

This position will be based out of the Wabtec facility located at 5406 E. El Campo Grande Ave., Las Vegas, NV 89115, approximately three miles south of Las Vegas Motor Speedway.

Relocation

Relocation assistance may be provided if eligibility requirements are met.

Work Authorization

Wabtec will only employ those who are legally authorized to work in the U.S. for this opening. Any offer of employment is conditioned upon the successful completion of a drug screen (as applicable) and fitness for duty test (as applicable)

The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. More information on offered benefits, which include health, welfare, and retirement, are available at mywabtecbenefits.com. What could you accomplish in a place that puts People First?

At Wabtec, it’s not just about a job - it’s about the impact you make. When our people come together, we’re Expanding the Possible by continuously improving what we do and how we do it - for our clients and each other.

If you’re ready to revolutionize how the world moves for future generations, Wabtec is the place for you.

Who are we?

Wabtec is a leading global provider of equipment, systems, digital solutions, and value-added services for the freight and transit rail sectors. Drawing on more than 150 years of experience, we are leading the way in safety, efficiency, reliability, innovation, and productivity. Whether it’s freight, transit, ports, logistics, mining, industrial, or marine, our expertise, technologies, and people together – are accelerating the future of transportation. With roots that date back to George Westinghouse, Thomas Edison, and Louis Faiveley, Wabtec has always built technologies and implemented solutions for a variety of sectors that are critical to meeting the needs of customers and governments alike.

Our global team of about 30,000 employees worldwide delivers performance that moves the world forward. We’re lifelong learners, obsessed with better. Learn more at www.WabtecCorp.com.

Culture powers us and the possibilities.

We believe the best ideas come from a mix of experiences and backgrounds. At Wabtec, we strive every day to create a place where everyone belongs. We’re building a culture where leadership, inclusion and your unique perspective fuel progress.

title: Claims Specialist 1
description:
Job Description:

This position is in-office 5 days a week.

About Walbec Group

Walbec produces high-quality construction materials and delivers unparalleled professional design, engineering and construction services at its six companies, including Payne and Dolan, Northeast Asphalt, Zenith Tech, Parisi, Premier Concrete, and Construction Resources Management. Whether building bridges, stabilizing shorelines, rehabilitating structures, or providing site engineering and construction solutions for solar, Walbec is your bridge to expertise in construction and engineering. With safety and ethics at the core of everything we do, our experienced professionals are hard at work on commercial and industrial sites throughout the Midwest.

The Position:

Under the direction of the Claims Manager, the Claims Specialist 1 is primarily responsible for handling Owned Property, Equipment, and Builder's Risk claims across multiple jurisdictions. The Claims Specialist 1 serves as a key business partner responsible for the investigation, documentation, reporting, follow-up, and resolution of claims.

This position performs professional-level work requiring the application of legal, analytical, and claims management principles. The individual must be highly organized and detail-oriented, exercise sound judgment, maintain established timelines and deadlines, and effectively manage multiple responsibilities that may require a quick turnaround.

Essential duties and responsibilities are outlined below. Additional duties may be assigned to meet business needs.

Responsibilities:

· Investigates Owned Property, Equipment, Builder's Risk, and other assigned claims of simple to moderate complexity.

· Conducts thorough claim and incident investigations.

· Communicates regularly with Safety, Project Managers, field personnel, and other appropriate internal departments to obtain claim and incident information and supporting documentation.

· Documents and maintains complete and accurate claim files, including associated costs, by entering claim and incident information into the Risk Management Information System, Origami.

· Establishes timely and adequate reserves in accordance with the organization's reserving philosophy and methodology.

· Evaluates questions involving insurance coverage, liability, damages, contractual responsibility, and claim value.

· Reviews applicable insurance policies, contracts, deductibles, coverage provisions, and project documentation.

· Secures necessary official reports, claim forms, estimates, invoices, photographs, receipts, and other supporting documentation.

· Reviews bills, estimates, invoices, and receipts for accuracy, reasonableness, and relevance to the claim.

· Coordinates site inspections when necessary.

· Works with internal and external parties to develop appropriate repair, replacement, mitigation, or resolution strategies.

· Monitors claim activity and follows up with the appropriate parties to ensure claims progress toward timely resolution.

· Identifies potential recovery opportunities and investigates and pursues recovery when appropriate.

· Documents recovery efforts, including subrogation and other applicable sources of reimbursement.

· Maintains appropriate follow-up regarding outstanding documentation, payments, reimbursements, and recovery efforts.

· Applies sound judgment and established claims-handling principles when evaluating coverage, liability, damages, and recovery opportunities.

· Maintains confidentiality of claim, employee, project, and company information.

· Provides cross-coverage for Workers' Compensation, General Liability, Auto Liability, and Auto Physical Damage claims, as necessary.

Requirements:

· Bachelor's degree or a minimum of three years of equivalent relevant work experience.

· Prior experience handling property, equipment, Builder's Risk, or multi-line claims preferred.

· Working knowledge of insurance coverage, claims investigation, reserving, damages evaluation, and recovery practices.

· Ability to review and apply relevant insurance policy and contractual provisions.

· Experience with Risk Management Information Systems, Origami, preferred.

· Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.

· Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills

· Strong written and verbal communication skills.

· Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to work effectively with internal and external business partners.

· Ability to manage multiple priorities and demanding assignments in a fast-paced environment.

· Ability to exercise sound judgment, maintain established timelines, and meet applicable deadlines.

· Ability to work independently while appropriately escalating complex coverage, liability, contractual, or claim-handling issues.

· High level of discipline and a strong sense of responsibility and accountability.

· Consistent attention to detail and commitment to maintaining complete and accurate claim documentation.

· Valid driver's license and ability to meet applicable company insurability standards.

Must have an active DoD Secret clearance.

A strong background of ServiceNow development and experienced in the design and implementation of ServiceNow security architecture.

Certifications such as ServiceNow Certified System Administrator, Certified Implementation Specialist, ITIL Foundation, and optionally Enterprise Architecture or advanced ServiceNow certifications.

ServiceNow platform engineering (cloud) with TPSM Modules including Service Request, Incident, Problem, Change, and Configuration Management and security / regulatory disciplines.

An excellent communicator with the ability to talk on a process level with clients and manage the direction of a distributed development team.

Experience of significant cloud hosted Service Now implementations which span TPSM and security / regulatory disciplines.

Experience in designing Application Programming Interface (API) frameworks to move data into and out of ServiceNow.

Knowledge of AI integration within ServiceNow, including Now Assist and AI Agents.

Experience with optimizing ServiceNow table structures and data models.

Proven experience in large-scale ServiceNow implementations and platform governance.

Master's degree in IT or a related field.

Certified Application Developer.

ITIL v4 Foundations Certification.

BMC Helix or BMC Remedy experience.

title: Sr. Software Engineer II - Cloud Detection Engine (Hybrid, London)
description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.



The CrowdStrike Cloud Detection Engine (CDE) team is building a powerful, next-generation platform designed to be a force multiplier for security teams. Our platform empowers customers who leverage multiple Falcon products to create and manage advanced, unified detections and content. This core platform capability is a strategic imperative for CrowdStrike, aiming to provide a competitive advantage that is difficult to replicate, ensuring our customers have unparalleled detection and response capabilities across the entire Falcon ecosystem.

We build the real-time data systems behind CrowdStrike's detection pipeline. Our team owns the streaming engine that processes all first-party sensor telemetry and maintains a petabyte-scale graph of real-time system activity, and the distributed correlation engine that evaluates trillions of events a day to catch multi-stage attacks that no single event can surface. Both systems are at the core of how CrowdStrike finds adversaries.

We're looking for someone who is excited about working in systems programming: custom query languages, graph databases, state machines, performance work where microseconds matter. We ship fast, we build with modern tooling including AI in our dev workflow, and own everything end to end from design to production


About the Role:
We are seeking a Senior Engineer II to join the CDE Platform team. In this role, you will be instrumental in designing, building, and scaling the foundational services that orchestrate data, content, and execution logic across CrowdStrike’s products (e.g., NGSIEM, FCS, Endpoint). You will be a key driver in creating a highly performant, scalable, and resilient platform that processes internet-scale data streams and enables real-time detection generation.

  • Lead backend engineering efforts from rapid prototypes to large-scale applications across CrowdStrike products

  • Kafka

  • Docker

  • Redis

  • Degree in Computer Science (or professional experience in data structures/algorithms/distributed systems)

  • Being a team player

  • A thorough understanding of engineering best practices from appropriate testing paradigms to effective peer code reviews and resilient architecture.

  • The ability to thrive in a fast-paced, test-driven, collaborative and iterative programming environment.

  • The skills to meet your commitments on time and produce high-quality software that is unit tested, code reviewed and checked in regularly for continuous integration.

  • Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.

Bonus Points:

  • Contributions to the open-source community (GitHub, Stack Overflow, blogging)

  • Existing exposure to Go or C++, Scala, AWS, Cassandra, Kafka, Elasticsearch...

title: Principal Engineer, Router Architect
description:
We are seeking a Principal Router Architect with 10 to 15 years of experience to define the backbone of next-generation Zonal and Central Compute Automotive architectures. This role focuses on architecting high-bandwidth, ultra-reliable Ethernet Routing Engines and PCIe subsystems that serve as the primary data fabric for Autonomous Driving (AD) and Cockpit controllers. The ideal candidate will bridge the gap between high-speed data center-grade throughput and the rigorous Safety (ISO 26262) and Deterministic Networking requirements of the automotive industry.

Responsibilities:

  • Automotive Ethernet Routing: Architect L2/L3 switch fabrics supporting Time-Sensitive Networking (TSN) standards (e.g., IEEE 802.1AS, 802.1Qbv, 802.1Qbu) to ensure deterministic latency for safety-critical traffic.
  • PCIe Backbone Architecture: Define PCIe Gen 5/6 integration for high-speed chip-to-chip connectivity between SoCs, AI accelerators, and storage, including support for SR-IOV to virtualize resources across multiple Virtual Machines (VMs).
  • Functional Safety (ASIL): Integrate hardware safety mechanisms (ECC, Parity, BIST, and End-to-End protection) to meet ASIL-B/D requirements within the routing engine and bus fabrics.
  • Zonal Interconnect & Bus Fabric: Design the interface between Ethernet/PCIe controllers and internal NoC/CHI fabrics, ensuring efficient data movement for ADAS sensors (Camera, LiDAR) and telemetry.
  • Virtualization & Security: Architect hardware-assisted isolation and Secure On-board Communication (SecOC) to protect the vehicle network from cyber threats while allowing shared access to network resources.
  • Infrastructure & Power: Define robust clock, reset, and power management schemes capable of operating under automotive thermal profiles and supporting rapid "Instant-On" boot requirements

  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s in Electrical Engineering or Computer Engineering (PhD desirable)
  • Experience: 12+ years in high-speed networking or SoC architecture, with at least 5 years focused on Automotive-grade silicon.
  • TSN Mastery: Deep expertise in IEEE 802.1 TSN protocols and their hardware implementation for real-time traffic shaping and synchronization.
  • Protocol Expertise: Expert knowledge of PCIe (Root Complex/Endpoint) and Automotive Ethernet (10BASE-T1S to 10G+ levels).
  • Automotive Standards: Familiarity with ISO 26262 functional safety flows and AEC-Q100 reliability requirements.
  • System Integration: Proven track record of integrating routing engines into complex SoCs using AXI/CHI bus protocols and managing IOMMU configurations.

Quality Assurance Technician - 1st shift (7am - 3:30pm)

Summary/Purpose

The quality assurance technician will support manufacturing and follow policies and procedures related to successful operations.

Essential Duties and Accountabilities:
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform the essential duties satisfactorily.

Perform measurements of components and assemblies
Perform heat treat inspection including cutting, mounting, polishing and hardness testing
Perform weld testing/inspection
Performs receiving inspection when needed
Assist in problem solving for nonconformances
Conduct basic PM and cleaning (5S) duties
Others duties as assigned by management

Supervisory Responsibilities:

This position has no supervisory responsibilities.

Job Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:
The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill and/or ability required.

Metrology and gage calibration experience
Metallurgy basics and heat treat testing
Problems solving capabilities (especially related to manufacturing)
Knowledge of GD&T and SPC
Product and performance testing
Willing/able to learn to operate and maintain various equipment at an acceptable level with an emphasis on quality, IATF 16949 standard, ISO 14001, safety/environmental, 5S and productivity
Ability to understand and demonstrate standard work and support company policy
Proficient communication skills, both written and oral
Ability to work in a team environmental and be flexible

Education and Experience:

High school diploma or GED equivalent.

Work Environment/Physical Demands:

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Work shift as assigned and overtime is required, as needed.
Will be required to do the following throughout the shift: standing, bending, pushing, pulling, reaching above and below shoulders, moving left to right repetitively, grasping, and fine finger dexterity.
May be required to lift during shift up to 40 lbs.
Specific vision abilities required with this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus.
The performance of this position requires exposure to manufacturing areas which require the use of personal protective equipment such as steel toed shoes, safety glasses with side shields.

title: Senior Cloud Engineer F/H
description:
Are you ready to invent the future of cloud infrastructure? Join us to shape a new era in cloud computing and build a career that matches your ambition. We are looking for Cloud Engineers to design, deploy, and operate the infrastructure-as-a-Service (IaaS) layer of the Outscale cloud in Houston, TX or in Secaucus, NJ.

You will work at the intersection of our Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS) and the underlying physical infrastructure, driving automation, expanding services to new regions, and ensuring the platform is secure, resilient, high performing, and compliant. You will partner with infrastructure development, automation, and operations teams to implement cloud best practices and deliver production ready, compliant cloud solutions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Deploy, operate, and maintain the OUTSCALE cloud platform, with a focus on scalability, performance, reliability, and security.
  • Build and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and automation pipelines using Terraform, Ansible, SaltStack, Packer, Jenkins, and related tools.
  • Automate and standardize deployments, upgrades, and regional expansions through repeatable and auditable release processes.
  • Improve platform performance, resilience, scalability, and cost efficiency while contributing to its technical evolution.
  • Define and track SLIs, SLOs, SLAs, and other key operational metrics.
  • Build and maintain monitoring and observability solutions using Prometheus, Grafana, Zabbix, and the ELK Stack.
  • Identify and address performance issues, security risks, and single points of failure.
  • Lead incident investigations, conduct root-cause analyses, and participate in the on-call rotation.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation, runbooks, and operational procedures, and lead internal knowledge-sharing sessions.
  • Collaborate with engineering, security, product, support, vendor, and partner teams.
  • Support capacity planning and infrastructure roadmap development.
  • Ensure compliance with internal security policies and applicable regulatory requirements

Minimum Qualifications

  • 8–10 years of experience in infrastructure/cloud engineering
  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, or a related discipline.
  • Strong infrastructure virtualization and system administration skills
  • Good working knowledge of AWS based infrastructure services
  • Proficiency in scripting and automation using Bash and Python 3.
  • Expertise in infrastructure automation with SaltStack or Ansible; SaltStack experience is preferred.
  • US Citizenship required; eligibility for security clearance is a must for this role.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Deep understanding of networking fundamentals and physical and virtual compute, storage, and infrastructure technologies.
  • Experience with data protection, backup, disaster recovery, and compliance frameworks.
  • Working knowledge of Kubernetes architecture and operations.
  • Experience administering HAProxy, NGINX, Redis, and database technologies.
  • Experience with monitoring and observability tools, including Prometheus, Grafana, Zabbix, and the ELK Stack.
  • Experience with virtualization technologies such as QEMU, KVM, and VMware ESXi.
  • Hands-on experience with IaC and automation tools, including Terraform, Packer, and Jenkins.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, with an automation-first mindset.

title: Associate Director, Genesis, Portfolio Operations
description:

title: Director, Diagnostic Imaging
description:
Summary

Job Description:

Director, Diagnostic Imaging

Full-Time, 1st Shift

Radiology Support | Corbin, KY

The Radiology Support Unit provides essential administrative, technical, and patient support services that help ensure the efficient operation of diagnostic imaging departments. Team members serve as a vital link between patients, providers, technologists, and clinical departments, helping coordinate imaging services while delivering exceptional customer service and support throughout the patient's care experience.

The Director of Diagnostic Imaging will be responsible for the development, organization, and ongoing management of diagnostic imaging services. Responsibilities that include planning, implementing, evaluating quality of care and management, development and motivation of personnel. Assists in the development and implementation of imaging standards of practice, policies and procedures, standards of patient care, and metrics to measure, assess, and improve patient care consistent with research, evidence-based practices, and nationally recognized professional standards. Prepares and submits budget and is responsible for maintaining adherence to the budget. Coordinates and/or participate in multidisciplinary teams involving internal and external members. Responsible for appropriate delegation and supervision of the duties of the diagnostic imaging staff. title: AI Engineer - Mid-Level
description:
As a Data Engineer II on the Data & Analytics team at St. Peter’s Health, you’ll play a key role in building and supporting the data solutions that help drive better healthcare decisions. You’ll design and maintain data pipelines, integrations, models, and cloud-based data assets while working with clinical, financial, operational, and business teams to turn complex data into trusted, actionable insights. Using technologies such as SQL and Snowflake, you’ll help modernize our data environment, improve data quality and reliability, and support secure, governed access to information across the organization. This role offers the opportunity to work independently, collaborate with a talented team, explore responsible AI-enabled tools, and make a meaningful impact through data.

KNOWLEDGE/EXPERIENCE:
Required:

  • Four or more years of relevant experience in data engineering, data analytics, database development, business intelligence, or related information technology work; or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Strong working knowledge of SQL and relational database concepts.
  • Experience independently designing and supporting data extracts, data transformations, data validation, reporting datasets, analytical data assets, and production data pipelines.
  • Working knowledge of data modeling, data quality, data integration, orchestration, monitoring, and production support concepts.
  • Demonstrated ability to document technical work clearly, including data mappings, business rules, process steps, runbooks, and support procedures.
  • Demonstrated analytical, written, verbal, customer service, and stakeholder engagement skills.

Preferred:

  • Healthcare provider, payer, health system, or healthcare analytics experience.
  • Experience with Epic, Clarity, Caboodle, Cogito, or a comparable EHR system.
  • Experience with Snowflake or a comparable cloud data platform; BI tools; ETL/ELT or orchestration tools.
  • Experience with Git, Azure DevOps, APIs, SFTP, or file-based data exchange patterns.
  • Experience with Python, dbt, AWS Glue, Azure Data Factory, or similar data engineering tools.
  • Familiarity with HIPAA, HITECH, healthcare data privacy, information security practices, and responsible use of AI-enabled productivity tools.

EDUCATION:
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Information Systems, Data Analytics, Health Informatics, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Business Analytics, or a related field is preferred. In the absence of a bachelor’s degree, an associate degree or relevant advanced certifications in a related field with six or more years of relevant experience may be accepted.

A master’s degree in a related field is preferred and may substitute for a portion of required experience. Equivalent combinations of education, certification, and directly relevant experience may be considered.

LICENSE/CERTIFICATION/REGISTRY: No license required. Preferred certifications include Snowflake, Epic Cogito/Clarity/Caboodle, Microsoft Azure, AWS, SQL, data engineering, data analytics, cloud data platform, information security, or healthcare analytics credentials.

title: AI Research Engineer (Pre-training - LLM & Multi-Modal)
description:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

As a member of the AI model team, you will drive innovation in architecture development for cutting-edge models of various scales, including small, large, and multi-modal systems. Your work will enhance intelligence, improve efficiency, and introduce new capabilities to advance the field.

You will have a deep expertise in Large Language Model (LLM) and Multi-Modal architectures, a strong grasp of pre-training optimization, and a hands-on, research-driven approach. Your mission is to explore and implement novel techniques and algorithms that lead to groundbreaking advancements: multi-modal data curation and alignment, strengthening baselines, and identifying and resolving existing pre-training bottlenecks to push the limits of cross-modal AI performance.

Responsibilities

  • Large-Scale Pre-Training: Conduct foundational pre-training for LLMs and Multi-Modal models (integrating text, vision, audio, or other modalities) on large, distributed servers equipped with multi-nodes & thousands of NVIDIA GPUs.

  • Architecture & Alignment Innovation: Design, prototype, and scale innovative architectures, tokenizers, and cross-modal alignment layers to enhance model intelligence and multi-modal understanding.

  • Data Strategy: Source, filter, and curate massive-scale textual and multi-modal datasets, establishing robust data pipelines for efficient pre-training.

  • Experimental Research: Independently and collaboratively execute experiments, analyze results, and refine training methodologies for optimal performance and token efficiency.

  • Optimization & Debugging: Investigate, debug, and eliminate bottlenecks in model efficiency, computational performance, and multi-modal alignment stability during long training runs.

  • System Scalability: Contribute to the advancement of distributed training systems to ensure seamless scalability and hardware efficiency on target platforms.

Requirements

  • A degree in Computer Science or related field. Ideally PhD in NLP, Machine Learning, or a related field, complemented by a solid track record in AI R&D (with good publications in A* conferences).

  • Hands-on experience contributing to large-scale LLM or Multi-Modal pre-training runs on large, distributed servers equipped with thousands of NVIDIA GPUs, ensuring scalability and impactful advancements in model performance.

  • Familiarity and practical experience with large-scale, distributed training frameworks, libraries and tools.

  • Deep knowledge of state-of-the-art transformer and non-transformer modifications aimed at enhancing intelligence, efficiency and scalability.

  • Strong expertise in PyTorch and Hugging Face libraries with practical experience in model development, continual pretraining, and deployment.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

title: L&I Medical Program Specialist 2, Bilingual Spanish
description:
Description

Our Mission: Keep Washington Safe and Working!
Our Values: Customer Focus, One L&I, Respect, Diversity, Equity and Inclusion, Learning and Growth, Reliability


Do you read, write, and communicate fluently in Spanish and English? Are you looking for an opportunity to take your experience working in a medical clinic, managing insurance claims or vocational service work to the next level? Do you want to work on a positive, goal-oriented team and focus on improving access to high-quality care for workers with limited English proficiency and/or who experience cultural barriers when using the workers’ compensation system?

If so, check out this opportunity and consider joining our team as our next Bilingual Medical Program Specialist 2.

If hired for this position, our top applicant will be required to pass an assessment of your ability to write and speak Spanish fluently. We do not use translating software. Employees with bilingual responsibilities receive a 5% increase in pay.

What we are looking for:

  • An individual who has experience with quality improvement principles and practices.
  • Demonstrated understanding of clinical workflow.
  • Ability to read, write, and communicate effectively in both English and Spanish.
  • An individual who has experience with care coordination, including collaborating with a variety of provider types.
  • Proficiency in cultural mediation and the ability to effectively work with individuals from diverse cultural and linguistic backgrounds.

The Department of Labor & Industries (L&I) is a diverse state agency dedicated to the safety, health, and security of Washington's workers. We help employers meet safety and health standards and inspect workplaces when alerted to hazards. As administrators of the state's workers' compensation system, we are similar to a large insurance company, providing medical and limited wage-replacement coverage to workers who suffer job-related injuries and illness. Our rules and enforcement programs also help ensure workers are paid what they are owed, that children's and teens' work hours are limited, and that consumers are protected from unsound business practices.

Insurance Services is the largest division within the agency and administers one of the premier workers’ compensation organizations in the nation serving over 3.8 million employees working for 260,000 employers.

Within Insurance Services, the Office of the Medical Director (OMD) is responsible for L&I’s statewide health policy to ensure that injured and ill workers have access to high quality, evidence-based care and that services paid for by the workers compensation Medical Aid Fund are clinically appropriate and cost effective.


Duties

Some of what you’ll do:

  • Conduct outreach with community healthcare providers in English and/or Spanish.
  • Provide English and Spanish customer service to injured workers, providers and health care organizations regarding L&I services and using the workers comp system to improve access to services.
  • Collaborate with provider staff and other care team members to develop procedures and care pathways that will reduce potential barriers to treatment.
  • Collaborate with appropriate internal programs and units to provide assistance to providers in English and/or Spanish.
  • Assess claim-specific issues and provider process support, recommend course of action and seek to ensure high-quality health care delivery.
  • Create and implement policies/procedures related to quality improvement, appropriate treatment, and cost containment.
  • And much more!

Qualifications

Required:

The ability to read, write, and speak fluently in Spanish and English.

AND

One-year of experience as a Medical Program Specialist 1,

OR

A Master’s degree with major study in public health, public administration, nursing, health administration, economics, mathematics, accounting, business administration, or closely allied field, AND Two years of supervisory or consultative experience in analysis, research, program coordination, or project management in a health services, medical insurance, social services, or workers compensation program,

OR

A Bachelor’s degree with major study in public health, public administration, nursing, health administration, economics, mathematics, accounting, business administration, or closely allied field, AND Four years of consultative experience in analysis, research, program coordination, or project management in a health services, medical insurance, social services, cost account, financial management, or workers compensation program,

OR

A total of eight years of demonstrated relevant professional experience in analysis, research, program coordination, or project management in a health services, medical insurance, social services, cost account, financial management, or workers compensation program will substitute for education.

*Qualifying experience could be clinical, vocational, or with insurance claim management.

Required Language Qualifications:

  • Ability to read, write, and communicate effectively in both English and Spanish to increase access to services for underserved communities and Limited English Proficient (LEP) injured workers.
  • Must successfully pass language testing at the Advanced-Low pass language testing at the advanced-low proficiency level.

AND the following competencies:

  • The ability to take action to learn and grow.
  • The ability to take action to meet the needs of others.

Desired:

  • Five or more years of progressively responsible experience in healthcare delivery, healthcare program administration, care coordination, or quality improvement.
  • Prior Experience working in occupational health and/or workers' compensation programs.
  • Familiarity with Washington State L&I workers' compensation systems, including Claim and Account Center (CAC), Utilization Review, and FileFast.
  • Ability to read, write, and communicate in Russian and/or Mandarin Chinese in addition to English and Spanish.

Supplemental Information

Things You Need To Know

At L&I, your voice matters. L&I is a diverse state agency dedicated to the safety, health and security of Washington's 3.8 million workers. Watch this brief video and learn more about why L&I is an employer of choice.

L&I provides a modern work environment and excellent benefits including paid leave, tuition reimbursement, Infants at Work Program and a generous retirement package for qualified employees at the end of their career. Click on the “Benefits” tab to learn more.

We value our employees and their work-life balance. We support a hybrid work model and offer flexible custom work schedules. This position is eligible for a flexible schedule (4/10’s, 9/80’s, 5/8’s, etc.) upon approval by management.

Telework is dependent upon business needs and supervisor approval. For positions where statewide travel or travel to other office environments is needed, the frequency of telework will be discussed with the supervisor of the position at the time of offer. The incumbent must reside anywhere in Washington State and preferably in the following counties: Clallam, Jefferson, Kitsap, Pierce, Grays Harbor, Mason, Pacific, Thurston, Lewis, Wahkiakum, Cowlitz, Clark, Skamania, Klickitat.

The assigned duty station for this position is Tumwater, Washington.

To receive more information on opportunities at L&I sign up for GovDelivery and select L&I job alerts.

Application process

To be considered for this opportunity, you must submit a complete online application including detailed work history and professional references with current phone numbers.

Please include the following documents with your application:

  1. A cover letter describing specific qualifications.
  2. A current resume detailing applicable experience and education.
  3. A list of at least three professional references with current telephone numbers.

We will contact the top candidates directly to advance in the selection process. Because we base the selection on the information you provide, please ensure your application clearly demonstrates how your experience relates to the qualifications and responsibilities described in this announcement.

Applications with incomplete work history, references to a resume in place of detailed work experience, or missing attachments may be considered incomplete and not considered for further review.

Please do not attach or place any medical information (vaccination status included) within the application, resume, or cover letter. If you do, we will have to reject your application to safeguard others from receiving your confidential information. You will have to remove the confidential information before you can apply again.

To learn more about our hiring process timeline at L&I please visit our L&I recruiting page at Hiring Process at L&I. If you would like to read our website in a language other than English, scroll up to the top of the page to select your language of choice from the banner.

Background Check Notice:

Prior to a placement in this position, a background check, including criminal history record will be conducted. Information from your background check will not necessarily preclude employment but will be considered in determining your eligibility to perform the requirements of the position.

Other information

  • For positions requiring travel, you must have a valid unrestricted driver's license and have insurance if driving a privately owned vehicle on state business.
  • This position is represented by the Washington Federation of State Employees (WFSE).
  • Candidates who are offered a job with L&I must possess work authorization that does not require sponsorship by the employer for a visa now or in the future.
  • The Department of Labor & Industries complies with the employment eligibility verification requirements of the federal employment eligibility verification form, I-9. The selected candidate must be able to provide proof of identity and eligibility to work in the United States consistent with the requirements of that form on the first day of employment.
  • Please note: L&I may use this announcement to fill multiple permanent and/or non-permanent positions.


Did You Know?

Washington is America's Top State to live, play, and work, according to U.S. News (2021). Join the L&I team and enjoy all the Evergreen State has to offer.

Veterans Preference


Applicants wishing to claim Veterans Preference should attach to their application a copy of their DD-214 (Member 4 copy), NGB 22, or signed verification of service letter from the United States Department of Veterans Affairs. Please blackout any personally identifiable data such as Social Security numbers. For further information, contact L&I’s Jobs@lni.wa.gov.

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Employer

L&I employees come from all walks of life. We strive to hire great people from a wide variety of backgrounds. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

We believe in the importance of recognizing the value each of us contribute to the success of the agency mission. Having a diverse workforce is this agency’s greatest resource of strength and knowledge. It is through the combination of talents and abilities that we can pursue finding effective measures to provide the best customer service. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace for everyone and we strongly mean everyone.

The State of Washington is an equal opportunity employer. Persons with a disability who need accommodation in the application process or testing process, or those needing this announcement in an alternative format, may call 360-902-5700. TTY users should first call 711 to access the Washington Relay Service.

You are welcome to include the name and pronoun you would like to be referred to in your materials and we will honor this as you interact with our award-winning diverse and inclusive organization.

For more Information

If you have any questions regarding this job posting, program, or the agency, please contact Jacque Crawford at HRBTU@lni.wa.gov.

title: Solutions Architect
description:
Movable Ink scales content personalization for marketers through data-activated content generation and AI decisioning. The world’s most innovative brands rely on Movable Ink to maximize revenue, simplify workflow and boost marketing agility. Headquartered in New York City with close to 600 employees, Movable Ink serves its global client base with operations throughout North America, Central America, Europe, Australia, and Japan.

As a Solutions Architect, you will work with some of the world’s best-known brands, enabling them to deliver AI-powered, highly personalized email and mobile programs. You will act as a universal translator, investigator, and product evangelist focused on establishing clients for long-term success. Using your technical expertise, you will partner with our clients and internal teams to scope, design, and implement custom technical solutions, develop project plans, and manage them through to completion. Naturally curious and determined, you’ll hunt down and resolve technical issues within the client environment, considering the impact on future integrations and the overall technical landscape.

Responsibilities:

  • Client Onboarding & Migration: Lead the technical setup and onboarding process for new clients, guiding them to migrate existing email and marketing strategies to our AI/ML-based platform quickly and smoothly.
  • Solution Design & Customization: Collaborate with clients and cross-functional internal teams to scope, design, and implement custom technical solutions, integrations (e.g., Custom Apps, Webhook transforms, CDP/API integrations), and workflows to achieve client objectives.
  • Data Orchestration: Working directly with client and internal teams to parse, manipulate and format data feeds to support near and long-term initiatives.
  • Issue Resolution & Troubleshooting: Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve complex integration issues, evaluating potential impacts across key stakeholders including clients, GTM teams, EPD, and leadership.
  • Training & Workshops: Conduct virtual and in-person engaging training sessions and workshops to empower clients and internal teams with knowledge about our platform.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with Sales, Solution Consultants, Implementation Managers, and other teams to ensure a cohesive and successful client experience
  • Product Expertise & Thought Leadership: Serve as a subject matter expert and go-to resource on Studio, Da Vinci, and applied AI use cases; advise on product roadmap and feature improvements based on client feedback.

Qualifications:

  • 3+ years in a technical implementation, solution architect, or technical account management role, preferably in the marketing technology sector
  • 3+ years of consulting experience, influencing marketing strategy with advanced technical solutions across interconnected systems
  • Extensive experience with multiple enterprise email or mobile service providers (e.g., Attentive, Airship, Bird, Sinch, Vibes, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Oracle Responsys, Adobe Campaign, Adobe Journey Optimizer, Braze, Epsilon, Cordial, Cheetah Digital, Bloomreach, Zeta, Iterable)
  • Ability to identify opportunities to further integrate with clients' existing APIs, web services, and tech stacks
  • Proven track record of managing complex client onboarding projects
  • Technical proficiency in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and data architectures; familiarity with Python or API/webhook integrations is a plus
  • 2+ years experience with cloud-based large data warehousing solutions, data lakes, and ETL processes
  • Excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills
  • High-level understanding of digital marketing strategies/objectives for Movable Ink supported channels (currently Email, Mobile) and the expected outcomes of personalization strategies
  • Ability to explain technical concepts in simple terms to various stakeholders
  • Strong communication and project management skills
  • Strong understanding of AI/ML applications in email and digital marketing, including experience managing AI systems

The base pay range for this position is $81K - $106K/year and OTE range is $97.3K -127K, which can include additional bonus depending on the position ultimately offered, in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits. The base pay offered may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

Studies have shown that women, communities of color, and historically underrepresented people are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive culture where all Inkers can thrive. If you’re excited about the role but don’t meet all of the abovementioned qualifications, we encourage you to apply. Our differences bring a breadth of knowledge and perspectives that makes us collectively stronger.

We welcome and employ people regardless of race, color, gender identity or expression, religion, genetic information, parental or pregnancy status, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, ethnicity, family or marital status, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, disability, Veteran status, or other protected characteristics. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

title: Dental Administrator
description:
Position: Dental Administrator
Location: Bragg Creek, AB
Clinic: Bragg Creek Dental

We know that exceptional patient care goes beyond scheduling appointments and processing paperwork—it’s about creating a welcoming experience, building trust, and ensuring every visit is smooth and stress-free.
We're growing and building something special! As our practice expands, we’re seeking a skilled and dedicated Dental Administrator who’s ready to play a key role in our continued success. This is your chance to join a collaborative, patient-focused team where your expertise truly makes an impact.

Specifics about the role:

Job Type: Full-time
Schedule: 5 Days per week (evenings and weekends)

Bragg Creek Dental is located in the beautiful foothills of the Rocky Mountains, just a short drive from Calgary. The scenic commute through rolling foothills and forested landscapes offers a refreshing start and end to your day, making the drive feel less like a commute and more like an escape from the city.
Currently operating out of the owner’s residence, we’re excited to move into our expanded clinic space with a targeted opening in July 2026. description:

title: Director, Product Management, Core Products
description:
PENN Entertainment, Inc. is North America’s leading provider of integrated entertainment, sports content, and casino gaming experiences. From casinos and racetracks to online gaming, sports betting and entertainment content, we deliver the experiences people want, how and where they want them.

We’re always on the lookout for those who are passionate about creating and delivering cutting-edge online gaming and sports media products. Whether it’s through Hollywood Casino, theScore Bet Sportsbook, or theScore media app, we’re excited to push the boundaries of what’s possible. These state-of-the-art platforms are powered by proprietary in-house technology, a key component of PENN’s omnichannel gaming and entertainment strategy.

When you join PENN Entertainment’s digital team, you’ll not only work on these cutting-edge platforms through theScore and PENN Interactive, but you’ll also be part of a company that truly cares about your career growth. We’re committed to supporting you as you expand your skills and explore new opportunities.

With locations throughout North America, you can build a future at PENN Entertainment wherever you are. If you want to challenge conventions in gaming, media and entertainment, we want to talk to you.

About the Role & Team
We are looking for a Director of Product to lead our Core Products organization, responsible for the foundational experiences and platforms that enable customers to safely and seamlessly engage with PENN across online gaming and our digital retail experiences. This leader will own a broad portfolio across Identity & Trust, Payments & Fraud, and Internal Tools — including registration and onboarding, KYC, login and account access, compliance and Responsible Gaming, deposits and withdrawals, fraud prevention, and the tools and workflows used by Customer Support, VIP, and operational teams.

You will set the strategy for these areas, lead multiple product teams, and partner closely with Engineering, Design, Analytics, Compliance, Risk, Operations, and business leaders to improve customer experience, drive growth, manage risk, and build scalable capabilities across PENN. You will lead a team of Product Managers, including both managers and individual contributors.

About the Work

  • Define and drive the product strategy and roadmap for Core Products across Identity & Trust, Payments & Fraud, and Internal Tools.
  • Lead, coach, and develop Product Managers and product leaders, creating clear ownership and accountability across the portfolio.
  • Own critical customer journeys including registration, identity verification, account access, funding, withdrawals, and account management.
  • Build shared capabilities that support PENN’s online Sportsbook and Casino businesses and increasingly connect our digital and retail customer experiences.
  • Improve payment performance and customer funding experiences while partnering with Fraud and Risk teams to protect customers and the business.
  • Partner with Compliance and Responsible Gaming teams to build regulatory and customer-protection requirements into intuitive product experiences.
  • Modernize internal tools and workflows for Customer Support, VIP, Fraud, Compliance, and Operations, reducing manual work and improving how teams serve customers.
  • Establish clear KPIs and use customer insights, data, and business impact to prioritize investments and measure outcomes.
  • Partner deeply with Engineering to make thoughtful decisions around platform architecture, scalability, reliability, and third-party integrations.
  • Influence and align senior stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Design, Analytics, Operations, Compliance, Legal, Finance, and our business teams.
  • Other duties as required.

About You

  • 8+ years’ experience in product management, plus 2+ years of people leadership experience is required.

  • Experience in one or more complex platform domains such as identity, authentication, onboarding, KYC, payments, fraud, risk, trust & safety, compliance, or internal tooling.

title: Vice President, Model Research & Development
description:
About Thomson Reuters Labs

Thomson Reuters Labs is the global research and development division of Thomson Reuters. We bring together scientists, engineers, and domain experts to explore emerging technologies and develop compelling new AI products.

From research and prototyping to customer success, our work bridges frontier science with practical application. Our innovations help professionals make better decisions, faster – for example, with intelligent legal assistants, automated compliance workflows, or agentic tax engines.

We are always looking for creative, highly adaptable scientists and engineers who enjoy solving hard problems that matter.

Job Description

Thomson Reuters Labs builds and ships custom models for professional workflows requiring fiduciary-grade AI. The Thomson LLM model family was developed by training leading open-weight models on decades of authoritative Thomson Reuters content, with thousands of hours of subject-matter-expert input. Owning the model layer is how we earn trust in the most regulated, highest-stakes professional workflows: it lets us tune for the accuracy, citation-grounding, and jurisdictional awareness our customers require, set our own training and evaluation priorities, and build the unit economics that let AI scale profitably across products used by more than a million professionals.

This role leads that effort: an organization of scientists, research engineers, and embedded subject-matter experts responsible for advancing Thomson Reuters's LLMs. Leadership includes setting direction for the research program and product roadmap.

See the detailed technical report for more information on the latest model release: Thomson 1.0 Technical Report on Hugging Face.

Location: this is a hybrid role that will be based in either Zug, Switzerland or London, UK.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the model-development roadmap end to end (data strategy, training, evaluation, and the release decision) for models that ship to real users across CoCounsel, Westlaw, and Practical Law.

  • Set the target for an online, agentic reinforcement-learning pipeline, training with subject-matter experts in the loop, and hold the work accountable to it.

  • Ensure data strategy and evaluation approach are rigorous and tied to measurable outcomes.

  • Enable new product capabilities to be built directly on Thomson LLMs, with demonstrated cost and/or quality advantages over third-party alternatives.

  • Build and retain a senior bench of scientists and engineers, including hiring the next wave of senior IC and leadership talent.

  • Partner across product, infrastructure, and editorial/SME teams to align model priorities with what customers actually need.

  • Make the model-quality, safety, and cost tradeoffs the role is accountable for, and represent that judgment to executive stakeholders.

Required Qualifications

  • Program ownership. You have led a production LLM program end to end (data strategy through training, evaluation, and the release decision) for models that shipped to real users, and personally made or ratified the calls, even where execution ran through your team.

  • Technical fluency. Enough command of post-training methods (SFT, preference optimization, RL), distributed training, and evaluation infrastructure to set direction, spot a training run going wrong, and be credible in the room with your own technical leads, without needing to run the experiments yourself.

  • Track record. Shipped models, widely-used open-source contributions, or peer-reviewed publications at top research venues (e.g., NeurIPS, ICML, ACL, EMNLP) that speak for themselves.

  • Leadership. Experience leading an organization of comparable size and shape (ideally with a manager/director layer beneath you), attracting and retaining senior ICs, and partnering across product, infrastructure, and domain experts.

  • Delegation with accountability. Comfortable delegating hands-on post-training and data-strategy execution to your team, while retaining full accountability for the outcomes.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience applying LLMs in law, tax, or another comparably regulated professional domain, or clear evidence you can acquire that grounding quickly.

  • Experience with model safety, adversarial robustness, and red-teaming, at the level of setting policy rather than implementing it.

#LI-PFF


What’s in it For You?

  • Hybrid Work Model: We’ve adopted a flexible hybrid working environment for our office-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected.
  • Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance.
  • Career Development and Growth: By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow’s challenges and deliver real-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future.
  • Industry Competitive Benefits: We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing.
  • Culture: Globally recognized, award-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together.
  • Social Impact: Make an impact in your community with our Social Impact Institute. We offer employees two paid volunteer days off annually and opportunities to get involved with pro-bono consulting projects and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives.
  • Making a Real-World Impact: We are one of the few companies globally that helps its customers pursue justice, truth, and transparency. Together, with the professionals and institutions we serve, we help uphold the rule of law, turn the wheels of commerce, catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world.

DISCLAIMER

The above information in this description has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employees within this classification. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities, and qualifications required of employees assigned to this job.


About Us

Thomson Reuters informs the way forward by bringing together the trusted content and technology that people and organizations need to make the right decisions. We serve professionals across legal, tax, accounting, compliance, government, and media. Our products combine highly specialized software and insights to empower professionals with the data, intelligence, and solutions needed to make informed decisions, and to help institutions in their pursuit of justice, truth, and transparency. Reuters, part of Thomson Reuters, is a world leading provider of trusted journalism and news.

We are powered by the talents of 26,000 employees across more than 70 countries, where everyone has a chance to contribute and grow professionally in flexible work environments. At a time when objectivity, accuracy, fairness, and transparency are under attack, we consider it our duty to pursue them. Sound exciting? Join us and help shape the industries that move society forward.

As a global business, we rely on the unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences of all employees to deliver on our business goals. To ensure we can do that, we seek talented, qualified employees in all our operations around the world regardless of race, color, sex/gender, including pregnancy, gender identity and expression, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, disability, age, marital status, citizen status, veteran status, or any other protected classification under applicable law. Thomson Reuters is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer providing a drug-free workplace.

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come.   • Apply strong problem-solving skills to rapidly understand and address complex technical concepts in support of mission and system design.
  • Prepare technical charts, present data, and provide clear, actionable recommendations to internal teams, program leadership, and external customers, demonstrating excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Manage tasking and mentor team members across multiple program schedules, ensuring execution of deliverables against tight deadlines.

This requisition may be filled at a higher grade based on the qualifications listed below.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Principal Software Engineer (Level 3)
    • Bachelor’s degree in a STEM discipline with 5+ years of relevant software engineering experience or Master’s degree in a STEM discipline with 3+ years of stated experience or Ph.D. in a STEM discipline with 1+ years of stated experience.
  • Sr. Principal Software Engineer (Level 4)
    • Bachelor’s degree in a STEM discipline with 8+ years of relevant software engineering experience or Master’s degree in a STEM discipline with 6+ years of stated experience or Ph.D. in a STEM discipline with 4+ years of stated experience.
  • Active U.S. Government Secret clearance required at the time of application.
  • Experience using FreeFlyer or similar flight dynamics modeling software.
  • Hands-on experience with astrodynamics and orbital mechanics.
  • Experience programming in Python and/or MATLAB.
  • Experience designing and/or optimizing satellite trajectories and maneuvers.
  • Familiarity with spacecraft deployment, state estimation, and station keeping concepts.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Hands-on experience developing software tools for constellation deployment, mission planning, and orbit raising.
  • Experience with low-thrust maneuver planning and nonlinear optimization algorithms
  • Knowledge of optical crosslink planning and automation of large satellite constellations (orbit determination, ephemeris propagation, maneuver planning).
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver innovative solutions for small-sat and new space missions.
  • Experience presenting technical work and system design at major reviews (e.g., Preliminary/Critical Design Review (PDR/CDR) with government customers.
