About Our Culture:
At the City of Grand Junction, we lead the way with continuous improvement, collaborative partnerships, and exemplary service. Our core values are demonstrated by our willingness to challenge the status quo, ability to work together using all areas of expertise to achieve a common goal, and commitment to fulfilling the needs of our community through thoughtful interactions.

About the Fleet Team Division:
The Fleet Services Division is responsible for the repair and maintenance of over 700 pieces of equipment that are utilized to serve our community in the areas of Public Safety, Street Maintenance, Wastewater, Water, Solid Waste, Recycling, Urban Forestry, Parks and Open Space. This is an ideal opportunity for someone dedicated to providing exemplary service who wants to be part of a diverse team that plays an important part in providing services directly to the community we live in.

What You'll Do:

  • Perform a variety of duties in the installation, maintenance, and repair of electrical systems; install, adjust, maintain, and repair electrical timers, electronic and hydraulic valves, and controllers, diagnose and find root cause of issues in interlock, and safety systems by reading interpreting, and following wiring diagrams.
  • Perform thorough diagnostic procedures on a variety of complex mechanical, hydraulic, and electrical systems using visual inspections, specialized testing equipment, and critical thinking skills.
  • Diagnose and repair major and minor components such as ignition, brakes, transmissions and drive train components.
  • Perform wood and metal fabrication as needed for the installation of specialized equipment; determine materials needed and basic design.
  • Other duties as assigned

To view the full job description for Automotive and Equipment Technician, please click here.

What We're Looking For:

  • Three (3) years of automotive and/or equipment repair experience.
  • High School Diploma or G.E.D.; supplemented by specialized training in preventative maintenance and routine repair of gas and diesel-powered equipment or a related field.
  • Possession of or the ability to obtain a valid Colorado Class B commercial driver's license with tanker endorsement within one (1) year of employment.
  • Possession of Air Conditioning Recovery and Recycle certification.

Other combinations of experience and education that meet the minimum requirements may be substituted.

This position is a safety-sensitive position, which means you will be subject to random drug screens due to the nature of the work performed.

Notice to Applicants:
In compliance with the Colorado Job Application Fairness Act, we kindly request that you do not include the dates of your education to include years of attendance or graduation on your application, resume or attachments.

City Employee Health Clinic:
The City is committed to supporting the health and well-being of employees and their families. Our near-site Sage Health & Wellness Center offers free or low-cost healthcare services for employees and dependents enrolled in a City health plan. Services include preventive care, health assessments and coaching, treatment for common illnesses, lab services, physical therapy, a medical massage therapist, and behavioral health counseling. The clinic also offers wellness programs, challenges, and classes that empower employees and their families to stay healthy and thrive.

Explore the Area:
Grand Junction, Colorado, is the key access point to the mountains and canyonlands of western Colorado and eastern Utah. Centrally located between Denver, CO (250 miles east) and Salt Lake City, UT (270 miles west), Grand Junction was named for the convergence of the Gunnison River and Colorado River. Over 1.5 million acres of public lands connect the area’s alpine terrain with the dramatic high desert, nourished by powerful rivers that sustain the vibrant agriculture industry. Opportunities for outdoor adventures are abundant in every season due to the year-round temperate climate. Home to “Nature’s Trifecta,” Grand Junction is surrounded by the Colorado National Monument – a mini-Grand Canyon, Rattlesnake Arches – the second-largest concentration of natural arches in the world, and the Grand Mesa – the largest flat-top mountain in the world. Agritourism, art and history, boutique shopping, and trendy restaurants complement the outdoor recreation scene. With a population over 160,000 in Mesa County (over 70,000 within the City limits), Grand Junction has all the city amenities you expect with a hometown atmosphere that is friendly and comfortable. title: Director, Global Logistics, Trade & Supply Chain Compliance
description:
Position Summary

Ichor Systems is seeking an experienced Director, Global Logistics, Trade & Supply Chain Compliance to lead the company's global logistics strategy, trade compliance program, Foreign-Trade Zone (FTZ) implementation, and supply chain compliance initiatives.

This senior leadership role is responsible for improving logistics performance, reducing landed cost, ensuring regulatory compliance, strengthening supply chain resilience, and enabling scalable global operations across a complex semiconductor manufacturing environment.

The successful candidate will combine strong operational leadership with deep expertise in international transportation, customs and export compliance, tariff management, supplier risk, and business process transformation. This individual must be comfortable operating at both the strategic and operational levels while partnering closely with executive leadership and global functional teams.

Key Responsibilities

Global Logistics Leadership

  • Lead Ichor's global transportation and logistics services across domestic and international business activities.
  • Develop logistics strategies that improve cost, service, delivery performance, visibility, and supply chain responsiveness.
  • Manage relationships with freight forwarders, carriers, customs brokers, and logistics service providers.
  • Drive freight optimization initiatives including network design, mode selection, consolidation, carrier strategy, and premium freight reduction.
  • Develop logistics KPIs, reporting, budgets, forecasts, and cost improvement programs.

Trade Compliance & Customs Strategy

  • Lead and continuously improve Ichor's global trade compliance program.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable import, export, customs, sanctions, and regulatory requirements.
  • Oversee classification, licensing, restricted party screening, recordkeeping, customs compliance, and related governance activities.
  • Monitor evolving trade regulations, tariffs, sanctions, and export control requirements impacting the semiconductor supply chain.
  • Partner with Finance, Procurement, and Operations to develop tariff mitigation and duty recovery strategies.

Foreign Trade Zone (FTZ) Program Leadership

  • Lead Ichor's FTZ activation initiative and transition the program into sustainable operations.
  • Establish policies, controls, governance processes, training, and operating procedures supporting FTZ compliance.
  • Partner with Operations, Finance, IT, and external stakeholders to integrate FTZ requirements into business processes.
  • Drive ongoing utilization, compliance, and financial benefits from FTZ operations.

Supply Chain Compliance & Risk Management

  • Lead supplier compliance and supply chain risk management programs across the global supply base.
  • Strengthen supplier visibility, risk assessment, responsible sourcing, and resilience capabilities.
  • Oversee supplier compliance activities supporting responsible minerals reporting, forced labor requirements, supplier due diligence, and customer compliance obligations.
  • Partner with Procurement, Quality, IT, and Operations to proactively identify and mitigate supply chain risks.

Systems, Analytics & Business Transformation

  • Develop technology roadmaps supporting logistics, trade compliance, supplier compliance, and supply chain visibility.
  • Improve data quality, automation, reporting, and decision support capabilities.
  • Partner with IT and business stakeholders to implement logistics, compliance, and analytics solutions.
  • Develop executive dashboards and metrics providing visibility into logistics performance, tariff exposure, compliance risk, and supplier resilience.

Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Lead and develop a global team while providing matrix leadership across multiple regions and functions.
  • Build strong partnerships across Procurement, Supply Chain, Operations, Engineering, Finance, Legal, IT, Quality, and executive leadership.
  • Translate complex regulatory and operational issues into practical business recommendations.
  • Drive cross-functional initiatives that improve cost, compliance, operational performance, and scalability.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, International Business, Business Administration, Engineering, Compliance, or a related field.
  • 10+ years of progressive experience in logistics, supply chain, international trade compliance, customs, or related disciplines.
  • 5+ years of leadership experience managing teams and complex cross-functional programs.
  • Strong knowledge of global transportation, customs operations, international logistics, and trade compliance requirements.
  • Working knowledge of U.S. import and export regulations including EAR, HTSUS, ECCN, export licensing, Customs compliance, AES filings, sanctions, and restricted party screening.
  • Experience managing freight providers, customs brokers, trade partners, and third-party service providers.
  • Demonstrated success leading complex business transformation or systems implementation initiatives.
  • Strong analytical, communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced global manufacturing environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience within semiconductor, electronics, precision manufacturing, aerospace, medical device, or other highly regulated manufacturing industries.
  • Foreign Trade Zone activation and operational experience.
  • Experience with tariff mitigation, duty recovery, customs strategy, and trade optimization programs.
  • Knowledge of supplier compliance, responsible sourcing, supply chain risk management, or resilience programs.
  • Experience implementing logistics, compliance, ERP, or supply chain technology solutions.
  • Licensed Customs Broker (LCB), CCS, CES, or similar professional certification.
  • International business experience working across multiple regions and cultures.

What Success Looks Like

  • Successful implementation and operation of Ichor's FTZ program.
  • Improved logistics performance, cost efficiency, and shipment visibility.
  • Reduced transportation expense and premium freight.
  • Effective tariff mitigation and trade compliance execution.
  • Enhanced supplier compliance, risk visibility, and supply chain resilience.
  • Increased automation, process standardization, and data-driven decision making.
  • Strong executive visibility into logistics, compliance, tariff exposure, and supply chain risk.
  • Development of a high-performing, scalable global team.

Why Join Ichor?

This is a unique opportunity to build and lead an integrated global function spanning logistics, trade compliance, FTZ operations, and supply chain risk management. The role offers significant executive visibility and the ability to directly influence cost, compliance, resilience, and operational performance across a global semiconductor supply chain.

title: Product Development Engineer
description:
ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.

Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.




THE ROLE:

As Product Development Engineer specializing in System Level Test (SLT), you will own hands-on debug execution across product bring-up, production ramp, and sustaining support. This role requires strong technical depth in SLT flows, platform enablement, diagnostics, BIOS/OS/firmware interactions, failure triage, and data-driven issue resolution to drive products from first silicon readiness through stable manufacturing execution.

The successful candidate will serve as a primary technical owner for SLT debug, working closely with Product Engineering, Test Engineering, Platform, Diagnostics, Design, Quality, Operations, Manufacturing, and OSAT partners to isolate issues, drive containment and corrective actions, and ensure timely readiness for release and sustaining needs. The ideal candidate is a strong hands-on problem solver who can connect system-level failures to actionable engineering paths and maintain execution discipline across multiple products and debug priorities.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Own SLT debug execution across bring-up, production ramp, and sustaining phases, ensuring issues are triaged, contained, and driven to closure
  • Drive structured debug of SLT failures across test content, test flow, platform, diagnostics, BIOS/OS/firmware, hardware, and manufacturing interactions
  • Lead first-pass triage, failure reproduction, isolation experiments, data collection, and issue characterization to identify root cause and next-step ownership
  • Partner with Product Engineering, Test Engineering, Platform, Diagnostics, Design, Quality, Operations, Manufacturing, and OSAT teams to resolve product and flow readiness blockers
  • Analyze yield, failure pareto, first-test-rate, repeatability, coverage, and test time data to identify debug priorities, execution risks, and improvement opportunities
  • Support SLT bring-up readiness by validating test flows, platform stability, diagnostics availability, data logging, automation, and release package completeness
  • Drive debug closure for production excursions, yield loss, test escapes, flow instability, hardware interactions, and OSAT execution issues
  • Document debug findings, containment actions, root-cause status, lessons learned, and recommended flow or coverage improvements
  • Communicate debug status, risks, blockers, and recovery plans clearly to technical leads, program stakeholders, and cross-functional partners

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:

  • 5~10 years’ experience in Product Development Engineering.
  • Hands-on experience in System Level Test, Product Engineering, Test Engineering, platform validation, silicon debug, or manufacturing test support
  • Strong experience owning debug activities during silicon bring-up, qualification readiness, production ramp, and sustaining support
  • Practical knowledge of SLT test flows, diagnostics, BIOS/OS/firmware dependencies, platform readiness, failure logging, automation, and release package validation
  • Demonstrated ability to isolate complex system-level failures using structured experiments, data analysis, reproduction methods, and cross-functional debug plans
  • Strong understanding of yield, failure pareto, first-test-rate, repeatability, test time, coverage, and quality metrics used to guide product and manufacturing decisions
  • Ability to work effectively with Product Engineering, Test Engineering, Platform, Diagnostics, Design, Quality, Operations, Manufacturing, and OSAT partners to close debug issues
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to summarize debug status, risks, blockers, root-cause progress, and recovery actions clearly and concisely
  • Ability to operate with ownership, urgency, and technical discipline in a fast-paced environment with parallel bring-up, and sustaining priorities

ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS:

  • BS/MS in Electrical / Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, or comparable disciplines

Hsinchu, Taiwan

title: Senior Software Engineer, Access Controls
description:
About Lucid

At Lucid, we are creating exceptional mobility experiences through innovation to drive the world forward. Built on Lucid’s proprietary technology and software-defined vehicle architecture, our award-winning vehicles bring our “Compromise Nothing™” approach to the global automotive market. That means refusing to choose between performance and sustainability, design and engineering, ambition and integrity. In Lucid Air and Lucid Gravity, we have designed and built vehicles that have redefined their segments, combining exceptional range, performance, design, and expansive space in a single experience.

We achieve this through deep vertical integration, with design, engineering, and production happening in-house across our global offices and manufacturing facilities. Our teams come from industries around the world, united by a shared commitment to excellence. By refusing to settle, you can help redefine what’s possible and shape the future of mobility.

Overview Job Title: Senior Software Engineer, Access Controls

About the Team

The Body Controls team is responsible for many of the vehicle features customers use every day, including access and security, closures, windows, mirrors, lighting, seating, power management, and diagnostics. The team develops and supports software across multiple ECUs and vehicle platforms, ensuring high-quality customer experiences from development through production and service.

This is a highly cross-functional team that works on embedded software development, diagnostics, vehicle integration, supplier management, new hardware bring-up, and production support. The team owns end-to-end delivery of body electronics features across multiple vehicle programs, offering engineers broad technical exposure and significant ownership of customer-facing vehicle functionality.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop control systems for vehicle access control features; this includes vehicle lock/unlock, access device authentication, device localization through advanced controls algorithms such as kalman filters and bi/trilateralization.
  • Develop requirements and related test cases for access control and other assigned features modeled in Matlab/Simulink.
  • Collaborate with simulation engineers to improve or develop a simulation model/platform to analyze, optimize, and troubleshoot access control and localization algorithms.
  • Assist in the integration of features into the controller code base. Test the developed software on the vehicle and assist in calibration of the features.
  • Support Failure Modes and Effects Analysis (FMEA) for various features to comply with ISO 26262 standards. Develop diagnostic, communication, and other interfaces across controllers/ECUs. Work in cross-functional teams to solve controls problems.
  • Participate in the design of a world-class engineering effort to bring electric vehicles to a new level of refinement.

What You Bring

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree (or higher) in computer engineering, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, automotive systems, or related technical fields is required.
  • 4+ years of experience with automotive control systems and knowledge of advanced controls algorithms; experience with vehicle access/ingress/egress control features and RF/BLE/UWB technologies is a plus.
  • Expert knowledge of model-based design using Matlab/Simulink/Stateflow.
  • Expert understanding of Automatic Control Systems, with a firm grasp of classical control theory tools like compensator design, Kalman Filtering, and PID tuning.
  • Proficiency in C/C++ and integration into embedded ECUs
  • Experience with industry standard development tools such as JAMA/JIRA/Git/Confluence.
  • Experience in working with cross-functional teams. Creativity in design, hands-on ability, and strong communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with RF/BLE/UWB.
  • Experience with kalman filters, machine learning and clustering techniques.
  • Common understanding of ISO 26262 and Autosar.
  • Experience in designing controllers for electric vehicle systems.
  • Experience with CAN analysis tools like CANalyzer and CANape. Experience with Embedded Coder in Matlab/Simulink.
  • Master's degree (or higher education) in computer engineering, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, automotive systems, or related technical fields is preferred.

Work Location Requirement:

  • This role is fully onsite at Lucid Phoenix Hub

Compensation & Benefits: Lucid offers a comprehensive and competitive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision insurance; life and disability coverage; paid time off; paid holidays, paid sick leave; and a 401(k) retirement plan. Hourly/non-exempt employees accrue up to 120 hours paid time off, and salaried/exempt employee accrue up to 160 hours paid time off. title: Applied AI Engineer
description:
About the role

You are our first dedicated Applied AI Engineer, and your remit is the whole business: sales, customer success, marketing, delivery, finance and operations. Anywhere someone is doing work a well-designed agent or workflow should be doing, that's yours.

Critically, you are the architect. Work will reach you as a problem, not a specification — "renewal risk is invisible until it's too late", "delivery handovers lose information every time", "this report takes two days a month to produce". From there the system is yours: interrogate the brief, work out what it should actually do, choose the approach and the tooling, design how it sits across the platforms we already run, build it, launch it and own it in production. Nobody will hand you a solution design, and nobody will review your architecture for you. That is the job, and it's why we're hiring at this level rather than for a pair of hands.

It also means you'll work directly with the people who own the results your systems affect — short feedback loops, no committee, and a very clear read on whether what you built actually mattered.

Wide surface, real autonomy, and everything you ship gets used the next morning.


What you'll own

  • Production AI agents and routines — taking prototypes to monitored, reliable, production-grade systems, starting with the commercial suite already in flight
  • A reusable skills and prompt library for drafting, analysis, reporting and document generation, shared across functions
  • The internal integration layer across monday.com, HubSpot, Aircall, Microsoft 365 and Guidde
  • Commercial systems — pipeline and portfolio reporting, account health signals, onboarding flows, executive business review generation
  • Marketing and go-to-market systems — content pipelines and campaign operations
  • Delivery and operations systems — project reporting, resourcing visibility, document and scope production, handover automation
  • Finance and administrative workflows — reconciliation, reporting and the recurring manual work that currently eats hours
  • Documentation, standards and internal enablement — everything you build is documented, supportable and teachable to the people who use it


What we're looking for

We are optimising for AI fluency and creative problem solving over depth of traditional software engineering. You need to be able to build and maintain what you design, but we care more about how you think about a problem than how elegant the code is.

  • Demonstrable fluency with modern LLM tooling — agent design, prompt and context engineering, MCP, evaluation and iteration. Claude and Claude Code experience is a strong advantage
  • Model-agnostic judgement — the ability to assess Claude, OpenAI, Gemini and whatever lands next on capability, cost, latency and fit, pick the right one for each job, and re-test that decision as the landscape shifts. We are not loyal to a vendor; we are loyal to the outcome
  • Strong automation and integration skills across SaaS APIs (REST, webhooks, authentication) and iPaaS platforms such as Make, Zapier or n8n
  • The technical ability to ship and support production systems: Python/TypeScript, git, cron, CI/CD, Linux, error handling and logging
  • Confidence working with data across systems — extracting, transforming and reconciling records from multiple platforms
  • The ability to architect a solution from a vague problem statement — scoping it, choosing the approach, and being able to explain and defend the design to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • A portfolio of things you have actually launched, that other people still use. Tell us about them
  • The judgement to push back on a brief, propose a better approach, and know when not to build something
  • Comfort working across unfamiliar business domains — you'll be automating finance one month and delivery the next, and you'll need to learn each well enough to design for it
  • Written English strong enough to work asynchronously with a senior team across time zones, and the security-mindedness to work inside tenant boundaries with customer data

Nice to have: monday.com or HubSpot platform experience (apps framework, GraphQL APIs); prior work inside a consultancy or agency; light front-end for internal tools; experience with documentation or video documentation tooling.


What this role isn't

No billable client delivery. No model training from scratch. No general IT helpdesk. Your entire remit is making one company measurably more effective.


What success looks like

  • First 30 days — access established, the systems we already run documented and understood, and the backlog assessed and sequenced with your recommendations on what ships first
  • First 90 days — Existing AI based workflows optimised and performing in a production environment— monitored, logged and reliable without supervision — plus two new systems live and in daily use
  • First 6 months — the same patterns extended beyond the commercial team into at least two other functions, with a documented, reusable foundation others can build on
  • First 12 months — a maintained internal AI platform spanning the business, with measurable hours returned across functions and a clear roadmap you own

Job Description

We are seeking a meticulous and compliance-focused Digital Asset Management (DAM) Librarian to manage and optimize digital assets across multiple DAM platforms within a healthcare environment. As a key member of the Digital Strategy team this role is critical in ensuring the secure, compliant, and efficient use of digital assets across websites, portals, and marketing channels.

The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of healthcare data privacy regulations, including HIPAA, and experience managing assets potentially containing or pertaining to PII and PHI. They will lead taxonomy governance, rights management, asset migration, and user training while maintaining the integrity and security of all digital content.

What You'll Do

Digital Asset Oversight:

  • Manage digital assets across multiple DAM systems, ensuring secure storage and access.
  • Enforce consistent metadata and taxonomy practices across all platforms.
  • Ensure assets are appropriately classified, especially those containing or pertaining to PII or PHI.

Taxonomy & Metadata Management:

  • Develop and maintain a unified taxonomy tailored to healthcare content.
  • Train users on metadata standards and taxonomy usage, with emphasis on compliance.
  • Continuously refine taxonomy to support evolving healthcare communication needs.

Compliance & Rights Management:

  • Ensure all digital assets comply with HIPAA, GDPR, CCPA, and any other relevant healthcare or privacy regulations.
  • Oversee digital rights management (DRM) and licensing for all assets.
  • Implement access controls and audit trails for sensitive content.

Migration & Consolidation:

  • Lead the planning and execution of asset migration between DAM systems.
  • Identify and manage duplicate or outdated assets, ensuring secure disposal of sensitive data.
  • Recommend strategies for content consolidation and DAM optimization.

Training & Support:

  • Provide training and support to internal teams on DAM usage, taxonomy, and compliance.
  • Develop user documentation and best practice guides.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for DAM-related questions and issues.

Reporting & Auditing:

  • Conduct regular DAM health audits, including compliance checks for PII/PHI handling.
  • Generate reports on asset usage, taxonomy adherence, and system performance.

You’ve probably enjoyed our fries without even knowing it! As a leading manufacturer in our industry, we inspire and bring people together with foods they love and trust. Job Description Summary

Demand Planner is an integral player of LW’s supply chain planning team, responsible for driving excellence in demand planning for multiple product lines across business units with high to medium complexity, including market inputs, statistical forecasting, incorporating commercial intelligence, product lifecycle management, and continuous improvement analysis. LW seeks a professional who can handle large sets of data and collaborate with others to create robust forecasts, enabling effective demand planning and execution throughout the supply chain. This role will collaborate with the Commercial & Business Units, National Account Managers, Supply Planning, driving business initiatives and transforming SAP IBP working with IT.


This role owns and manages the overall demand signal, maintenance of the demand planning system, building the relationship with the Sales team, and driving continuous improvements supporting the demand planning deliverables in the weekly/monthly processes.

Create and maintain all stages of the demand plan - inception to discontinuity.

Maintain data relative to demand forecasting including hierarchy, historical data cleansing, demand shaping and model parameters.

Independently handle complex issues with minimal supervision, while escalating only the most complex issues to appropriate staff.

title: Product Manager, Customer Experience Platforms
location: Helpful Smiles Technology Center (HST), James Street, Grimes, IA
description:
Additional Considerations (if any):

-

At Hy-Vee our people are our strength. We promise “a helpful smile in every aisle” and those smiles can only come from a workforce that is fully engaged and committed to supporting our customers and each other.

Job Description:

Job Title: Product Manager, Customer Experience Platforms

Department: Information Technology

FLSA: Salaried (Exempt)

Revision Date: 09/2026

About Hy-Vee

At Hy-Vee, we believe the shortest distance between two people is a smile. We’re seeking people with a passion for customer service, a willingness to learn, and a commitment to being part of a team that strives to make our customers’ lives easier, healthier and happier.

The Role and Why It’s Important

This role owns the product vision, roadmap, and delivery outcomes for the platforms that shape how Hy-Vee and its subsidiaries listen to, serve, and resolve issues for customers, spanning Hy-Vee Customer Care, Midwest Heritage Bank, Vivid Clear Rx, and RedBox Rx. Day to day, you will translate business need into clear, prioritized requirements, partner with data, digital, retail, and subsidiary teams to bring that work to life, hold vendors accountable to the value they were bought to deliver, and measure whether each release actually made the customer experience better.

If you’re relentlessly curious, energized by questioning the status quo, and want to see your work land in the hands of customers and the teams who serve them every day, this is the role for you.

What You’ll Do

No two days are exactly the same, but here’s what you can expect:

Product Strategy and Roadmap

  • Owns and maintains a single, transparent roadmap spanning Customer Care, MHB, Vivid Clear Rx, and RedBox Rx; sequences work based on measurable customer and business value rather than volume of requests.
  • Builds business cases for new capabilities and platform investments, including cost, benefit, risk, and the specific outcome the investment is expected to move.
  • Identifies opportunities to simplify and consolidate the customer experience technology stack — reducing tool sprawl, license cost, and the number of hand-offs between systems.
  • Partners with the Chief Data Officer to translate enterprise data strategy into a customer experience platform strategy, and to surface trade-offs that require executive decision.

Stakeholder Partnership

  • Serves as the primary product partner to Customer Care leadership, Retail Operations (Store Directors, Area Vice Presidents, Territory SVPs), Digital, Ecommerce, Marketing, Legal, Finance, and subsidiary leadership at MHB, Vivid Clear Rx, and RedBox Rx.
  • Runs a consistent intake, prioritization, and communication rhythm so stakeholders know what is committed, what is next, what was declined, and why.
  • Builds trust by going to where the work happens — store visits, Customer Care listening sessions, pharmacy and subsidiary ride-alongs — and brings that firsthand context back into the roadmap.
  • Establishes and maintains RACI clarity on cross-functional initiatives so decision rights are explicit and escalation paths are known before they are needed.

Requirements and Delivery

  • Defines clear, testable requirements and acceptance criteria; partners with Data Integration and Data Platform engineering teams to shape technically sound solutions rather than handing over finished designs.
  • Leads matrixed delivery teams composed of analysts, integration engineers, and vendor resources — without direct reporting authority.
  • Manages the full product lifecycle from concept and definition through planning, development, release, adoption, and post-launch measurement.
  • Owns go-to-market and change enablement for platform releases: training materials, communication to stores and subsidiary teams, and adoption tracking after go-live.

Measurement and Continuous Improvement

  • Establishes and publishes the metrics that define platform health — contact volume by channel and intent, AI containment and deflection rate, time to first response, time to resolution, close-the-loop completion, survey response rate, and customer satisfaction.
  • Interrogates the data rather than accepting it: validates definitions, understands data quality caveats, and ensures reported figures are defensible before they reach retail leaders or the executive team.
  • Maintains an active hypothesis backlog — proposes experiments, defines what success looks like in advance, and retires capabilities that do not earn their keep.
  • Conducts regular reviews of underused platform features and license consumption, and recommends elimination, replacement, or renewed enablement.

Vendor and Contract Management

  • Serves as the day-to-day product relationship owner for Salesforce, ThinkLP, SurveyMonkey, Sierra AI, and related vendors; holds partners accountable to roadmap commitments, service levels, and contracted value.
  • Leads or contributes to RFP and vendor evaluation processes, including requirements definition, evaluation criteria, demo coordination, scoring, and recommendation to the steering committee.
  • Partners with IT Security, Legal, and Procurement on renewals, data privacy and protection requirements, and compliance obligations — including the heightened requirements that apply to banking (MHB) and pharmacy / protected health information (Vivid Clear Rx, RedBox Rx).

Your Skills

To be successful in this role, you’ll need to be able to:

  • Demonstrated experience managing products through all phases of an agile product lifecycle — concept, definition, planning, development, implementation, and iteration.
  • Hands-on working knowledge of CRM and customer service platforms, with Salesforce (Service Cloud) strongly preferred; comfortable discussing objects, case routing, workflow automation, and integration patterns with engineers.
  • Working familiarity with Salesforce Marketing Cloud or a comparable customer engagement platform — journey design, audience segmentation, and email/SMS campaign execution — and an understanding of how consent, preference, and suppression requirements apply in a regulated financial services context.
  • Experience with survey, voice-of-customer, or feedback management platforms and the workflows that turn feedback into resolved customer issues.
  • Familiarity with conversational AI or virtual agent platforms, and a practical understanding of containment, deflection, escalation design, and the limits of automation in a service context.
  • Data fluency: able to read and reason about operational data, ask sharp questions of an analyst, understand data quality caveats, and draw conclusions that hold up to executive scrutiny. SQL familiarity is a plus.
  • Proven ability to lead and influence cross-functional teams without direct authority, and to build durable partnerships across corporate, retail, and subsidiary organizations.
  • Genuine curiosity and a continuous-improvement mentality — actively seeks out how the work is actually done, challenges assumptions constructively, and is energized by making things measurably better.
  • Clear and concise writing, communication, and facilitation skills; able to move fluidly between a technical working session and an executive readout.
  • Resourceful, detail-oriented, and highly organized problem solver, comfortable holding several competing priorities at once.
  • Ability and desire to manage multiple projects and business lines on a daily basis.
  • Comfort operating across regulated environments, including financial services and pharmacy, with appropriate care for customer and patient data.
  • Demonstrates a commitment to the Hy-Vee mission and a willingness to promote the core values and fundamentals of the company.
  • Drives a positive culture of innovation and continuous learning.

Reporting Relationships

Accountable and Reports to: SVP, Chief Data Officer

Direct Reports: None (leads matrixed, cross-functional delivery teams)

None. This position leads matrixed, cross-functional teams and is formally accountable for the delivery outcomes of those teams, including assigning and reviewing work, planning work of others, maintaining standards, and coordinating activities across internal teams and vendor resources.

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • Five or more years of product management, product ownership, or closely related experience, including direct ownership of a customer-facing or customer-service platform.
  • Experience in retail, grocery, healthcare, pharmacy, or financial services is preferred but not required.

Physical Requirements

  • Visual requirements include: ability to see detail at near range with or without correction.
  • Must be physically able to perform sedentary work: operating a computer, occasionally lifting or carrying objects of no more than 10 pounds, and occasionally standing or walking.
  • Must be able to perform the following physical activities: meeting with customers, kneeling, reaching, handling, grasping, feeling, talking, hearing, and repetitive motions.

Working Environment

The duties for this position are performed in a general or remote office setting. Periodic travel to stores, distribution centers, Customer Care operations, and subsidiary locations is expected. There is weekly pressure to meet deadlines and handle multiple tasks in a day.

Laptop and desktop computer, telephone, copier, printer, PC with Microsoft Office programs, and other software relevant to the specific position.

Scope of Ownership

Business Lines Supported

  • Hy-Vee Customer Care — Customer care contact and case management across phone, email, web, chat, social, and AI-assisted channels; post-purchase and close-the-loop survey programs; store- and district-level feedback routing and escalation.
  • Midwest Heritage Bank (MHB) — CRM, customer-service, and customer marketing tooling for Hy-Vee’s banking and insurance subsidiary, including account servicing workflows, Marketing Cloud journeys and campaigns, and the data integrations that support them.
  • Vivid Clear Rx — Member and patient support experiences for the prescription savings and mail-order pharmacy platform.
  • RedBox Rx — Patient support and service workflows for the telehealth and online pharmacy business.

Platforms and Technologies

  • Salesforce (Service Cloud / CRM / ThinkLP) — case management, contact linking, bi-directional sync, org administration across Hy-Vee and subsidiary instances
  • Salesforce Marketing Cloud — customer journeys, segmentation, and email/SMS campaign execution in use at Midwest Heritage Bank today
  • SurveyMonkey — multichannel survey build and delivery across POS, loyalty, email, SMS, web, and app
  • Sierra AI — conversational AI agent, deflection and containment, agent handoff to Customer Care
  • Zoom (Phone / Chat) — voice and chat channel enablement for Customer Care
  • Google Cloud — BigQuery, Pub/Sub, and Cloud Functions integration patterns supporting the customer data flow
  • Reporting and visualization tooling used by store, area, and executive audiences

Are you ready to smile, apply today.

Employment is contingent upon the successful completion of a pre employment drug screen.

title: Instructional Technology and Erate Coordinator (Part Time)
description:
BURLINGTON COMMUNITY SCHOOL DISTRICT

POSITION DESCRIPTION AND SPECIFICATIONS

Position Title: Instructional Technology & E-Rate Coordinator (Part-Time) FLSA Status: Non Exempt

Reports to: Director of Technology Days: 260

================================================================================

POSITION PURPOSE

The Instructional Technology & E-Rate Coordinator provides leadership and expertise in assisting the district with the planning, coordination, oversight, evaluation, and continuous improvement of instructional technology and E-Rate eligible technology services. Working collaboratively with the Director of Technology, district administration, instructional leaders, and the Business Office, this position helps ensure that technology resources support high-quality teaching and learning while remaining fiscally responsible and compliant with all applicable federal, state, and district requirements.

This position serves as the district's resource for the evaluation, selection, implementation, and integration of instructional technology to enhance student learning, strengthen instructional practices, and support district curriculum goals. The coordinator collaborates with administrators and educators to identify instructional technology needs, evaluate emerging technologies, and recommend cost-effective solutions that improve educational outcomes.

In addition, the position provides leadership in the administration of the federal E-Rate program by coordinating planning activities, maintaining required documentation, ensuring regulatory compliance, maximizing reimbursement opportunities, and promoting responsible stewardship of district technology resources.

This position serves in an advisory, planning, and oversight capacity and is not responsible for the day-to-day operation, maintenance, or technical support of district technology systems.

This position will be no more than 15 hours a month.

QUALIFICATIONS/EXPERIENCE/TRAINING/LICENSES

Requires the following (or equivalent qualifications):

  • Bachelor's degree in Education, Instructional Technology, Educational Technology, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Teaching experience and/or a valid Iowa teaching license preferred.
  • Experience assisting educators with the selection, implementation, and integration of instructional technology to improve teaching and learning preferred.
  • Experience with K-12 technology systems, technology budgeting, purchasing, and E-Rate administration.
  • Experience working in a public school system is preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience with E-Rate administration and federal program compliance preferred.
  • Experience reviewing technology contracts, invoices, purchasing, and vendor agreements preferred.
  • Knowledge of school finance, purchasing procedures, and public procurement practices preferred.
  • Knowledge of E-Rate rules, procedures, eligible services, and compliance requirements.
  • Knowledge of instructional technology, educational software, digital learning resources, networking, telecommunications, software licensing, and related technology services.
  • Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and customer service skills.
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality and exercise professional judgment.
  • Valid Driver's License.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Protect the confidential nature of information concerning instructional technology initiatives, technology programs, purchasing, contracts, E-Rate documentation, and district communications while adhering to professional ethics.

  • Collaborate with the Director of Technology, district administration, instructional leaders, the Business Office, and staff to support district technology planning and instructional technology initiatives.

  • Assist with the evaluation, selection, implementation, and integration of instructional technology resources, digital learning platforms, educational software, and instructional applications.

  • Collaborate with teachers and administrators to identify instructional technology needs and recommend solutions that enhance teaching effectiveness, student engagement, and academic achievement.

  • Evaluate emerging instructional technologies and provide recommendations regarding instructional effectiveness, accessibility, compatibility, sustainability, and cost effectiveness.

  • Support district instructional technology initiatives that align with curriculum, instructional best practices, district strategic goals, and state standards.

  • Assist with the development, implementation, and periodic review of the district's instructional technology plan.

  • Identify professional learning needs related to instructional technology and collaborate with district leadership in planning technology-related professional development opportunities.

  • Work collaboratively with curriculum leaders and instructional staff to promote the effective integration of technology into classroom instruction.

  • Coordinate E-Rate planning activities, applications, competitive bidding requirements, documentation, compliance activities, and reimbursement requests.

  • Review technology invoices and billing statements to verify accuracy, contract compliance, eligibility, and proper authorization.

  • Monitor recurring technology expenditures and recommend corrections when discrepancies, duplicate services, billing errors, or unnecessary expenditures are identified.

  • Conduct periodic reviews of technology services, contracts, telecommunications, Internet services, software subscriptions, cloud services, and related expenditures to ensure district resources are utilized efficiently and effectively.

  • Review technology purchases to ensure alignment with district instructional priorities, technology plans, budget objectives, procurement requirements, and E-Rate eligibility.

  • Identify opportunities for cost savings through vendor negotiations, service consolidation, purchasing strategies, contract renewals, and E-Rate funding opportunities.

  • Maintain documentation required for E-Rate compliance, audits, reimbursement, and federal record retention requirements.

  • Prepare documentation and assist with responses to Program Integrity Assurance (PIA) reviews, audits, and other federal inquiries.

  • Review E-Rate funding commitment decisions, reimbursement requests, and supporting documentation for completeness and accuracy.

  • Review Requests for Proposals (RFPs), vendor proposals, contracts, service agreements, and renewals to ensure they support district instructional priorities and comply with procurement and E-Rate requirements.

  • Monitor technology contract renewal timelines and notify the Director of Technology regarding upcoming renewals, competitive bidding requirements, and cost-effective alternatives.

  • Review technology inventories, instructional technology resources, software licensing, subscriptions, and recurring services to help ensure accurate records and efficient utilization of district resources.

  • Assist in determining district instructional and operational technology needs and recommend sustainable, cost-effective technology solutions.

  • Assist with budget preparation related to instructional technology, telecommunications, networking, Internet services, software licensing, and E-Rate eligible services.

  • Coordinate with vendors, consultants, Area Education Agencies, service providers, district staff, and the Business Office to resolve technology, purchasing, billing, and contract issues.

  • Monitor vendor performance and recommend improvements to service quality, purchasing practices, contract terms, and technology resources.

  • Provide recommendations regarding technology lifecycle planning, including replacement schedules for networking equipment, instructional technology devices, telecommunications systems, and other eligible technology resources.

  • Maintain current knowledge of instructional technology best practices, educational technology trends, digital learning resources, E-Rate regulations, cybersecurity awareness, and technology funding opportunities, and communicate relevant information to district leadership.

  • Prepare reports, analyses, and recommendations regarding instructional technology initiatives, technology expenditures, E-Rate funding, contract compliance, purchasing efficiencies, and cost-saving opportunities.

  • Provide the Director of Technology with an annual report summarizing instructional technology initiatives, E-Rate activities, technology contract reviews, compliance efforts, funding opportunities, and recommendations to support future planning and budgeting.

  • Provide consultation to district leadership regarding instructional technology planning, technology purchases, contract administration, technology funding opportunities, and E-Rate eligible expenditures.

  • Perform other duties as assigned or required by law.

WORKING CONDITIONS

Work is primarily performed in an office or school setting. Occasionally exposed to dust, noise, odors and other irritants. Stress associated with work pace and pressure. Travel may be required. Exposed to hazards of the road when driving.

PHYSICAL, MENTAL, AND VISUAL EFFORT

Continuous speaking, hearing, and visual effort. Frequent walking, sitting, and standing. Occasional reaching, kneeling, transporting and lifting up to 100 lbs. Close mental and visual attention. Fine motor skills necessary. Work involves repetitive and varied tasks.

title: Product applications specialist
description:
Under the supervision of the Executive Director, the incumbent is responsible for supporting the sales force and customers in understanding, training on, and using the product line under their responsibility. The incumbent actively participates in the development of the solutions development plan and in the creation of product development documentation, as well as pre-sales, post-sales, and go-to-market tools.

The incumbent also supports the Engineering team by conducting application testing on products under development and recommending changes and improvements. They also contribute to the continuous improvement of the product line(s) under their responsibility. Finally, they support the Product Manager in the development of new solutions.

Key Functions and Responsibilities

Support the Sales Force and Train Users:

  • Identify and develop new solutions by considering internal development capabilities, existing solutions available on the market, and potential partnership opportunities;
  • Deliver and develop training on instrumentation and its applications for the sales force and international customers;
  • Contribute to the improvement of training programs and training materials;
  • Actively contribute to the technical and commercial support provided to the sales force and customers for their assigned product line;
  • Respond promptly to questions and requests from customers and the sales force.

Contribute to the Product Development Plan:

  • Analyze market needs and make recommendations regarding products and sales methods;
  • Develop portions of the specifications for new products based on market information and specific criteria provided by the Product Manager;
  • Work closely with various Engineering departments to facilitate product development and recommend changes or modifications as needed;
  • Ensure that decisions and actions are aligned with the product development plan;
  • Conduct analyses, troubleshoot issues, propose solutions to problems encountered, and implement them.

Participate in Go-to-Market Activities:

  • Develop product/solution documentation and sales and post-sales tools in accordance with the direction provided by the Product Manager;
  • Actively participate in the launch of solutions and new products;
  • Recommend changes and improvements related to go-to-market activities and participate in their implementation;
  • Perform any other related duties as requested by their supervisor.

Education and Relevant Experience

  • 8 to 10 years of experience in the field of Phased Array Ultrasonics;
  • College diploma (DEC) in Physics with 8 to 10 years of experience / Bachelor's degree in Physics with 5 to 7 years of experience, or an equivalent combination of relevant education and experience, an asset;
  • Experience in marketing and go-to-market activities, an asset.

Technical Skills

  • English proficiency: Advanced.

Behavioral Competencies

  • Initiative;
  • Ability to work independently;
  • Professional rigor and attention to detail;
  • Problem-solving skills;
  • Creativity;
  • Strong customer focus and commitment to customer satisfaction;
  • Teamwork;
  • Strong analytical, synthesis, and integration skills;
  • Willingness to travel approximately 20% of the time;
  • Must hold or be able to obtain a valid passport;
  • International business travel experience.

What could you accomplish in a place that puts People First?

At Wabtec, it’s not just about a job - it’s about the impact you make. When our people come together, we’re Expanding the Possible by continuously improving what we do and how we do it - for our clients and each other.

If you’re ready to revolutionize how the world moves for future generations, Wabtec is the place for you.

Who are we?

Wabtec is a leading global provider of equipment, systems, digital solutions, and value-added services for the freight and transit rail sectors. Drawing on more than 150 years of experience, we are leading the way in safety, efficiency, reliability, innovation, and productivity. Boardwalk is a limited partnership operating in the midstream portion of the natural gas and natural gas liquids industry, providing transportation and storage services for our customers. title: First Aid Specialist
description:
Batterjee Medical College is seeking a qualified and responsible First Aid Clinic Specialist to provide immediate medical assistance, basic clinical care, and emergency response services to students, employees, and visitors.

The role is responsible for ensuring the readiness and effective operation of the First Aid Clinic, responding to medical incidents across campus, providing appropriate first aid and basic treatment, and coordinating emergency referrals and transfers when required.

Key Responsibilities

First Aid & Emergency Response

  • Provide immediate first aid for injuries, illnesses, and medical emergencies.
  • Assess patient conditions and determine the appropriate course of action.
  • Stabilize patients until further medical care is available.
  • Respond promptly to medical incidents occurring across campus.
  • Coordinate emergency transfers to hospitals or emergency medical services when required.

Clinic Operations & Patient Care

  • Manage the day-to-day operation and readiness of the First Aid Clinic.
  • Ensure treatment areas are clean, organized, properly equipped, and ready for use.
  • Provide basic medical care, including wound cleaning and dressing, minor injury treatment, vital-sign monitoring, and support for minor illnesses.
  • Provide professional and compassionate assistance to students, employees, and visitors requiring medical attention.

Medical Records & Confidentiality

  • Maintain accurate records of patient visits, treatments, incidents, and emergency cases.
  • Document and report medical incidents appropriately.
  • Maintain strict confidentiality of patient and medical information.
  • Ensure records are maintained in accordance with institutional and healthcare requirements.

Emergency Preparedness & Medical Supplies

  • Ensure emergency medical supplies and equipment are available and ready for use.
  • Regularly inspect and restock first aid kits across campus.
  • Monitor first aid supplies, medical equipment, and emergency kits.
  • Check expiry dates and ensure all medical supplies remain suitable for use.
  • Support emergency response planning, preparedness activities, and drills.

Health, Hygiene & Infection Control

  • Maintain appropriate hygiene and infection-control standards within the clinic.
  • Ensure proper disposal of medical waste.
  • Follow infection prevention, medical, and safety protocols.
  • Provide basic health and hygiene guidance when required.
  • Support first aid and emergency-response awareness sessions for students and employees.

External Medical Coordination

  • Coordinate with hospitals, ambulance services, and healthcare providers when required.
  • Facilitate referrals and emergency transfers.
  • Maintain effective communication with relevant internal teams during medical incidents.
  • Support continuous improvement of clinic operations and emergency response processes.


Requirements

  • Diploma or degree in Nursing, Paramedics, or a related medical field.
  • Valid certification in First Aid, CPR, and Basic Life Support (BLS).
  • Minimum 2–5 years of relevant clinical, first aid, or emergency-response experience.
  • Strong emergency-response and first aid skills.
  • Good basic clinical knowledge and patient-care skills.
  • Ability to assess situations and make timely decisions during emergencies.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to remain calm and effective in stressful situations.
  • High attention to detail and strong sense of responsibility.
  • Professionalism, empathy, and commitment to patient confidentiality.
  • Ability to work effectively under pressure.
  • Basic communication skills in Arabic and English.

title: Kokki Peijaksen sairaala
description:
Haluatko työskennellä moniammatillisessa työyhteisössä? Kiinnostaako työ, jossa tehtävät ovat aidosti monipuolisia ja pääset haastamaan omaa osaamistasi? Tule meille kokiksi!

Haemme ammattitaitoista, reipasta ja oma-aloitteista kokkia monipuolisiin tehtäviin Peijaksen sairaalan keittiöön vakituiseen työsuhteeseen.

HUSin tukipalvelut, viralliselta nimeltään Runkopalvelut, vastaa siitä, että sairaalassa on parhaat mahdolliset puitteet potilaiden hoitamiseksi.

Kokin työtehtävät pitävät sisällään ruoan valmistamista potilaille ja henkilökunnalle erityisruokavaliot huomioiden. Työtehtäviin kuuluu myös potilasruoan jakoa, astiahuoltoa sekä muita keittiön monipuolisia tehtäviä.

Työpaikan sijainti: Peijaksen sairaala, Vantaa

Työsuhde: Kokoaikainen, 2-vuorotyö, työaika sijoittuu arkisin klo 6.30–17.00 välille ja viikonloppuisin klo 7.00–16.30 välille

Työehtosopimus ja palkkaus: HYVTES, tehtäväkohtainen palkka on 2 725,50 €/kk + sopimuksen mukaiset lisät

Työn aloitus: 5.10.2026 tai sopimuksen mukaan

Tutustu toimintaamme:

Miksi töihin HUSin Runkopalveluihin?

  • Monipuolisissa potilaan hoitoa tukevissa tehtävissä olet tärkeä osa sairaalamaailmaa.

  • Kattava perehdytys: kukaan ei joudu kylmiltään työntekoon. Saat myös aina apua perehdytyksen jälkeenkin.

  • Rento ja monimuotoinen työyhteisö, johon jokaisen työntekijän on helppoa tulla mukaan. Meillä kaikki auttavat toisiaan parhaansa mukaan ja töitä tehdään yhdessä hyvällä fiiliksellä.

  • Monipuoliset ura ja koulutusmahdollisuudet.

  • Työterveyshuolto, liikunta-, kulttuuri- ja työsuhdematkaetu, tuettu työpaikkaruokailu sekä vaihtuvia henkilökuntaetuja liikunta- ja hyvinvointipalveluista.

Mitä toivomme sinulta?

Tehtävässä edellytetään alan koulutusta ja työkokemusta sekä erikoisruokavalioiden tuntemusta. Ilahdumme hyvistä vuorovaikutustaidoista ja iloisesta palveluasenteesta, sillä teet töitä tiiviisti työkavereidesi kanssa asiakkaidemme hyvinvoinnin eteen. Lisäksi toivomme ammattimaista ja reipasta työotetta, koska työ on vaihtelevaa ja jokainen työpäivä voi olla erilainen.

Suomen kielen suullinen ja kirjallinen taito on välttämätön. Tehtävässä tarvitaan hygieniapassi.

Näin haet

Lähetä hakemus sähköisellä hakulomakkeella hakuajan loppuun mennessä. Voimme aloittaa haastattelut jo hakuaikana.

HUSissa olet osa vaikuttavinta hoitoa.

Tehtävän kelpoisuusehdot

Alan ammattikoulutus ja soveltuva kokemus.

Tehtävään valittavan tulee olla täysi-ikäinen.

Edellytämme asiakas- ja potilastiloissa työskentelevältä tartuntatautilain mukaista rokotussuojaa, ja terveydenhuollon toimintayksiköissä työskentelevältä terveydentilan selvitystä keuhkotuberkuloosista ja salmonellasta.

Yhteystiedot

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa arkisin klo 7.00–14.30 Palveluesihenkilö Merianne Autio, puh. 050 427 9352.

title: Sr Manager, Data Engineering
description:
Abbott is a global healthcare leader that helps people live more fully at all stages of life. Our portfolio of life-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritionals and branded generic medicines. Our 122,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries.

JOB DESCRIPTION:

Position Overview

The Sr. Manager, Data Engineering is the Enterprise Data department's accountable engineering leader for a specified data domain, owning domain data engineering strategy, delivery, data quality practices, stakeholder alignment, technical governance, and the integrated roadmap for business-critical capabilities. The role aligns domain data products and integrations to shared platform capabilities and represents the domain in platform direction and decisions.

The role leads the domain data engineering organization, including domain Staff Engineers, and holds full people accountability for that organization. Where delivery depends on shared or matrixed teams, the role partners with their accountable leaders to execute domain priorities.

The Sr. Manager is accountable for timely resolution of material technical decisions within delegated domain boundaries and owns priority, delivery, and technical-debt tradeoffs. Staff Engineers own domain technical design, solutioning, and recommendations, with support of Principal Engineers who provide cross-domain standards and technical guidance. The role represents Enterprise Data in cross-functional forums and partners with Software Engineering, IT Applications, Security, Privacy, Enterprise Architecture, and the AI organization to maintain a unified, well-governed data architecture.

This role is based in Madison, WI.

Essential Duties

Include, but are not limited to, the following:

Domain accountability and delivery

  • Own domain data engineering strategy, prioritization, the integrated roadmap, delivery planning, cross-system integration, risks, and stakeholder outcomes for the domain.

  • Lead the domain data engineering organization to deliver required outcomes on schedule and ensure data quality practices follow enterprise standards, established patterns, and agreed technical direction.

  • Engage domain business leadership to shape priorities, set direction, and align on outcomes and delivery commitments.

  • Partner with the leaders of dependent or shared teams on execution, escalating capacity, sequencing, and dependency conflicts as needed.

Technical decision-making and architecture

  • Ensure timely resolution of material technical decisions within delegated domain boundaries. Staff Engineers own technical design and recommendations; the Sr. Manager owns priority, delivery, and technical-debt tradeoffs.

  • Govern the domain integration approach, including authoritative data sources, systems of record, API, event, and batch patterns, data contracts and schemas, and where applicable, entity resolution across domain records.

  • Require adoption of enterprise Data Engineering standards and shared capabilities, maintain a secure architecture, and ensure domain data products are documented, discoverable, governed, observable, and supported throughout their lifecycle for governed reuse across analytics, semantic layers, machine learning, and AI applications.

  • Partner with Software Engineering, IT Applications, Security, Privacy, Enterprise Architecture, and the AI organization to align integration strategies and platform direction.

  • Represent Enterprise Data in platform reviews and technology governance, evaluating new capabilities for business value, architecture fit, and delivery risk, and coordinating with Principal Engineers on cross-domain standards, exceptions, and recommendations to standardize, consolidate, or retire platforms.

People and delivery leadership

  • Lead, recruit, develop, and retain talent across the domain data engineering organization, including Staff Engineers, and build succession and capability plans for the domain.

  • Set clear goals, decision rights, priorities, performance expectations, and development plans; conduct performance reviews and support professional growth.

  • Manage assigned resources within established constraints, including contractor quality, delivery, and performance; forecast domain capacity and skill needs and provide renewal, staffing, and investment recommendations to the Engineering Leader.

  • Establish an operating model in which Staff and Principal Engineers engage stakeholders at the appropriate level and remain accountable for technical quality, design clarity, and delivery support.

Stakeholder engagement

  • Own stakeholder alignment for the domain, partnering with business leaders to define outcomes and align technology decisions with enterprise objectives, with support and delegation as needed to Staff Engineers.

  • Maintain transparent relationships with business and technology leaders, communicating roadmap status, risks, dependencies, decisions, tradeoffs, and complex technical topics to engineering, business, and executive audiences.

  • Collaborate and negotiate with senior leaders on priorities, platform direction, operating constraints, and critical matters affecting the domain.

Operational excellence and compliance

  • Drive adoption of enterprise data engineering and data quality standards and patterns within the domain, ensuring delivered solutions meet requirements for quality, reliability, observability, incident response, security, privacy, access, and lifecycle management. Define and monitor appropriate measures of domain delivery, quality, reliability, and stakeholder outcomes.

  • Ensure production support coverage and escalation paths are established for the domain, and serve as the point of escalation for significant incidents affecting domain systems.

  • Uphold company mission and values through accountability, innovation, integrity, quality, and teamwork.

  • Support and comply with the company's Quality Management System policies and procedures, and partner with Security, Privacy, Compliance, and Business Continuity teams to meet applicable enterprise and regulatory requirements.

  • Regular and reliable attendance.

  • Ability to work on a mobile device, tablet, or computer screen and perform typing for approximately 90% of a typical working day.

  • Ability to travel up to 15% of working time away from the work location, including possible overnight or weekend travel.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business, or a related field.

  • 8+ years of progressively responsible experience in data engineering, data platforms, technology delivery, or related leadership roles.

  • 5+ years of direct people leadership experience, including managing engineering staff.

  • Demonstrated experience owning delivery, stakeholder outcomes, and operating performance for a data domain, platform, or program from planning through production support.

  • Demonstrated technical depth sufficient to direct and evaluate data engineering work and make priority, delivery, and technical-debt tradeoffs related to data architecture, integration patterns, data models, and platform decisions.

  • Demonstrated ability to lead delivery across direct reports, contractors, and dependent or matrixed teams, including risk, change, contractor, and dependency management.

  • Experience operating in a regulated or highly controlled data environment and delivering stakeholder outcomes at the required quality and on schedule.

  • Demonstrated ability to perform the Essential Duties of the position with or without accommodation.

  • Authorization to work in the United States without sponsorship.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with modern data platforms such as Databricks, event streaming architectures such as Kafka, and cloud data services in AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

  • Experience delivering governed data products and semantic capabilities supporting analytics, machine learning, and AI use cases across commercial, financial, laboratory, clinical, or customer-facing business functions.

  • 5+ years in a regulated environment such as SOX, HIPAA, CLIA, Good Clinical Practice (ICH-GCP), FDA, ISO 13485, or IEC 62304.

  • Life sciences, diagnostics, or clinical laboratory experience.

  • Experience leading delivery across internal teams and contractor-based delivery models, and applying data privacy, security, access governance, lineage, retention, and business continuity practices.

title: On-Call Lead Product Manager
description:
We are currently hiring an experienced On-Call Lead Product Manager to serve as a senior engagement leader in support of our federal government clients.

Our Team

Join a team of senior consultants and problem-solvers working to champion product thinking in federal IT delivery. Product Managers @ ICF Next are difference-makers. They understand and connect with the client mission and act as the curators and stewards of the product vision throughout Agile IT Modernizations.

This is a dynamic and visible senior consultant position, capable of wearing different hats and communication styles in different settings to depending on the day and context: teammate or leader, collaborator or visionary, listener or coach, business development or delivery.

ICF is a purpose-driven company with a strong culture and underlying values that prize diversity, opportunity, equality, and respect. Our core values include embracing differences, and we seek candidates who are passionate about building a culture that encourages, embraces, and hires dimensions of differences.

Our Work

A Lead Product Manager in our practice:

  • Serves as a leader on federal client engagements, shapes the Agile team and processes for success and drives the backlog of work in the right direction
  • Is a consultant first; able to effectively represent our practice’s product management playbook and the services we sell in the way they do their work, while also tailoring their approach on a project-by-project basis to deliver value to their teams and customers
  • Uncovers and articulates the needs and goals of the client organization as they relate to the contract and product; Loves to dig in and make sense of things, can quickly get smart on a new program or subject matter
  • Collaborates with a variety of internal and external experts, facilitates conversations and workshops to brainstorm and get buy-in for decisions
  • Generates clear and compelling artifacts to explain the product vision, strategy, process, target outcomes, progress toward those outcomes, and high-level requirements to a variety of audiences
  • Brings a minimum viable product (MVP) mindset to everything they do, keeps the team focused on what matters in different phases and minimizing risks, while also creating time, space, and confidence amongst our teams to innovate and deliver the best results long-term
  • Manages and plans Agile work across multiple workstreams, can effectively balance and steer discovery and delivery tasks to drive the backlog and deliver value to users continuously
  • Is a team player with excellent problem-solving and consensus-building skills; fosters a culture of creativity, collaboration, innovation, honesty, and best ideas forward
  • Is an active member of our product practice; contributes to our community by building relationships across the company, mentoring others, creating and collecting best practices, supporting proposal writing, other internal initiatives that help us grow and thrive

***As an on-call with our team, you might work zero to 30 hours per week, depending on our workload.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience
  • 5+ years of professional experience in a digital product delivery role
  • 3+ years direct product management or product strategy experience on an Agile team (e.g. as a product owner or product manager)
  • 2+ years experience in a professional consulting role
  • 1+ years experience leading virtual workshops that employ human-centered design, design thinking, or generative brainstorming techniques
  • Ability to obtain a Public Trust Clearance, must reside in the United States

Professional Skills

  • Strong understanding of Agile methodologies, professional experience on integrated cross-functional Agile teams that include discovery functions such as user research and UX design SMEs
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Proficient with product management and collaboration tools such as JIRA, Confluence, and Mural

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with distributed remote-first teams
  • Experience working on federal contracts in a variety of engagement models and team sizes, including custom open-source development, low-code/no-code solutions, data projects, and management consulting related roles
  • Agile Product management training or certifications such as SAFeÒ POPM, Pragmatic, Product School or equivalent

Bot and Third-Party Applications

Working at ICF

ICF is a global advisory and technology services provider, but we’re not your typical consultants. We combine unmatched expertise with cutting-edge technology to help clients solve their most complex challenges, navigate change, and shape the future.

We can only solve the world's toughest challenges by building a workplace that allows everyone to thrive. We are an equal opportunity employer. title: Transport Supervisor
description:
Location: Warrington HubSalary: £33,900 plus benefits Shift Pattern: 4 on, 4 off – Days & NightsHours: 06:00–18:00 / 18:00–06:00
Keep our transport operation moving.
We're looking for a Transport Supervisor to join our busy Warrington Hub, helping to keep our transport operation running safely, efficiently and on time.
Working closely with the Transport Shift Manager, you'll take responsibility for the day-to-day coordination of drivers and transport activity across your shift. You'll be a visible point of leadership for the team, making decisions, resolving operational issues and ensuring our drivers have everything they need to deliver a great service.
This is a fast-paced role where priorities can change quickly, so we're looking for someone who is organised, confident making decisions and comfortable working in a busy transport environment.
What You'll Be Doing

Supervising and supporting drivers throughout your shift, providing clear direction and keeping the operation running smoothly.
Briefing and debriefing drivers, ensuring route instructions, collections and deliveries are clearly understood and completed.
Monitoring daily transport activity and responding quickly to delays, route issues and other operational challenges.
Reviewing driver documentation, log sheets and digital tachograph information to ensure accuracy and compliance.
Ensuring vehicle defects identified during checks are recorded, escalated and appropriately actioned.
Making sure accidents, incidents and vehicle damage are reported correctly and within required timescales.
Working closely with internal teams and external partners to coordinate collections and deliveries.
Supporting route optimisation and making operational adjustments when required.
Maintaining high standards of Health & Safety and transport compliance across the shift.
Providing clear and detailed shift handovers to Transport Shift Managers and fellow Supervisors.
Using transport systems and operational data to monitor performance and identify issues requiring action.

What You'll Need
We're looking for someone with experience working within transport, logistics or a similarly fast-paced operational environment, ideally with some experience supervising or coordinating drivers or operational teams.
You'll also need:

A good understanding of driver compliance, including digital tachographs and driver documentation.
Experience working with transport management systems such as Isotrak, Tachomaster, Ortec or similar.
Strong organisational and problem-solving skills, with the ability to prioritise when things change quickly.
Confidence communicating with drivers, colleagues, managers and external partners.
Good IT skills, including Excel, Outlook and Microsoft Teams.
A proactive approach to Health & Safety and operational compliance.
The confidence to make decisions and keep people focused during a busy shift.

Experience of route planning or optimisation would be an advantage, but isn't essential.
Why Join Evri?
At Evri, no two shifts are exactly the same. You'll be joining a large-scale transport operation where you'll have the opportunity to develop your leadership experience, build your transport knowledge and progress your career.
We offer a competitive package alongside opportunities for learning, development and career progression across our operation.
If you're an experienced transport professional ready to take more ownership of a busy operation, we'd love to hear from you.
