title: Integration Interoperability Lead
description:
MANTECH seeks a motivated, career and customer-oriented Integration Interoperability Lead to join our team. This role offers remote flexibility, with the potential for either a hybrid or fully remote arrangement depending on final operational needs, alongside periodic travel for key meetings and projects.


The Integration Interoperability Lead will own enterprise healthcare integration, including Health Level Seven (HL7), Digital Imaging and Communications in Medicine (DICOM), DICOMweb, and Integrating the Healthcare Enterprise (IHE) standards, Veterans Health Information Systems and Technology Architecture (VistA) and Oracle Electronic Health Record (EHR) interfaces, Master Patient Index (MPI) reconciliation, and edge device connectivity across complex clinical environments.


Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Lead the design, testing, and operational deployment of enterprise healthcare integration patterns across HL7, DICOM, DICOMweb, and IHE standards.

  • Own interface engine operations and data routing for VistA, Oracle Health, Joint Longitudinal Viewer (JLV), Clinical Context Object Workgroup (CCOW), and Department of Defense (DoD)/community health exchange frameworks.

  • Oversee Master Patient Index (MPI), Electronic Directory Person Identifier (EDIPI), and Social Security Number (SSN) identity reconciliation workflows to guarantee data integrity across disparate systems.

  • Manage DICOM routing, Modality Worklist (MWL) integration, and edge acquisition device connectivity across heterogeneous facilities.

  • Coordinate daily with site transition leads and biomedical/clinical engineering teams to support seamless modality and acquisition-device integration.

  • Direct interface troubleshooting, end-to-end integration testing, and issue resolution across multi-site production environments.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in technical or healthcare discipline with 10+ years of relevant work experience, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience.

  • Experience in healthcare system integration, interface engine management, and interoperability within enterprise healthcare environments or regional health networks.

  • Expertise with HL7 v2, DICOM, DICOMweb, and IHE integration profiles and protocols.

  • Experience implementing DICOM routers, modality worklists, and identity/MPI reconciliation workflows.

  • Background executing interface testing and complex production troubleshooting across heterogeneous clinical facilities.

  • Experience coordinating directly with biomedical engineering or clinical engineering teams at the acquisition-device edge.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Certified Imaging Informatics Professional (CIIP) certification or related credentials.

  • Experience with VistA, Oracle Health (Cerner), Joint Longitudinal Viewer (JLV), or CCOW integration architectures.

  • Experience supporting healthcare integration within federal healthcare systems (e.g., Department of Veterans Affairs, Department of Defense, or Defense Health Agency).

  • Master's degree in Health Informatics, Computer Science, or Systems Engineering.

Clearance Requirements:

  • U.S. Citizenship is required.

  • Must be able to obtain and maintain a Department of Veterans Affairs Moderate Risk Background Investigation (BI) or Public Trust clearance.

Physical Requirements:

  • Must be able to remain in a stationary position 50% of the time.

  • Needs to occasionally move about inside the office and clinical settings to access machinery and engage with team members.

  • Frequently communicates with co-workers, management, and government stakeholders, which may involve delivering technical briefings; must be able to exchange accurate information in these situations.

title: Principal Software Engineer – X-Lab Developer (26-411)
description:
RELOCATION ASSISTANCE: No relocation assistance availableCLEARANCE REQUIRED FOR START: YesCLEARANCE TYPE: SecretTRAVEL: Yes, 10% of the Time

Description

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.

Northrop Grumman Space Systems—Missile Defense Integration offers an excellent opportunity for a Principal Software Engineer – X-Lab Developer (26-411) to join our team of skilled and diverse professionals. Based at Schriever Space Force Base, CO, this role is essential to supporting the U.S. President, the Secretary of Defense, and combatant commanders at the strategic, regional, and operational levels.

This position does not provide relocation assistance and requires on-site work with no remote options.

Position Overview:

The Command and Control, Battle Management, and Communications (C2BMC) program is a key component of the Missile Defense System. It is a vital operational system that enables the U.S. president, the Secretary of Defense, and combatant commanders at strategic, regional, and operational levels to plan ballistic missile defense operations systematically, collectively monitor the battle, and dynamically control networked sensors and weapon systems to achieve global and regional mission goals. C2BMC supports layered missile defense capabilities that enable an optimized response to threats across all ranges and flight phases. It serves as a force multiplier by networking, integrating, and synchronizing autonomous sensor and weapon systems and operations, both globally and regionally, to improve performance. C2BMC is essential for all ground and flight tests that verify and demonstrate the current and future capabilities of missile defense systems.

The X-Lab develops and integrates prototypes for future missile-defense capabilities, such as Sensor/Weapon Integration, Algorithm Development, and User Interface Design. To strengthen the team, they seek a mid-level Software Engineer with Secret Clearance and proven skills in these key areas.

Basic Qualifications:

Please list your current security clearance and IAT or relevant certifications on your resume, if applicable.

  • A Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, or a related field from an accredited university, along with 5 years of experience; or a Master’s degree in a related field with 3 years of relevant work experience; or 9 years of relevant work experience may be considered as an alternative to a degree
  • Applicants must have a current, active Government-Issued 8140 certification at IAT Level II or higher (such as Security+ CE, CCNA-Security, CySA+, CND, etc.) at the time of application, which is required to start. The candidate is responsible for maintaining their 8140 certifications throughout the entire contract period
  • Applicants must have a current, active in-scope Government-issued Secret security clearance at the time of application, which is required to start
  • Willingness to travel 10% of the time for business needs
  • Full-cycle software engineering of new capabilities
  • Basic Systems Engineering understanding to inform software design
  • Software development with Java (or another object-oriented language).
  • Principles and patterns of Object-Oriented development
  • Should be comfortable with rapidly changing requirements, design challenges requiring novel solutions, fast-paced work, and tight deadlines
  • Application deployment, integration, and troubleshooting across Windows and Unix/Linux platforms
  • Operating systems experience with Windows and Unix/Linux
  • Experience with any of the following: Eclipse IDE, Maven, Git/GitLab, Python, and Ansible for build, version control, and configuration management
  • Create and manage Bash scripts to automate build and testing processes
  • Experience with JUnit, Mockito, and automated test frameworks; ability to produce repeatable test artifacts and maintain test coverage
  • Strong communication, organizational, and interpersonal abilities

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 3 years of hands-on Java development in a secure or defense-related environment
  • Strong command of the Java Spring framework (Spring MVC, Spring Data, Spring Boot)
  • Experience working within the Linux environment
  • Experience with software testing and analysis tools
  • Knowledge of JavaScript, CSS, and HTML is a plus

What We Can Offer You:

Northrop Grumman provides a comprehensive benefits package and a supportive work environment that encourages your growth, benefiting both employees and the company. The benefits are flexible and customizable, enabling you to choose options that suit your individual and family needs. Your benefits will include the following:

  • Health Plan
  • Savings Plan
  • Paid Time Off
  • Education Assistance
  • Training and Development
  • Flexible Work Arrangements

title: STEP Instructor - Biology
description:
Thank you for considering a career with the Research Foundation of The City University of New York (RFCUNY).

The team at RFCUNY is made up of dedicated, talented professionals committed to providing the services that allow CUNY researchers, faculty, and staff to focus on their intellectual curiosity and scientific discoveries.

We are pleased that you are interested in exploring opportunities to join RFCUNY.

Primary Location:

BOROUGH OF MANHATTAN C. C.

Bargaining Unit:

No

Position Overview

The STEP Program seeks an engaging, student-focused Biology Instructor to teach high school students. The instructor will develop interactive lessons that introduce students to biological concepts, scientific research methods, laboratory practices, and STEM career pathways. The ideal candidate will create an inclusive learning environment that promotes curiosity, critical thinking, and academic growth.

Key Responsibilities

· Develop and deliver engaging, age-appropriate biology lessons.

· Connect biological concepts to real-world issues, scientific research, and STEM careers.

· Incorporate laboratory activities, demonstrations, discussions, and student research projects.

· Teach and reinforce proper laboratory procedures and safety practices.

· Adapt instruction to support students from diverse backgrounds and with varying learning needs.

· Assess student progress and provide constructive feedback and academic support.

· Mentor students and encourage their educational and personal development.

· Maintain a safe, respectful, and inclusive classroom and laboratory environment.

· Collaborate with STEP coordinators, staff, instructors, and community partners.

· Supervise students during program activities, field trips, college tours, and conferences.

· Support STEP’s mission of student empowerment, college readiness, and academic achievement.

· Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

· Bachelor’s degree in biology, biological sciences, science education, or a related field; a graduate degree is preferred.

· Experience teaching, mentoring, or working with middle or high school students.

· Strong knowledge of biology and the ability to explain scientific concepts clearly and engagingly.

· Experience conducting or supervising laboratory activities.

· Effective classroom-management, communication, and organizational skills.

· Demonstrated commitment to inclusive and equitable education.

· Ability to work independently and collaboratively as part of a student-support team.

The successful candidate will be enthusiastic about helping high school students explore biology, develop scientific and laboratory skills, and build confidence in pursuing college and STEM career opportunities.

Pay Range:

$55 per hour

title: Production Scheduler, Submarines - Limited Term (24 months)
description:
Seaspan is seeking premier talent to join our Victoria Shipyards team and work alongside others who complete project plans and share a passion in ship repair strategies. The Production Scheduler, Submarines is an influencing role which focuses on the creation and maintenance of the project schedule for repair and overhaul programs.

In this role, you will be responsible for the development of planning and scheduling of tasks relative to repair and conversion projects. Key responsibilities include developing detailed production schedule incorporating material, engineering and productions plans, resources profiles and schedules, development and upkeep of department templates, Standard Operating Procedures and metrics.

You will have strong influential, interpersonal, and communication skills, including the ability to connect with others with tact and subtlety. Using your great personal skills, you will be able to stay focused on customer service and compliment this with a demonstrated desire to establish relationships that cultivate trust and dedication.

Note: This is a 24 months limited term employment with eligible benefits and vacation to cover a maternity leave. Due to business needs, this position is required to be fully on-site based at 825 Admirals Road, Victoria.

What you'll do

  • Utilize P6, contract documentation and estimating work/material sheets to develop and maintain Production Schedules for the Project Management Office (PMO).
  • Develop the detail planning and scheduling template to provide a consistent format for use in a variety of areas that will feed into the integrated master schedule. Ensure that a process to regularly update information is developed and communicated across the various functions.
  • Develop and maintain resource profiles for the submarine program to provide forecasting information to all functional areas for preplanning activities.
  • Prepare and distribute regular update reports that provide project resource status, schedule performance and identify variances to performance plans.
  • Support the preparation of Earned Value Management System (EVMS) reports that identify project status, cost, and schedule performance.
  • Develop and maintain P6 templates for the project plans bases on functional requirements.
  • Provide quality control of the plans that are produced by other planner schedulers.
  • Maintain department Standard Operating Procedures and department metrics.

What you'll bring

  • A bachelor’s degree in Engineering or Business is preferred. Trades certificated combined with scheduling experience may be considered.
  • 4+ years planning and scheduling experience is required. Scheduling experience in ship/submarine repair and overhaul or shipbuilding is desirable.
  • Certification by an accredited society in Planning, Production Control and/or Project Management is desirable.
  • Extensive knowledge of shipbuilding operations with a detailed understanding of the relationship between procurement, production, test and reactivation operations.
  • Proficiency working with scheduling software including Primavera P6 and Microsoft Project.
  • Experience using Power-BI and SAP Business Intelligence.
  • Knowledge of EVMS principles and their application in monitoring, reporting and controlling work activities.
  • Knowledge of Agile/Kanban methodologies would be an asset.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, ability to multi-task, analytical abilities and interpersonal skills.
  • Excellent communication skills both written and verbal.
  • Demonstrated initiative, adaptability, flexibility, creativity and integrity. Ability to work with limited direction and to function as a key team member.
  • Eligible for NATO Secret Clearance and Controlled Goods clearance.

Why you'll love working here

  • We also provide the best-in-class health and wellness benefits package for this position, including things such as extended health care (i.e. paramedical services for massage therapy, speech therapy, mental health coverage, physiotherapy, and more), dental care, vision care, life insurance, medical leave coverage, parental leave coverage, childcare benefit partnership, $500 personal spending account, and an Employee Family Assistance Program (EFAP).

The estimated salary for this position is $84,600 - $103,400. In determining final salary, Seaspan considers many factors including the successful Candidate’s skillset and experience as well as position location and internal equity. The final base salary offer will be at the Company’s sole discretion and presented as part of a competitive total compensation package.

description:

YOUR MISSION

We are looking for someone to join our Customer CRM Lifecycle team within the Growth organization. We are a team dedicated to crafting and implementing long-term automated lifecycle strategies designed to engage users with our app and drive incremental business results. As a CRM Lifecycle Lead, you will be an integral part of a team that thinks big, continuously pushing the boundaries to deliver & improve impactful communication strategies that align with our company’s vision and objectives.

THE JOURNEY

  • Craft and optimize communications strategy: Lead the development and execution of the communications lifecycle strategy aimed at enhancing customer activation, retention and reactivation by driving user engagement. Do so, by working on optimizing and personalizing communication based on insights driven through data analysis. This includes continuously exploring new opportunities to enhance customer interactions.

  • Manage complex projects: Take ownership of communication projects from inception to execution. Ensuring deadlines are met and execution set-ups are measurable to gather new insights. You will coordinate with cross-functional teams, manage timelines, and oversee project deliverables.

  • Make decisions based on Data Analysis and Reporting: While not serving as the team's data analyst, you will have to take ownership of the testing framework for new tests, interpret customer data, and generate insights that inform and optimize communication strategies.

  • Excel at Stakeholder Management: Engage and collaborate with various stakeholders across the organization. Navigate conflicts effectively, ensuring that roadmaps are aligned and executed seamlessly across different teams.

title: Director, Animal Protection
description:
Purpose of Position: The Director of Animal Protection provides strategic leadership in advancing Humane Colorado’s animal protection priorities, cultivating strong partnerships with law enforcement and animal control agencies, and representing the organization as a trusted authority in the field. This role also leads the development and delivery of professional education and training on animal cruelty investigations, animal welfare laws, animal handling, evidence collection, case preparation, and investigative best practices.


Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership and Program Development

  • Provide strategic leadership and subject-matter expertise in animal protection and animal cruelty investigations.
  • Cultivate and sustain strong relationships with animal control agencies, law enforcement, prosecutors, veterinarians, judicial partners, and other professional and community stakeholders.
  • Develop and maintain systems, resources, protocols, and best practices that strengthen the organization’s ability to support external partners and respond effectively to animal protection cases.
  • Manages and develops an effective staff: providing effective communication, leadership, guidance and resources. Determines staff qualifications and competency; recruits, interviews, selects, hires, trains, orients, mentors, evaluates, coaches, counsels, disciplines, and rewards. Establishes and monitors staff safety and regulatory compliance
  • Partner with internal departments on resources, equipment, and operational support.
  • Contribute to departmental planning, goal setting, performance measurement, and program evaluation.
  • Develops and manages departmental budgets and resources.
  • Maintain organized, accurate case files, documentation, data, and case-management records, and uphold appropriate standards for documentation and recordkeeping.
  • Work in collaboration with the Development and Communications teams to support fundraising efforts and campaigns, such as providing impact stories and reports resulting in financial support.
  • Participates in donor events, meetings, and tours.
  • Ensure program grant compliance, and quality of services and evaluations.

External Partnerships and Investigative Support

  • Consult and advise partners on investigating, documenting, and prosecuting animal cruelty cases.
  • Provide expert guidance and leadership during large-scale animal cruelty investigations, impoundments, emergency response situations, and other complex or high-risk cases.
  • Facilitate communication and coordination among partner agencies and internal departments to support effective investigations, positive animal welfare outcomes, and timely case resolution.
  • Identify and proactively address risks associated with investigations, animal handling, impoundments, emergency response, and community outreach.

Professional Education and Training

  • Develop, deliver, and evaluate educational training programs and presentations for partners about animal cruelty laws and best practices.
  • Establish and maintain professional training resources and materials that promote consistency, professionalism, and legally sound investigative practices.
  • Assess the effectiveness and impact of training initiatives and use feedback, data, and emerging best practices to strengthen programming.

People Care

People are the key to fulfilling our mission. Making internal and external patrons and their needs a primary focus is expected in all situations. This position interacts with and collaborates with employees at all levels of the organization. Communication occurs through face to face, telephone, and electronic interactions and may also include contact with the general public and business partners. Communication and contact must be clear, understandable, cooperative, professional, and respectful in all circumstances. Employees are expected to actively support a positive team environment, directly address conflict, and appropriately express concerns.


Competencies

Competencies are work behaviors and expectations necessary for successful job performance. They encompass knowledge, skills, abilities, attitudes, and actions. Additional definitions for competencies may be obtained from Human Resources.

Travel

title: MHE Operator
description:
3:00 PM to 11:00 PM Monday to Friday

Additional $1.50 hourly premium for afternoon shift

Reporting to the Operations Supervisor the Material Handler is responsible for a variety of warehouse tasks using an RF and various material handling equipment. Follows best practice processes to ensure we are efficient, accurate, and provide quality and on-time orders for our customers.

Previous experience with RF based Warehouse Management System (WMS), preferably Red Prairie.

Knowledge of warehouse processes, including receiving, order picking, shipping, and inventory control.
Organized and strong attention to detail.
Able to adapt to change and easily adopt new processes required to meet changing business needs.
Able to work in a structured environment and follow instructions.
Knowledge of WMS RF Scanner.
Experience with Red Prairie WMS an asset.

EDUCATION

Some high school, completion of secondary school diploma preferred.

CERTIFICATIONS

One or a combination of the following equipment experience and certification - Raymond Reach and Order Picker.

title: Tournament Coordinator SA (m/f/x)
description:
• Are you passionate about esports and enjoy turning complex tournament plans into well-executed live events?

  • Do you enjoy coordinating people, systems and deadlines to deliver tournaments successfully?

  • Are you confident managing operational risks, solving problems under pressure and keeping stakeholders aligned?

  • Do you take ownership of projects and enjoy seeing them through from initial planning to live delivery?

  • Do you want to play a key role in delivering high-quality tournament experiences for teams, partners and fans?

If the answers to the above questions are yes, then this role could be ideal for you!

GRID is looking for a Tournament Coordinator to join our Tournament Services team and take operational ownership of assigned tournaments from initial planning and design through to live delivery and post-event review.

You will be responsible for translating tournament objectives, approved designs and commercial requirements into clear, executable operational plans. You will coordinate the people, teams, systems and dependencies required to make each tournament successful, while maintaining event readiness, managing operational risks and keeping stakeholders aligned throughout the tournament lifecycle.

You will act as the primary operational point of contact for your assigned tournaments, working closely with GRID teams including Tournament Services, League Operations, Tournament Production, Partnerships, Integrity, Support and Commercial, as well as publishers, esports teams, partners and other tournament stakeholders.

The role combines tournament operations, project coordination, stakeholder management and live event delivery. You will be expected to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously, identify risks and blockers early, drive actions to completion and make sure every part of the tournament is ready for successful delivery.

What you will do

  • Before the tournament

    • Own the end-to-end operational planning, coordination and delivery of assigned GRID tournaments.

    • Coordinate tournament formats, schedules, competitive structures, invitations, registrations and operational requirements.

    • Ensure delivery remains aligned with agreed timelines, scope, budgets and quality standards.

    • Own event readiness from approved tournament design through transition into live operations.

    • Validate tournament systems, documentation, resources and operational requirements are complete before launch.

    • Maintain visibility of dependencies and escalate blockers where appropriate, driving resolutions.

    • Ensure handovers into live operations are clear, complete and actionable.

  • During the tournament

    • Coordinate tournament operations across the full tournament lifecycle, working with League Operations and other delivery teams.

    • Act as the primary operational point of contact for assigned tournaments.

    • Ensure formats, schedules, rules and operational processes are executed consistently against agreed standards.

    • Support operational decisions and stakeholder communications during live events.

  • After the tournament

    • Maintain tournament KPIs, trackers, dashboards and operational reporting.

    • Lead or support post-event operational reviews and debriefs.

What Success Looks Like

  • Assigned tournaments are delivered on time, within agreed scope, budget and quality standards.

  • League Operations, Production, Partnerships, Support and other stakeholders have everything required before live delivery.

  • Tournament formats, schedules, invitations, rulebooks and operational systems are accurate and delivered on time.

  • Operational documentation, KPIs and trackers remain complete, accurate, accessible and up to date.

  • Risks and dependencies are identified early and resolved or escalated before they impact delivery.

  • Live tournaments and operational handovers are delivered effectively, with issues resolved quickly and stakeholders kept aligned.

Nice to have

  • Previous experience in tournament operations, esports, event operations, project coordination or a similar delivery-focused role.

  • Strong understanding of tournament planning, competitive structures and live event operations.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English

  • Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to coordinate multiple workstreams, deadlines and dependencies.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively across internal teams, publishers, teams, partners and other stakeholders.

  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage complex operational information accurately.

  • Strong problem-solving, decision-making and risk-management skills, including the ability to act under pressure.

  • Ability to work independently, take accountability for outcomes and operate effectively in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

  • Strong interest in esports and a good understanding of competitive gaming ecosystems.

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment where priorities and requirements can change quickly.

title: Senior Scientist, Engineering- Lab Start-Up and Commercialization
description:
Job Description

Join Our Team as a Biologics Conjugation Senior Scientist!

We are seeking a strategic and technical scientist with expertise in laboratory start up and operations ideally in a development & commercialization space to support our ever growing and dynamic late-stage biologics pipeline within the expansive Biologics S&T portfolio.

Why You'll Love This Role:

As a Sr. Scientist in Biologics Conjugation Commercialization, you’ll be at the forefront of starting up new lab capabilities for conjugation. Setting up systems and processes to help the lab operate efficiently and effectively.

As the laboratory manager, you will troubleshoot and solve problems for the laboratory and operating systems, and help drive capital planning processes and asset management programs. A key deliverable of our commercialization team is to have qualified scale down models for our conjugation processes, and you will be instrumental in design and establishment of those models to support process characterization, right first time PPQ and regulatory filings. You will engage our program team members to understand their needs and continually look to improve operations by developing efficient solutions that will support business objectives and ensure continuity and Safety, and Environmental compliance.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Scientific Engagement: Help the Biologics Conjugation Commercialization team with scientific direction and consistent establishment of lab scale down models to be used across our portfolio.

  • Lab Operations Leadership: Lead daily lab operations, including scheduling, training, inventory management, tiers and operational metrics to enable efficient experimental execution and continuous improvement.

  • Asset Reliability and Capability Leadership: Lead capital asset startup, equipment ownership, project planning, maintenance, calibration, troubleshooting, and root cause failure analysis to ensure laboratory equipment and systems remain reliable, accurate, efficient, and ready for use.

  • Compliance, Safety, and Process Safety Leadership: Ensure laboratory activities, systems, and equipment are maintained in compliance with safety, environmental, quality, regulatory, and Process Safety Management requirements, including appropriate controls for work involving potent compounds.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Unite diverse teams to achieve program goals as One Team. Champion compliance and safety; promote a culture of diversity, inclusion, and equity. Experience and aptitude to work, and collaborate in internal and external cross-functional, matrixed teams.

  • Project Management: Adaptability and agility to prioritize and deliver complex objectives, often on tight timelines, in a rapidly changing environment.

  • Recognition: Celebrate team achievements and foster a culture of appreciation.

  • Innovation: Lead business improvement initiatives and leverage your network to drive change.

Education & Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in Chemical Engineering, Bioengineering, Biological Engineering, or a related field with six (6) years of relevant industry experience. OR

  • Master's degree in Chemical Engineering, Bioengineering, Biological Engineering, or a related field with four (4) years of relevant industry experience. OR

  • Ph.D. in Chemical Engineering, Bioengineering, Biological Engineering, or a related field with a no minimum relevant knowledge.

What You Bring:

  • Ability to lead without authority, build trust, and inspire accountability

  • Ethical, resilient, and committed to excellence

  • Skilled in risk management, team facilitation, and strategic planning

  • Sound judgment and issue-resolution mindset,

  • Laboratory start-up experience

  • Experience working in laboratories that handle potent compounds, high-containment materials, or specialized safety controls.

  • Experience in pilot or commercial scale manufacturing of biological molecules.

  • Familiarity with late-stage process development, process characterization, scale down model qualification, process validation regulatory submissions, and working with external contract organizations.

  • Minimum of 3 years experience troubleshooting equipment and utility systems

  • Minimum of 3 years experience executing/supporting Capital projects/Project Management

  • Understanding of or experience with Capital and Profit Planning Processe

  • Experience with Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS) software such as SAP, Procal, or Maximo

  • Experience in using QlikSense, Spotfire, or other data analytical software

  • Experience in performing root cause analysis

Antibody Drug Conjugates (ADC), Bioconjugation, Bioreactors, Capital Planning, Capital Project Management, cGMP Regulations, Chemical Engineering, Chromatographic Techniques, Clinical Judgment, Conjugation Chemistry, Design of Experiments (DOE), Detail-Oriented, Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), Influencing Without Authority, Laboratory Operations, Laboratory Setup, Leadership, Process Design, Process Optimization, Process Scale Up, Project Development, Project Management, Project Resource Management, Root Cause Investigations, Technology Transfer

title: Financial Resolutions Specialist
description:
Why This Role Exists
Financial hardship can be difficult and personal. Metro needs professionals who can approach charged-off accounts with sound judgment, respectful communication, and a genuine commitment to helping members find realistic paths forward.

As a Financial Resolutions Specialist, you will serve as a member advocate while supporting Metro’s recovery objectives. You will work directly with members to understand their circumstances, explain available options, negotiate appropriate solutions, and pursue positive financial outcomes. This role combines empathy, accountability, investigation, and consistent follow-through in support of innovative, member-centered financial resolutions.
What You’ll Own

A portfolio of charged-off accounts requiring timely review, outreach, monitoring, and resolution.
Constructive member negotiations that balance individual circumstances with responsible recovery efforts.
Accurate monitoring of payment activity, collection accounts, and department dashboards.
Skip-tracing and asset-search efforts used to reconnect with members and support account resolution.
Thoughtful recommendations regarding recovery products, litigation, and other appropriate next steps.

What You’ll Do

Engage members in respectful, solution-focused conversations about charged-off accounts.
Educate members about available options and develop personalized approaches based on their circumstances.
Negotiate appropriate resolutions while maintaining fairness, transparency, and clear expectations.
Use account data and analytics to identify trends, anticipate member needs, and recommend effective recovery strategies.
Monitor accounts, payment commitments, and dashboards to support timely outreach and follow-through.
Use approved skip-tracing and asset-search tools to locate information and advance recovery efforts.
Qualify members for recovery products and recommend actions that support financial wellness.
Recommend accounts for litigation when necessary and appropriately supported.
Maintain awareness of applicable state and federal regulations, industry practices, and emerging financial recovery trends.
Support process improvements, new projects, and other member-focused initiatives as directed by management.

Success Looks Like in 12 to 18 Months

Your assigned accounts are managed accurately, consistently, and with an appropriate sense of urgency.
Members receive clear explanations, respectful service, and practical resolution options.
Negotiations remain constructive and focused on achievable outcomes.
Account activity, payments, outreach, and recommended next steps are monitored and documented reliably.
Recovery and litigation recommendations are timely, fair, and supported by available account information.
You contribute useful observations and ideas based on account trends and member needs.
You are recognized as a dependable teammate who supports shared goals and deadlines.

You’ll Love This Role If...

You enjoy helping people work through challenging financial circumstances.
You can combine empathy with clear expectations and appropriate accountability.
You are comfortable negotiating, managing conflict, and finding common ground.
You are organized, attentive to detail, and committed to following through.
You adapt well to changing priorities, processes, and member needs.
You value teamwork, continuous learning, and professional member service.

AI Expectations
Where Metro has approved AI-enabled tools for this work, you will use them responsibly to organize information, identify trends, improve communication, and support workflow consistency. Human judgment, verification, confidentiality, regulatory awareness, and personal accountability remain central to every member interaction and account decision.
Required Qualifications

Ability to communicate clearly and professionally, both verbally and in writing.
Ability to negotiate, manage conflict, and remain focused on positive outcomes.
Basic knowledge of computer software.
Knowledge of applicable state and federal regulations.
Ability to prioritize work, manage information, meet deadlines, and adapt to changing needs.

Preferred Qualifications

High school diploma or equivalent.
Three or more years of related experience.
Previous credit union or banking experience.

This position operates in a general office environment, is highly stationary, and requires frequent computer and telephone use. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
This job description is not intended to contain a comprehensive listing of every activity, duty, or responsibility required of the employee. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time, with or without notice.
Why Metro
At Metro, you will have the opportunity to combine financial recovery with meaningful member advocacy. Your work will help members understand their options, strengthen recovery efforts, and improve how the Financial Resolutions team supports people experiencing financial hardship.
Benefits, Hybrid Eligibility, and Compensation
Our Benefits
We believe great work starts with supporting our people. That's why we offer a competitive and well-rounded benefits package designed to support your health, financial well-being, career growth, and work-life balance. From medical, dental, and vision coverage to retirement savings, paid time off, learning opportunities, and employee wellness resources, we invest in helping our employees thrive both at work and beyond.
Click here to learn more about our benefits package and employee perks.
Compensation Disclosure
$26.35 - $35.65/hour ($54,808 - $74,152 annualized)
The salary range listed provides a general expectation for the role. Final compensation is based on experience, unique strengths, and the impact you are expected to make. Metro also offers a competitive benefits package and additional perks that contribute to total compensation.
Ready to Make an Impact?
At Metro Credit Union, we believe our employees are our greatest asset. We are committed to creating a work environment where you can thrive professionally while maintaining work-life balance. From comprehensive benefits and competitive compensation to opportunities for growth and development, we invest in your success. Join a team where your work makes a real difference in protecting our members and strengthening our community.
About Metro Credit Union
Metro Credit Union is the largest state-chartered credit union in Massachusetts, with $3.4 billion in assets. Metro provides a full range of financial products to more than 200,000 members in Barnstable, Bristol, Essex, Franklin, Hampden, Hampshire, Middlesex, Norfolk, Plymouth, Suffolk, and Worcester counties in Massachusetts, and Cheshire, Hillsborough, Merrimack, Rockingham, and Strafford counties in New Hampshire. Metro is the credit union of choice for employees at over 1,200 companies through its Metro@work program.
Founded in 1926, Metro currently operates branch offices in Boston, Burlington, Chelsea, Dorchester, Framingham, Lawrence, Lynn, Medford, Melrose, Newton, Peabody, Reading, Salem, Tewksbury, and West Roxbury. Metro is also a Juntos Avanzamos (“Together We Advance”) designated credit union, an honor given to financial institutions for their commitment to serving and empowering Hispanic and immigrant consumers. Metro was recently named among the most charitable companies in Massachusetts by the Boston Business Journal; voted Top Credit Union in Banker & Tradesman's Best of 2025 awards; and recognized as one of America's Best Regional Banks and Credit Unions in 2025 by Newsweek. Learn more at MetroCU.org.

title: IT Project Manager (H/F)
description:
Wabtec Transit Business is quickly transforming from a legacy decentralized Business Units to a centralized global organization. This triggers number of IT projects that support these changes. In this context, we are looking for an experienced IT Project Manager, who will join the Wabtec Transit Business Relationship Management Team. The ideal candidate will discover and align Transit IT Business Requests with the global IT roadmap, then prepare and manage specific IT projects. This position requires a mix of energy, IT experience in the global Manufacturing industry, and curiosity, given the large scope of Business and functions covered.

Key Responsibilities

  • Engage with our Business – All functions, in the early stages of each Transit request. Discover and clarify the scope and its readiness
  • Search for an IT owner within our global IT Organization
  • Understand the existing IT Roadmap and how it covers the Business request. Formulate the gaps if any and what is the scope and value of a middle term / Long term project
  • Highlight issues and call for action in case of unresolved strategic topics that put projects on hold.
  • Manage preliminary studies and projects. Manage the Project in line with our IT PMO process

Qualifications

  • 6+ years of experience in IT project management, preferably in a global manufacturing industry
  • Experience with matrix IT organization, IT PMO process and certifications
  • Strong project management and budgeting skills
  • Excellent communication and documentation skills
  • Ability to work with cross-country and cross-functional teams
  • Fluency in English

What could you accomplish in a place that puts People First?

Drawing on more than 150 years of experience, we are leading the way in safety, efficiency, reliability, innovation, and productivity. Whether it’s freight, transit, ports, logistics, mining, industrial, or marine, our expertise, technologies, and people together – are accelerating the future of transportation. With roots that date back to George Westinghouse, Thomas Edison, and Louis Faiveley, Wabtec has always built technologies and implemented solutions for a variety of sectors that are critical to meeting the needs of customers and governments alike.

Our global team of about 30,000 employees worldwide delivers performance that moves the world forward. We’re lifelong learners, obsessed with better. Learn more at www.WabtecCorp.com.

Culture powers us and the possibilities.

Need accommodation? Just let us know - we’ve got you.

title: Training Change Management Lead
description:

title: AI Engineer
description:

You will be a core builder within ATLAS, Bridgit’s multi-agent orchestration platform, contributing hands-on to the design and implementation of Bridgit’s multi-agent workflows.

You will build and maintain scalable, production-ready multi-agent systems and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, working within the architecture and standards set by the Lead AI Engineer. Using frameworks such as LangGraph or AutoGen, you will help ensure our AI models and orchestration layers are performant, reliable, and seamlessly integrated into our core products.

You will also contribute to developing and integrating AI features, and automated guardrails for model evaluation, data privacy, and AI safety that our platform depends on.

This is a hands-on, execution-focused role. You will write production code, implement agentic patterns, debug model deployments, and work closely with the Lead AI Engineer and the wider AI Engineering team to deliver against the roadmap.

What you’ll do:

  • Development: Build and maintain components of Bridgit’s multi-agent orchestration platform to specifications set by the Lead AI Engineer, following agreed engineering standards.

  • Architecture implementation: Implement the AI platform architecture, RAG pipelines, and integrations with enterprise systems as designed by the Lead AI Engineer.

  • Orchestration and integration: Build API-driven connections with databases and external enterprise tools.

  • Context Engineering: Implement short-term memory, vector stores, and long-term knowledge retrieval systems to maintain continuity across tasks.

  • Multi-agent protocols: Implement reliable message-passing rules, handoff mechanisms, and shared state management so agents can swap inputs and resolve conflicts.

  • Testing and evaluation: Build evaluation loops, logging, and error-correction guardrails to help prevent cascading hallucinations or infinite loops.

  • Secure engineering: Build secure, reproducible agent sandboxes for remote development and CI testing. Apply guardrails for secrets and PII in day-to-day development.

  • Support AI Governance: Contribute to systems for reproducibility, traceability, and quality controls in accordance with Bridgit’s AI Governance Framework and Risk Appetite Statement. Support monitoring and observability.

  • Adopt standardised AI coding tools: Use and provide feedback on standardised AI coding tools, such as Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex, within org-wide configurations. Help track tool usage and reliability.

  • Contribute to a “shift-left” culture: Share practical, AI-enabled workflows and coding practices with peers, and continuously improve your own productivity without compromising code quality.

What we're looking for:

  • 2–4 years of experience in AI/ML Engineering, Software Engineering, or Data Science, ideally within a regulated fintech or high-growth tech environment.

  • Deep familiarity with Large Language Models (LLMs), prompt engineering and RAG systems.

  • A working understanding of modern AI architectures, with exposure to agentic AI concepts such as tool use, workflow orchestration, routing, memory, and multi-agent patterns.

  • Experience contributing to AI solutions running in production, with an appreciation for cost, scalability, observability, security, and governance considerations.

  • Exposure to elements of the machine learning lifecycle, including model evaluation, monitoring for drift and bias, or inference latency optimisation.

  • Clear communicator: comfortable explaining technical work to the Lead AI Engineer and cross-functional teams, and receptive to feedback and coaching.

Our Culture and Benefits

Bridgit values its team, they are the heart of how we build this business. Along with competitive remuneration, slick offices and the chance to be part of an innovative, agile fintech, we also offer:

  • Extra Leave – We offer birthday leave + an additional day of paid leave to be used for life events, celebrations, or just a mental health reset.

  • Two Weeks from Anywhere – We encourage employees to work remotely from a location of their choice for two weeks each year.

  • Learning and Development – All employees are encouraged and empowered to engage in professional development, including a number of learning initiatives run internally.

  • Social Events – We have a jam-packed social scene, with events throughout the year to bring the team together!

Ready to Make an Impact?

If you’re excited about reshaping the lending industry and want to be part of a company that values authenticity and innovation, we’d love to chat. Apply now and let’s build the future of finance together! 🚀

title: Group Staff Assistant II
description:

New ideas are all around us, but only a few will change the world. That’s our focus at JPL. We ask the biggest questions, then search the universe for answers—literally. We build upon ideas that have guided generations, then share our discoveries to inspire generations to come. Your mission—your opportunity—is to seek out the answers that bring us one step closer. title: Military Forces Analyst, Senior
description:
Military Forces Analyst, Senior

The Opportunity:

With all the information available today, it takes a skilled intelligence analyst to know how to find and interpret the best data to give their clients the right answers. With the critical decisions made in our government every day, we need an intelligence analyst like you to do just that. As a military forces analyst, you use your specialized regional experience and attention to detail to develop products and assessments to give your client the actionable intelligence and context they need. If you have strong analytical skills and a problem-solving mindset, we have an opportunity to use those skills to support our warfighters, protect our national security, and inform our nation’s leaders.

As a military forces analyst on our team, you’ll help your client understand an evolving threat landscape. Using your understanding of various collection platforms, you’ll explore new data sources, develop effective queries, and combine information from disparate sources. You’ll validate information and apply client tradecraft as you build assessments for warfighters and senior policymakers.

This is a chance to grow your expertise, develop new analytic skills, and share your methodologies with other analysts. We focus on growing as a team to deliver the best support to our customers, so you’ll have resources for mentoring and learning new skills and tools.

Work with us as we provide the right information at the right time to support the critical needs of our nation's leaders.

Join us. The world can’t wait.

You Have:

  • 3+ years of experience with strategic or operational-level intelligence analysis, including creating written products and providing verbal briefings
  • 3+ years of experience with military forces analysis or order of battle analysis
  • 3+ years of experience with order of battle databases such as MIDB and MARS
  • Experience collaborating across the DoW and interagency partners
  • Experience working with geospatial intelligence or imagery analysis
  • TS/SCI clearance with a polygraph
  • HS diploma or GED


Nice If You Have:

  • Experience with ICD 203, analytic tradecraft, and writing for DoW customers
  • Experience with strategic-level all-source analysis

title: Building Envelope Internship Opportunity
description:
SOCOTEC’s Building Envelope team helps clients evaluate, design, construct, maintain, and improve the exterior components of buildings. The building envelope includes systems such as exterior walls, windows, doors, roofs, waterproofing, and other components that protect buildings from weather and the surrounding environment.

Our projects range from new construction to upgrades, repairs, maintenance, and repositioning of existing buildings. As a Building Envelope Intern, you will work alongside experienced engineers, inspectors, and Project Managers to gain exposure to both the technical and practical sides of building envelope consulting.

About SOCOTEC’s Summer Internship Program

SOCOTEC’s summer internship program is designed for college students who are eager to gain hands-on industry experience and learn more about the work we do. Interns receive well-rounded exposure to their field, with opportunities to spend time both on job sites and in the office while working alongside experienced professionals.

As a Building Envelope Intern, you can expect to spend approximately 2–3 days per week in the field, gaining firsthand experience with real-world building projects, construction activities, and site inspections. The remainder of your time will be spent in the office supporting project teams and learning how Building Envelope services are delivered.

What You’ll Do

Depending on the project, you may have the opportunity to:

  • Participate in field visits and construction site inspections alongside experienced engineers and inspectors.
  • Observe different phases of exterior wall and building envelope construction.
  • Learn how building envelope projects progress from design and planning through construction.
  • Assist with field reviews and documenting construction progress.
  • Learn how to identify and document building envelope conditions and potential issues.
  • Assist with reviewing architectural and construction drawings.
  • Gain exposure to shop drawings, design development, and construction documents.
  • Assist with building envelope research, inspections, and technical evaluations.
  • Help prepare clear and detailed project reports, photographs, and other documentation.
  • Gain exposure to building codes, construction standards, and industry best practices.
  • Work alongside Project Managers and other team members to support project activities and deadlines.
  • Learn how engineers and inspectors communicate technical information to clients, contractors, architects, and design teams.
  • Attend team meetings, training sessions, and in-house seminars.
  • Assist with other project-related assignments as needed.
  • Develop your technical, communication, organization, and problem-solving skills.
  • Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management, or a related field. Architectural, Civil, or Mechanical Engineering is preferred.
  • Interest in building envelope design, construction, inspection, and engineering.
  • Basic understanding of building construction, architectural design, or structural concepts is a plus.
  • Ability or willingness to learn how to read and interpret architectural and construction drawings.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with engineers, inspectors, Project Managers, and other team members.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office.
  • Familiarity with AutoCAD, Revit, BIM, or other modeling/drafting software is a plus, but not required.
  • Comfortable working both in an office and on active construction sites.
  • Willingness to learn, ask questions, and take on new challenges.

What You’ll Gain

Through this internship, you will gain:

  • Hands-on experience with real-world Building Envelope projects.
  • Exposure to exterior wall systems, windows, doors, roofing, waterproofing, and other building envelope components.
  • Experience participating in field reviews and construction site inspections.
  • An understanding of how building envelope projects move from design through construction.
  • Exposure to architectural drawings, shop drawings, construction documents, and building codes.
  • Experience working with engineers, inspectors, Project Managers, clients, contractors, architects, and design teams.
  • Opportunities to apply your classroom knowledge to practical building and construction challenges.
  • Mentorship and professional development from experienced industry professionals.
  • A better understanding of career opportunities in Building Envelope Engineering, Inspection, and Consulting.

Work Environment

This is a combination of field and office-based work. Building Envelope interns should expect to spend approximately 2–3 days per week on construction sites or at project locations.

Field work may involve walking active construction sites, climbing stairs or ladders, and working in various weather conditions. Interns will be expected to follow all applicable site safety requirements and will receive guidance from their supervisor and project team.

Potential Career Paths

This internship can provide a strong foundation for future opportunities in Building Envelope Engineering, Inspection, and Consulting, including entry-level roles such as:

  • Building Envelope Engineer
  • Engineer Inspector
  • Building Envelope Consultant
  • Project Engineer

For more information, please visit www.socotec.us

Job Type: Full-Time

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

SOCOTEC is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

title: Associate Analyst, Falcon Complete
description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.


About the Role:

CrowdStrike is looking for highly motivated, self-driven, technical analysts dedicated to making a difference in global security by protecting organizations against the most advanced attackers in the world. Our CrowdStrike virtual security operations center offers opportunities to expand your skill set through a wide variety of experiences, detecting and responding to incidents as they occur in real-time for our customers.

Am I an Associate Analyst, Endpoint Protection Team Candidate?

  • Do you have a passion for cybersecurity and a strong desire to build a career protecting organizations from the world's most sophisticated threats?

  • Are you self-motivated and looking for an opportunity to rapidly accelerate your skills?

  • Do you crave new and innovative work that actually matters to your customer?

  • Do you have a foundational background in Information Technology or Information Security that you're ready to put to work?

  • Do you excel at communicating clearly and professionally with customers and colleagues?

  • Do you love working around like-minded, smart people who you can learn from on a daily basis?

  • Are you excited about the evolving role of AI in security operations, including AI models, prompt engineering, and agentic SOC workflows?

What You'll Do:

  • Deliver clear, concise, and professional customer communications as the primary first point of contact.

  • Produce high-quality written and verbal communications, recommendations, and findings to customers and internally.

  • Triage, investigate, and respond to security alerts across endpoint, identity, email, and cloud environments.

  • Conduct tactical analysis of EDR telemetry, log sources, and forensic artifacts to identify the scope of compromise and support remediation efforts.

  • Investigate suspicious Microsoft 365 activity, including business email compromise (BEC) and adversary-in-the-middle (AITM) attacks, contain the threat, and deliver actionable guidance to customers.

  • Develop and improve processes for incident detection and the execution of countermeasures.

What You'll Need:

Successful candidates will have training or knowledge in one or more of the following areas:

  • Incident Handling: training or foundational knowledge in incident response processes, including the investigation of security events such as targeted threats, malware infections, and unauthorized access.

  • Threat Landscape Awareness: foundational knowledge of attack vectors, threat actor tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs), including familiarity with frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK.

  • Operating System Fundamentals: understanding of Windows, Mac, and Linux operating systems, including typical Windows functionality such as the file system, registry, scheduled tasks, and running processes.

  • Systems Administration: experience administering a network and troubleshooting issues such as general connectivity and authentication issues. Has an understanding of general IT architecture configurations in small to large networks.

title: Machine Learning Engineer (Decision Engine)
location: Ho Chi Minh City, Ho Chi Minh, Vietnam
description:
Location: Ho Chi Minh City,Ho Chi Minh,Vietnam

Trusting Social is an AI Fintech company building credit profiles for underserved consumers across Vietnam, Indonesia, India, and the Philippines, combining alternative data with advanced AI to expand access to credit. Having profiled over 1 billion consumers, the company is now pushing toward 100 million credit lines delivered — grounded throughout in strict data privacy and consumer data rights.

How You’ll Make an Impact

The decision engine decides, for every account in a large consumer portfolio, whether we reach out, through which channel, when, and how often. It is a machine that turns models into money, and it runs every day. As an MLE on the Data Science team you build it and you run it.

You will see a model you built change a business number within weeks, on a real portfolio rather than a benchmark, with senior data scientists next to you to learn the rigor from. If you want to become a strong data scientist rather than a model trainer, this is the seat where that happens.

What You’ll Do

Decisioning Ownership

  • Build the decisioning that picks which accounts we work with, through which channel, when, and how often.
  • Own a decision end to end, from the signal that triggered it to the outcome it produced.

Models, Pipelines and Reliability

  • Build the models behind those decisions — propensity, timing, channel response, contactability — and the pipelines that feed them.
  • Hold recovery, cost and reliability together, and move one without giving away the other two.
  • Build the monitoring that catches a broken input or a drifted model before the business notices.

Evidence and the Frontier

  • Backtest a change before it ships and measure it on live traffic after, on the metric the business is actually paid on.
  • Benchmark new methods on our own portfolios and our own metrics before adopting them.

What We’re Looking For

Experience & Background

  • Minimum 2 years of experience in IT, Computer Science, Banking, or Finance.
  • Proficiency in Python, R, or Java.
  • Strong hands-on experience in machine learning, statistics, and experimentation.
  • Experience with SQL databases and statistical analysis.
  • Familiarity with bank-related products like unsecured personal loans and credit cards is preferred.
  • Experience with big data processing is a plus.
  • Startup or tech background is a strong plus.

How You Work

  • You build models and pipelines, and you use AI to get more of it done — writing and reviewing code, exploring data, running more variants than you could by hand — while judging every output on evidence before it reaches a live decision.
  • You experiment proactively instead of waiting to be told what to build — you take a hypothesis to the data, then bring the result to the table.
  • You move fluidly between modeling, data engineering and business context, coordinating across product and operations without needing a handoff document.
  • You treat every failed experiment as a learning input and keep sharpening your craft without being told to.

Skills & Competencies

  • Product Architect — Prototypes a working decisioning system, reads the metrics it produces, and iterates before anyone has to ask.
  • AI Engineer/Architect — Ships end-to-end ML systems, owning the path from data pipeline to production decision.
  • AI Operator — Keeps the engine running above target at controlled cost, catching a bad feed or a drifted model before it reaches the portfolio.
  • Strong English communication skills (spoken and written — professional fluency required).
  • High adaptability and comfort operating in fast-paced, ambiguous environments.

What We Offer

Join our vibrant team and enjoy:

  • Opportunity to work and learn from one of the best and brightest technology teams in Vietnam
  • Be part of a winning team with exponential growth regionally, experience recruiting world-class talents
  • Competitive compensation package, including 13th-month salary and performance bonuses

  • Generous leave policies, including annual leave, sick leave, and flexible work hours

  • Fun and engaging team-building activities, sponsored sports clubs, and happy hour every Thursday
  • Unlimited free coffee, tea, snacks, and fruit to keep you energized

At Trusting Social, we live by ownership, integrity, and agility in execution. We believe in doing what’s right, what’s best, and what’s innovative. If you’re smart, driven, and want to make a difference in the world with the most advanced and fascinating technology, come join our team. We offer the runway to truly make an impact.

title: L2 Helpdesk Technician
description:
SUMMARY

The Level 2 Technician – IT & VoIP is responsible for resolving escalated technical issues across endpoints, servers, networks, and voice systems, delivering stable, high-quality IT and VoIP services for multiple MSP clients. This role owns complex troubleshooting, configuration changes, and vendor coordination, especially for VoIP environments where hosted experience is a strong advantage.


JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

Escalated IT support (L2)

  • Own escalated tickets from L1 for desktops, laptops, printers, and standard business applications, resolving issues that go beyond scripted fixes.
  • Support Microsoft 365/Entra ID/AD: user provisioning/deprovisioning, permissions, shared mailboxes, and basic group/policy issues.
  • Perform L2 Windows Server tasks: troubleshoot common server issues, review event logs, manage disk space, coordinate patching/reboots during maintenance windows, and resolve file/permission problems.
  • Troubleshoot network issues at the L2 level: site connectivity problems, firewall rules, DHCP/DNS issues, Wi‑Fi problems, and VPN connectivity.
  • Work through a daily schedule of tickets and tasks in the PSA, maintaining SLAs and keeping clients informed of progress.

VoIP / Hosted VoIP-focused responsibilities

  • Handle escalated VoIP tickets from L1: no audio/one‑way audio, dropped calls, registration issues, and recurring call quality complaints.
  • Configure and maintain VoIP environments: call routing, ring groups, queues, auto‑attendants, voicemail policies, time schedules, and basic contact center flows.[18][4][3]
  • Provision and update IP phones and softphones, using templates, bulk provisioning, and platform tools (SkySwitch or similar).
  • Investigate call quality issues end‑to‑end: review CDRs, analyze network conditions (latency, jitter, packet loss), check QoS and firewall/NAT behavior, and implement corrective changes.
  • Work with SkySwitch (or other carriers/providers) on platform or carrier-side issues, driving vendor tickets to resolution and communicating outcomes internally.

Collaboration and escalation

  • Act as a technical escalation point for L1 techs on both IT and VoIP issues; coach them on recurring problems and best practices to reduce future escalations.
  • Collaborate with the Service Desk Coordinator on ticket priority, scheduling, and handoffs, ensuring complex work is planned and communicated clearly to clients.
  • Escalate to senior engineers or architects for project-level work, major incidents, or deep network/voice design changes, providing clean documentation and findings.

Documentation and continuous improvement

  • Document all troubleshooting, configurations, and changes in the PSA and knowledge base so issues can be resolved faster next time.
  • Identify patterns in recurring issues (IT or VoIP) and recommend improvements to standards, templates, and monitoring to reduce noise and improve reliability.


QUALIFICATIONS

Ideal technical profile

  • 3+ years in technical support roles, including at least 1–2 years in an MSP or multi‑client environment.
  • Strong Windows endpoint and Microsoft 365/Entra ID/AD skills (user management, common policies, standard apps).

Windows Server experience

  • Comfortable administering modern Windows Server versions (2016/2019/2022) in small–mid-sized environments.
  • Active Directory: users, groups, basic OU structure, group membership, file/NTFS permissions.
  • DNS and DHCP: create/modify scopes and reservations, troubleshoot name resolution issues, basic DHCP problems.
  • Group Policy: understand, edit, and troubleshoot common GPOs impacting users and workstations (drive mappings, basic security/settings).
  • Common L2 server tasks: basic server troubleshooting (services, event logs, disk space, performance symptoms), patching/reboot coordination, and configuring/troubleshooting file shares and permissions.
  • Nice to have: Hyper‑V or VMware in SMB environments, and RDS/Terminal Services basics (sessions, simple app issues).

Networking and VoIP

  • Solid networking fundamentals: VLANs, DHCP, DNS, routing, firewall rules, VPNs, and basic QoS concepts.
  • Hands-on VoIP experience: provisioning IP phones/softphones, configuring call flows (ring groups, queues, auto‑attendants), and troubleshooting call quality (jitter, latency, packet loss).
  • SkySwitch or similar white‑label VoIP platform experience (or equivalent multi‑tenant VoIP system) is a strong plus.

Tools and soft skills

  • Comfortable working in PSA/RMM tools (Autotask/Kaseya/ConnectWise or similar) and documenting all work thoroughly.
  • Strong analytical, problem‑solving, and communication skills; able to explain complex issues in simple terms to clients and L1 techs.


JOB REQUIREMENTS

  • Should be willing to accept a long-term work-from-home arrangement.
  • Should be amenable to a permanent night shift schedule.

description:
Company Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Aperçu de l’entreprise

Chez Motorola Solutions, nous pensons que tout commence par nos employés. Nous sommes une communauté mondiale soudée, unie par la volonté incessante de contribuer à la sécurité des personnes partout dans le monde. Nous concevons et connectons des technologies qui contribuent à protéger les personnes, les biens et les infrastructures. Nos solutions favorisent la collaboration essentielle pour améliorer la sécurité des populations, des écoles, des hôpitaux, des entreprises et, finalement, des nations. Connectez-vous à une carrière qui compte et aidez-nous à bâtir un avenir plus sûr.


Department Overview

Motorola Solutions’ Video Division is defining the future of the security industry through innovative end-to-end solutions. We’re changing the landscape of the surveillance industry through advanced, award-winning AI-based surveillance systems. Artificial Intelligence is transforming the world, and our team is advancing the field as it applies to the surveillance industry. We are proud to be industry leaders in video analytics with products like Appearance Search, Unusual Motion Detection, and our recently launched Avigilon Cloud Service platform. You will be able to contribute to intelligent camera surveillance systems through cutting-edge research and software engineering.


Job Description

We are seeking an Intermediate Software Developer experienced in development within on-premise or cloud development environments who can build product features primarily by directing AI coding agents through a plan-first, test-verified workflow — writing specs and plans, reviewing and steering agent output, and proving correctness through tests and verification, rather than hand-writing the bulk of the implementation. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience delivering complex, large-scale, public-facing applications and APIs. We are also seeking someone with solid knowledge of DevOps, CI/CD, and test automation tools and concepts.

This position is based in Vancouver, BC, and the candidate must reside in the Greater Vancouver area, as you will be required to go into the office on a hybrid work schedule.

Responsibilities include:

  • AI-Native Engineering

    • Turn a feature request into a plan (files that change, order of work, tests that prove it) that someone who wasn't in the conversation could execute.

    • Direct AI coding agents through implementation, staying accountable for the result as if hand-written — including the failing-test-first / fix-can't-edit-the-test discipline.

    • Translate product requirements into rigorous verification strategies, interpreting unit tests, mutation checks, and verdict-function results to deeply understand and validate system behavior.

    • Work concurrently across multiple agent sessions/worktrees when appropriate, reviewing multiple streams of in-flight work rather than one linear thread.

    • Contribute back to the shared skills/hooks/subagents library as patterns repeat.

    • Know the difference between "the agent said tests pass" and "I've verified this actually works," and never ship on the former alone.

  • Key contributor within the team:

    • Designing, implementing, and supporting end-to-end software solutions for Unity Video products worldwide.

    • Building team trust, mentoring peers, and helping drive the team toward high performance.

    • Contributing to build pipelines, containerization, DevOps tooling, and test automation strategies.

  • Growing and training our software organization:

    • Fostering strong collaborative relationships with fellow developers and technical leadership

    • Proactively providing technical guidance and mentorship

    • Upholding rigorous standards for software development and quality, both personally and across the team

  • Consistently showing up with:

    • Energy and passion

    • Optimistic outlook

    • Transparent communication

    • Growth-oriented perspective

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related

  • 4+ years of professional software engineering experience building robust front-end architectures and rich UIs. While we are framework-agnostic (workflow matters more than language), a proven track record in client-side development is essential.

  • Hands-on experience directing AI coding agents to build real features with a large customer base.

  • Experience working in a large code base

  • Excellent written and oral communication skills

  • Experience implementing multi-layered testing strategies (unit, integration, and E2E) and comfort reading/writing test code even when an agent drafts the first pass.

  • Judgment to know when to trust agent output and when to dig in — this is the core skill being hired for.

Nice to have:

  • Experience with streaming/media, video pipelines, or similarly verification-heavy domains.

  • Familiarity with git worktrees for parallel session workflows.

  • Prior contribution to internal tooling/conventions (skills, hooks, lint rules) rather than just consuming them.

  • Knowledge of CI/CD, test automation, and DevOps

Target Base Salary Range: $100,000 - 120,000 CAD
