title: Program Coordinator 1 (PCN 083024)
description:
Job Description


The Division of Banking and Securities is recruiting for a Program Coordinator 1 located in Juneau!

What you will be doing:
The Program Coordinator 1 is responsible for overseeing the daily and ongoing operations of all licensing and registration programs for the Division of Banking and Securities (DBS) and supervises a team of five on the licensing team.

The Program Coordinator 1 coordinates and carries out program activities and functions and develops effective and efficient licensing policies and is supervised by the Division Operations Manager.
  • Assists with developing and implementing program procedures and practices and the methods and standards to guide and train program staff.
  • This position is responsible for supervising, coordinating, and overseeing the daily operations of the state-wide financial licensing and registration programs, each with its own unique licensing and registration requirements. This includes banking, securities, money transmission, mortgage, and small loan companies.
  • As necessary, work with division management team and supervisor on special projects and assignments supporting legislation, statewide initiatives, development of division resources, and other needs.
  • The position requires extensive technical knowledge regarding complex subject matters and must display familiarity with federal laws, state statutes, regulations, policy, and program procedures.
  • The Program Coordinator 1 is responsible for handling the section’s initial investigations of unlicensed activity and collaborates with the Division Operations Manager, Chief of Enforcement and/or Director on actions to be taken. This includes research and detailed explanations to justify a request to deny or abandon a license application. This position will draft investigation reports, take action to deny or abandon a license application with management approval, answer legal questions, request disciplinary actions, offer guidance on other division cases, multi-state cases, testify in administrative hearings, and work with other state and federal agencies to bring cases to a successful conclusion and support compliance.

Our organization, mission and culture:

The Division of Banking and Securities' mission is to protect consumers of financial services and promote safe and sound financial systems. The Division’s most important functions are protecting consumers and ensuring that Alaska’s financial industry is safe and sound.

The benefits of joining our team:
The Division has a professional and dedicated staff who work well independently, and as part of a team. The Division offers training opportunities to enhance knowledge of changing rules and regulations governing regulated entities.

This position may be eligible for teleworking, an alternative work schedule, and travel for training in the lower 48.

The Division offers a comprehensive employee benefits package that includes health insurance, retirement, and paid holidays.

The working environment you can expect:
The position is located in Juneau, Alaska, and will supervise a team of five individuals. The incumbent will have a spacious cubical on the 9th floor of the State Office Building (SOB) with a beautiful view of the mountains and a parking pass for the covered parking garage off Willoughby Avenue.

Who we are looking for:
  • Accountability: Holds self and others accountable for measurable high-quality, timely, and cost effective results. Determines objectives, sets priorities, and delegates work. Accepts responsibility for own actions and decisions. Complies with established control systems and rules.
  • Decision Making: Makes sound, well-informed, and objective decisions; perceives the impact and implications of decisions; commits to action, even in uncertain situations, to accomplish organizational goals; causes change.
  • Planning and Evaluating: Organizes work, sets priorities, and determines resource requirements; determines short- or long-term goals and strategies to achieve them; coordinates with other organizations or parts of the organization to accomplish goals; monitors progress and evaluates outcomes.
  • Program Oversight: Plans, coordinates, and monitors programs to ensure that federal, state, and/or local government program requirements and plans are met, providing professional consultation on the specialized services of the program or associated project(s).
  • Supervision: Plans, distributes, and monitors work assignments; sets task priorities; evaluates work performance and provides feedback to others on their performance; ensures that staff are appropriately selected, utilized, and developed, and that they are treated in a fair and equitable manner. Assignments include the authority and responsibility to recommend or independently take action to employ (i.e., appoint, transfer, promote), discipline or discharge, or adjudicate grievances of direct reports.

Minimum Qualifications

Any combination of education and/or experience that provides the applicant with competencies in

  • Analytical Thinking/Problem Solving: uses a logical, systematic, sequential approach to address problems or opportunities or manage a situation by drawing on one’s knowledge and experience base and calling on other references and resources as necessary.
  • Compliance: Knowledge of procedures for assessing, evaluating, and monitoring programs or projects for compliance with Federal laws, regulations, and guidance.
  • Decision Making: Makes sound, well-informed, and objective decisions; perceives the impact and implications of decisions; commits to action, even in uncertain situations, to accomplish organizational goals; causes change.
  • Planning and Evaluating: Organizes work, sets priorities, and determines resource requirements; determines short- or long-term goals and strategies to achieve them; coordinates with other organizations or parts of the organization to accomplish goals; monitors progress and evaluates outcomes.

Equivalent to those typically gained by:

Training from an accredited college or university in any field and/or progressively responsible experience assisting with planning, coordinating, and implementing administrative controls, work processes, and/or procedures for a program, project, business, or organization.

Special Note:

“Competencies” means a combination of interrelated knowledge, skills, abilities, and behaviors that enable a person to act effectively in a job or situation.


“Typically gained by” means the prevalent, usual method of gaining the competencies expected for entry into the job.


“Training” and “education” are synonyms for the process of acquiring knowledge and skills through instruction. It includes instruction through formal and informal methods (such as classroom, on-line, self-study, and on-the-job), from accredited and unaccredited sources, and long-duration (such as a post-secondary degree) and short-duration (such as a seminar) programs.

“Progressively responsible” means indicating growth and/or advancement in complexity, difficulty, or level of responsibility.

Additional Required Information

At time of interview applicants are requested to submit:

  • A professional cover letter, completed per the instructions below.

  • Copies of your most recent three (3) evaluations (or you can bring them to the interview if selected); and

  • Three (3) professional references who have supervisory responsibility over you and their daytime contact phone numbers (or you can bring them to the interview if selected).

EDUCATION
If post-secondary education is required to meet the minimum qualifications, you must fill in the Education section of the application. If you have not obtained a degree, please indicate the number of units completed. Copies of transcripts are required to verify educational credentials if used to meet the minimum qualifications for a position. Transcripts can be attached at the time of application or provided at the time of interview.

WORK EXPERIENCE
If using work experience not already documented in your application, also provide the employer name, your job title, dates of employment, and whether full-or part-time. Applications will be reviewed to determine if the responses are supported and minimum qualifications are clearly met. If they are not, the applicant may not advance to the interview and selection phase of the recruitment.

MULTIPLE VACANCIES
This recruitment may be used for more than one (1) vacancy. The applicant pool acquired during this recruitment may be used for future vacancies for up to ninety (90) days after this recruitment closes. Interested applicants are encouraged to apply to each recruitment notice to ensure consideration for all vacancies.

If you choose to be contacted by email, please ensure your email address is correct on your application and that the spam filter will permit email from the 'govermentjobs.com' domains. title: Clinical Workflow Lead, Radiology
description:
MANTECH seeks a motivated, career and customer-oriented Clinical Workflow Lead, Radiology to join our team. This role offers remote flexibility, with the potential for either a hybrid or fully remote arrangement depending on final operational needs, alongside periodic travel for key meetings and projects.


The Clinical Workflow Lead, Radiology will own the end-to-end radiology diagnostic workflow, align National Teleradiology Program (NTP) operations, optimize worklists, and ensure seamless radiology informatics integration across enterprise systems.


Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Lead the operational optimization and technical alignment of diagnostic radiology workflows, worklists, reporting, and peer learning tools across enterprise health environments.

  • Direct the integration of National Teleradiology Program (NTP) workflows with local facility operations to support multi-site reading models and teleradiology fit.

  • Collaborate directly with radiologists, clinical leadership, and imaging stakeholders to drive engagement, establish workflow standards, and maintain clinical credibility.

  • Ensure seamless workflow-to-architecture alignment between Picture Archiving and Communication Systems (PACS), Radiology Information Systems (RIS), enterprise viewers, and reporting systems in coordination with enterprise architects.

  • Oversee specialized imaging workflows, Quality Assurance (QA) frameworks, and compliance for subspecialties including mammography and nuclear medicine.

  • Partner with deployment and transition teams during site cutovers to manage operational change, validate reading workflows, and resolve clinical escalations.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in healthcare or technical discipline with 10+ years of relevant work experience, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience.

  • Experience in radiology workflow optimization and PACS/RIS implementation within enterprise healthcare environments or regional health networks.

  • Experience with national or multi-facility reading models, teleradiology workflow integration, and NTP operational alignment.

  • Background in clinical radiology operations with technical familiarity across PACS, RIS, speech recognition, and reporting integration.

  • Experience supporting specialized imaging workflows, including mammography and nuclear medicine standards and QA processes.

  • Track record of direct engagement with radiologist stakeholders, clinical leads, and multidisciplinary healthcare teams.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Certified Imaging Informatics Professional (CIIP) certification or related credentials.

  • American Registry of Radiologic Technologists (ARRT) credential or clinical radiology background.

  • Experience supporting federal healthcare systems (e.g., Department of Veterans Affairs, Defense Health Agency), enterprise Veterans Health Information Systems and Technology Architecture (VistA) Imaging, or national VA Enterprise Cloud (VAEC) clinical platforms.

  • Master's degree in Health Informatics, Healthcare Administration, or a related discipline.

Clearance Requirements:

  • U.S. Citizenship is required.

  • Must be able to obtain and maintain a Department of Veterans Affairs Moderate Risk Background Investigation (BI) or Public Trust clearance.

Physical Requirements:

  • Must be able to remain in a stationary position 50% of the time.

  • Needs to occasionally move about inside the office and clinical facilities to engage with radiology staff and leadership.

  • Frequently communicates with co-workers, management, and clinical customer stakeholders, which may involve delivering technical briefings; must be able to exchange accurate information in these situations.

Job Description:

Sr. Database Administrator

General Dynamics Information Technology, the premier provider of high-tech IT solutions to the government IT market, delivers cost-effective, next-generation IT solutions and services to the Department of Defense, the intelligence community, and federal civilian agencies.

We are seeking an exceptional Sr. Database Administrator to join our highly functioning team of analysts, designers, and developers to deliver outstanding results for our customers. This is an opportunity to impact the future of the United States Federal Courts and officers in the field through your innovation and creativity. Combine your knowledge, talent and skills with state-of-the-art tools and technology to provide users with the most superior experience in class.

If you are a Sr. Database Administrator with a strong background in large scale, complex applications, and Extensible Markup Language (XML) processing, we want you to join our team at US Courts in Washington DC. Become a critical part of GDIT’s team to support the Administrative Office of the U.S. Courts (AO) Product Development Office (PDO) suite of computer and automated software applications. PDO supports a broad range of complex business systems which are instrumental to the AO mission.

The Sr. Database Administrator will execute the following responsibilities:

  • Provide support for discovery and source assessment, schema design, data mapping, migration development, transition and cut over planning, production execution and maintenance.
  • Inventory, catalog, and analyze all Extensible Markup Language (XML) data sources, including schemas, Document Type Definitions (DTDs), and XML Schema Definitions (XSDs).
  • Provide a comprehensive Discovery and Assessment Report that catalogs source structures, update frequencies, XSD/DTD constraints, and discovered data anomalies.
  • Plan and implement a repeatable data migration strategy of XML data into a normalized relational database schema.
  • Design a normalized relational schema and map XML hierarchies to tables, keys, and indexes. Establish parent-child relationships and junction tables for many-to-many relationships.
  • Provide an Entity-Relationship Diagram (ERD) and a Data Dictionary detailing the target relational database structure and mappings.
  • Develop Extract, Transform, and Load (ETL) routines utilizing database-native SQL (such as T-SQL) embedded with XPath/XQuery expressions, or language-specific XML parsers.
  • Create and maintain an audit log of migrated and unmigrated records for each data source.
  • Track dates of repeated migrations and updates for identical records. Conduct unit tests for data verification and reconciliation.
  • Generate and deliver Migration Scripts and Pipeline Source Code with built-in audit logging capability and automated verification checks.
  • Plan and execute the production migration using a fully documented Runbook and Rollback. Migration plan containing detailed step-by-step instructions and time-to-complete estimates. Complete verification and reconciliation check to guarantee data migration completeness and accuracy.
  • Provide the Maintenance and Migration Interval plans for ongoing migrations (daily, on-demand, or at record update). Detail the necessary processes to support continuous updates of scripts and data schemas over time.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • 7+ years experience in Server database maintenance and database administration or similar role.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field. Also, experience may be considered in lieu of degree.
  • Strong SQL proficiency in SQL query development, data modeling, schema optimization, and preliminary data analysis based on business/customer requirements.
  • Hands-on experience installing, configuring, administering and troubleshooting relational databases, including backup and recovery operations.
  • Proven track record in performance tuning, implementing database security protocols, managing access controls, automating routine tasks, and handing SSL certification installation.
  • Experience in leading technical projects, managing deliverables, and providing technical support or training to team members.
  • Proficient in working with complex XML schemas and hierarchical data structures including XPath and XQuery.
  • Proven experience in designing and implementing reliable SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS) workflows that incorporate robust error handling, logging, data validation, transformations, and performance optimization.
  • Experience with SQL Server XML data types and capabilities, including storing, querying, parsing, transforming, and validating XML using XPath and XQuery.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Entity Framework (EF) / Entity Framework Core (EF Core) and understanding of how LINQ expressions translate into SQL.
  • Experience communicating and collaborating with developers, testers, systems engineer, DBAs, scrum masters, business owners and management.
  • Familiarity with the Agile principles and methodology, SAFe Framework.
  • IBM Database certification is optional.

OPTIONAL

O profissional atuará no gerenciamento do fluxo de aprovação entre demandantes internos e agências parceiras, garantindo a cadência dos cronogramas e a aderência aos guias da marca.

What knowledge and experiences will you need to bring to share with our network?

  • Gerenciar o cronograma de ponta a ponta, acompanhando o fluxo de produção junto a clientes internos (solicitantes/demandantes) e agências parceiras, assegurando entregas nos prazos estabelecidos.

  • Avaliar e propor constantemente otimizações nas réguas existentes, identificando oportunidades de adaptação, automação de conteúdo e melhoria contínua dos processos da área.

  • Promover e participar de escutas ativas e visitas a campo para compreender a rotina das consultoras e identificar novas oportunidades de engajamento e de negócios.

  • Documentar fluxos, padronizar informações da área, responder e sanar dúvidas de conteúdo e realizar levantamentos de materiais sempre que solicitado.

Quais os requisitos?

  • Graduação completa, preferencialmente nas áreas de Comunicação Social, Jornalismo, Publicidade e Propaganda, Relações Públicas, Marketing ou correlatas.

  • Experiência prévia em comunicação corporativa, comunicação de marketing ou criação de conteúdo focado em engajamento e vendas.

  • Conhecimento e vivência com estratégias e fluxos de CRM (réguas de relacionamento, jornadas de comunicação e canais proprietários).

  • Domínio da norma culta da língua portuguesa, com excelente capacidade de redação, adaptação de tom de voz e visão comercial de texto.

title: Capital Project Manager
description:
Capital Project Manager
$53,700 - $89,400 per year, full-time permanent, generous benefits package

Are you ready to turn ambitious ideas into exceptional visitor experiences? Are you an experienced project leader who can navigate construction sites, stakeholder expectations, operational constraints, and strategic priorities? Can you bring together diverse teams, navigate complexity, and deliver results on time and on budget?

At Science North, we are guided by our North Star values of Respect, Curiosity, Accountability, Innovation, and Empathy. Our Exhibits & Projects team creates inspiring experiences and spaces that engage people with science in the world around them.

As a Capital Project Manager, you will lead the planning and delivery of visitor experience renewal projects across Science North, such as science centre galleries, multimedia theatres and travelling exhibitions. Working closely with internal teams, consultants, contractors, funders, and community partners, you will manage projects through their full lifecycle, from business case and design development through procurement, construction, commissioning, and project closeout.

This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced professional who enjoys bringing people together, solving complex challenges, and delivering projects that have a lasting impact on our community.

In this role you will:

Lead capital projects to create unique and engaging exhibitions and experiences – from concept development through design, procurement, construction, commissioning, and closure
Develop and manage project scope, budgets, schedules, forecasts, risk, and reporting
Build strong relationships with project stakeholders, funders, sponsors, rightsholders, and community partners
Work collaboratively with internal Science North teams such as STEM engagement, marketing, graphic design, technical services, and facilities
Coordinate external consultants such as exhibit designers, architects, engineers, and graphic designers
Coordinate exhibit fabricators and construction contractors, including representing Science North during construction activities, site reviews, commissioning, and occupancy planning
Oversee procurement processes, contract administration, change management, and project documentation
Prepare project reports, presentations, and recommendations for leadership, governance committees, and funding partners
Champion health and safety and support Science North best practices for accessibility, sustainability, equity, diversity, inclusion, and reconciliation throughout project delivery
Support the continuous improvement of project management practices, standards, and tools across the organization

Qualifications:

Degree or diploma in Project Management, Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management, or a related discipline
2-6 years of experience managing projects through planning, design, procurement, construction, and occupancy
Genuine curiosity and interest in the Science North visitor experience and high-quality exhibit development
Excellent communication, negotiation, relationship-building, and facilitation skills
Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and sound professional judgment
Knowledge of project budgeting, forecasting, scheduling, contract administration, procurement, and risk management
Ability to read and interpret design and construction drawings, specifications, and contracts.
Proficiency with Microsoft 365 and project management tools

Assets:

PMP, CAPM certification or actively pursuing this designation
Experience working in a science centre, museum, or cultural/tourism institution and/or developing exhibitions for the general public
Knowledge of building codes, Occupational Health & Safety Act, and AODA
Familiarity with grant reporting and public procurement processes

Compensation Highlights:

Full-time permanent opportunity
Competitive salary starting at $53,700 to $89,400 per year
Annual performance and merit increase consideration
Participation in the Science North Employee Incentive Plan
Flexible work arrangements
Comprehensive group benefit package including medical, dental, vision, paramedical, life/travel insurance, short and long-term disability coverage, 24/7 telemedicine access, wellness spending account/ onsite physio/chiro services
Pension plan following one year
Science North annual family membership
Onsite gym
Free or discounted admission to other attractions outside Sudbury, Science North facilities and program discounts, fitness membership contribution, on-site parking
Professional development opportunities
Minimum 4 weeks vacation with incremental entitlements of one week after 5 and 10 yrs of service
Free onsite parking

Don’t meet every single requirement? At Science North, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Apply online at http://sciencenorth.ca/careers. An early application represents your best opportunity for consideration. Science North is committed to an inclusive workplace and invites applications from all qualified individuals to join our diverse team. Accommodations are available upon request in all aspects of Science North’s selection process. We thank all interested candidates; only those selected for interviews will be contacted.

Science North is grateful to work with First Nations across Northern Ontario and we give thanks to the Indigenous Peoples who have cared for this land since time immemorial. We pay respect to their traditions, ways of knowing, and acknowledge their many contributions to innovations in Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics, past and present. We also recognize the Métis Nation of Ontario for their historic and ongoing contributions. Science North commits to deepening engagement, relationships and partnerships in order to advance truth and reconciliation, honour and reflect Indigenous ways of knowing, grow economic opportunities, and collaborate with Indigenous peoples as partners in order to inspire all people to be engaged with science in the world around them.

Science North is a registered charity and is an agency of the Government of Ontario

title: Social Listening Analyst Burson Colombia
description:
Who we are:

Burson, part of WPP, is the global communications leader built to create value for clients through reputation. For more information visit and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

Quiénes somos:

Burson es la agencia global líder en comunicación, diseñada para generar valor para los clientes a través de la reputación. Con equipos altamente especializados, tecnologías líderes en la industria y una creatividad innovadora, ayudamos a marcas y empresas a redefinir la reputación como ventaja competitiva para que puedan liderar hoy y en el futuro. Trabajar en Burson es formar parte de una comunidad global de profesionales comprometidos con el aprendizaje continuo y con liderar el cambio innovador.

Burson forma parte de WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP), un referente mundial en transformación creativa. Para más información, visite y síganos en LinkedIn e Instagram.

Más información sobre el puesto:

Este rol está orientado a un especialista responsable del monitoreo continuo de conversación pública y señales reputacionales para clientes de mercados internacionales. Durante el turno nocturno, deberá dar seguimiento en tiempo real a menciones relevantes, identificar narrativas emergentes, diferenciar señales críticas de ruido operativo y escalar oportunamente al equipo cualquier hallazgo que requiera atención inmediata del cliente.

Trabajo 100% remoto desde Bogotá, con exposición directa a marcas globales y a un equipo internacional desde el primer mes.

Requisito indispensable: Disponibilidad para trabajar en horario nocturno y fines de semana.

PERFIL QUE BUSCAMOS

Formación:

  • Profesional o estudiante de últimos semestres en Comunicación Social, Periodismo, Ciencia Política, Publicidad, Relaciones Internacionales o afines.
  • Se valora formación complementaria en analítica de datos, social listening o investigación de opinión pública.

Experiencia:

  • 6 meses a 1 año en monitoreo de medios, social listening, análisis de opinión pública, community management, sala de redacción digital o consultoría de comunicaciones.
  • Experiencia comprobable operando software de social listening como Brandwatch, Talkwalker o Sprinklr.

Conocimientos técnicos:

  • Excel y Google Sheets.
  • Conocimiento de queries booleanas.
  • Deseable: Looker Studio o Power BI para visualización básica.

Condiciones indispensables:

  • Disponibilidad real y sostenida para trabajar en turno nocturno, incluyendo fines de semana en rotación.

COMPETENCIAS CLAVE:

  • Identificación de narrativas: capacidad para interpretar el desarrollo de conversaciones públicas y reconocer patrones discursivos más allá de menciones aisladas.
  • Clasificación rigurosa: criterio consistente para etiquetar menciones bajo los mismos parámetros de análisis a lo largo del tiempo.
  • Criterio editorial: habilidad para evaluar la relevancia de una publicación según su contexto, alcance potencial, actores involucrados y posible impacto reputacional.

Actividades que desempeñarás:

  • Monitoreo en tiempo real:

    • Vigilar de forma continua menciones de marca, competencia y temas sensibles en redes sociales, medios digitales, foros y comunidades durante el turno asignado.
    • Aplicar los criterios de severidad definidos por cliente para clasificar cada mención (informativa, de atención, crítica).
    • Detectar narrativas emergentes: no solo el volumen, sino el marco desde el cual se está hablando de la marca y quién lo está impulsando.
    • Identificar patrones anómalos de crecimiento en volumen o cambios de sentimiento que puedan anticipar una crisis.

    Alertas y escalamiento:

    • Reportar alertas críticas al equipo en inglés, siguiendo el protocolo de escalamiento y dentro de los SLA acordados.
    • Redactar alertas claras y accionables: qué pasó, dónde, desde cuándo, cuál es la magnitud, quién lo está amplificando y qué está pasando ahora.
    • Mantener registro trazable de cada alerta emitida, su clasificación y su resolución.

    Clasificación y estructuración de datos:

    • Etiquetar y categorizar menciones de forma consistente según las taxonomías de cada cliente.
    • Garantizar limpieza y consistencia de los datos que alimentan dashboards y reportes posteriores.

    Reportería:

    • Elaborar el resumen de cierre de turno (end-of-shift wrap-up) con hallazgos, alertas emitidas y temas a observar en el siguiente turno.
    Aportar el contexto cualitativo que los dashboards no capturan: tono, actores relevantes, subtexto político o cultural

title: Business Analyst
description:
The Role


As a Business Analyst at Amplify, you will help translate business and product requirements into clear, actionable specifications that the Creatorverse team can confidently build and deliver.


You will be a key member of the Creatorverse team, working closely with Product, Experience Design, and Engineering. Your role will focus on ensuring that requirements are clearly documented, properly broken down, and ready for development. This includes writing clear acceptance criteria, breaking down complex requirements into manageable user stories, and making sure that all necessary information is available before work moves into development.


This role requires strong attention to detail, curiosity, persistence, and excellent written communication. You should be comfortable asking questions, challenging unclear requirements, and working collaboratively with different teams to make sure everyone is aligned.


This is a focused contract engagement with a defined objective: to bring the existing backlog to a standard where Engineering can confidently build without needing to make assumptions, while also keeping the requirements pipeline sufficiently ahead of development.


Key Responsibilities


Acceptance Criteria

  • Write clear, specific, and testable acceptance criteria that allow QA to create and execute test cases without needing additional clarification.
  • Ensure requirements meet the team's Definition of Ready, including clearly defined objectives, testable criteria, linked designs, and identified dependencies.
  • Review and work through backlog items based on priority and the agreed execution sequence.
  • Ensure requirements are complete and sufficiently detailed before they are handed over to Engineering.

Requirement Decomposition

  • Break down complex requirements into clear, manageable, and development-ready user stories.
  • Ensure stories are logically structured and follow the appropriate dependencies and sequence.
  • Refine existing or in-progress requirements while maintaining the original scope and avoiding duplicated or unnecessary work.
  • Review requirements against delivered features to ensure previously completed work is not unnecessarily recreated or duplicated.

Backlog Management & Traceability

  • Ensure each ticket is properly linked to the relevant documentation, requirement, or source of truth.
  • Identify and flag tickets that do not have clear documentation or context.
  • Review stalled, inactive, or incorrectly tagged tasks and work with the appropriate stakeholders to determine the next steps.
  • Follow up on outstanding questions and ensure they result in either a clear decision, assigned owner, or agreed deadline.
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and up-to-date backlog.

Forward Planning & Requirements Pipeline

  • Support the Product and Engineering teams in preparing requirements for upcoming release cycles.
  • Ensure requirements are sufficiently ahead of development to minimize delays caused by incomplete specifications.
  • Progress requirements from early drafts or incomplete states through to full build-readiness.
  • Facilitate reviews with Design and Engineering leads to address questions, incorporate feedback, and secure alignment before development begins.

Analysis & Collaboration

  • Review requirements critically to identify missing scenarios, error states, permissions, dependencies, and potential edge cases.
  • Ask thoughtful questions to understand the purpose and rationale behind requested features.
  • Ensure features are grounded in clear user or business needs rather than assumptions or preferences.
  • Identify ambiguities and gaps in requirements and proactively raise them with the appropriate stakeholders.
  • Work collaboratively with senior stakeholders, Product, Design, Engineering, and QA to reach clear and practical solutions.

Handover

  • Provide a comprehensive handover at the end of the engagement.
  • Document relevant templates, processes, project conventions, and other information required to ensure continuity.
  • Ensure the team has the necessary documentation and context to maintain the backlog and requirements process moving forward.


Qualifications & Experience

  • Educational Background: Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Professional Experience: 2–4 years of experience working directly with software/product delivery requirements. Experience should involve requirements gathering, documentation, user stories, acceptance criteria, and working closely with Product or Engineering teams. General business analysis, financial analysis, or reporting-only experience will not be considered sufficient.
  • Acceptance Criteria: Demonstrated experience writing clear Given/When/Then acceptance criteria that QA or Engineering teams can use without ambiguity. Candidates should be prepared to provide examples.
  • Requirement Decomposition: Experience breaking down complex requirements or specifications into clear, manageable user stories based on logical dependencies.
  • Analytical & Critical Thinking: Strong ability to review requirements, identify missing information or scenarios, and proactively raise potential issues.
  • Tools: Strong working knowledge of Jira, Linear, Notion, or similar project management and documentation tools. Experience with Notion is an advantage, as our internal workflows are primarily Notion-based.
  • Communication: Confident communicator who is comfortable asking questions, clarifying requirements, and respectfully challenging assumptions when needed.
  • Written English: Excellent written English, with the ability to create clear and detailed documentation that can serve as a reference for Engineering and QA.
  • Availability & Location: Based in the Philippines, with a 14–21 day availability/start lead time and the ability to maintain consistent daily working-hour overlap with the Sydney team.
  • Contract: This is a fixed-term contract focused primarily on backlog clearance and requirements readiness. While an extension is not guaranteed, future opportunities may be discussed based on business requirements.


Preferred Skills


The following are advantageous but not required:

  • Industry Experience: Exposure to influencer marketing, creator economy, AdTech, MarTech, or digital advertising.
  • Marketplace Experience: Experience working with two-sided platforms where the end user and paying customer are different user groups.
  • Agile Experience: Practical experience working in Agile environments, particularly within teams that are improving or evolving their delivery processes.
  • Technical Understanding: Familiarity with data relationships, entity mapping, user roles, permissions, or other complex product/technical concepts.
  • Remote Collaboration: Experience working effectively with distributed teams across different countries and time zones.


Life at Amplify

We move fast, back big ideas, and hold ourselves to high standards, all while keeping things down-to-earth, kind, and genuinely collaborative. Amplify is an energetic home for curious minds and bold thinkers who want true ownership over their work. We give sharp, ambitious people the freedom, clarity, and backing to craft a standout career and see the direct impact of their work on a global scale.

What You’ll Enjoy

  • Big Impact: Work directly with premier creators and iconic global powerhouse brands on campaigns that define modern culture.
  • Uncapped Trajectory: Build your career with total ownership, backed by clear, structured progression pathways to help you grow rapidly.
  • Flexible Rhythm: Strike the right balance with a hybrid model, including one day a week to work from home.
  • Time to Celebrate: Take a fully paid day off on your birthday to reset and celebrate you.
  • Family Backing: Access up to 12 weeks of Paid Parental Leave to support you and your growing family.
  • Holistic Support: Prioritise your well-being with dedicated, confidential EAP services designed to keep you feeling supported inside and outside of work.
  • Social & Connection: We celebrate everyone’s contributions and reward the team with regular events, lunches, and overseas company offsites to keep us connected.

title: Onsite Data Center Inventory Specialist
description:
At Jabil (NYSE: JBL), we are proud to be a trusted partner for the world's top brands, offering comprehensive engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing solutions. With 60 years of experience across industries and a vast network of over 100 sites worldwide, Jabil combines global reach with local expertise to deliver both scalable and customized solutions. Our commitment extends beyond business success as we strive to build sustainable processes that minimize environmental impact and foster vibrant and diverse communities around the globe.

Location/Division Specific Information: Mt. Pleasant, WI

How will you make an impact?

The Data Center Inventory & Warranty Operations Specialist is responsible for onsite spare parts receiving, material put away, storage cage control, customer ticket support, technician material handoff, defective material processing, and outbound shipping coordination within a data center environment.

This role maintains accurate inventory records in SAP and supporting systems, supports part availability and retrieval during working hours, and ensures defective parts are inspected, documented, packaged, shipped, and tracked through the required handoff process.

What will you do?

• Receive inbound shipments of material at the data center and verify condition, quantity, and shipment details.

Unbox material and put away all parts in the designated storage cage or assigned cage location.

Update SAP with inbound material receipts and applicable inventory transactions.

Manage customer tickets during working hours, including part requests, status updates, and fulfillment coordination.

Retrieve, stage, and hand off material to technicians as needed.

Update and track all applicable transactions in SAP, ServiceNow, inventory control tools, RFID / barcode systems, or related tracking files. Inspect defective material returned by technicians and validate part condition, part number, and applicable serial number information.

Update the system and RFI tag with defective part information, including serial number when applicable.

Prepare defective or return material for shipping by boxing, taping, placing on pallet, and printing / applying shipping labels.

Hand off prepared shipment to the courier or carrier.

Pass tracking information to the Austin Inventory Specialist so SAP, RMA, RTV, and shipment tracking activities can be completed.

How will you get here?

Education:

  • High school diploma or GED required; associate degree in supply chain, logistics, operations, information technology, or related field preferred.

Experience:

  • Experience in inventory control, warehouse operations, logistics, data center operations, hardware support, or service operations preferred.

  • Working knowledge of receiving, put away, inventory tracking, shipping preparation, and courier handoff processes.

  • Experience with SAP, ServiceNow, inventory tracking tools, barcode tools, RFID systems, or similar systems preferred.

  • Ability to follow work instructions and maintain accurate transaction records.

  • Ability to work onsite during assigned business hours and support customer ticket activity.

Preferred Qualifications:
• A good materials and manufacturing process knowledge.
• Be computer literate.
• Good knowledge of SAP.
• A high attention to detail.
• Or an equivalent combination of education, training or experience


WORKING CONDITIONS

• Regular business hours. Some additional hours may be required.

What Can Jabil Offer You?

Along with growth, stability, and the opportunity to be challenged, Jabil offers a competitive benefits package that includes:

  • Medical, Dental, Prescription Drug, and Vision Insurance with HRA and HSA options

  • 401K Match

  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan

title: Patient Experience Specialist I
description:
About CLS Health

CLS Health is a growing healthcare system in Houston, Texas that is taking a different approach to healthcare. We are a physician-led healthcare group that focuses on providing patients with holistic, multispecialty care. We're a dynamic team on a mission to provide better healthcare options for Houstonians!


Job Summary:

The Patient Experience Specialist plays a critical role in managing, investigating, and resolving patient complaints while identifying system-wide opportunities to improve service delivery and patient satisfaction. This role requires strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and extensive cross-departmental collaboration.


The Specialist is responsible for accurately logging, reviewing, researching, escalating, and closing patient concerns while ensuring appropriate documentation, follow-up, and reporting. The role also contributes to audits, trend analysis, and improvement initiatives that strengthen the overall patient experience across CLS Health.



Key Responsibilities:


  • Accurately document all new complaints in the Excel-based tracking system, ensuring complete and correct patient identification, often requiring additional investigation when information is incomplete or inaccurate.
  • Manage high complaint volumes efficiently while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Careful analysis of complaint details and patient feedback.
  • Retrieval and review of all relevant documentation
  • Listening to and reviewing multiple call recordings when necessary to fully understand patient concerns.
  • Comparing patient feedback with documented information to identify gaps, discrepancies, or process failures.
  • Determine whether patient concerns have already been resolved prior to escalation.
  • When unresolved, prepare and send detailed, well-documented communications to Clinic Leads and Operations Managers outlining the concern, findings, and required actions.
  • Perform consistent follow-up with unresponsive stakeholders and escalate appropriately to ensure closure and accountability.
  • Coordinate resolution across multiple departments when complaints span clinical, operational, or administrative areas.
  • Conduct in-depth reviews that uncover systemic or recurring issues impacting patient experience.
  • Identify issues such as incorrect contact information, unmonitored voicemail boxes, or unclear call ownership and collaborate with Marketing, IT, and clinic teams to implement solutions.
  • Perform call audits and service reviews (e.g., auditing 25+ VMAs within defined timeframes).
  • Prepare summaries, findings, and corrective recommendations for leadership.
  • Track low Net Promoter Score (NPS) trends and recurring complaint themes.
  • Provide insights and data to leadership to support informed decision-making and performance improvement initiatives.
  • Travel to other CLS Health locations as needed.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

title: Sr. Client Partner, Pinterest Spark
description:
About Pinterest:

Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.

Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.

At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.

Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here.

Pinterest Spark — because stepping away shouldn't mean falling behind

At Pinterest, our mission is to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love — and that starts with our own people. Life's biggest moments shouldn't come at the cost of the career you've built.

That's why we created Pinterest Spark.

What it is. Spark is a dedicated team of tenured Client Partners and Client Account Managers who step in to look after a colleague's clients and business while they're on a leave of absence. They safeguard relationships and revenue, keep the work moving, and hand back a healthy, thriving book when our teammate returns.

What it means for you. When you take a leave, you can be fully present for what matters — knowing your clients are in expert hands and there's a strong business to come back to, providing the confidence to step away, and the momentum to step back in.

Because creating a life you love means being able to step away — and Spark keeps your business thriving while you do.

Pinterest's Spark program is a full-time staffing model purpose-built to ensure uninterrupted client service and consistent business performance during periods of extended employee leave, including parental and medical absences. Each engagement offers genuine ownership of high-value client relationships, hands-on expertise across Pinterest's full-funnel advertising solutions, and direct contribution to the North America Enterprise organization. Hires join Pinterest as regular, full-time employees, fully embedded within their teams and client portfolios from day one, with assignments typically scoped for approximately 6 months and subject to extension based on business needs.

As a Client Partner at Pinterest, you will serve as a strategic visionary, cultivating trusted relationships with top-tier clients through your deep expertise in full-funnel sales. By leveraging your nuanced understanding of client businesses, you will independently engage assigned customer accounts to promote Pinterest products effectively. Your primary responsibilities include meeting performance targets, developing new business, maintaining and expanding customer relationships, and resolving specific customer issues. By guiding clients’ efforts, you'll drive value for millions of Pinners seeking inspiration and action, forming strategic alliances both internally and externally. Success in this role depends on your ability to drive substantial revenue growth and spearhead a vision for long-term client success in a collaborative, dynamic environment.

What you'll do:

  • Retain and grow partner relationships, ultimately driving Pinterest revenue.
  • Build strong relationships with clients, agencies, C-suite, and key stakeholders both internally and externally.
  • Demonstrate leadership and a deep understanding of client business goals and industry trends.
  • Develop tailored media strategies to drive adoption of Pinterest ads.
  • Position Pinterest as a key platform by highlighting ad performance and impact.
  • Identify and communicate new growth opportunities to expand client partnerships.

What we are looking for:

  • Proven experience building long-term partnerships and successful negotiations.
  • Performance based ad sales background (lower funnel experience), turning data into actionable next steps is preferred.
  • Experience working with executive-level business and marketing leaders.
  • Analytical thinker, skilled at turning data and trends into clear strategies for growth.
  • Track record of meeting revenue goals and fostering ongoing partnership growth.
  • Success working in fast-paced, collaborative, and high-performance environments.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Digital Media, SaaS Sales, or related field, or equivalent experience.
  • AI Enthusiast: Demonstrates a strong curiosity for and practical application of AI to improve productivity, streamline workflows, and elevate client communications, presentations, and recommendations. Uses AI thoughtfully across account strategy and sales motions to uncover insights, sharpen strategic narratives, and show up as a strong, trusted advisor while maintaining sound judgment and a high bar for quality.

In-Office Requirement Statement:

  • We let the type of work you do guide the collaboration style. That means we're not always working in an office, but we continue to gather for key moments of collaboration and connection.
  • This role will need to travel for quarterly team on-sites and client engagements as needed.

title: Principal AI Engineer
description:

title: Tournament Coordinator EMEA (m/f/x)
description:
• Are you passionate about esports and enjoy turning complex tournament plans into well-executed live events?

  • Do you enjoy coordinating people, systems and deadlines to deliver tournaments successfully?

  • Are you confident managing operational risks, solving problems under pressure and keeping stakeholders aligned?

  • Do you take ownership of projects and enjoy seeing them through from initial planning to live delivery?

  • Do you want to play a key role in delivering high-quality tournament experiences for teams, partners and fans?

If the answers to the above questions are yes, then this role could be ideal for you!

GRID is looking for a Tournament Coordinator to join our Tournament Services team and take operational ownership of assigned tournaments from initial planning and design through to live delivery and post-event review.

You will be responsible for translating tournament objectives, approved designs and commercial requirements into clear, executable operational plans. You will coordinate the people, teams, systems and dependencies required to make each tournament successful, while maintaining event readiness, managing operational risks and keeping stakeholders aligned throughout the tournament lifecycle.

You will act as the primary operational point of contact for your assigned tournaments, working closely with GRID teams including Tournament Services, League Operations, Tournament Production, Partnerships, Integrity, Support and Commercial, as well as publishers, esports teams, partners and other tournament stakeholders.

The role combines tournament operations, project coordination, stakeholder management and live event delivery. You will be expected to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously, identify risks and blockers early, drive actions to completion and make sure every part of the tournament is ready for successful delivery.

What you will do

  • Before the tournament

    • Own the end-to-end operational planning, coordination and delivery of assigned GRID tournaments.

    • Coordinate tournament formats, schedules, competitive structures, invitations, registrations and operational requirements.

    • Ensure delivery remains aligned with agreed timelines, scope, budgets and quality standards.

    • Own event readiness from approved tournament design through transition into live operations.

    • Validate tournament systems, documentation, resources and operational requirements are complete before launch.

    • Maintain visibility of dependencies and escalate blockers where appropriate, driving resolutions.

    • Ensure handovers into live operations are clear, complete and actionable.

  • During the tournament

    • Coordinate tournament operations across the full tournament lifecycle, working with League Operations and other delivery teams.

    • Act as the primary operational point of contact for assigned tournaments.

    • Ensure formats, schedules, rules and operational processes are executed consistently against agreed standards.

    • Support operational decisions and stakeholder communications during live events.

  • After the tournament

    • Maintain tournament KPIs, trackers, dashboards and operational reporting.

    • Lead or support post-event operational reviews and debriefs.

What Success Looks Like

  • Assigned tournaments are delivered on time, within agreed scope, budget and quality standards.

  • League Operations, Production, Partnerships, Support and other stakeholders have everything required before live delivery.

  • Tournament formats, schedules, invitations, rulebooks and operational systems are accurate and delivered on time.

  • Operational documentation, KPIs and trackers remain complete, accurate, accessible and up to date.

  • Risks and dependencies are identified early and resolved or escalated before they impact delivery.

  • Live tournaments and operational handovers are delivered effectively, with issues resolved quickly and stakeholders kept aligned.

Nice to have

  • Previous experience in tournament operations, esports, event operations, project coordination or a similar delivery-focused role.

  • Strong understanding of tournament planning, competitive structures and live event operations.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English

  • Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to coordinate multiple workstreams, deadlines and dependencies.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively across internal teams, publishers, teams, partners and other stakeholders.

  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage complex operational information accurately.

  • Strong problem-solving, decision-making and risk-management skills, including the ability to act under pressure.

  • Ability to work independently, take accountability for outcomes and operate effectively in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

  • Strong interest in esports and a good understanding of competitive gaming ecosystems.

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment where priorities and requirements can change quickly.

title: Deputy Director/Director, Business Partnerships
description:
About GF

GlobalFoundries (GF) is a leading manufacturer of essential semiconductors, enabling AI at scale from the cloud to the physical world. Through deep partnerships with customers, GF delivers differentiated, power efficient and high-performance solutions for high growth markets. With global manufacturing operations across the U.S., Europe and Asia, GF is a trusted and holistic technology partner for customers around the world. GF’s talented, global team remains focused every day on security, longevity, and sustainability. For more information, visit .

Introduction

The senior Business Partnerships role is an elite commercial negotiator at the center of GlobalFoundries’ most consequential business opportunities. Reporting to the Head of Business Partnerships, this role leads GF’s most strategic negotiations end-to-end and transforms GF’s negotiation process into a robust, collaborative model that maximizes long-term commercial value.

The successful candidate is the architect of GF’s negotiation process—assembling the right internal expertise around each deal, aligning resources and decisions, and ensuring the organization enters every strategic negotiation as a coordinated team with a single, aligned strategy. Working in partnership with Sales, Product Lines, Legal, Finance, and Manufacturing, the individual translates cross-functional complexity into disciplined, value-maximizing commercial outcomes. This is not a support function: this senior executive owns the end-to-end negotiation process and is accountable for results.

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Lead GF negotiations end-to-end for a concentrated portfolio of strategic deals—across live meetings and document-exchange formats—from preparation and strategy through execution and close, ensuring all responses are coherent, coordinated, and strategically aligned.

  • Drive the transformation of GF’s negotiation process into a robust collaborative model, including mechanisms to manage long-term power fluctuations between GF and its counterparties.

  • Define objectives, walk-aways, trade-off logic, and sequencing in alignment with the Head of Business Partnerships and relevant stakeholders.

  • Ensure all deals are reviewed through the lens of the full organization—Manufacturing, Finance, Legal, and long-term relationship value; apply and uphold the Delegation of Authority.

  • Strengthen the economic quality of strategic negotiations by translating commercial proposals into risk-adjusted value; model trade-offs, concessions, contingencies, probability-weighted outcomes, implementation risks, and long-term enforceability before major commitments are made.

  • Challenge weak assumptions and premature concessions respectfully and evaluate whether proposed deals are robust across future power fluctuations, market cycles, capacity changes, and likely renegotiation scenarios.

  • Gather commercial interests, constraints, and red lines from Sales, Product Lines, Legal, Finance, and Manufacturing, and facilitate the internal alignment that determines GF’s external negotiating position.

  • Surface competing priorities early, frame trade-offs clearly, and ensure internal disagreements are not exported to the customer-facing table or exploited by counterparties.

  • Own a focused portfolio of counterparty relationships, building genuine trust and positioning GF’s approach as collaborative and value-creating for both sides; manage and repair relationships under pressure.

  • Design and scale negotiation playbooks, preparation frameworks, and debrief protocols; champion negotiation intelligence tools, including AI-assisted preparation, and share learnings to upskill the broader Commercial organization.

  • Ensure deal terms translate cleanly into execution, maintaining tight integration across the quote-to-cash process, and escalate unresolved internal impasses with a clear framing of trade-offs and a recommended path forward.

Other Responsibilities:

  • Perform all activities in a safe and responsible manner and support all Environmental, Health, Safety & Security requirements and programs.

  • Other duties as assigned by manager.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Engineering, Law, or a related field; a post-graduate qualification in Business, Negotiation, Conflict Resolution, or a related discipline is preferred.

  • Demonstrated excellence in collaborative negotiation, with the proven ability to move counterparties toward value-creating frameworks even under pressure and in adversarial conditions.

  • Deep command of negotiation theory, including interest-based approaches and strategies for managing power dynamics, coupled with the practical ability to apply and adapt these frameworks in real, high-stakes commercial settings.

  • A track record of outcomes that reflect both value maximization and relationship preservation.

  • 5+ years of experience in B2B commercial roles, with meaningful exposure to high-complexity negotiations, enterprise deal structuring, or strategic account management.

  • Strong quantitative reasoning: ability to model deal economics, evaluate trade-offs, and stress-test structures across multiple dimensions.

  • Superior stakeholder management across technical, legal, finance, and executive functions in a matrixed organization, including the ability to synthesize competing interests into a coherent commercial position and defend it.

  • Location: Taiwan or Singapore

Preferred Qualifications:

  • MBA or advanced degree in Negotiation, Conflict Resolution, or a related discipline.

  • Experience in semiconductor, advanced manufacturing, or high-technology industries, with an understanding of foundry economics, capacity dynamics, and product line interdependencies.

  • Deep knowledge of GF’s internal processes, stakeholder landscape, and negotiation history with key accounts, or equivalent depth in a comparable enterprise.

  • Familiarity with Deal Desk processes, order-to-cash flows, and enterprise contract structures in a B2B technology environment.

  • Exposure to value-based pricing, risk-sharing contract models, or strategic agreements.

The role will be central to evaluating, procuring, and operationalising specialised data governance tooling, including Data Loss Prevention (DLP) platforms, to give the organisation real-time visibility and control over its sensitive data estate.

Kids Planet Day Nurseries Central Support Office will be relocating to Altrincham in the coming months.

Key Responsibilities

Data Governance Framework

Develop, own, and continuously improve the Kids Planet Data Governance Framework, including data classification schemes, data dictionaries, and data quality standards.
Define and enforce policies covering data creation, storage, sharing, retention, archiving, and secure deletion across all business functions.
Establish and chair a Data Governance Working Group, bringing together representatives from operations, People, finance, and IT to embed a culture of data stewardship.
Maintain a comprehensive data asset register and ensure all critical data flows are mapped and documented.

Data Protection & GDPR Compliance

Act as the organisation’s subject matter expert for UK GDPR and the Data Protection Act 2018, providing guidance to all departments on compliant data handling.
Manage and coordinate responses to Data Subject Access Requests (DSARs), erasure requests, and other data subject rights in line with statutory timescales.
Conduct and maintain Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIAs) for new systems, processes, and third-party relationships.
Maintain and test the organisation’s data breach response procedures, coordinating with the IT Security team and, where required, the ICO.
Ensure Records of Processing Activities (RoPA) are kept accurate and up to date.

Data Loss Prevention (DLP) & Tooling

Lead the evaluation, procurement, and implementation of the organisation’s DLP platform
Define DLP policies and rules that reflect Kids Planet’s data classification framework, ensuring sensitive data – including children’s personal data – cannot leave the organisation inappropriately.
Monitor DLP dashboards and reporting, investigating alerts, identifying patterns, and driving remediation actions.
Oversee the AI data usage governance programme, ensuring that staff use of AI tools is controlled, audited, and compliant with the organisation’s acceptable use policy.
Act as the business owner for all data governance tooling, managing vendor relationships and licence renewals.

Third-Party & Supplier Data Governance

Lead the data governance aspects of supplier onboarding, ensuring Data Processing Agreements (DPAs) are in place and proportionate data-sharing controls are enforced.
Conduct periodic reviews of third-party data processors to confirm ongoing compliance with contractual and regulatory obligations.
Maintain the organisation’s supplier data risk register and escalate material risks to the CTO.

Training, Awareness & Culture

Design and deliver data governance and data protection training programmes for all staff, tailored to role-specific responsibilities
Produce clear, accessible data governance guidance materials and maintain a staff-facing knowledge base.
Champion a ‘data-responsible’ culture across Kids Planet, ensuring data is treated as a strategic asset.

Reporting & Assurance

Produce regular governance reports for the CTO and Senior Management Team covering data quality metrics, compliance status, DLP incidents, and open risks.
Support internal and external audit processes relating to data governance and data protection.
Track and report on the closure of data governance-related audit findings and recommendations.

Person Specification

Essential

Demonstrable experience in a data governance, data protection, or information management role, ideally within the education, childcare, social care, or regulated services sector.
Strong working knowledge of UK GDPR, the Data Protection Act 2018, and practical application of data subject rights processes.
Proven experience designing and implementing data governance frameworks, policies, and data classification schemes.
Experience managing DSARs, DPIAs, and Records of Processing Activities.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex governance requirements into plain-language guidance for non-specialist audiences.
Highly organised with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously.

Desirable

Professional qualifications in data protection or information governance (e.g. BCS Certificate in Data Protection, CIPM, ISEB/IAPP, GDPR Practitioner).
Practical experience evaluating or operating DLP, data discovery, or data classification platforms.
Familiarity with AI data governance considerations and acceptable use frameworks for AI tools.
Experience producing governance reporting for senior leadership or board-level audiences.
Knowledge of the childcare regulatory environment (Ofsted, DfE safeguarding requirements) and how this intersects with data protection obligations.
Knowledge of, or experience working within, recognised information security, privacy and quality management standards, particularly ISO/IEC 27001, ISO/IEC 27701 and ISO 9001, including supporting certification, surveillance audits and continuous improvement activities.

What We Offer

Salary of £50,000 per annum
Contributory pension scheme
25 days annual leave plus bank holidays
Hybrid and flexible working arrangements
Professional development budget and support for relevant qualifications
Supportive, family-friendly working environment
The opportunity to build a data governance function from the ground up in a growing, values-led organisation

We are unable to offer any kind of visa sponsorship for this role.
We embrace everyone. Our goal is to create a truly inclusive culture and diverse workforce. We break down barriers so you can be your authentic self and flourish!

Kids Planet is dedicated to safeguarding and promoting the well-being of children and young people. An enhanced DBS check will be required for this role. We expect all staff and volunteers to uphold this commitment, and safeguarding training is a fundamental part of every role. All colleagues are required to complete regular training to ensure they understand and fulfil their responsibilities. A Disclosure and Barring Service Certificate is mandatory for all positions, and this role will be subject to enhanced checks as part of our safeguarding duties.

title: Senior Computational Research Scientist - Department of Imaging Sciences
description:
AI and Computer Vision
for Biomedical Imaging
St. Jude Children’s Research Hospital | Memphis, Tennessee
Manor Laboratory • Department of Imaging Sciences • Full-time
Principal investigator: Uri Manor, Ph.D.

The Manor Laboratory seeks an experienced computational imaging professional to develop and apply artificial intelligence, computer vision, and quantitative image analysis to challenging questions in cell biology and biomedical research. Working closely with Dr. Uri Manor, experimental scientists, and collaborators, this individual will provide technical leadership across the laboratory’s computational imaging portfolio and translate advanced imaging data into validated biological measurements and broadly usable research tools.

The position spans fluorescence, label-free, live-cell, three- and four-dimensional (3D/4D), and electron microscopy. Applications include sensory-organ structure and pathology, cellular and organelle dynamics, and dense reconstruction of biological tissue. The role combines independent algorithm development, end-to-end scientific software engineering, collaborative research, and technical mentorship; it is not restricted to one disease, imaging modality, or biological system.

Key responsibilities

1. Guide computational imaging strategy

Partner with the principal investigator to prioritize and execute computer-vision and quantitative image-analysis projects across the laboratory. Translate biological questions into computational objectives, technical plans, and measurable deliverables. Establish reusable architectures, evaluation standards, and best practices that support consistent, reproducible analysis across imaging modalities and research programs.

2. Develop and validate AI methods

Design, implement, and benchmark methods for segmentation, classification, detection, tracking, image reconstruction and restoration, denoising, virtual staining, resolution enhancement, and quantitative phenotyping. Apply appropriate approaches, including convolutional and recurrent neural networks, Transformers, multimodal learning, generative models, and vision-language models. Evaluate performance on independent data, assess failure modes and generalizability, and verify that image transformations preserve biologically meaningful information.

3. Translate imaging data into biological insight

Develop quantitative analyses of multichannel 3D sensory-organ images and time-resolved cellular and organelle dynamics. Advance dense 3D segmentation and reconstruction of serial-section electron-microscopy data, including approaches that learn from sparse two-dimensional annotations. Work with experimental collaborators to connect computational outputs to interpretable measurements, rigorous biological conclusions, publications, and reusable research resources.

4. Build reliable software, datasets, and analysis platforms

Lead end-to-end workflows spanning annotation strategy, dataset curation, model training, validation, deployment, and maintenance. Develop documented, tested, version-controlled software, including interactive desktop plugins and web-based analysis tools where appropriate. Optimize workflows for large, multidimensional datasets and GPU or parallel computing. Expand annotated resources, support generalizable models, and collaborate with institutional and external partners to make tools accessible, maintainable, and useful to researchers.

5. Mentor researchers and disseminate methods

Provide technical guidance and mentorship to students, postdoctoral fellows, staff, and collaborators developing or applying AI tools. Advise on experimental design, data preparation, annotation, model selection, code development, validation, interpretation, and reproducibility. Develop training materials, lead hands-on instruction, and support adoption of shared tools. Contribute to manuscripts, grant applications, scientific presentations, and collaborative methods development while fostering a supportive, interdisciplinary research environment.

Minimum Education Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Bioinformatics, Molecular Biology, Biochemistry, Computer Science, or related field.
  • Master's degree or PhD preferred.

Minimum Experience Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree and 7+ years of relevant experience.
  • Exception: Master's degree and 5+ years of relevant experience (OR) PhD with 2+ years of relevant experience.
  • Rough criteria for this position based on publication output: 1-2 first author papers IF > 10 (or equivalent contribution to other research outputs).
  • Prior experience in computational research techniques and processes.
  • Proven performance in earlier role/comparable role.

Preferred qualifications

  • A Ph.D. in computer science, computer engineering, electrical engineering, biomedical engineering, applied mathematics, or a closely related quantitative field.
  • Demonstrated independent development and validation of machine-learning or computer-vision methods for biomedical images, supported by publications, deployed software, or comparable research outputs.
  • Strong Python programming and experience with a major deep-learning framework such as PyTorch or TensorFlow; experience with MATLAB, C++, GPU computing, or parallel processing is advantageous.
  • Experience with 3D/4D microscopy, multichannel or multimodal imaging, segmentation, tracking, image restoration, or quantitative phenotyping. Experience with electron microscopy, sparse annotations, or large volumetric datasets is particularly relevant.
  • Ability to translate research prototypes into usable software, with experience in dataset curation, version control, testing, documentation, and reproducible workflows. Experience with Napari or other interactive scientific analysis interfaces is beneficial.
  • Effective interdisciplinary communication, collaborative problem-solving, and experience mentoring researchers or teaching computational methods. Familiarity with cell biology, sensory neuroscience, organelle biology, spatial biology, or related biomedical applications is helpful.

Compensation

In recognition of certain U.S. state and municipal pay transparency laws, St. Jude is including a reasonable estimate of the compensation range for this role. This is an estimate offered in good faith and a specific salary offer takes into account factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets, experience and training, licensure and certifications, and other business and organizational needs. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the salary range and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current salary range is $104,000 - $186,160 per year for the role of Senior Computational Research Scientist - Department of Imaging Sciences.

Lead by Example. Develop People. Deliver Results.

At Thomson Power Systems, we are building a world-class manufacturing facility in Arlington, Texas. We are seeking a Lead Assembler who can combine technical knowledge with a passion for developing people and supporting team success.

This position serves as a hands-on working leader who helps train, coach, and support production team members while actively participating in assembly operations. The Lead Assembler plays a key role in maintaining safety, quality, productivity, and employee engagement.

As a Lead Assembler, you will act as the day-to-day leader for a production team, supporting Assemblers, Mechanical Assemblers, and Wiring Assemblers.
