title: Group Leader - Senior Director, Quantitative Pharmacology and Pharmacometrics – Oncology
description:
Job Description

We are seeking an accomplished scientific leader to join the Quantitative Pharmacology and Pharmacometrics – Oncology (QP2 Oncology) team as Senior Director, Group Leader. QP2 Oncology is part of the Global Clinical Development organization and has oversight of clinical pharmacology, mechanistic PK-PD modeling, and pharmacometrics for oncology programs from post-preclinical candidate (PCC) selection through registration.

Senior Directors are recognized scientific thought leaders who develop and implement clinical pharmacology strategies with a focus of utilizing MIDD strategies to advance drug development. This would include translational PK/PD strategies, biomarker-driven dose selection approaches, pharmacometric modeling and other quantitative approaches (e.g. QSP, AI/ML) for key development and regulatory decisions.

This role provides strategic leadership and scientific oversight across a significant portion of the oncology portfolio. The Senior Director, Group Leader will lead a team of QP2 scientists and serve as a key contributor to oncology program strategy by applying model-informed drug development (MIDD) approaches to support critical decisions.

Reporting directly to the QP2 Oncology Executive Director, the individual will collaborate closely with the QP2 Oncology Leadership team and broader organization to ensure consistent, high-value quantitative pharmacology contributions throughout the oncology portfolio. The role requires strong collaboration with cross-functional partners, including Clinical Development, Translational Medicine, Biostatistics, and Regulatory, as well as alignment with preclinical partners to inform first-in-human and clinical development strategies.

Primary Responsibilities:

Strategic & Scientific Leadership

  • Lead and shape quantitative pharmacology strategy across oncology programs to inform key development decisions (e.g., dose selection, trial design, go/no-go decisions)

  • Develop and implement integrated MIDD strategies to support decision-making across development stages

  • Ensure alignment of modeling strategies with regulatory expectations and business priorities

  • Maintain a comprehensive understanding of global regulatory expectations for small molecules, biologics including new modalities such as ADCs and TCEs

Team Leadership & Organizational Impact

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a team of QP2 scientists, including performance management, hiring, retention, and talent development

  • Provide scientific and operational oversight to team members, ensuring high-quality and timely deliverables

  • Contribute to broader QP2 and Oncology leadership initiatives, including talent strategies and organizational priorities

  • Identify and support resource planning and allocation in partnership with senior leadership

Program & Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Serve as QP2 lead on assigned programs and represent QP2 in cross-functional teams and governance forums

  • Collaborate with Translational, Clinical, and Biostatistics teams to integrate quantitative insights into development strategies

  • Partner with preclinical teams to ensure appropriate translation of nonclinical findings into clinical development plans

  • Contribute to due diligence for business development and licensing opportunities

Regulatory & External Engagement

  • Develop and contribute to regulatory strategies, including authoring and reviewing key documents (e.g., INDs, CSRs, CTD modules, NDA/BLA submissions)

  • Ensure delivery of high-quality clinical pharmacology and pharmacometric analyses and reports

  • Represent the company in interactions with regulatory agencies, scientific conferences, and external collaborations

Minimum Education

  • Ph.D. in pharmacokinetics/pharmacodynamics, pharmacometrics, mathematics, statistics/biostatistics, chemical/biomedical engineering, or related discipline with ≥10 years of relevant pharmaceutical industry experience

OR

  • Master’s, PharmD, or equivalent degree with ≥15 years of relevant pharmaceutical industry experience, with a demonstrated record of increasing responsibility, independence, and leadership in similar roles.

Required Experience and Skills

  • Educational background in biopharmaceutics, pharmaceutical sciences, pharmacometrics, chemical/biomedical engineering, mathematics, computational biology, or a related field

  • Oncology therapeutic area or disease knowledge

  • Demonstrated ability to lead an interdisciplinary team or taskforce, and/or to oversee the work of others

  • Extensive experience in developing quantitative strategies for impacting pipeline decisions, and drug development expertise

  • Ability to influence regulatory strategies including prior experience independently authoring and defending regulatory filings for marketing authorization (NDA/MAA)

  • Record of ability to operate in an inclusive and high-performance work environment applying enterprise ways of working principles including fostering collaboration and driving results, while managing ambiguity

  • Relevant regulatory and quantitative pharmacology experience

  • Proficiency in written and verbal communication, interdisciplinary collaboration, and problem scoping and planning

description:
How You’ll Make An Impact

At Strive Health, patients come first. We’re on a mission to transform chronic conditions by identifying risk earlier, coordinating thoughtful care, and supporting people through every stage of their health journey.

Our work reduces emergency visits, improves outcomes, and helps patients live fuller lives. You’ll work alongside passionate Strivers who care deeply about making an impact, show up for one another as One Team, and find ways to elevate the everyday.

If you’re looking for meaningful work where your contributions truly matter, you’ll feel right at home at Strive!

Benefits & Perks

  • Hybrid-Remote Flexibility – Work from home while fulfilling in-person needs at the office, clinic, or patient home visits.
  • Comprehensive Benefits – Medical, dental, and vision insurance, employee assistance programs, employer-paid and voluntary life and disability insurance, plus health and flexible spending accounts.
  • Financial & Retirement Support – Competitive compensation with a performance-based bonus program, 401k with employer match, and financial wellness resources.
  • Time Off & Leave – Paid holidays, vacation time, sick time, and paid birthgiving, bonding, sabbatical, and living donor leaves.
  • Wellness & Growth – Family forming services through Maven Maternity at no cost and physical wellness perks, mental health support, and an annual professional development stipend.

To learn more about our offerings, click here.

What You’ll Do

The Enrollment Associate is responsible for educating patients about their eligible healthcare services and directly scheduling them with our provider team. Depending on the patient’s eligibility, this role will also be collecting sensitive patient information to assist our care teams in preparing the right services for the patient.

Building trust-based relationships is at the core of Strive’s care model, and that patient experience starts with the Enrollment Associate. By establishing an empathetic connection with our patients, this individual will convincingly present Strive’s care model based on patient needs, nimbly address inquiries and objections, and be the patient’s support anchor throughout the enrollment process.

This role is a high call volume remote contact center-based position that supports Strive patient growth initiatives through both inbound and outbound calls. Success is dependent upon supporting our patients to schedule appointments with our providers. As a data-driven organization, we will use key performance indicators to help guide and coach this role’s performance. title: Research Fellow in Atherosclerosis Inflammation at MGH Cardiovascular Research Center’s Jaffer Lab
description:
Site: Massachusetts General Physicians Organization, Inc.


Mass General Brigham relies on a wide range of professionals, including doctors, nurses, business people, tech experts, researchers, and systems analysts to advance our mission. As a not-for-profit, we support patient care, research, teaching, and community service, striving to provide exceptional care. We believe that high-performing teams drive groundbreaking medical discoveries and invite all applicants to join us and experience what it means to be part of Mass General Brigham.


Job Summary

A postdoctoral position is available in the Division of Cardiovascular Medicine at Massachusetts General Hospital and Harvard Medical School in the NIH-funded laboratory of Dr. Farouc Jaffer. The postdoc’s focus; investigation of atherosclerosis inflammation using small and large animal models using novel molecular imaging approaches spanning intravascular microscopy to catheter-based intravascular imaging.


A highly motivated, collaborative, critically thinking candidate is sought for a research fellowship that will investigate atherosclerosis in small and large animal disease models, utilizing intravital microscopy, cell biology, molecular pharmacology and physiology to understand the role of in vivo inflammation in atheroma disease progression and complication. Experience in atherosclerosis biology, surgical models, molecular biology (histopathology, RNA, cell culture), microscopy, and flow cytometry is desirable. We are seeking candidates with a PhD, MD/PhD, or MD with prior laboratory experience in biomedicine.

Our interdisciplinary laboratory performs translational research, bridging the gap between understanding in vivo mechanisms of atheroma inflammation and the clinical goal of imaging coronary artery disease inflammation in patients for the first time in the cardiac catheterization laboratory. We focus on developing novel molecular imaging approaches to visualize high-risk plaques, vascular inflammation, and blood clots, including investigating blood flow restoration and therapeutic strategies to improve deep vein thrombosis resolution and prevent thrombotic syndrome. Another major focus is the use of intravital microscopy and intravascular imaging to study atherosclerosis and develop novel molecular imaging approaches.

Recent trainees have published manuscripts in high-impact journals, presented at national and international conferences, won competitive fellowship awards, and have discovered new insights into how atheroma inflammation can be modulated by translational pharmacotherapeutic and coronary interventional devices. Recent trainees have attained faculty posts at prestigious academic institutions in the US, Korea, Japan, UK, Australia, and China, as well as senior scientist positions in the biotechnology and pharma industry.


Qualifications

REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

  • PhD., M.D., PhD. or equivalent
  • Research experience in Atherosclerosis, Vascular Biology, Microscopy, Molecular Biology
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Experience with mouse or large animal surgical models, intravital imaging, cell culture, cell and molecular biology, and flow cytometry, is highly desirable
  • Excellent organizational skills, working independently and as a team member, collaboratively

EXPERIENCE:

  • PhD completion, or 2+ years of experience in a research-related field required at a postdoctoral level

WORKING CONDITIONS:

Work will be performed in the Simches and Edwards Research Building on the Massachusetts General Hospital main campus, in Boston, MA.

The salary for this position ranges from $73,544 to $81,199.

Our published work can be found here:

title: Logistics Lead
description:
At Wedgewood Pharmacy, we are dedicated to improving the lives of animals through customized medication and compassionate care. Every role in our organization contributes to helping pets live healthier, happier lives. We are a team driven by purpose, quality, and a shared commitment to animal health.

The Logistics Team Lead is a hands-on role that supports daily operations within the Dispensing and Materials departments. This position provides informal leadership and guidance to hourly warehouse staff while working alongside the team to ensure safety, efficiency, and quality standards are met. The Team Lead helps prioritize workflow, implementing lean practices, coaching peers, supporting training, and serves as a point of contact on the floor escalating issues to supervisors or managers as needed.

The Basics

Location: Swedesboro, NJ (Onsite)
Job Type: Full-time
Schedule: Monday- Friday 8:00 am - 4:30 pm
Compensation: $25- $29.00. Placement within the range will be determined based on experience, qualifications, skills, internal equity, and other business-related factors.


Benefits: Eligible

How You’ll Make an Impact

  • Provide on-the-floor leadership to warehouse staff in the Dispensing and Materials departments.
  • Lead by example and participate in daily operations including picking, packing, shipping, and material delivery as needed.
  • Monitor team performance to ensure standards for safety, quality, and productivity are consistently achieved.
  • Support inventory management, including ordering, restocking, and adjustments to maintain optimal inventory levels.
  • Collaborate with supervisors, managers, and the planning team to align staffing and operational schedules.
  • Conduct departmental meetings and lead daily huddles to communicate priorities and updates.
  • Facilitate the training and development of new team members and backups in the CDS process.
  • Assist with unloading materials using appropriate handling equipment or by hand.
  • Troubleshoot operational or equipment issues and escalate complex concerns to supervisors or managers.
  • Ensure timely generation and collation of packing slips for customer sales orders.
  • Support effective coordination with third-party shipping services.
  • Maintain flexibility in work schedule, including overtime and weekend rotations as required.
  • Serve as a resource for questions and support during shift operations, escalating employee or process concerns as appropriate.
  • Participate in special projects or other duties as assigned by the Warehouse Manager or Supervisor
  • Promote and support Wedgewood Pharmacy’s operational excellence and customer service goals.
  • Serves as a peer resource and role model on the production floor
  • Provides informal guidance and training to team members
  • Supports the team in meeting daily goals by assisting with workflow, verifying order accuracy, and communicating roadblocks to the supervisor.
  • Helps onboard new hires by demonstrating standard work and answering questions.
  • Identifies improvement opportunities and shares feedback with leadership; does not implement changes independently.
  • Leads by example in adherence to safety, quality, and compliance standards.

What We’re Looking For

  • Strong willingness to learn and apply leadership and process improvement techniques.
  • High attention to detail and ability to multitask in a dynamic environment.
  • Proven ability to lead a team calmly and effectively in a fast-paced production setting.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to coach and develop employees to meet performance goals.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and decision-making capabilities.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, Excel, Word, PowerPoint).
  • Experience interpreting and utilizing performance data and metrics.
  • Flexibility to rotate across job functions as needed.
  • Associate degree or equivalent experience in a warehouse or production environment.
  • 2–4 years of experience in a production or logistics setting.
  • 1–3 years of experience in a pick, pack, and ship operation (preferred).
  • Prior lead or supervisory experience.
  • Experience using Sage MAS500 or a similar Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) system.
  • Valid NJ Pharmacy Technician License.
  • MAS500, or equivalent, system experience.

What You’ll Love About Wedgewood

  • A comprehensive benefits package that includes health, dental, and flexible spending accounts
  • 401(k) retirement plan with a generous company contribution to help you save for the future
  • Company Paid Life and disability insurance
  • Access to voluntary insurance options
  • A generous paid time off program that increases every year
  • Tuition reimbursement
  • Opportunity for growth - We believe in promoting from within and do so through our internal job posting program!

Pay Range
$25—$29 USD

Why We Do What We Do

At Wedgewood Pharmacy, your work has purpose. Every prescription you help prepare, support, or deliver contributes to improving the health and well-being of animals. We are passionate about what we do and proud to build a workplace where people feel supported, included, and valued.

Our Commitment to Inclusion

Wedgewood Pharmacy is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive.

title: Learning & Development Specialist
description:
The Learning & Development Specialist is responsible for managing and driving the overall Learning & Development activities for Ichor Malaysia. The role partners with managers, Supervisors, HR Business Partners and the Direct Labour Training Manager to identify capability requirements, develop training plans and ensure effective implementation of learning and development programs.

The role serves as the L&D subject matter specialist and manages the end-to-end L&D framework, including Training Needs Analysis, annual training planning, training coordination, training effectiveness, competency development, training records and HRDC-related matters.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Manage and drive the overall Learning & Development programs and activities for Ichor Malaysia in alignment with business and workforce requirements.
  • Partner with managers, Supervisors, HRBPs and the Direct Labour Training Manager to identify skills, competency and development gaps and translate business requirements into appropriate learning solutions.
  • Lead the Training Needs Analysis (TNA) process by gathering departmental training requirements, analyzing competency gaps, prioritizing needs and developing the annual training plan.
  • Develop and manage the annual L&D plan, training calendar and training budget, ensuring programs are aligned with business priorities and effectively utilized.
  • Coordinate with internal trainers, subject matter experts and external training providers to plan and deliver effective learning programs.
  • Partner with the Direct Labour Training Manager to align overall L&D strategy with Direct Labour technical, skills and competency development programs.
  • Monitor completion of mandatory, compliance, technical, behavioral and leadership training and follow up with managers on outstanding requirements.
  • Manage and maintain accurate training, competency and employee development records, including training hours, attendance, completion and certification records.
  • Evaluate training effectiveness through feedback, assessments and relevant performance indicators and recommend improvements to learning programs.
  • Manage HRDC-related activities, including training registration, grant applications, levy utilization, claims, documentation, reporting and compliance requirements.
  • Monitor HRDC requirements and maximize the utilization of available HRDC funding for eligible training programs.
  • Develop and maintain L&D reports and dashboards covering training participation, completion, training hours, expenditure, HRDC utilization and other relevant L&D metrics.
  • Support the development and implementation of competency frameworks, skills matrices, career development and employee capability-building initiatives.
  • Partner with HRBPs and managers to identify critical talent and development needs and recommend appropriate development interventions.
  • Coordinate onboarding, leadership, technical, behavioral, compliance and other business-specific learning programs in partnership with relevant stakeholders.
  • Ensure L&D processes, practices and documentation comply with company requirements and applicable statutory or regulatory requirements.
  • Continuously review and improve L&D processes, systems and programs to enhance training effectiveness, employee capability and learning experience.
  • Lead or participate in HR and L&D projects and perform other duties as assigned.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Strong knowledge of Learning & Development principles, training methodologies and adult learning practices.
  • Strong practical knowledge of Training Needs Analysis (TNA), training planning, competency development and training effectiveness.
  • Working knowledge and hands-on experience with HRDC requirements, training grants, claims and levy utilization.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to partner effectively with managers, Supervisors, HRBPs, trainers and external training providers.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess competency gaps and translate business needs into effective learning solutions.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple L&D programs and priorities simultaneously.
  • Good communication, facilitation, presentation and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work independently, demonstrate initiative and take ownership of L&D activities from planning through execution.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accurate training and compliance records.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, PowerPoint and Word.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Learning & Development, Business Administration, Education or related discipline, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • 3–5+ years of relevant experience in Learning & Development, training, HR or a related field, preferably within a manufacturing or operational environment.
  • Demonstrated experience in Training Needs Analysis, annual training planning, training coordination and training effectiveness.
  • Hands-on experience managing HRDC processes, training grants and claims is strongly preferred.
  • Experience in technical/production training, competency management or skills development is preferred.
  • Experience working with internal subject matter experts, trainers and external training providers.
  • Relevant L&D, HR, training or professional certification is an advantage.

title: Ergotherapeut Gehandicaptenzorg (Tijdelijk)
description:
Ten behoeve van het behandel en expertisecentrum, vakgroep Ergotherapie, zijn wij van december 2026 tot en met mei 2027 op zoek naar een Ergotherapeut voor 20 uur per week.

Ergotherapie is een vakgroep binnen het behandel en expertisecentrum die ten behoeve van cliënten van Pergamijn werkzaam is op diverse locaties in Midden- en Zuid-Limburg. Als professional binnen deze vakgroep lever je een waardevolle bijdrage door middel van uitgebreid onderzoek, gerichte behandeling, persoonlijke begeleiding en deskundig advies. Je richt je op uiteenlopende ergotherapeutische gebieden, waaronder zelfverzorging, productiviteit en ontspanning. Dit betekent dat je cliënten ondersteunt bij het ontwikkelen of herstellen van vaardigheden die nodig zijn om dagelijkse activiteiten zelfstandig uit te voeren, bij te dragen aan hun omgeving en te genieten van vrije tijd en recreatie.

Daarnaast werk je nauw samen met andere disciplines binnen het behandel- en expertisecentrum en stem je jouw aanpak af op de unieke behoeften en doelen van de cliënt. Dit vraagt niet alleen om specialistische kennis en vaardigheden, maar ook om empathie, creativiteit en het vermogen om oplossingsgericht te denken. Door jouw inzet draag je bij aan het vergroten van de zelfstandigheid en het welzijn van de cliënten, waarmee je een tastbare impact maakt in hun dagelijks leven.

Wat bieden we jou?

  • Een dienstverband van 20 uur per week;

  • Een tijdelijk contract van december 2026 tot en met mei 2027;

  • Een salaris in overeenstemming met de cao gehandicaptenzorg; FWG 55 (maximum €3.948,- op basis van 36 uur);

  • 144 verlofuren per jaar uitgaande van een fulltime dienstverband en 57 Persoonlijk Budget Levensfase uren;

  • Een interessante werkkostenregeling waarmee je als medewerker voordeel kan hebben bij de aanschaf van een fiets, tablet, smartphone of tablet, voordeel met bedrijfsfitness of korting op de contributie van je sportvereniging en meer.

Jouw profiel

Je hebt ervaring én affiniteit met de doelgroep mensen met een verstandelijke beperking en je bent in het bezit van een geldig diploma ergotherapie.

Registratie in het kwaliteitsregister paramedici is wenselijk. Verder dien je in het bezit te zijn van een rijbewijs en heb je de beschikking over een eigen auto. Je bent in staat om zelfstandig te werken, overzicht te houden en prioriteiten te stellen. Ten slotte sta je voor kwaliteit en heb je een actieve en ondernemende werkhouding en beschik je over goede didactische en mondelinge vaardigheden.

Enthousiast? Solliciteer snel!

Wil je eerst meer informatie? Neem dan contact op met Ergotherapeut Ingrid Verdonschot-Meeuvis via I.Meeuvis@pergamijn.org/0642615904 of met Teammanager Simone Dautzenberg via s.dautzenberg@pergamijn.org/06-20482057.

Heb je vragen over de sollicitatieprocedure? Bel of app dan met recruiter Justin Zelissen via 06-14957174 of mail naar J.Zelissen@pergamijn.org.

Solliciteren kan tot 16 oktober. Gesprekken vinden plaats op 22 oktober in de ochtend.

title: Leasing Professional - Multi-site - Vancouver
description:
ABOUT GREYSTAR


Greystar is a leading, fully integrated global real estate platform offering expertise in property management, investment management, development, and construction services in institutional-quality rental housing. Headquartered in Charleston, South Carolina, Greystar manages and operates over $350 billion of real estate in more than 260 markets globally with offices throughout North America, Europe, South America, and the Asia-Pacific region. Greystar is the largest operator of apartments in the United States, managing over one million units/beds globally. Across its platforms, Greystar has nearly $79 billion of assets under management, including over $34 billion of development assets and over $36.5 billion of regulatory assets under management. Greystar was founded by Bob Faith in 1993 to become a provider of world-class service in the rental residential real estate business. To learn more, visit .

JOB DESCRIPTION SUMMARY

This position is responsible for coordinating the community’s marketing, leasing, and renewal strategies to achieve occupancy, revenue, and resident retention goals by performing all activities related to leasing to new residents, providing resident satisfaction throughout the term of the lease, and securing resident lease renewals.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Essential Responsibilities:
• Performs all sales and leasing activities to achieve the community’s revenue and occupancy goals by greeting and qualifying prospects, conducting community tours and showing apartments, processing applications, credit screening, and criminal background checks, preparing the lease and move-in package, and ensuring a smooth resident move-in and lease signing.
• Inspects apartments prior to resident move-in and ensures apartments are in move-in ready condition and schedules any outstanding item to be addressed with the maintenance team.
• Stays informed about current market and competitor conditions that may impact the community’s occupancy and sales results, develops and implements short- and long-term marketing plans and goals to sustain occupancy, and follows the community’s established policies related to concessions, specials, and other programs to boost occupancy.
• Designs and executes marketing activities to create and drive traffic to the community, including implementing resident referral and employer outreach programs, using internet marketing tools (Craigslist, Facebook, e-mail, and other websites), and following other community-specific marketing plans, drives, and special programs.
• Uses the on-site property management software (OneSite, Yardi, etc.) to track apartment availability, record traffic and leasing activities, manage resident and prospect data, and capture critical demographic and other information about existing and future residents.
• Ensures that the community and show units meet the Company’s standards for show quality by daily inspecting the marketing corridor and leasing tour, communicating maintenance and upkeep needs to the community’s maintenance team members, merchandising and ensuring a physically appealing show unit and/or model and amenities, and preparing the leasing office for daily leasing activities.
• Follows-up with prospects and new residents to ensure satisfaction by sending e-mail, thank-you notes, and cards or making telephone calls or other contacts to finalize decisions to lease and/or renew.
• Executes and performs activities in support of the community’s lease renewal program by preparing lease renewal letters and packages for residents, meeting with and contacting renewing residents in advance of move-out dates, and ensuring that lease renewal documents are signed and implemented on time.
• Responds quickly and courteously to resident and client/owner concerns and questions, and takes prompt action to solve problems and/or document and convey resident or other requests to the appropriate individual(s).

Required Licenses or Certifications:
• Incumbents must have all licenses and/or certifications as required by State and Local jurisdictions

• Incumbents must have valid driver’s license to operate a golf cart on property.

  • Incumbents need to be able to stand, walk, and/or sit for extended periods of time and bend, stoop, climb ladders, reach, carry objects, and crawl in confined areas.
  • Incumbents must be able to work inside and outside in all weather conditions (rain, snow, heat, hail, wind, sleet).
  • Incumbents must be able to push, pull, lift, carry, or maneuver weights of up to twenty-five (25) pounds independently and fifty (50) pounds with assistance.
  • Rare or regular travel may be required to assist other properties as needed, attend training classes, business meetings, or other situations necessary for the accomplishment of some or all of the daily responsibilities of this position.

title: Staff Customer Experience Strategist
description:
About Plooto

Plooto is a payment automation platform built to help accountants, bookkeepers, and their clients take control of their payables and receivables. From approval workflows and audit trails to bulk payments and automated reconciliation, Plooto gives our customers time back and confidence that their books are accurate and up to date. Our customers range from busy entrepreneurs to finance teams and non-profits, with a strong footprint among accounting firms and bookkeeping professionals across Canada.

About the Role

We are looking for a Staff Customer Experience Strategist to help shape how Plooto delivers a seamless and trusted experience across the customer journey. Reporting to the VP, Risk & Operations, this is a highly influential individual-contributor role with the opportunity to work across Product, Engineering, Operations, Risk, Data, Finance, and GTM to solve some of our most important customer and business problems.

This role owns Customer Experience Insights and Optimization: uncovering what drives customer contact and product/operational churn, diagnosing the underlying payment, product, and process issues, and turning those insights into action. You will identify what we can improve now through tooling, automation, AI, or process changes, and where deeper Product or Engineering investment can create meaningful impact.

You will bring together deep customer understanding, payments expertise, hands-on data analysis, and strong business judgment to uncover root causes, quantify customer and business impact, and translate insights into clear recommendations that drive measurable improvement.

What You'll Do

  • Uncover the biggest opportunities to improve the customer journey. Bring together customer contacts, churn, payment behavior, operational data, reviews, and NPS/CSAT to identify friction and the opportunities with the greatest customer and business impact.
  • Diagnose what is driving the experience. Go beyond high-level themes to understand the underlying product, payment, process, policy, tooling, or integration drivers and define the outcomes that matter most.
  • Shape customer experience priorities across SaaS and payments. Identify where product workflows, payment flows, and operational processes create friction and help define the customer and business outcomes that should improve.
  • Turn data into decisions. Test hypotheses, segment customers, quantify impact, and connect insights to contact rate, churn, revenue retention, and cost-to-serve.
  • Create momentum now while shaping what comes next. Identify opportunities through AI, automation, tooling, communications, and process improvements, while partnering with Product and Engineering on opportunities that require deeper product investment.
  • Influence high-value improvements across Plooto. Use strong problem framing, evidence, and clear target outcomes to build alignment across Product, Engineering, Customer Operations, Risk, Data, Finance, and GTM.
  • Build a stronger Customer Experience capability. Evolve how Plooto measures and acts on customer insights, create reliable visibility into contact and churn drivers, and translate complex analysis into concise, decision-ready recommendations for senior leaders.

What We're Looking For

  • Significant experience in payments, fintech, SaaS, customer experience strategy, or a related analytical role, ideally in a product-led environment.
  • Strong understanding of how money moves through a payments business, including funding, settlement, returns, reconciliation, risk reviews, recalls, cross-border payments, chargebacks, and exceptions.
  • Demonstrated track record of using data to identify and solve systemic customer, product, or operational problems, with measurable improvements in areas such as contact rate, churn, onboarding, payment transparency, or cost-to-serve.
  • Strong hands-on data proficiency using SQL, Databricks, Salesforce, and similar tools, with minimal reliance on Data for routine analysis.
  • Strong first-principles problem solving and business judgment, with the ability to move from signal → driver → root cause → opportunity → recommendation and connect insights to customer and business impact.
  • Experience building or materially improving a customer experience or friction-reduction capability, including using AI, automation, tooling, and process improvements to create measurable impact.
  • Strong cross-functional influence and communication skills, with the ability to build alignment through clear problem framing, evidence, sound judgment, and concise, decision-ready recommendations for Product and senior leaders.

Why Become a Plootonian?

If you’re looking to make a meaningful impact, look no further. We’re transforming the payments space in North America by delivering an unrivalled product experience to solve a real and pressing problem for SMBs.

The biggest reason small businesses fail is poor financial management and cash flow — and Plooto fixes that. We have strong product-market fit, a massive opportunity ahead, and the backing of experienced fintech leaders.

You’ll join a team that cares deeply about customer impact, takes pride in our craft, and moves with urgency. We’re just getting started — and you’ll help shape the next chapter of our growth story.

Join Plooto and be part of a mission that matters.

Our Commitment to Inclusion

Plooto is committed to building an inclusive workplace where people of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives can thrive. We know great teams are built through diverse thinking, and we encourage you to apply even if your experience does not align perfectly with every qualification listed.

Accommodation is available throughout the recruitment process in accordance with applicable accessibility legislation. If you require accommodation at any stage, please let us know—we’re happy to work with you.

This posting is for one available position. Compensation will be determined based on the successful candidate’s knowledge, skills, experience, and overall alignment with the role.

description:
Onko toiveenasi kiinnostava ja vaihteleva laboratoriohoitajan työ innostavassa työyhteisössä?

HUS Diagnostiikkakeskus on Suomen johtava kliinisten laboratorio- ja kuvantamispalvelujen tuottaja. Pääasiallinen toiminta-alueemme on HUS-yhtymän erikoissairaanhoito ja HUSiin kuuluvien hyvinvointialueiden perusterveydenhuolto. Vastaamme myös Kymenlaakson hyvinvointialueen ja Etelä-Karjalan hyvinvointialueen laboratorio- ja kuvantamistoiminnasta.

Toimimme kahdeksalla lääketieteen erikoisalalla. Vastaamme valtakunnallisesti useista erityisosaamista vaativista tutkimuksista sekä yliopistolliselle sairaalalle kuuluvasta tutkimuksesta ja opetuksesta. Diagnostiset tutkimukset ovat keskeisessä roolissa sairauksien varmistamisessa, poissulkemisessa, osana hoitoa sekä hoidon seurannassa ja seulonnassa. HUS Diagnostiikkakeskuksessa työskentelee noin 3300 laboratorio- ja kuvantamisalan asiantuntijaa yli 150 toimipisteessä.

Haemme kahta laboratoriohoitajaa/bioanalyytikkoa vakituisiin ja kokoaikaisiin työsuhteisiin HUS Diagnostiikkakeskuksen Automaatio 2 laboratorioon kliinisen kemian vastuualueelle Meilahteen.

Odotamme sinulta sitoutunutta työotetta, hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja tiimityöskentelytaitoja sekä oma-aloitteisuutta, organisointikykyä ja joustavuutta muuttuvissa työtilanteissa. Tehtävän hoitaminen edellyttää hyvää suomen kielen suullista ja kirjallista taitoa.

Täältä löydät mukavat ja osaavat työkaverit sekä monipuoliset ja mielenkiintoiset työtehtävät, joihin saat kattavan perehdytyksen. Tarjoamme sinulle hyvät ammatilliset kehittymismahdollisuudet sekä mahdollisuuden osallistua erilaisiin kehittämis- ja vastuutehtäviin. Käytössämme olevan yhteisöllisen työvuorosuunnittelun avulla voit vaikuttaa omiin työvuoroihisi.

HUS on Suomen suurin erikoissairaanhoidon toimija ja työnantaja. HUS tarjoaa henkilöstölle monipuolisia etuja, joihin kuuluvat mm. ePassin liikunta-, kulttuuri- ja työmatkaetu sekä työsuhde- ja loma-asuntojen vuokrauspalvelut.

title: Project Coordinator
description:
TRI Environmental Group (TRI) is an independent laboratory testing, research, and information management company serving the environmental, geotechnical, and earthen infrastructure industries. The Project Coordinator coordinates laboratory testing workflows and provides administrative support at TRI’s Austin laboratory after scope and authorization are established. Client outreach is part of the job: regular outbound calls and emails to active, past, and dormant accounts. The work is client-facing and detail-heavy: the coordinator tracks active jobs, keeps project records straight, and keeps clients informed.


Project Coordination & Operations Support

  • Maintain accurate project files, records, and sample information after project approval.
  • Confirm receipt of approved work orders and coordinate internal project setup for laboratory testing.
  • Track active projects as they progress through testing workflows.
  • Partner with laboratory, client services, and administrative teams to keep priorities aligned and work moving efficiently.
  • Help prioritize tasks and monitor deadlines across multiple active jobs.

Client Communication

  • Provide clients with factual status updates regarding testing and laboratory processing stages, following established procedures.
  • Make regular outbound calls and emails to active, past, and dormant client accounts.
  • Re-engage inactive client relationships and follow up on open quotes, proposals, and potential testing needs.
  • Identify potential new opportunities and communicate them to laboratory or management staff for scoping and authorization.

Workflow & Logistics Management

  • Coordinate daily workflow handoffs between departments to support efficient turnaround times.
  • Support scheduling priorities to keep laboratory production on track.
  • Identify and document scheduling or workflow issues that could affect testing or reporting and communicate solutions internally.
  • Coordinate information between clients, laboratory personnel, and internal staff as needed.

Documentation & Reporting

  • Assist with preparation and release of laboratory reports.
  • Prepare, review, and organize project documentation.
  • Enter, review, and reconcile data in the ERP and LIMS systems.
  • Support QA/QC documentation, accreditation compliance, and traceability of client deliverables.
  • Verify consistency between reports, project documentation, and laboratory records.

Schedule Requirements

  • Full-time position.
  • Participation in a rotating Saturday schedule is required approximately once every 4–6 weeks (2–4 hours reviewing and distributing laboratory results).

title: LatAm Debt Capital Markets Senior Analyst
description:
Excited to grow your career?

We are more than 121,000 professionals working in multidisciplinary teams with profiles as diverse as financiers, legal experts, data scientists, developers, engineers and designers.

About the job:

Position Overview

The Senior Analyst in the BBVA LatAm Debt Capital Markets (DCM) group will support the structuring, origination, and execution of international bond issuances and financing solutions for corporate, financial institutions, sovereign, and agency clients across Latin America, with a focus on Brazil, Mexico, Peru, Colombia, Chile, and Argentina.

The individual will work closely with senior bankers, product specialists, legal advisors, rating agencies, and clients throughout all stages of transaction execution. The role requires strong analytical capabilities, financial modeling skills, capital markets knowledge, and the ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.

This position offers significant exposure to international debt markets, client interaction, and cross-border financing transactions, while providing substantial opportunities for professional development and increased responsibility within the team.

Key Responsibilities

-Prepare client presentations, pitchbooks, transaction proposals, and marketing materials for debt capital markets transactions

-Analyze market conditions, secondary bond pricing, investor trends, and new issue activity to support origination and execution efforts

-Assist in the execution of international bond transactions, including:

  • Due diligence processes
  • Documentation review
  • Internal approval processes

title: Team Leader - Technology
description:
Team Leader - Technology
Location: Auckland
Full-time | Permanent | Yoobee Auckland CBD

About the role:

We’re looking for an experienced technology educator and people leader to join Yoobee Colleges as our Team Leader – Technology, leading the delivery of our Bachelor of Software Engineering programmes.

This is a campus-based leadership role with national responsibility for the tutors delivering the programme across our campuses. You’ll provide academic and people leadership to the teaching team, ensuring students receive a consistent, high-quality learning experience regardless of where they study.

Alongside leading and developing your team, you’ll remain connected to the classroom through teaching within the Bachelor of Software Engineering programme and contributing to its ongoing development.

Key areas of responsibility include:

  • Leading, coaching and developing a team of Software Engineering tutors across multiple campuses.
  • Supporting tutors to deliver engaging, innovative and industry-relevant teaching.
  • Teaching within the Bachelor of Software Engineering programme.
  • Managing tutor performance, development plans and regular coaching conversations.
  • Ensuring consistent programme delivery, lesson planning and assessment practices across campuses.
  • Monitoring student attendance, progress and academic outcomes and supporting appropriate interventions.
  • Working closely with Faculty, Quality, Learner Success and campus teams to continuously improve programme delivery.
  • Supporting moderation, assessment verification and the development of quality teaching resources.
  • Contributing to programme development and ensuring teaching remains relevant to the evolving technology industry.

About you:

You’ll bring a strong background in software engineering or a closely related technology discipline, along with the leadership capability to guide, support and develop a team of tutors delivering our Bachelor of Software Engineering programme.

You don’t necessarily need to be an established academic leader. We’re looking for someone with strong people leadership skills, technical credibility and the ability to bring out the best in others. Previous teaching or tertiary education experience would be ideal, particularly if you’ve taught at degree level.

To be successful in this role, you’ll bring:

  • A Master’s degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology or a closely related discipline.
  • Strong knowledge and experience within software engineering or the wider technology sector.
  • Strong leadership skills, with the ability to coach, develop and motivate a team.
  • Teaching, tutoring or facilitation experience, ideally within a tertiary or degree-level environment.
  • The confidence and capability to teach within the Bachelor of Software Engineering programme.
  • Strong communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to work effectively across teams and campuses.
  • A collaborative approach and the ability to drive consistency and high standards across programme delivery.
  • A strong focus on student achievement and creating engaging, supportive learning experiences.
  • An interest in current and emerging technology and software engineering practices, with the ability to bring industry relevance into the classroom.

Why work with us?

Yoobee Colleges prides itself on supporting a diverse and inclusive culture - open to inputs from creative people of all genders, ethnicity, identity, thought and experiences. We are fast movers, action orientated, keen innovators, and quick thinkers who enjoy a workplace that is inspiring and fun.

  • Work within a collaborative academic environment

  • Support postgraduate learners preparing for professional careers

  • Gain teaching and academic experience in a supportive setting

  • Be part of an innovative institution committed to excellence and student success

To Apply:

To apply for this position, please submit your resume and a cover letter detailing your relevant experience and interest in the role. Suitable candidates will be contacted as applications are received.

Questions about your identity help us appreciate the diversity of individuals looking to work with us, ensuring we’re attracting applications from people with identities and perspectives that are as diverse as our students.

We are an equal opportunity employer. As part of our commitment to equity, we work to ensure a fair and consistent interview process. We celebrate diversity and we are committed to an inclusive work environment.

Providing care under the names Advocate Health Care in Illinois; Atrium Health in the Carolinas, Georgia and Alabama; and Aurora Health Care in Wisconsin, Advocate Health is a national leader in clinical innovation, health outcomes, consumer experience and value-based care. title: Criminal Justice Technician 1/2 (PCN 20-6060)
description:
Job Description


The Department of Corrections, Division of Pretrial, Probation, and Parole is recruiting for a Criminal Justice Technician 1/2 position at the Anchorage Pretrial Office located in Anchorage, Alaska.

Watch Alaska DOC's video here:
DOC Extended Cut mp4 (vimeo.com)

Watch Alaska DOC’s Division of Pretrial, Probation, & Parole video here:
DP3 - 30sec mp4 (vimeo.com)

What You Will Be Doing:

The key responsibilities of this position include, but are not limited to:

  • Provide advanced technical and clerical support for the Anchorage Pretrial Office, including document processing and criminal justice data entry.
  • Conduct Electronic Monitoring installs and releases daily, perform urinalysis/PBT testing, and support law enforcement staff in paraprofessional tasks.
  • Maintain Redwood Toxicology program data collection and randomized testing schedules.
  • Assist with monitoring low-risk defendants assigned to the General Supervision bank.
  • Conduct cyclical audits of absconder banks and numerous other databases.


Our Mission, Values, and Culture:

The Division of Pretrial, Probation, and Parole is committed to enhancing the safety of Alaska through fair, evidence-based community supervision that respects the rights and dignity of all individuals. At the heart of this mission are Criminal Justice Technicians who, like Pretrial Services Officers, play an essential role in advancing our vision of a safer, more just Alaska.


Our mission is to foster positive change by upholding public safety, supporting the fair administration of justice, and providing consistent, accountable supervision.


Benefits of Joining Our Team:

By joining the Anchorage Pretrial Office you will be an integral team member in making our communities safer. The Department of Corrections offers paid training, paid time off and many opportunities for career advancement.


The Working Environment You Can Expect:

This office supervises approximately 700 defendants daily on various forms of pretrial release residing within the Municipality of Anchorage. We provide a dynamic work environment amongst a cohesive group of coworkers committed to success.


Who We Are Looking For:

We are interested in candidates who possess some or all of the following position specific competencies:

  • Customer Service: Works with clients and customers (that is, any individuals who use or receive the services or products that your work unit produces, including the general public, individuals who work in the agency, other agencies, or organizations outside the Government) to assess their needs, provide information or assistance, resolve their problems, or satisfy their expectations; knows about available products and services; is committed to providing quality products and services.
  • Attention to Detail: Is thorough when performing work and conscientious about attending to detail.
  • Self-Management: Sets well-defined and realistic personal goals; displays a high level of initiative, effort, and commitment towards completing assignments in a timely manner; works with minimal supervision; is motivated to achieve; demonstrates responsible behavior.

Minimum Qualifications

Competency Based Minimum Qualifications Instructions

This job class uses competency based minimum qualifications. Please ensure your application (through work history, volunteer experience (duties summary), training, education, licenses, certifications, etc.) supports how you have gained the knowledge, skills, abilities, and behaviors (competencies) and that you possess the minimum required competencies for the job class.


Competency Description
The competency description(s) listed below have been designed to promote a common understanding of the essential elements of the job class. They highlight the more general and customary knowledge, skills, abilities (KSAs), tasks, and behaviors used to describe the competency. They typically list expectations, as opposed to specific tasks, and are to be used only as parameters and guidelines. A competency’s description is not intended to exclusively define every KSA, task, and behavior needed to successfully meet the competency, but rather to provide the manager/agency with a broad reference of options as to how an applicant can meet the job expectation.

Criminal Justice Technician 1
Any combination of education and/or experience that provides the applicant with competencies in:
  • Accountability: Accepts responsibility for own actions and decisions and demonstrates commitment to accomplish work in an ethical, efficient, and cost-effective manner.
  • Computer Skills: Uses computers, software applications, databases, and automated systems to accomplish work.
  • Interpersonal Skills: Shows understanding, friendliness, courtesy, tact, empathy, concern, and politeness to others; develops and maintains effective relationships with others; may include effectively dealing with individuals who are difficult, hostile, or distressed; relates well to people from varied backgrounds and different situations; is sensitive to cultural diversity, race, gender, disabilities, and other individual differences.
  • Oral and Written Communication: Expresses information (for example, ideas or facts) to individuals or groups effectively, taking into account the audience and nature of the information (for example, technical, sensitive, controversial); makes clear and convincing oral and written presentations; listens to others, attends to nonverbal cues, and responds appropriately.
  • Problem Solving: Identifies problems; determines accuracy and relevance of information; uses sound judgment to generate and evaluate alternatives, and to make recommendations.
Equivalent to those typically gained by:
Any combination of education and/or work, internship, and/or volunteer experience or service from any combination of fields that sufficiently builds the above and any job-specific competencies.

Criminal Justice Technician 2
Successful completion of training under a formally established Criminal Justice Technician 1-2 flexible staffing training plan with the State of Alaska;
OR
Any combination of education and/or experience that provides the applicant with competencies in:

title: Manoeuvre
description:
Evident Canada est une société du groupe Wabtec ! Evident Canada, une société du groupe Wabtec, est un chef de file mondial dans la fabrication d'équipements d'inspection innovants utilisés dans des applications industrielles et de recherche dans l'aérospatiale, la production d'énergie, la pétrochimie, les infrastructures civiles, l'industrie automobile et les produits de consommation.

Description du poste

**Ce poste est disponible sur le quart de soir**

  • ​Notre bâtisse à Québec offre un atelier d’usinage propre et climatisé.

  • Horaire 4 jours par semaine, lundi au jeudi (40 heures)

  • Prime de soir et fin de semaine (3,50$/heure)

Sous la supervision du contremaître de production, le ou la manœuvre de l'atelier de finition réalise les opérations de finition sur des pièces usinées de petit volume : barattage, sablage au jet (beadblast en cabinet), polissage, encrage et installation d'inserts. La personne titulaire lit et interprète les bons de travail, les dessins techniques et les gammes de fabrication, valide la conformité dimensionnelle des pièces à l'aide d'instruments de mesure de précision, et assure le suivi rigoureux des données de production. Il s'agit d'un excellent point d'entrée dans le domaine manufacturier, avec formation complète offerte sur place et possibilité de progression vers des postes spécialisés.

Tâches et responsabilités

  • Lire et interpréter les bons de travail, les dessins techniques et les gammes de fabrication afin de réaliser les opérations de finition requises.

  • Effectuer les opérations de barattage, de sablage au jet (beadblast en cabinet), de polissage, d'encrage et d'installation d'inserts sur des pièces de petit volume.

  • Mesurer les pièces à l'aide d'instruments de mesure de précision afin de valider la conformité dimensionnelle après les opérations de finition.

  • Identifier et localiser les défauts d'aspect visuel des produits, puis effectuer les retouches selon les procédures qualité en vigueur.

  • Assister les machinistes dans la préparation et la manutention des pièces, au besoin.

  • Effectuer l'ébavurage, le nettoyage et l'inspection visuelle des pièces produites.

  • Approvisionner les postes de travail en matières premières et en consommables de finition.

  • Enregistrer avec exactitude les données de production (quantités, temps, rebuts, etc.) sur les bons de travail ou dans le système en place.

  • Respecter les délais de production et les priorités établies.

  • Assurer l'entretien régulier des outils et des équipements (nettoyage, rangement) afin d'en garantir la durée de vie optimale.

  • Maintenir la propreté et l'ordre de l'aire de travail en tout temps.

  • Participer à l'amélioration continue de son poste de travail et à la mise en place de procédures communes (5S).

Profil recherché

  • Bonne dextérité manuelle et souci du détail.

  • Débrouillardise, autonomie et minutie dans l'exécution des tâches.

  • Bon sens de l'organisation et capacité à gérer plusieurs priorités.

  • Esprit d'équipe et volonté d'entraide.

  • Ponctualité et fiabilité.

  • Capacité à travailler debout pour des périodes prolongées et à effectuer des tâches physiques légères à modérées.

  • Bonne capacité d'apprentissage et volonté de suivre les consignes et les procédures qualité.

Our job titles may span more than one career level. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. More information on offered benefits, which include health, welfare, and retirement, are available at mywabtecbenefits.com. Other benefit offerings for this role may include annual bonus, if eligible.

What could you accomplish in a place that puts People First?

At Wabtec, it’s not just about a job - it’s about the impact you make. When our people come together, we’re Expanding the Possible by continuously improving what we do and how we do it - for our clients and each other.

If you’re ready to revolutionize how the world moves for future generations, Wabtec is the place for you.

Who are we?

Wabtec is a leading global provider of equipment, systems, digital solutions, and value-added services for the freight and transit rail sectors. Drawing on more than 150 years of experience, we are leading the way in safety, efficiency, reliability, innovation, and productivity. Whether it’s freight, transit, ports, logistics, mining, industrial, or marine, our expertise, technologies, and people together – are accelerating the future of transportation. With roots that date back to George Westinghouse, Thomas Edison, and Louis Faiveley, Wabtec has always built technologies and implemented solutions for a variety of sectors that are critical to meeting the needs of customers and governments alike.

Our global team of about 30,000 employees worldwide delivers performance that moves the world forward. We’re lifelong learners, obsessed with better. Learn more at www.WabtecCorp.com.

Culture powers us and the possibilities.

We believe the best ideas come from a mix of experiences and backgrounds. At Wabtec, we strive every day to create a place where everyone belongs. We’re building a culture where leadership, inclusion and your unique perspective fuel progress.

title: Privacy Analyst
description:
This position may be filled prior to the posted deadline. Interested candidates are encouraged to apply as soon as possible.
Koniag Professional Services, LLC a Koniag Government Services company, is seeking a Privacy Analyst with a Secret security clearance to support KPS and our government customer in Arlington, VA.

Duties and Responsibilities:
Specific Tasks:

The Privacy Analyst will work with OIG staff and system owners to safeguard privacy and promote transparency through compliance, advice, training, and collaboration.
The Privacy Analyst will conduct privacy risk assessments throughout the lifecycle of PII at the OIG; identify and evaluate processes for handling PII to mitigate potential risks; and address gaps in privacy policies and procedures.
Assist with ensuring compliance with the E-Government Act of 2002 and the Privacy Act of 1974 by analyzing privacy impact assessments (PIAs) of OIG IT systems that collect PII from the public or employees to identify risk to personal information and opportunities to minimize the collection of PII; and by identifying systems of records (SOR) from which information is retrieved by reference to an individual identifier (i.e. individual’s name), respectively.
Support efforts in research, assessments, and assist with proposing recommendations about strategies or approaches to improve the effectiveness and efficiency of the Department’s privacy protection business processes.
Support the implementation of policies, plans, and procedures for the Department’s compliance with the Privacy Act, the E-Government Act, Presidential E-Gov initiatives, OMB directives, and other legal mandates to ensure PII is properly acquired, stored, accessed, disseminated, and disposed of in accordance with existing statutory requirements.
Offers expert consultative advice and guidance to OIG on various intra- and inter-agency initiatives such as best practices for implementation of NIST 800-53 rev 5, aspects of OMB Circular A-130, and other initiatives as needed.

Serves as a consultant on preparing and presenting deliverables including talking points, analytical reports, statistical summaries, memoranda, computer generated visuals, executive presentations, and other products as requested.

Secret Security clearance

The Senior Indirect Tax Analyst is responsible for overseeing and executing complex indirect tax compliance, providing technical guidance, supporting process improvements, and serving as a key resource across the organization. This role ensures accurate and timely filing of sales and use tax returns, supports tax audits, leads process improvement initiatives, and contributes to cross-functional tax technology projects. The Senior Analyst also assists with training junior team members and strengthening tax operational effectiveness.

As a Senior Indirect Tax Analyst, your essential job functions will include the following:

Sales/Use Tax

  • Oversee the resolution of tax notices, ensuring timely follow‑up, effective issue escalation, and minimal backlog across the compliance function.
  • Oversee and support a variety of indirect tax projects involving external taxing authorities, including Voluntary Disclosure Agreements (VDAs), sales and use tax audits, nexus reviews, account registrations and closures, taxability research, notice resolution initiatives, and other compliance or remediation projects with outside providers and state/local jurisdictions.

Property Tax

  • Assist with property tax reporting requirements by preparing supporting schedules.
  • Work with Accounting to help compile and maintain documentation needed for property tax filings, including inventory and tangible personal property details by state.

  • Develop strong working relationships with other functional areas, as appropriate.
  • Prepare all business license filings, as assigned, and coordinate with statutory agent(s), as required.

  • Support the maintenance of the tax calendar and other departmental tracking documents as needed.
  • Drive efficiency in tax workflows by refining Standard Operating Procedures and leading automation and reporting initiatives, including Vertex, Alteryx and OneStream.
  • Other duties, as assigned.

Position Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or related field required.

  • Intermediate to Advanced skills in Microsoft Office products, including Excel.
  • Proven attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Demonstrated interpersonal skills and an ability to collaborate with individuals at all organizational levels.
  • Familiarity with using JDE (JD Edwards), NetSuite or another major ERP system is a plus.
  • Experience with Vertex (O‑Series or Vertex Cloud), including assisting with maintaining tax rates, exemption certificates, jurisdictional settings, return preparation, system testing, reporting validation, and supporting cross‑functional teams in resolving tax engine issues.

title: 2027 Summer Intern, Pricing Associate (Reston, VA or Remote)
description:
ICF is seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Pricing Associate Intern to join our Corporate Pricing Team. In this role, you’ll learn to develop accurate, compliant, and competitive pricing solutions that support ICF’s proposals and contribute to meaningful client outcomes. You will work with members of the pricing department, operations teams, capture managers, contracts, finance, and proposal professionals to analyze solicitation requirements, support and build pricing models, and help prepare cost and business proposals for federal, state, local, and commercial clients.

Our summer internship is full-time for 10-weeks beginning in early June and ending in early August. Work may be hybrid from Reston, VA or performed from any U.S. location. At this time, we are unable to provide relocation nor housing assistance.

This is a strong opportunity for a candidate who is interested in growing in pricing, finance, cost analysis, and government contracting. You’ll gain exposure to the full proposal lifecycle, learn from experienced pricing professionals, and build skills in financial analysis, compliance, collaboration, and business strategy. The successful candidate will bring strong analytical skills, intellectual curiosity, a collaborative mindset, and a commitment to accuracy and continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support the development of timely, accurate, and compliant cost and business proposals that help ICF compete effectively and deliver strong value to clients.

  • Review requests for proposals and related documents to identify pricing requirements, evaluation criteria, submission instructions, compliance considerations, and key assumptions.

  • Assist in building, maintaining, and quality-checking pricing models, including labor, other direct costs, travel, subcontractor costs, indirect rates, fees, and escalation assumptions.

  • Collect, organize, and analyze cost inputs from operations, subcontractors, finance, contracts, and other stakeholders to support complete, clear, and defensible pricing submissions.

  • Document pricing assumptions, methodologies, and supporting rationale so proposal teams and reviewers can easily understand how pricing aligns with the proposed technical approach.

  • Participate in pricing strategy discussions, proposal reviews, color team reviews, and internal approval processes by preparing analyses and responding to reviewer feedback.

  • Prepare financial analyses, scenario comparisons, and pricing summaries that help proposal teams evaluate competitiveness, profitability, and risk.

  • Contribute ideas to improve pricing templates, tools, quality controls, and processes that support consistency, compliance, and efficiency across proposals.

Basic Qualifications

  • By start date at least 15 completed credit hours in Accounting, Data Analytics, Economics, Finance, Management, Supply Chain Management or related field.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, including formulas, data organization, workbook review, and the ability to learn and work with detailed pricing models.

  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work accurately with financial, operational, and proposal data.

  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to summarize assumptions, analyses, and recommendations for different audiences.

  • Attention to detail, sound judgment, and the ability to follow structured processes and meet deadlines.

  • Interest in cost estimation, pricing, financial analysis, business operations, government consulting, or government contracting.

title: Third-Party Risk Management - Cybersecurity
description:
Job Description:

GRC TPRM Assessment and Remediation SME

We are seeking an experienced Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) Assessment and Remediation Subject Matter Expert (SME) to manage the end-to-end lifecycle of supplier/vendor cybersecurity risk assessments and remediation.

The role will be responsible for supplier inventory governance, assessment coordination, findings management, remediation tracking, escalation management, and executive reporting. The ideal candidate will have strong TPRM/GRC expertise, excellent communication skills, and experience managing high-volume, multi-step risk assessment workflows.

Location: Austin, TX / Cupertino, CA
Work Model: Hybrid – 3 Days a Week Onsite
Duration: 12+ Months Contract

Key Responsibilities

1. Supplier Inventory Management

  • Maintain the Supplier Inventory within the GRC platform as the single source of truth for assessment status.

  • Tier and filter suppliers requiring reassessment versus new assessments based on program criteria.

  • Maintain accurate Direct Responsible Individual (DRI) records within the GRC tool.

2. Assessment Execution

  • Evaluate suppliers against established frameworks and standards, including:

    • SIG

    • CAIQ

    • NIST CSF

    • ISO 27001

    • SOC 2

  • Review and validate supplier evidence, including audit reports, certifications, penetration test results, and other security documentation.

  • Confirm DRI ownership and obtain kick-off acknowledgement before initiating assessments.

  • Log and track assessment tasks in workflow/tracking tools, including acknowledgement evidence.

  • Verify that onsite-assessed suppliers have current-year assessment coverage.

  • Participate in recurring findings-review meetings and provide guidance on policy requirements and evidence standards.

3. Remediation Management

  • Own Corrective Action Plans (CAPs) from initiation through closure.

  • Define remediation SLAs and track progress against established timelines.

  • Drive remediation closure with suppliers and internal business owners.

  • Coordinate with Legal, Procurement, and Information Security (InfoSec) teams regarding remediation timelines and compensating controls.

  • Monitor open findings and ensure appropriate documentation and evidence are maintained.

4. Stakeholder Communication & Escalation

  • Manage a structured outreach cadence with DRIs, including:

    • Initial kick-off

    • Follow-up communications

    • Management escalations

  • Track response and non-response rates for each outreach cycle.

  • Escalate unresolved or high-risk findings to appropriate leadership.

  • Maintain clear documentation of all communications, decisions, and remediation activities.

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with business stakeholders and suppliers.

5. Weekly Reporting

  • Prepare and deliver weekly metrics and status reports for leadership.

  • Track and report:

    • Outreach volume

    • Supplier response rates

    • Follow-up and escalation status

    • Suppliers approved for new assessments or reassessments

    • Assessment completion and coverage

    • Open findings and remediation status

    • Overall TPRM program progress

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in Cybersecurity, Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM), GRC Operations, Supplier Risk, or a related field.

  • Strong working knowledge of:

    • NIST CSF

    • ISO 27001

    • SOC 2

    • SIG

    • CAIQ

  • Hands-on experience with GRC/TPRM platforms, such as:

    • OneTrust

    • RSA Archer

    • ServiceNow GRC

    • SupplierNinja

    • or similar platforms

  • Proven experience managing high-volume, multi-step communication and assessment workflows.

  • Strong findings and remediation management experience.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Strong documentation, organization, and follow-through skills.

  • Experience working with distributed or remote teams.

  • Ability to communicate effectively with business stakeholders, suppliers, and leadership.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Relevant certification such as CTPRP, CRISC, CISA, or CISSP.

  • Experience with workflow and tracking tools such as:

    • Wrike

    • Airtable

    • Jira

    • or similar platforms

  • Experience working in regulated industries such as:

    • Financial Services

    • Healthcare

    • Insurance

  • Experience preparing leadership-facing metrics, dashboards, and weekly reports.

  • Experience managing supplier cybersecurity assessments and remediation programs in a large enterprise environment.

description:

Carrier Global Corporation, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions, is committed to creating innovations that bring comfort, safety and sustainability to life. About the Role

As a Sr. Supervisor – Supplier Quality & Development, you will lead the strategy, execution, and continuous improvement of supplier quality across components used in HVAC systems. This role combines technical leadership, team management, and supplier development to ensure supplier processes are capable, materials meet specifications, and risks are proactively mitigated across both New Product Introduction (NPI) and serial production.

You will directly influence product performance, reliability, and compliance while developing a high-performing Supplier Quality team and strengthening supplier partnerships to achieve long-term quality excellence. This role is critical in ensuring that supplier-provided components consistently meet the performance, reliability, and regulatory standards required for HVAC systems, enabling product quality, operational efficiency, and customer satisfaction.

Key Responsibilities

As a Sr. Supervisor – Supplier Quality & Development, you'll be responsible for:

• Lead, coach, and develop a team of Supplier Quality Engineers and incoming quality personnel, driving accountability and continuous improvement.

• Define and deploy supplier quality strategies, including supplier qualification, certification, performance monitoring, and risk-based development plans.

• Lead supplier quality activities for NPI programs, ensuring supplier readiness through audits, process validation, capability studies, and successful product launches.

• Govern supplier process validation, PPAP/UPPAP approvals, change management, and compliance with engineering and product requirements.

• Drive supplier development initiatives and structured problem-solving methodologies to improve supplier performance, process capability, and quality maturity.

• Lead escalation and resolution of critical supplier quality issues, ensuring rapid containment, root cause analysis, and corrective action implementation.

• Partner cross-functionally with Engineering, Procurement, Manufacturing, and Quality teams to support supplier selection, risk mitigation, and overall business objectives.

Requirements

We are looking for people who are results-driven, collaborative, analytical, and passionate about continuous improvement. If this is you, get in touch.

As a minimum you must have:

• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a related technical field.

• 5–7+ years of experience in Supplier Quality, Quality Engineering, or Manufacturing Quality.

• Demonstrated experience leading teams or supervising technical personnel.

• Strong knowledge of quality systems, supplier quality processes, and quality core tools.

• Advanced English proficiency, both written and verbal.


Although not necessary, it would be nice if you have:

• Experience in HVAC manufacturing, appliances, or thermal/mechanical systems.

• Expertise in PPAP/UPPAP, PSW approval, supplier qualification, incoming inspection systems, and advanced sampling strategies.

• Knowledge of manufacturing processes such as sheet metal fabrication, brazing, welding, and refrigeration systems.

• Six Sigma or Lean Manufacturing certification and experience leading supplier development and transformation initiatives.

• Strong data analytics, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
