title: Senior Specialist, Inventory Management
description:
Job purpose

The Senior Specialist, Inventory Management will ensure accurate, compliant, and cost-effective management of inventory, assets, and warehouse operations across multiple camps. The role supports uninterrupted operations by implementing effective stock control systems, warehouse management, coordinating with vendors and field teams, maintaining data integrity, enforcing safety and audit compliance, and driving continuous improvement in inventory processes.

Key Accountabilities

1. Inventory Oversight

  • Oversee general inventory, asset, and warehouse management across multiple camps through rotational presence (not fixed to a single location).
  • Manage daily inventory operations including receiving, inspecting, storage, issuance and distribution of materials and assets.

2. Stock Control & Warehouse Management

  • Implement systems to monitor material usage, prevent shortages, and reduce wastage.
  • Define reorder levels, safety stock, and asset thresholds for all inventory items and ensure timely replenishment.
  • Oversee warehouse operations across multiple camps, ensuring efficient storage, space utilization, material handling, and inventory flow.
  • Maintain organized warehouse layouts, proper binning systems, and accurate stock location records to facilitate efficient material retrieval and control.
  • Ensure all materials are stored in accordance with manufacturer recommendations, safety requirements, and company procedures.
  • Monitor warehouse capacity and utilization, recommending improvements to optimize storage efficiency and operational effectiveness.
  • Coordinate warehouse housekeeping activities to maintain clean, safe, and compliant storage facilities.
  • Manage warehouse equipment and storage infrastructure, ensuring serviceability, maintenance, and operational readiness.
  • Implement best practices in warehouse management to improve productivity, reduce handling time, and minimize loss or damage.

3. Reporting & Analysis

  • Maintain and update accurate daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual inventory reports.
  • Prepare ad hoc reports, dashboards, and data analysis to support management decision making.
  • Track, verify, and validate inventory data and report submissions received from field teams.

4. Compliance & Safety

  • Ensure inventory handling, storage, and distribution comply with safety, environmental, legal, and audit standards.
  • Enforce FIFO (or other approved inventory methods) to avoid expiry, damage, or obsolescence.
  • Maintain proper housekeeping, labeling, segregation, and safety compliance at all store locations.

5. Vendor & Service Coordination

  • Coordinate with suppliers and service providers to ensure timely delivery, repairs, maintenance, and quality assurance of inventory and assets.
  • Review technical proposals and quotations related to inventory, warehouse, and asset related services or supplies.

6. Asset Management

  • Track and monitor assets issued to users on a weekly basis.
  • Manage system requests for permanent and temporary asset assignments.
  • Ensure appropriate storage and handling conditions for sensitive items such as electronics, chemicals, and controlled materials.

7. Physical Checks & Audits

  • Maintain complete documentation for inward, outward, inter camp transfers, and asset issuance transactions.
  • Conduct random inspections and physical inventory counts to verify stock accuracy against system records.
  • Support internal and external audits and address discrepancies through corrective actions.

8. Disposal & Inventory Optimization

  • Identify and process disposal of obsolete, damaged, expired, or unused materials in line with company policies.
  • Apply inventory optimization techniques such as ABC analysis, safety stock calculation, and demand forecasting.
  • Monitor and minimize inventory shrinkage resulting from loss, damage, or theft.

9. Team Coordination & Training

  • Conduct weekly coordination meetings with field camp management teams to review stock status, issues, and compliance.
  • Deliver training on inventory procedures, reporting requirements, and system usage.

10. Financial Controls

  • Review petty cash invoices (for items bought in petty cash) and supporting documents for completeness and compliance before submission to reporting team
  • Follow up for the Inventory items related Delivery, Invoices & RN

11. Administrative Support

  • Request for PRs for inventory items, assets, and related services and follow up until delivery and closure.
  • Review and validate supplier invoices related to inventory, assets, and services for accuracy and compliance.

12. Continuous Improvement & Other Duties

  • Drive initiatives to improve inventory efficiency, reduce costs, and enhance system reliability.
  • Perform any other related tasks assigned by management in support of inventory and logistics operations

Minimum Qualification, Experience and Competencies

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in supply chain management, Logistics, Business Administration, or a related discipline, or relevant work experience

Minimum Experience:

  • +10 years of experience in inventory control, warehouse management, or asset management roles or other related experience at the discretion of Company.
  • Experience working in remote sites, camps, or industrial / mining environments is preferred.
  • Experience managing inventory across multiple locations or remote sites is preferred.
  • Proven experience with audits, reporting and ERP or Inventory Management systems.

Maaden High Performance Competencies

  • Achievement Drive
  • Safety & Compliance Orientation
  • Operational Excellence
  • Analytical Thinking
  • Planning & Organizing
  • Accountability & Ownership
  • Teamwork & Collaboration
  • Communication
  • Continuous Improvement Mindset
  • Problem Solving & Decision Making
  • Integrity & Ethical Conduct
  • Digital & Process Orientation

Skills

  • Strong knowledge of inventory systems, asset management, and supply chain workflows.
  • Analytical ability to forecast demand, define reorder levels, and apply stock optimization techniques.
  • Proficiency in preparing detailed inventory reports and conducting data analysis.
  • High accuracy and attention to detail in documentation, system updates, and compliance records.
  • Ability to conduct audits, investigate variances, and reconcile discrepancies.
  • Vendor coordination and negotiation skills to ensure timely supply and service delivery.
  • Knowledge of safety, legal, and regulatory requirements for inventory operations.
  • Familiarity with FIFO/LIFO, ABC analysis, safety stock, and shrinkage control.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills for multi‑location oversight.
  • Leadership and training capabilities to guide and support field teams.
  • Competence in using inventory management software, Excel tools, and ERP systems.
  • Ability to monitor KPIs and enforce accountability across distributed teams.

Do you like working with your hands? Do you enjoy variety in your work? Surface Experts Technician might be the job for you! Enjoy using your creativity to problem-solve repairs that typically take less than an hour.

A Day in the Life of a Surface Experts Technician:
WE OFFER:
  • Base Salary + Bonus Opportunity: Performance-based commissions starting on day 1
  • 401K with matching contributions
  • Medical benefit assistance
  • Great Work/Life Balance: No required overtime, no nights, no weekends
  • Time Off: Paid holidays and accruable vacation
  • Flexible Work Schedule: Can accommodate midweek appointments
  • Paid Training: Onboarding includes comprehensive training. Additional monthly training opportunities.
  • Clothing allowance
  • Company Car: Each technician drives a branded company vehicle for job duties
  • Tools Included: All necessary tools and products are provided
  • Learn a New Trade: Develop skills in a brand-new emerging trade
  • Supportive Work Environment: Team celebrates achievements and collaborates in their approach to problem-solving
  • Small Business: Local business with owners that work alongside the team
  • Mentorship Opportunities: Ongoing repair training and career development
  • Dedicated Help Lines: Technician Support Team on call to assist to questions
DUTIES:

In the Field Daily
  • On the jobsite for 4+ customers per day
  • On-site Work Orders, customer service, and follow-ups
  • Working for a variety of customers in different industries including Property Management, Hotels, Movers, Builders, etc.
Customer Service and Communication
  • Display world-class customer service for tenants and property management staff
  • Track work progress and notes in our CRM/Dispatch tool
  • Communicate with support team with questions
Follow Repair Process
  • Understand and utilize our unique 5-step repair process
  • Employ each tool in your custom tool-kit
  • Problem-solve repairs with creativity
We're seeking someone with experience in the construction industry, a trade, or any kind of handyman work. Your familiarity with tools, construction materials, and basic construction common sense will be essential in mastering the Surface Experts process.

QUALIFICATIONS
  • Experience working with your hands - This could be in construction, manufacturing, painting, or even a personal hobby.
  • Experience working with HVLP or no airless paint sprayers is a plus.
  • An ability to identify, compare, and recreate colors - Understanding color and how to match color is a large part of what we do.
ABOUT SURFACE EXPERTS

Surface Experts is an all-inclusive surface repair service provider. We repair small damage to surfaces like Floors, Countertops, Bathtubs, Cabinets, Appliances, Furniture, Elevator Panels … Almost Everything!

  • We combine old school skill sets with new technology and products, resulting in a durable and appealing repair all provided with a smile.
  • Most repairs are simple and smaller than a dinner plate, yet our competition focuses on complete resurfacing. Our objective is a happy customer and a long-term relationship. We focus on saving our customers time, money and wasted materials that end up in a landfill.
  • Our typical repair requires only 1 to 2 tablespoons of product so our technicians can carry their entire set of tools and equipment in a small vehicle. Our approach is clean and free of odors in less than two hours.
VISION
  • To establish and lead a nationally recognized market for surface repair as an alternative to replacement or complete refinishing.
  • Our goal is to be represented in every major metropolitan area, and for our brand to be synonymous with spot repair among all facilities and maintenance management.
MISSION
  • Our mission is to develop outstanding teams by investing in strong relationships.
  • Together, we work to solve our customers’ problems by reducing the waste of time, money, and materials that end up in landfills.
VALUES
  • Serve Others
    • Put Relationships First
    • No Jerks
    • Be Humble
  • Be a Problem Solver
    • Be Curious
    • Seek to Understand the Cause of the Problem
    • Work Smart
    • Constantly Improve
  • Trust the Process
    • Be Organized
    • Be Teachable
    • Put Business Needs Above Personal Wants

description:
Job Title: Scoping Specialist

FLSA Status: Exempt

Status: Full-Time

Reports To: Project Manager

Company Overview

Ontivity, referred to as the Company1, is a national-scale technology infrastructure company specializing in technology upgrades, structural engineering and tower modifications, macro tower builds, small cell installations, in-building solutions, DAS and 5G installations, fiber design and deployment, EV Infrastructure builds, generator services, civil services, microwave networks, and more. As a leading turnkey service provider in the technology infrastructure space, the Company serves industries such as communications, wireless and wireline, fiber design and deployment, sustainable energies, utilities, oil & gas, and security and defense.

Summary

The Scoping Specialist will act as a key interface with the site acquisition team, construction and project teams, supply chain, and general contractors to define the Scope of Work (SOW) based on RFDSs, CDs, and other provided data for various company projects.

This is a safety-sensitive position.

Key Responsibilities

Uphold the company’s core value of safety across all operations.

Define the Scope of Work (SOW) based on RFDSs, CDs, and other provided data for company projects.

Be the key interface between the site acquisition team, construction and project teams, supply chain, and general contractors to complete company projects.

Work with procurement to create the Bill of Materials (BOM) per the SOW.

Work with the construction team to understand site-specific characteristics and schedule requirements for build plans.

Analyze drawings, site surveys, photos, RF information, schedules, etc., to determine materials and services needed to construct a site as specified by the customer.

Develop Scoping and other appropriate documentation based on customer-provided RF DSs and Construction drawings when requested.

Develop and submit detailed quotes associated with SOWs and review the scope and quote for accuracy and timeliness.

Execute any change of scope throughout the life of a project, including true-up requirements for scoped services and materials.

Apply industry knowledge and experience to resolve issues as needed.

Represent the company and participate in planning and status meetings as needed.

Interpret and explain plans to administrative staff, crew, etc.

Ensure the highest level of safety and quality control requirements are upheld.

Must continue to work towards training and certifications for work-related jobs.

Other duties as assigned.

Physical Demands

Must be in good physical condition with the ability to routinely bend, squat, climb, kneel, push, pull, lift 30lbs or more, lift in awkward positions, stand, and twist for extended periods.

May be required to work long and unpredictable hours.

Must be able to pass pre-employment screening that includes DOT physical, background check, and drug/alcohol testing and participate in the random testing program.

Must be willing to work in all weather conditions, including extreme heat, extreme cold, rain, ice, snow, and wind.

Minimum Qualifications:

Technical Skills:

Must be able to work in a team environment and be a valued member of the crew and the company.

Must have knowledge of building products, construction details, and relevant rules, regulations, and quality standards.

Must have knowledge of wireless technology and telecommunications, with emphasis on site design, including acquisition, construction, RF, cabinet builds, and power.

Must understand how to build a site from a construction and pricing perspective with industry-standard materials, and have a good understanding of engineering concepts.

Working knowledge of UMTS, GSM, LTE, 5G, and Small Cell.

Must be proficient in Microsoft Office products and have advanced computer skills.

Soft Skills:

Must be able to communicate at a high level in person, by phone, and by email with team members and clients.

Must be able to read, comprehend and carry out instructions.

Must be self-motivated with the desire to learn new things and project a positive attitude toward others in all work-related settings.

Must be able to work on a team and independently as required.

Supervisory Requirements

No supervisory requirements

Position Type and Expected Hours of Work

This is a full-time position with a typical work schedule of Monday – Friday, 6:00 am – 5:00 pm with overtime requirements or as directed by leadership. The work schedule is subject to change depending on market conditions which may require overtime, night work and/or weekend work.

Travel

Depending on market location and/or conditions, travel is required 0-25% of the time. Travel requirements are subject to change.

Required Education and Experience

High School diploma or general education degree (GED); related trade school education preferred

4 years+ of experience in the cellular or telecommunications industry or related/similar field.

Benefits

The Company offers a comprehensive benefits package that is designed to enhance all aspects of our employees’ well-being. In addition to competitive pay, our benefits package includes:

Health, dental, and vision plans (for team members and their families)

Financial planning through our 401(k) program

Additional benefits including life and disability insurance

title: Materials Supervisor - A Crew
description:
Materials Supervisor
About Voltava:
At Voltava, people power everything we do. We are a premier global manufacturing and assembly partner formed through the combination of Detroit Manufacturing Systems, Android Industries, and Avancez with approximately 5,400 Team Members across 21 facilities worldwide. Our vibrant, collaborative, and people-focused culture is the foundation for everything we deliver, from complex module assembly and sequencing to contract manufacturing, supply chain, automation, and tooling and equipment design for OEM customers across the automotive, industrial, e-mobility, heavy truck, defense, and technology sectors. Kinetyc, our scalable contract manufacturing arm based in Wixom, Michigan, expands our capabilities and capacity to support customers across a range of industries. Together, we are Building A Better Everything.
About the Role:
The Materials Supervisor is responsible for leading material flow operations within the manufacturing facility, ensuring materials are delivered safely, accurately, and on time to support production requirements. This role manages material handlers, inventory movement, line replenishment, and warehouse activities while driving safety, quality, productivity, and continuous improvement initiatives.
What You Will Do:

Supervise daily material handling operations, including line feeding, inventory movements, and warehouse support activities.
Lead and develop material handlers to achieve safety, quality, delivery, and productivity goals.
Ensure uninterrupted material flow to production areas to prevent downtime.
Monitor and maintain inventory accuracy through proper scanning, transactions, and cycle count activities.
Coordinate material replenishment using FIFO, Kanban, and other inventory control processes.
Investigate and resolve material shortages, inventory discrepancies, and process issues.
Ensure compliance with safety regulations and company policies regarding powered industrial equipment.
Track and report department KPIs, including inventory accuracy, forklift utilization, productivity, and material delivery performance.
Support continuous improvement projects aimed at reducing waste and improving operational efficiency.
Collaborate with production, shipping, receiving, quality, and supply chain teams to meet customer requirements.

What You Need To Be Successful:

Strong leadership, coaching, and employee development skills.
Knowledge of material handling, inventory control, and warehouse operations.
Experience working in a manufacturing environment.
Strong problem-solving and analytical abilities.
Excellent communication and organizational skills.
Ability to prioritize tasks and manage multiple responsibilities in a fast-paced environment.
Experience with ERP, WMS, RF scanners, and inventory management systems.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel.
Commitment to safety, quality, and continuous improvement.

Bonus Points If You Have:

Automotive manufacturing experience.
Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, FIFO, Kanban, and warehouse optimization principles.
Experience managing forklift fleets and powered industrial truck operations.
Experience with cycle counting, inventory reconciliation, and inventory accuracy programs.
Knowledge of EDI, ASN processing, and customer-specific logistics requirements.
Previous experience leading Kaizen events or continuous improvement initiatives.
Forklift certification and hands-on material handling experience.

Education:

Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, Operations Management, or a related field preferred.
Equivalent combination of education and relevant manufacturing or logistics experience will be considered.

Travel:

Minimal travel required (less than 5%).
Occasional travel may be required for training, audits, benchmark visits, or support at other company locations.

What We Offer:
We believe our team members are our greatest investment, which is why we offer a competitive total rewards package designed to support you at every stage of your career and life. Our benefits may include comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage, retirement savings programs with employer contributions, tuition reimbursement, paid time off and holidays, employee assistance resources, and additional wellness programs and benefits designed to support your health, financial well-being, professional growth, and overall quality of life.

Our Core Values:
Voltava is committed to creating an environment where every Team Member feels welcomed, respected, valued, and empowered to make an impact.

Respect: We create belonging by bringing out the best in each other.
Integrity: We earn trust through every interaction.
Courage: We show up fully even when it would be easier not to.
Impact: We strengthen the people and places around us.

Together, we are Building A Better Everything.
Voltava is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.
We are committed to attracting, developing, and retaining talented individuals from diverse backgrounds and experiences. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, and related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.
At Voltava, employment decisions are based on qualifications, skills, experience, and business needs. We believe that a diverse and inclusive workforce strengthens our ability to innovate, serve our customers, and achieve our goals.
Accessibility and Accommodations
Voltava is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities throughout the hiring process and during employment. If you require assistance or an accommodation to participate in the application process, please contact careers@voltava.com. Requests for accommodation will be reviewed and considered in accordance with applicable laws and regulations.

Lazarus Naturals was founded in 2016 to make quality hemp-based CBD accessible to everybody. It's why we own our manufacturing process from start to finish - beginning at our hemp farms in Central Oregon to our extraction, formulation, and packaging - all to deliver safe, effective CBD at an affordable price. We provide a 60% Assistance Program to veterans, individuals with disabilities, or those experiencing income challenges, because we believe everybody should be able to experience the benefits of CBD and natural medicine regardless of their financial situation.

Cycling Frog is normalizing the consumption of casual use THC products. We are on a mission to make THC convenient, affordable, and fun by making a sessionable THC beverage the same price as a beer or soda. description:

Description

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.

Northrop Grumman is a space pioneer, supporting government, civil and commercial customers in solving their biggest challenges. Our forward-leaning, innovative spirit is backed by a legacy of expertise that began at the dawn of the space age. Our mission experience in space runs deep, we know our customers well, and our capabilities are unmatched. This is what allows us to provide reliable, agile and affordable space solutions to best serve our customers.

From defending freedom to advancing human discovery, we are defining what is possible in space every day.

Entry Level opportunities at Northrop Grumman are unique. Are you interested in boosting your knowledge through experience and exposure, while supporting a mission that seeks to protect our nation and its allies? If so, then Northrop Grumman is the place you!

Our professionals live and breathe different perspectives; we are curious about the world, accepting each other, and aware that the more ideas, backgrounds, opinions and experiences we bring to our work, the stronger that work will be. Just as you would invest your time and hard work into our company, we focus on investing back into you through enriching professional experiences and high-quality learning and development opportunities. We want you to bring your whole self to work, and for you to have meaningful connections with your coworkers, customers and communities, while providing the best products, systems and technologies to protect our world.

Northrop Grumman is seeking Associate Supply Chain Planning Specialist. This position will be located at our Space sector in Chandler AZ.

The qualified candidate will become part of Northrop Grumman’s Launch Vehicles, Launch and Exploration Division, and Production Planning.

Roles and Responsibilities

  • Define and develop material strategies to meet operational goals.
  • Assess supply resources, prioritize demand requirements, and plan inventory, distribution, material, and rough-cut capacity for raw materials.
  • Serve as the primary focal point for a cross-functional team, providing leadership, guidance, and coordination to ensure effective supply chain execution.
  • Engage in long-term capacity and resource planning, including product phase-in/phase-out, manufacturing ramp-up, end-of-life management, and product-line transitions.
  • Analyze and synthesize complex supply/demand requirements to inform strategic decision-making.
  • Plan and manage inventory levels based on Bill-of-Materials (BOM) requirements, creating or reducing supply requirements as needed.
  • Develop and execute critical procurement strategies by conducting in-depth lead time analyses and identifying critical paths.
  • Apply advanced analytical techniques to evaluate and refine supply chain workflows, addressing inefficiencies and mitigating risks.
  • Create and release requisitions, review non-standard part requirements, and support new product scheduling while phasing out obsolete lines.

Basic Qualifications:

A candidate must meet ALL of the below criteria. The candidate must:

  • Has completed their degree Bachelor’s from an accredited institution
  • Having majored in Supply Chain Management, Operations Management, Industrial Engineering, Business Administration, Logistics, Manufacturing Engineering, Economics or similar major.
  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively in team environments, contributing to a culture of collaboration, accountability, and achieving shared goals
  • Strong analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, and provide actionable insights.
  • Basic proficiency with Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Have an overall cumulative GPA of 3.00/4.0 or higher
  • Exposure to/or coursework in material management, preferably related to defense or aerospace environments.
  • Familiarity with basic program management concepts and interest in supporting problem resolution and “Return to Green” activities.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel (e.g., formulas, sorting/filtering, basic data analysis); exposure to or interest in learning Deltek Costpoint Materials Module.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively within cross-functional teams and build positive working relationships.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to break down issues and contribute to practical solutions.
  • Basic understanding of procurement, manufacturing, or purchasing processes through coursework, internships, or prior work experience.
  • Awareness of forecasting, planning, or scheduling concepts and interest in learning how they support operational execution.
  • Demonstrated ability to work with guidance, prioritize assigned tasks, and maintain strong attention to detail.

Salary Range:

$ 54,400 to $81,600

campusjobs

Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay. title: Project Manager
description:
Due to our team development and new projects started, Intellisync is looking for a Project Manager, who has already 5 years of experience in the IT field.

The project manager plays a pivotal role in guiding the company’s projects from the beginning to end. This role is responsible for planning, executing, monitoring, controlling, and closing projects, ensuring timely delivery while maintaining quality standards and staying within budget.

Your responsibilities will be:

• Collaborate with stakeholders to define project purpose, objectives, and client’s requirements;

• Develop comprehensive project plans, detailing timelines, milestones, resource allocation, and risk

assessments and mitigation strategies;

• Coordinate and oversee the day-to-day operations of the project, ensuring that work progresses

according to the established plan (including budget);

• Act as a bridge between developers, designers, testers, and other roles, ensuring effective

communication and collaboration;

• Oversee the testing phase to identify bugs and necessary modifications, ensuring they are addressed

before product deployment;

• Manage expectations and address concerns or feedback from stakeholders;

• Lead, motivate, and support the project team to ensure productivity and a good climate;

• Conduct post-project reviews to evaluate project outcomes and identify areas of improvement;

• Document lessons learned and provide feedback to improve the company's project management processes.

You'll receive a positive evaluation in case you have:

• 5+ years of experience in project management role in a company;

• Experience with budgeting and resources allocation;

• Proven track record of successfully delivering company’s projects on time and within budget;

• Experience managing cross-functional teams and complex projects;

• Proficiency in project management tools (e.g., Microsoft Project, Jira);

• Knowledge of project management methodologies (e.g., Agile, Waterfall);

A previous experience in digital trasformation, cybersecurity and AI fields will be considered a plus.

Soft Skills:

  • • Leadership and team management skills;
  • • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills;
  • • Problem-solving and decision-making abilities;
  • • Flexibility and adaptability to changing project requirements;
  • • Stakeholder management and negotiation skills;
  • • Strong organizational and time management skills.
  • • Ability to resolve conflicts and make decisions under pressure.

We offer:

  • Full-time employment with a competitive salary (based on your experience and capabilities)
  • Inclusive, supportive, and people-oriented co-working spaces surrounded by green spots
  • Extensive learning opportunities and flexible career path
  • Free canteen and gym, relax areas, video game room, parking lot
  • 20 days of parental leave for either gender
  • Physiotherapy service
  • Hybrid working formula (3 days on site+2 at home)

Place of employment: Acireale (Catania), this is not a remote position

Working hours: 40 hours per week from Monday to Friday

If you have the right skills and experiences and you believe you are the person we are looking for, do not waste time and reply to this announcement with an updated CV and your motivational letter.

This announcement is aimed at both sexes, pursuant to laws 903/77 and 125/91 and to people of all ages and all nationalities, pursuant to legislative decrees 215/03 and 216/03.
